jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - MLS & Associations
jobs.excerpt: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Lone Wolf, you will own the ongoing success of a portfolio of MLS and Association customers and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes through our solutions.
jobs.description:
As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Lone Wolf, you will own the ongoing success of a portfolio of MLS and Association customers and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes through our solutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor, customer advocate, and internal orchestrator across the post-sale journey. Your role is to understand what success means for each customer, translate those goals into a clear plan, drive adoption and value realization, identify risk early, and coordinate the right resources to keep the customer moving forward. This is not simply a relationship-management or issue-escalation role. Our CSMs are expected to take accountability for the customer experience, lead with insight, maintain strong operational discipline, and ensure customers and internal teams have a clear understanding of goals, progress, risks, and next steps.

Our MLS and Association customers serve thousands of real estate professionals, and their success is measured both by their own organizational health and by the value they deliver to their members. You will work with executive leaders, staff, and board members to align our solutions to their strategic priorities.

Responsibilities:

  • Own Customer Outcomes: Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, priorities, workflows, stakeholders, and desired outcomes, including their governance structure, member needs, and strategic goals. Translate those objectives into clear success criteria, milestones, and an actionable customer Success Plan.
  • Drive Adoption and Value: Use product knowledge, customer conversations, usage data, and business context to identify adoption gaps and opportunities across the organization and its membership. Guide customers toward the workflows and behaviors that will help them realize greater value from Lone Wolf solutions.
  • Lead Proactive Engagement: Conduct regular, proactive virtual and in-person meetings (1:1 or group) based on customer needs, segment, risk, and opportunity. Lead purposeful conversations with staff, executives, and, as needed, boards and committees to share updates and insights, provide best practices, address obstacles, and ensure customers are deriving ongoing value from their investment.
  • Manage Customer Health and Risk: Continuously assess customer health indicators and usage data to proactively identify potential risks early, diagnose root causes, and lead documented recovery plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, and communication.
  • Orchestrate the Customer Experience: Coordinate effectively across Support, implementation, Product, Sales, and other teams to deliver a connected customer experience. While you may not personally perform every action, you will maintain ownership of customer communication, internal alignment, and follow-through.
  • Build Renewal Readiness: Ensure customers are positioned for renewal by helping them achieve measurable value, maintaining strong alignment with executive and board-level stakeholders, and surfacing risks well before the renewal date, accounting for governance processes, budget cycles, and formal review timelines. Partner closely with Sales or the appropriate commercial owner to provide an accurate, evidence-based view of account health, outcomes, and renewal risk.
  • Contribute to Team Excellence: Share knowledge, contribute ideas, strengthen playbooks and best practices, and help build a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • Customer-first mindset with a passion for driving customer outcomes and delivering value through every interaction
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing Success role (Customer Success, Account Management, or similar) in a SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated ability to understand customer business needs and connect software adoption to measurable outcomes
  • Strong consultative skills, including discovery, active listening, problem diagnosis, and the ability to guide or challenge customers constructively
  • Experience managing a portfolio of customers with competing priorities, risks, and deadlines
  • Executive presence and comfort engaging senior leaders and presenting to boards, committees, or other group audiences
  • A vocal team player and emerging leader: you speak up, contribute ideas, and help lift the team through positivity, initiative, and knowledge-sharing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills: you know how to simplify complex topics and tailor your message to your audience
  • Solid problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to managing customer needs and resolving issues
  • Collaborative and resourceful: you know when to own it and when to loop in teammates or other departments
  • A keen interest in technology and helping customers adopt software to improve their business
  • Preferred: Experience with MLS, REALTOR® associations, or other membership-based or governance-driven organizations, or a strong working knowledge of the real estate industry
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% for customer meetings and industry events

About Justt:

Justt is a leader in the chargeback automation industry, providing hands-free solutions that help merchants reclaim their revenue. We are a forward-thinking company that values innovation, responsibility, and fairness.

This is a critical role requiring complete ownership of complex technical processes — from initial pre-sales through full customer onboarding. The ideal candidate is a seasoned professional with exceptional communication skills and the ability to lead processes independently in a fast-paced startup environment.

The role:

As the product marketing lead, you own what we say about Justt and how we prove it: positioning and messaging, sales content, go-to-market for product launches, competitive and market intelligence, and customer proof. It's a hands-on role, with the room to shape how product marketing grows at Justt.

Justt sells to two kinds of buyers: enterprise merchants, and platforms such as PSPs and PayFacs that manage many merchants. You give each one a clear, provable story and put it in the hands of every seller, CSM, and executive.

Product marketing sits in the CRO's organization, on the same team as our customer-facing subject matter experts. You'll also work closely with Sales, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, Product, Partnerships, and other marketing functions.

Key Responsibilities:

Positioning and Messaging

  • Own Justt's positioning and messaging for both of our motions: enterprise merchants and platforms. Keep them current as the market, product, and competition change.
  • Define the ideal customer profile for each motion and the buyer personas within it, from payments to fraud/risk and finance leaders.
  • Draft and maintain the core narrative with the exec team.
  • Build industry playbooks, starting with high-dispute industries such as travel, digital goods, ticketing, or subscription.
  • Partner with Content Marketing on website copy, so the site reflects our current positioning, messaging, and proof.
  • Extend the narrative to new buyer segments as Justt launches new products.

Sales Content

  • Build and maintain the core pitch deck, one-pagers, talk tracks, and objection-handling guides.
  • Give Sales Enablement the messaging and content they need to train AEs, SEs, and CSMs, so everyone customer-facing tells the story the same way.
  • Keep the demo narrative current.
  • Build expansion messaging for existing customers and an RFP library for new ones.
  • Track which materials sellers use and which ones move deals, and use that to decide what to update, build next, or retire.

Go-to-Market for Product Launches

  • Build and run a product launch process so Sales and CS are ready at every release: narrative, sales content, and launch materials.
  • Bring market and competitive input to roadmap, pricing, and packaging discussions.
  • Measure each launch's impact on adoption, pipeline, and win rates, and feed what you learn into the next one.

Competitive and Market Intelligence

  • Keep competitive battlecards current and expand them as competitors move.
  • Run a win/loss program with Sales and RevOps, using customer interviews and call recordings.
  • Share a monthly market and competitive intel update.

Customer Proof

  • Partner with Customer Success to build case studies, reference stories, and benchmarks.
  • Build and maintain a claims and proof register, so every external claim traces to our own data with a methodology we can show a customer.
  • Run the quarterly Customer Advisory Board and turn what members tell us into positioning, messaging, and product input.

Requirements

Must have

  • 8+ years in B2B product marketing, including enterprise sales motions, ideally in payments, fraud/risk, or fintech SaaS
  • Has built positioning, messaging, launch processes, and sales content from scratch at a growth-stage company, not only run an existing machine
  • Writes clearly and concisely, and backs every claim with data
  • Learns technical products fast and turns them into clear, credible messaging
  • Works independently, creates momentum fast, and earns buy-in across Sales, Product, CS, and the exec team without formal authority
  • Uses AI tools to research, analyze, and draft

Nice to have

  • Has managed or mentored product marketers
  • Exposure to chargebacks, disputes, or payments risk
  • Experience marketing to platforms such as PSPs or PayFacs
  • Experience in high-dispute verticals: travel, digital goods, ticketing, subscription, marketplaces, gaming

Reporting and Why Join

  • Reports to: Senior Director, Payments & Chargebacks Strategy
  • Why join: You'll build product marketing into a full function at a company with deep domain expertise. You'll shape how merchants and platforms think about disputes as network programs, data, and AI change the rules, with scope to grow a team as the function scales.

📈 Equity / stock options

Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.

About the project

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.

About the roles

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience& skillsets.

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November

  • Languages: Korean

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

  • Project compensation: varies depends on different programming language

  • Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

  1. Language test: short exercises in the target language.

  1. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

  1. Financial Onboarding & Role placement:complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

  1. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

Seneca Federal Health, LLC (SFH) provides solutions to federal health agencies that enable better health outcomes to those our federal customers serve. Our portfolio comprises multiple subsidiaries that participate in the Small Business Administration 8(a) program. To learn more about SNG, visit the website and follow us on LinkedIn.

Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.

Seneca Federal Health is seeking a Licensed Clinical Social Worker to support our federal client. The position is 100% remote

  • Perform brief, evidenced-based virtual individual and/or group counseling for low to moderate acuity patients with acute mental health conditions in accordance with military health system model of behavioral health
  • Develop, monitor and documents comprehensive treatment plans to restore and rehabilitate patients with personal, emotional and/or mental illnesses. Consult reference material, for example the most current version of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual for Mental Disorders (DSM), to identify symptoms, make diagnoses, and develop therapeutic or treatment
  • Exercise clinical judgment in licensure area and proactively supports behavioral health service line in accordance with stated policies and procedures. Demonstrate skill in written and oral communication especially in case formulation and presentation.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of requirements and benefits of TRICARE and effectively communicate these to assigned caseload. Prepare and maintain convenience file, outpatient medical record, and inpatient record documentation in accordance with service and hospital SOPs.
  • Prepare case summaries and other correspondence in a timely and effective fashion using approved electronic medical records.
  • Recommend hospitalization as applicable or determine a service member's fitness for duty; assess and complete Active-Duty Profiles, Medical Evaluation Board (MEB), Military occupation/Mental Status Evaluations (MSE), command consultations, and other administrative processes from Air Force, Army, and Navy as required and prepare reports of such evaluations according to applicable regulations.
  • Attend staff meetings to provide case discussion, continuing education, and continuous quality improvement and safety. Such direction and interaction will adhere to Government and professional clinical standards and accepted clinical protocols. Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Updates patients’ charts/information within 72 business hours post appointment. Documentation for a high visibility or higher acuity patient shall be updated within COB to allow shared visibility to shared providers. HCW shall follow the SOP’s duty limitations, weapons access assessments. Safety and notification are a multi-disciplinary approach using providers, provider extenders, and case management teams. This solution will focus on low to moderate safety risk patients allowing the Military Treatment Facility (MTF) to focus on the higher needs, specialty needs of Soldiers in person.
  • Provider schedule will follow DHA requirement based on skill type (18-001 has the specifics).

Qualifications:

  • Master's degree (or higher degree) in social work from a school accredited by the Council on Social Work Education.
  • A minimum of three years of independent clinical psychotherapy experience obtained after initial licensure as a Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW).
  • Virtual health experience outside the MHS is acceptable.
  • A current, active, valid, unrestricted clinical license to practice Clinical Social Work independently, offered by a U.S. State, District of Columbia, commonwealth, territory, or jurisdiction, and active/valid for a minimum of 3 years.

Desired Skills:

  • Preferred candidate will have experience as a Clinical Social Worker using virtual platforms within the MHS.

Conditions of employment: This position requires the contractor to fulfill credentialing requirements and obtain and maintain appropriate/relevant clinical privileges. Must be able to obtain and maintain current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through the American Red Cross. Advanced certification (e.g., ALS) does not supersede BLS.

Freestar is a pioneering company that engineers best-in-class, cutting-edge solutions for website monetization. Sr. Software Engineer — Prebid & Header Bidding

If you are a problem solver, have significant JavaScript experience, and you know what dynamic allocation is without having to look it up, this position is for you.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Freestar, you will be a subject-matter expert on Prebid and the header bidding ecosystem, instrumental in developing high-quality solutions that handle massive amounts of monetization opportunities for some of the world’s largest websites. This role is for someone that has experience in client side monetization and scripting, has a significant amount of experience in the ad technology industry, and has in depth knowledge of how the auction lifecycle works.

You will measure and protect Core Web Vitals — including INP, LCP, and CLS — along with memory usage, script execution time, and network overhead, ensuring our monetization code enhances publisher revenue without degrading the user experience or the publisher's site performance.

jobs.excerpt: About JobGetAs the #1 app focused on everyday workers, JobGet is redefining the future of hiring.
jobs.description:
About JobGet

As the #1 app focused on everyday workers, JobGet is redefining the future of hiring. Founded in 2019, JobGet began as the only mobile-first hiring platform for everyday workers. Since then, we've grown by joining forces with Snagajob, the largest hourly job board in the U.S., followed by Seasoned, the leading platform for restaurant hiring, and most recently RippleMatch, the leading platform for early career hiring. Each acquisition has brought JobGet closer to the frontline, making the platform faster, smarter, and more effective.

While most platforms chase volume, JobGet is laying the foundation for a new kind of hiring infrastructure focused on precision, speed, and real outcomes. Our AI-powered engine learns, adapts, and improves continuously. Employers don't just get candidates, they get hires. Workers don't just search, they get matched. The result is a more efficient hiring process with less friction and better results.

We serve a diverse range of industries, from food service and customer support to healthcare, logistics, and manufacturing. With access to over 200 million job seekers, our platform leverages cutting-edge AI to match qualified, role-ready candidates, automating key parts of the hiring process for faster decisions and better outcomes. By combining scale with precision, we're transforming how businesses hire and how people find meaningful work.

Our mission is simple: to help everyday workers thrive by providing accessible, frictionless hiring solutions that deliver real results. Join us as we continue to build the future of work for the millions of people who power our world every day.

Learn more about our culture here.

Who We Are

We've designed our values to be more than just buzzwords; they're things we can do. We hope that our culture reflects our values by our commitment to living them every day.

Make a difference every day

  • Teamwork - We make time to help colleagues across JobGet succeed.
  • Excellence - We set ambitious targets, put in extraordinary effort, and persevere until we have accomplished — or exceeded — our goals.
  • Innovation - We're a team of creative, outside-the-box thinkers who thrive in a continuously evolving environment. To us, innovation is about questioning the status quo and always striving to do things better.

Have Unwavering grit

  • Resilience - By remaining resilient and adaptable, we grow stronger as individuals and as an organization.
  • Accountability - We operate with an ownership mentality where everyone feels a sense of responsibility to make us better and always act in the best interest of JobGet.
  • Speed - We make decisions fast and execute them even faster. Bias for speed is one of our core strengths and a key advantage over our competitors.

Grow through curiosity & kindness

  • Respect - We treat each other with mutual respect, kindness, and celebrate our differences.
  • Learning - We ask questions and seek to understand by being genuinely curious & communicative.
  • Culture - We believe that each of us is responsible for our culture. It requires self-discipline and the drive to contribute to something greater than ourselves.

What You'll Do

As the Publisher Relationship Manager, you will be the primary point of contact for JobGet's publishing partners and the person who owns that supply end to end. The role blends relationship management, commercial negotiation, and hands-on analysis: you will decide which publishers to grow, which to fix, and which to say no to, and you will hold partners to JobGet's performance and financial standards while advocating for their success. This is a highly visible role that works daily with Campaign Analyst, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Leadership.

Publisher Relationship Management

  • Own the Relationship: Serve as the day-to-day contact and issue-resolution owner for JobGet's publishing partners, managing expectations while advocating for both publisher success and JobGet's business objectives.
  • Run a Strategic Cadence: Lead recurring reviews with priority publishers, set goals and performance floors with each, and follow through on every open item until it closes.
  • Grow Priority Publishers: Track growth and margin by publisher, choose where to focus, and push bid, content, and volume opportunities to Trading while protecting margin.
  • Maintain the Ranking Framework: Continuously evaluate the publisher ranking framework by client type (direct clients, agency partners, and job board partners) so the right publishers are activated in the right contexts.
  • Find Incremental Traffic: Proactively engage publishers to uncover new volume by country, vertical, or job category, and conduct structured deep dives on high-potential partners' inventory, audience, technical capabilities, and content strengths.

Publisher Development & Contracts

  • Close Supply Gaps: When the current publisher mix can't deliver for clients, research and qualify new publishers, and own outreach, negotiation, and onboarding end to end.
  • Vet and Decline: Apply a consistent vetting standard to new partners, including saying no when traffic quality or commercial terms don't meet our bar.
  • Negotiate and Support Agreements: Work with Sales leadership, Finance, and Legal on redlines, pricing, and publisher agreements, and support updates and adherence to those agreements.

Performance, Quality & Credits

  • Analyze Publisher Performance: Analyze publisher performance within advertising campaigns, identify trends, opportunities, and discrepancies, and translate them into clear actions for Trading and Customer Success.
  • Detect and Investigate Spikes: Monitor for traffic spikes and quality issues, and pull click-level data and run out-of-area, bot, and data-center checks to build the evidence.
  • Recover Credits: Request and negotiate credits with publishers, presenting data-backed technical analyses and managing each request through to receipt.
  • Run Quality Reviews: Conduct regular click-rule and traffic-quality reviews, and prepare files and findings for publishers so disputes are resolved on facts.
  • Validate New Publishers: Partner with Trading to confirm that newly onboarded publishers are closing the identified gaps and meeting expectations before full activation.

Tracking, Technical & tCPA Programs

  • Set Up Feeds and Tracking: Coordinate feed specifications and server-to-server (S2S) tracking with Engineering, test the setup, and notify Trading of new publishers and their minimum bids.
  • Launch and Manage tCPA Programs: Set up, monitor, and reconcile target-CPA programs with publishers, including negotiating caps and lookbacks and checking budget and CPA performance daily so margin doesn't erode unnoticed.
  • Escalate Technical Issues: Work with Engineering and Product to escalate tracking and reporting gaps, and identify product opportunities based on what publishers and traders need.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Finance

  • Partner with Finance: Confirm invoice accuracy and receipt of credits, resolve discrepancies and disputes, and maintain the monthly publisher payment-priority list so key partners stay live.
  • Keep Teams Informed: Gather, organize, and distribute performance feedback from Trading and Customer Success, and keep a weekly view of publisher performance, risks, and opportunities for leadership.
  • Enable Partners and Traders: Train publishers on product capabilities, policies, and expectations, and give Trading a clear view of what each partner can and cannot deliver to inform bid strategy and campaign optimization.
  • Coordinate with Product: Deliver feature updates and roadmap changes to publishers, and support investigations related to invoicing disputes.
  • Maintain Reference Docs: Keep the publisher reference materials Trading relies on current, including minimum bids, content rules, and publisher contacts.

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of experience in the jobs or job-advertising space with direct exposure to publisher relationships.
  • Understanding of how a pay-for-performance (PFP) jobs ecosystem works, including how jobs flow to partners and general bidding strategies across partners (bid logic, campaign optimization, and publisher ranking in context).
  • Hands-on experience managing advertising campaigns that include publisher traffic.
  • Comfortable working with click-level data: you can write or read SQL, have experience with Excel, Looker, and Claude to interpret performance reports, and turn findings into a clear recommendation.
  • Working knowledge of conversion and click tracking, including S2S tracking, and the ability to debug issues alongside Engineering.
  • Experience negotiating credits, pricing, or bid floors, and the confidence to say no to a publisher when it's the right call.
  • Willingness to independently own external partnerships end to end, including performance accountability, commercial negotiations, and growth planning.
  • Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear, actionable language for publishers, traders, and executives.
  • Comfort engaging on invoicing disputes and credit negotiations, and a working understanding of publisher legal agreements and compliance matters.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with a history of cross-functional collaboration (Customer Success, Trading, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Leadership).
  • Able to run many relationships and open follow-up threads in parallel without dropping any; detail-oriented with strong operational follow-through.
  • Thorough understanding of, or the ability to quickly learn, the JobGet ecosystem, product suite, and brands.
  • Confidence to act as both an advocate for publishers and a steward of JobGet's performance standards.
  • Curious, accountable, and resilient: you take ownership, move fast, and keep learning as the business evolves.

At JobGet, we're looking for people who see themselves in our Values. If you have made a measurable impact in your career and are known for your grit and curiosity, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

Please only apply to one position with JobGet; we regularly cross-reference submitted resumes for other open roles.

Benefits & Rewards

  • Purpose-driven organization
  • Flexible time off
  • Remote-first
  • Flexible work hours - our employees are in multiple time zones
  • Medical & dental plans
  • Parental leave
  • Employee stock options

Job Overview

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
  • Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
  • Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
  • Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
  • Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
  • Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
  • Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
  • Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
  • Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
  • Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
  • Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
  • Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
  • Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

    • This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role
  • Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute
  • Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria
  • Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads
  • Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects
  • Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners
  • Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred
  • Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid-cooled and high-density rack deployments
  • Owner-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer
  • Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites
  • Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes
  • Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA
  • Experience in a fast-growth owner organization building in-house technical capability

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

As Director, Strategic Partnerships, you will own our most consequential partnerships from first conversation through long-term scale. This is a full-cycle role: you source it, negotiate it, close it, and grow it. You will build deep executive relationships across the landscape, structure complex high-value deals, and ultimately build and lead a team beneath you as this vertical scales. If you thrive at the intersection of strategic thinking and relentless execution — and you want to build something that matters at a category-defining company — this is your role.

Here's What You'll Do

You decide which accounts to retain and which to pass onto the partner success organization. Drive retention, expansion, and partner satisfaction across your portfolio.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Finance to craft tailored proposals, support partner onboarding, and ensure Engine's platform capabilities match industrial partner needs.
  • Industry Representation: Represent Engine at relevant conferences, industry events, and executive forums. Build Engine's brand and credibility in the market.
  • Pipeline Rigor & Forecasting: Maintain a well-organized, accurate pipeline in Salesforce. Forecast clearly, communicate progress to leadership, and leverage AI & sales tools to drive efficiency.
  • Team Building: As the vertical matures and scales, recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing BD team beneath you. You're not just a dealmaker — you're building a business within a business.

What You'll Bring to Engine

  • Expertise: 10+ years of strategic BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales experience with a Deep network and established credibility within the industrials ecosystem.
  • Partnership Track Record: Proven history of sourcing, structuring, and closing complex B2B partnerships at significant scale — not just transactional deals. You've managed high-value portfolios and know what it takes to win and keep strategic accounts.
  • Executive Presence: Strong executive presence with the ability to navigate complex organizations, build trust with senior stakeholders, and lead high-stakes conversations at the C-suite level.
  • Builder's Mindset: You create the playbook as you go. You thrive in environments without a defined script, identify the right path forward independently, and turn ambiguity into momentum.
  • Leadership Orientation: Experience building, managing, or mentoring BD or sales teams — and a genuine drive to scale a high-performing team as this vertical grows.
  • Commercial Acumen: Ability to model and communicate the commercial value of complex deals. Comfortable with deal economics, partnership structures, and cross-functional alignment on contract terms.
  • Industry Bonus: Experience in travel, fintech, SaaS, or marketplace platforms is a strong plus. Familiarity with the corporate travel ecosystem is an advantage.

Overview

Multi-Line Claim AdjusterLocation: RemoteSchedule: Core business hoursSalary Range: $75,000 - $85,000

Build Your Career With Purpose at CCMSI

At CCMSI, we partner with global clients to solve their most complex risk management challenges, delivering measurable results through advanced technology, collaborative problem-solving, and an unwavering commitment to their success. We don’t just process claims—we support people. As the largest privately-owned Third Party Administrator (TPA), CCMSI delivers customized claim solutions that help our clients protect their employees, assets, and reputations. We are a certified Great Place to Work®, and our employee-owners are empowered to grow, collaborate, and make meaningful contributions every day. Job Summary The Multi-Line Claim Consultant position is responsible for the investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of premises liability, product liability, auto liability, bodily injury, and property damage claims, including litigated matters. The position requires the ability to evaluate liability, assess injury and damages exposure, manage defense counsel, negotiate settlements, establish appropriate reserves, and effectively communicate with clients and stakeholders throughout the claim lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve complex commercial liability claims from assignment through closure.
  • Analyze coverage, determine liability, establish appropriate reserves, and evaluate damages exposure.
  • Manage litigated claims, including oversight of defense counsel and review of litigation strategy.
  • Negotiate settlements within authority and recommend resolutions on higher-exposure matters.
  • Maintain timely and accurate claim documentation, action plans, and client reporting.
  • Communicate effectively with clients, claimants, attorneys, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Identify and escalate claim trends, exposure concerns, and coverage issues as appropriate.
  • Deliver responsive service while maintaining quality, compliance, and claim handling standards.

Qualifications

Required:
  • Minimum 5 years of experience handling commercial liability claims with bodily injury exposure.
  • Experience independently handling premises liability claims from inception through resolution.
  • Experience handling auto liability claims involving bodily injury exposures.
  • Experience managing litigated liability claims.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve complex liability claims.
  • Experience establishing reserves, assessing liability, evaluating damages, and managing claim outcomes.
  • Active adjuster's license required.
  • Strong written, verbal, and client communication skills.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience handling complex commercial casualty claims and coverage issues.
  • Experience working within a Third Party Administrator (TPA), insurance carrier, or self-insured program environment.
  • New York adjuster's license.
  • Experience supporting high-profile national accounts with significant communication and reporting expectations.
Bilingual (Spanish) proficiency — highly valued for communicating with claimants, employers, or vendors, but not required.How We Measure SuccessSuccess in this role is measured through effective claim resolution, accurate liability and damages evaluation, sound reserve management, timely claim handling, quality file documentation, litigation management performance, client satisfaction, and consistent adherence to CCMSI claim handling standards.

  • Retirement plans: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Career growth: Internal training and advancement opportunities
  • Culture: A supportive, team-based work environment
This is where we shine, and we hire adjusters who want to shine with us.

Our Core Values

  • Lead with transparency We build trust by being open and listening intently in every interaction.

  • AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
  • 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)

About the Role

Snowflake is the partnership that built phData's reputation, and you will help lead it, working hand in hand with a dedicated commercial leader and a services leader who co-own the relationship. When we show up in front of Snowflake's customers and sellers, we carry their product, brand, and reputation with us, and every interaction is a chance to strengthen the trust we have built together. You'll turn what matters most to Snowflake- the priorities that create real value for their business and their customers- into a go-to-market plan we can execute, while holding our own revenue and budget to account. You'll do it through cross-functional collaboration with our sales, solutions, and revenue leaders, as well as their counterparts at Snowflake. If the relationship goes stale, or we make a commitment we can't keep, that lands on you.

You are strengthening a partnership that is already one of the most decorated in Snowflake's ecosystem, and the job is to help it evolve to the next level by continuously pursuing value for both Snowflake and phData. Seven straight years of recognition is the foundation, and the next chapter is yours to help write.

The Partnership You'll Lead

  • 7x Snowflake Partner of the Year, including 2026 Global Snowflake Services AI Partner of the Year and 2026 AMER Snowflake Services Implementation Partner of the Year, announced at Snowflake Summit 2026.
  • Snowflake Elite Services Partner, the highest services tier Snowflake awards.
  • #1 partner in advanced Snowflake certifications, with 367+ SnowPro Core and 139+ SnowPro Advanced certifications.
  • 300+ Snowflake projects delivered, with roughly 497 tracked use cases in production.
  • Elite across the modern data stack: one of only two partners at the elite level with Snowflake, Fivetran, and dbt.
  • A Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Snowflake built around executive AI workshops, mutually invested offerings, and a focused set of priority engagements.
  • An AIM launch partner, delivering Cortex Code-first migrations with our own Toolkit and Forge accelerators.

About You

Read this section like a mirror, not a checklist. Some of it is meant to make you nod. Some of it is meant to make you uncomfortable. Both reactions are useful, to you and to us.

  • You've been accountable for a revenue or consumption number you didn't control. Sellers on another team owned the quota and the deals, yet you were still held accountable for the results.
  • You've inherited a partnership that was already winning, and you refused to coast on it.
  • You've told a partner executive no, and the relationship came out stronger.
  • You've told your own CEO or CRO that a commitment wouldn't be met before they heard it from the partner.
  • You listen longer than is comfortable, then say it in one sentence. Your partner's priorities, and ours, fit on a page you can write and say out loud.
  • You treat a tier requirement or a funding commitment as a promise, not a target to negotiate down. You track it every month, not only when the QBR is coming.
  • You know who the right person is on each side before the problem arrives. You build the enterprise-to-enterprise network in advance, so you don't scramble to do so during an escalation.
  • You've led a small team through a partner program while peers in other orgs held the levers you needed, and you got it done through influence.

If none of that landed, this probably isn't your role, and that's fine. If more than a couple did, keep reading.

What You'll Own

  • Own the Snowflake partner strategy, portfolio, and annual plan, built with Sales.
  • Build and deliver the joint go-to-market plan for each motion, including executive AI workshops, priority offerings, and migration programs, in collaboration with sales and services organizations.

  • Own commercial enablement for our sellers and Snowflake's sellers.

  • Chair the monthly partner revenue committee with our Chief Revenue and Chief Technology & Solutions leaders.

  • GTM plan attainment
  • Partner NPS
  • Commitments and tier requirements met
  • Partner-sourced pipeline coverage
  • Return on partner funding (MDF and co-op)

Who You'll Work With

  • Chief Partnerships & Marketing Officer: strategy, budget, priorities, escalations
  • Partner Ops, Development & Marketing Manager (your direct report): joint GTM plans, partner operations, campaigns, funding, QBRs, reporting
  • Partner Sales Manager: strategy input, targets, relationship transfers, quota alignment, co-sell, deal escalations
  • Partner Solutions Manager (Technology & Solutions org): offers, technical enablement, partner technical forums, speaking engagements
  • Chief Revenue and Chief Technology & Solutions leaders: monthly partner revenue committee, shared priorities

The Table Stakes

Skills and experience get you in the room. The traits above are what get you the job.

  • Led a partner or alliance function with hyperscalers, data platforms, or AI vendors
  • Built joint go-to-market plans with shared targets and managed a channel budget
  • Managed partner agreements, tiers, and commitments
  • Led a small team while working closely with Sales and Solutions leaders who report elsewhere

  • Ability to make the partner value the story simply, in writing and live

Location & Time Zone Expectations

  • You will collaborate with global teams in India and South America, and must be flexible in working across time zones.

Why phData?

Overview

Apogee is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to be located remotely or in Omaha, NE, in support of the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC) Weather Systems Branch (AFLCMC/ESAW) Numerical Weather Modeling (NWM) program.

This position will provide Systems Engineering support to the NWM program, directly supporting the planning, procurement, testing, implementation, operations, and sustainment of Information Technology (IT) components and systems to support data ingest, numerical models, and dissemination of products to the AF Weather Enterprise. As our program office transitions to the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), this role will play an integral part in aligning engineering practices, backlog management, and collaborative cross-functional workflows using the Atlassian tool suite (Jira and Confluence).

This is a full-time position and can be fully remote.

Responsibilities

Agile & SAFe Transformation:

  • Support the NWM team’s adoption of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), participating in Program Increment (PI) planning, sprint iterations, backlog grooming, and Agile Release Train (ART) syncs.
  • Facilitate and streamline tracking, reporting, and lifecycle traceability using Atlassian Jira and Confluence.

Systems Analysis & Engineering:

  • Perform system analysis and develop comprehensive system specifications.
  • Provide technical reviews of design and development specifications of software applications, systems, and other engineering artifacts; develop and maintain these artifacts throughout the systems engineering lifecycle.
  • Assess technical and architectural changes for impact to IPT-specific software, other command-level systems, and the broader enterprise.
  • Integrate user community requirements and desired operational capabilities into requirements/capability generation and planning documents.
  • Provide analyses of interface requirements for applications based on recommendations from modernization initiatives.

Software Testing, Integration, & Delivery:

  • Support the certification, maintenance, and testing of software applications as well as the integration of complex software systems, providing status, risk analyses, and actionable recommendations.
  • Support the delivery of software, installation, configuration, testing, problem resolution, and maintenance procedures/timelines required to achieve approval to test and promote software to production environments.
  • Support the development, analysis, and implementation of an Agile DevOps, CI/CD model of software development, integration, and deployment; Cloud technologies; and microservice architectures.

Governance, Standards, & Acquisition:

  • Advise the Government to ensure compliance with applicable engineering and configuration management directives; participate in developing new standards and improving existing processes.
  • Use approved processes (e.g., Systems Engineering Plan (SEP)) and prepare technical and briefing materials for program management reviews and technical milestones.
  • Support the Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) process for placing new software deliveries into production, assisting in the security evaluation of program information and hardware.
  • Assist in reviewing or proposing inputs to Requests for Proposal (RFP) artifacts, Acquisition Plans, Life Cycle Management Plans (LCMP), and Acquisition Strategies.
  • Provide direct systems engineering support to the NWM program, collaborating closely with the PM, Financial Manager (FM), and Program Lead Engineer.

Qualifications

Citizenship: Must be a US citizen Clearance: Must possess and maintain a Secret clearance

Possess one of the following education/experience combinations:

  • Advanced Degree (MA/MS) and a minimum 10+ years of years of relevant experience (12+ years preferred), 5 years of which must be in the DoD
  • OR, BA/BS degree and a minimum of 12+ years of relevant experience (15 years preferred), 5 years of which must be in the DoD
  • OR, 18+ years of relevant experience (20 years preferred), 8 years of which must be in the DoD

Preferred Qualifications:

Certifications:

  • Current Atlassian Certification (e.g., Atlassian Certified Associate/Professional in Jira or Confluence) is highly desired.
  • Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) certification (e.g., Certified SAFe Agilist, SAFe Practitioner, or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) is strongly preferred.

Your Scope and Impact

You will establish technical direction for complex, high-impact customer solutions while developing reusable engineering approaches that improve delivery across engagements.

Expected Outcomes and Impact

  • Successful, secure, and supportable production environments that meet agreed customer acceptance criteria.

  • Reduced implementation complexity and faster resolution of recurring technical issues.

  • Reusable engineering assets that improve delivery consistency and shorten time to customer value.

  • Improved solution reliability, classification quality, and production readiness.

  • Stronger alignment between customer implementation needs and Nasuni's product capabilities.

What You'll Bring

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Deep hands-on C#/.NET engineering experience, including modern .NET (.NET 8 or later), REST API development, integration design, and production troubleshooting.

  • Demonstrated technical ownership of complex enterprise software implementations, including architecture, coding, testing, and operational support.

Ideal Candidate Differentiators

Experience Guidelines

AI at Nasuni

Qualifications

Why This Role Matters

jobs.companyName: Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis
jobs.description:
Graphic and Information Designer (Asia-based, Remote, Full-time)

The Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis (IEEFA) is seeking a Graphic & Information Designer to join our dynamic team in Asia to create high-quality, engaging, and interactive content that supports our research and communications work.

The Graphic & Information Designer will be a creative and analytical professional with strong design capabilities and a solid understanding of digital marketing and audience engagement. They will have a proven ability to translate complex technical and financial data into clear, visually compelling, and platform-optimized content that supports IEEFA’s research, communications, and impact. They will work closely with research analysts and communications professionals to ensure insights are presented in a clear, accessible, and impactful way across reports, presentations, media, and digital channels.

We are looking for a self-motivated multitasker who can work independently without continuous supervision. Working as part of a remote team in Asia, the ideal candidate will be expected to be able to communicate effectively with other members of the team over a variety of mediums (Zoom, G-suite, ClickUp, etc.), be comfortable with raising issues or questions along the way, and provide insights into their work.

The Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis (IEEFA) is a global NGO/non-profit think tank that produces a significant volume of original independent public interest research and analysis on issues related to sustainable energy markets, trends, regulations, and policies. Our mission, major research reports, daily commentaries, press coverage, and other resources can be found on our website:

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Create clear, compelling data visualizations, including charts, graphs, infographics, and hero visuals that turn complex technical and financial findings into accessible visual outputs
  • Design and format reports, briefing notes, fact sheets, and presentations in InDesign and Word, delivering polished, near-publication-ready drafts that need minimal revision
  • Collaborate with IEEFA analysts and the communications team to identify key insights from research, and proactively advise on how layouts, data, and findings are best presented visually
  • Develop templates and design assets for social media, newsletters, and other formats
  • Manage the design, layout, and distribution of email newsletters using HubSpot and Canva with attention to audience engagement and performance
  • Produce engaging digital content, including social media carousels, short-form videos, and interactive elements for the Asia section of the IEEFA website, such as story scrolling and Flourish visuals
  • Contribute to organizational impact reporting, and global and regional communications projects as required

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in data visualization, graphic design, information design, or a related field
  • 4 to 7 years of demonstrated professional experience designing charts, graphs, reports, data visualizations, and digital content, ideally for research, policy, or financial organizations
  • A portfolio demonstrating the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling, and well-designed visualizations across a range of formats
  • Ability to explain visual design decisions clearly to non-design audiences
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities and deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and deliver on-brand first drafts with minimal supervision or revision
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator) is essential; experience with video production is strongly preferred
  • Experience in programming tools and design platforms such as Flourish and Canva
  • Commitment to IEEFA’s mission to accelerate the transition to a diverse, sustainable, and profitable economy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a research organization or in sectors such as energy, climate, or finance
  • Strong interest in current affairs, particularly in the energy and finance sectors

Compensation and Benefits

Full-time 12-month fixed-term employment contract with the option of extension by mutual agreement and a market competitive remuneration. Pay rates are also based on education, skill, experience level and internal equity.

Work Schedule

Full-time, 5 days/week, with occasional evening or weekend work as required.

Travel

Some travel is required. All team members attend IEEFA’s annual conference and team retreat.

Physical Demand and Work Environment

Must be able to work for prolonged periods at a computer. Computer work can involve repetitive motion, eyestrain, back and neck strain.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at IEEFA. All members of under-represented groups are especially encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing all team members with a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy/parental status or disability status.

IEEFA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process should contact the Office of Human Resources at +254716710509. Determinations will be made on a case-by-case basis.

To Apply

jobs.description:
Department: Marketing

Location: Home-based in the UK, with occasional travel to the London office

Reports to: Marketing Director

Hours: 37.5 per week

Please note: this role is open to UK-based candidates only. We do not employ remote staff overseas and cannot offer relocation support. Candidates must already have the right to work in the UK; visa sponsorship is available only in exceptional circumstances.


Role Overview

Cambridge Spark is building a modern B2B marketing function to match an ambitious new direction: helping large, complex organisations build the capability to adopt AI and prove the results. We're investing in editorial, research, video, community and events to earn the attention and trust of senior leaders. The Head of Growth Marketing makes sure that trust turns into pipeline and revenue.

You'll own how marketing wins new clients: finding, engaging and converting the organisations most likely to buy from us. The right accounts, the right people within them, the right message, at the right time. That means building an account-based, data-led demand generation programme from the ground up, with a written playbook and clear measures. It covers our core business and the newer areas where we're growing: new markets, new propositions and new lines of business where pipeline has to be built from scratch.

Two partnerships sit at the heart of the role. With our Marketing Operations Lead, you'll build a best-in-class, technology-enabled and data-enabled demand engine, turning intent signals, scoring and account data into targeted action. With our highly skilled New Business sales team, you'll run joint plays on target accounts, agree what a qualified opportunity looks like, and build the feedback loop that tells us what actually converts.

This is a founding role. It suits someone who can set the strategy and run the programmes themselves, who is comfortable being measured on pipeline, and who wants to build something properly. As the programme proves its return, we expect to build a growth team around it.


Key Responsibilities

Growth strategy and targeting

  • Own the growth marketing strategy and annual plan, tied to company revenue targets and our priority sectors
  • Define, with New Business and Marketing Operations, our ideal customer profile, target account list, account tiering, and the personas and buying groups within those accounts
  • Write it down: build and maintain a shared growth playbook that marketing and sales both work from
  • Design account-based programmes across one-to-one, one-to-few and one-to-many tiers

New business and new markets

  • Focus on new logos: winning the organisations that don't yet work with us
  • Build pipeline for our newer propositions and markets as well as our core business, and help shape how each one goes to market
  • Direct the wider marketing team's work towards one goal: qualified account opportunities for New Business to convert. That means events that move accounts forward, customer proof points that build confidence, PR and earned media that open doors, email nurture that keeps accounts warm, and answer-engine optimisation (AEO) so we show up when buyers ask AI tools

Building the demand engine with Marketing Operations

  • Work hand in hand with the Marketing Operations Lead to build a best-in-class, tech-enabled, data-led demand generation capability across intent data, scoring, qualification, routing and attribution
  • Turn the signals and data that system produces into action: which accounts to prioritise, who to reach, when and with what
  • Partner with the Marketing Operations Lead on selecting and rolling out our account-based and intent platform. Marketing Operations owns the platform; you're its lead commercial user
  • Use AI tools to work faster and smarter, and help set the standard for how the wider team uses them in demand generation

Partnering with New Business

  • Run coordinated account plays with the New Business team, sequencing marketing and sales activity on priority accounts
  • Agree qualification definitions and handover with sales leadership, and run a regular rhythm of pipeline review and feedback
  • Equip sellers with timely account insight and relevant content for their conversations
  • Build a relationship of trust with sales, grounded in shared targets and honest data

Campaigns and channels

  • Plan and run demand campaigns across paid social, account-based advertising, search, email and nurture, events and partner channels
  • Select and package our editorial, research, video and community content for in-market audiences
  • Own the growth budget, run a disciplined test-and-learn approach, and move spend to what works

Measurement

  • Own the number that matters most: qualified account opportunities delivered to New Business, along with the measures behind it (target account engagement, pipeline created and influenced, velocity, conversion and win rates)
  • Set the benchmarks: in your first 90 days, establish baselines and agree realistic targets with the Marketing Director
  • Report clearly to the Marketing Director and leadership team on what is working, what isn't and what we'll change


Candidate Specification

Essential

  • Significant B2B marketing experience (typically 7+ years), including senior ownership of demand generation, account-based or growth marketing and a track record of building qualified pipeline
  • Experience marketing a considered, high-value purchase with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders in the buying decision
  • Has designed and run an account-based programme end to end, with measurable pipeline and revenue impact
  • Proven, close partnership with sales teams, and credibility with sales leaders
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM (HubSpot preferred) and with account-based or intent data platforms
  • Commercially minded and numerate: confident with funnel metrics, attribution, budgets and forecasting
  • Able to set strategy and execute it, and comfortable working in a growing team where you'll build as well as run
  • A clear communicator and a strong writer
  • Actively uses AI tools in their own work

Desirable

  • Experience selling into large enterprises, regulated sectors (such as financial services, pharmaceuticals or health) or the public sector
  • Background in EdTech, learning and development, professional services or consultancy
  • Experience selecting, implementing or getting value from an ABM or intent platform
  • Experience building pipeline for a new market, proposition or line of business
  • Experience building or leading a team
  • Interest in AI and how organisations adopt it



Background to our Organisation

We are an education technology company that enables corporate and government organisations to achieve their business goals by educating their workforce with critical digital transformation skills to succeed in the AI era.

We deliver unique and innovative professional education that is accelerating the digital transformation of our clients, advancing the careers of their employees, helping people get into work and closing the digital skills gap. We are in a sector that is crucial to the economy and workforce, with a lot of opportunity for change and innovation. We are at the cutting edge of teaching applied data and digital skills, with our unique patented learning platform EDUKATE.AI offering our clients and learners a unique learning experience. EDUKATE.AI was developed with support from Innovate UK and provides all of our learners with 24/7 immediate feedback on their work, helping accelerate the learning process and providing a sandbox environment to experiment on real world datasets.

Since 2016, we have supported more than 15,000 learners across four continents with nearly 550,000 pieces of code submitted for feedback on EDUKATE.AI. We are trusted by some of the most recognisable brands in the world to educate their workforce, including Microsoft, the NHS, GSK, easyJet, the BBC and John Lewis. Our focus on applied learning to create business impact sets us apart - individual learners have reported applying their skills at work to generate recorded value of up to £40m.


Our Values

At the centre of the way we work together and inspire each other to achieve success are these core values:

Entrepreneurial

We take initiative and show entrepreneurial spirit which fuels innovation at Cambridge Spark. This includes identifying opportunities for improvement, taking ownership for implementing solutions effectively and driving improvement by using proof of concepts to demonstrate the feasibility and value of their work.

Team Spirit

Everyone is part of building an open and transparent culture, communicating effectively to raise issues, discuss improvements and share the evidence used to make decisions.

Customer-focused

Our customers are at the centre of everything we do, inspiring us to create great work. We strive to build friendly, professional and lasting relationships with them to better understand and anticipate their needs.

Gold Standard

We are experts in our field and are constantly developing our technology and offering. We set the benchmark in our industry: both in what we offer customers and in how we deliver it.

Cambridge Spark is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunities for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Cambridge Spark are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, colour or ethnicity, ability or disability, gender or gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Cambridge Spark will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Cambridge Spark encourages applicants of all ages.

  • Support the sales team on target accounts and keep internal tracking systems and processes current.
  • Build relationships with consultants and A&E firms to drive IQSIGHT specifications.
  • Train and enable SI technicians and engineers, rep firms, and internal sales staff on products, analytics, and system design, and create application notes, how-to guides, and demo content.
  • Maintain territory demo kits.

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively across sales, product, and technical support teams.

The US based salary range for this position is $120,000-135,000. This role is also eligible for commission. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc.

At Keenfinity Group we don’t just build innovative solutions — we shape a smarter, more connected world through technology. We value different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences and we’re committed to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team. Everyone is welcome here — we foster an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: ⚡️ About Merkle ScienceMerkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies.
jobs.description:
⚡️ About Merkle Science

Merkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies. Our vision is to make cryptocurrencies safe and provide infrastructure for the safe and compliant growth of cryptocurrencies.
Merkle Science is headquartered in New York with offices in Singapore, Bangalore and London. The team has combined experience across Bank of America, Paypal, Luno, Thomson Reuters and Amazon. The company has raised over US$27 MM from SIG, Beco, Republic, DCG, Kenetic, GGV and several others.

The Role

You will design, build and run the systems behind our data products, covering ingestion, processing, analytical storage and serving. You own your work from the design document through to production. The people who design a pipeline also run it and answer for its numbers.

Our stack is very wide, and we go deep in every part of it. We don't stop at "it works." We keep measuring, profiling and tuning to make systems faster, cheaper and more reliable. We want engineers who are razor sharp, pay close attention to detail, and care as much about why a query takes 800 ms as whether it returns the right answer.

You don't need blockchain experience. If you're a strong data engineer who wants to learn it, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build scalable, high-throughput data pipelines and platform systems for blockchain data across 30+ chains.

  • Build backend data services and loaders in Go and Python.

  • Design and evolve data models and analytical workloads in ClickHouse, and tune them for sub-second queries.

  • Build incremental, idempotent pipelines on Databricks over billions of rows and tens of terabytes.

  • Keep improving the scale, reliability, freshness, performance and cost efficiency of the platform.

  • Investigate hard performance and reliability problems and see them through to resolution.

  • Work closely with the product, analytics and investigations teams that use the data, and turn their needs into platform designs.

  • Help set technical direction through architecture discussions, design reviews and code reviews.

  • Mentor engineers and help set strong engineering and operational practices.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building and operating production data systems, including ETL and ELT pipelines. At least two of those years should be spent owning systems that other engineers depend on.

  • Expert Python and strong SQL. You write typed, tested code, are comfortable with asyncio and concurrency, and have built incremental data models over billions of rows.

  • Go for backend services. You have built and run high-throughput services or data loaders in Go in production.

  • ClickHouse in production. You know MergeTree schema and sort-key design, materialised views, bulk loads and query tuning.

  • Databricks in production. You have worked with PySpark, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog, designed incremental and idempotent tables, and kept an eye on compute cost.

  • Large-scale data. You have hands-on experience with pipelines over billions of rows and tens of terabytes. You understand how partitioning, clustering and file sizing affect cost and latency.

  • Kafka, Airflow and Kubernetes in production. You understand delivery semantics and idempotent writes, have handled backfills and failures, and have run data workloads with Docker and Helm. Google Cloud is preferred; AWS is fine.

  • An operations and communication mindset. You instrument what you build, write runbooks and post-incident reviews, and can write a design document that a reviewer in another time zone can approve.

Nice to Have

  • Blockchain data: EVM, UTXO or non-EVM chain data models, and pulling data from nodes over JSON-RPC or gRPC.

  • Graph or distributed key-value stores: entity resolution or clustering on large graphs.

  • Infrastructure as code, GitOps and observability: Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana, and load-test design.

  • Experience building platforms that serve multiple data sources, datasets or product teams.

  • AI-assisted development, and experience in fintech, compliance or AML.

How We Work

  • You'll join a small, senior team where everyone owns their work end to end.

  • We make decisions based on measured evidence, not opinion.

  • We keep design notes and runbooks next to the code.

  • We test at production scale and run blameless post-incident reviews.

  • We use AI coding tools every day, and we use judgement when reviewing what they produce.

❤️ Well Being, Compensation and Benefits

We care about your well-being. Along with excellent health insurance, we offer flexible time off, learning & development initiatives and hours that are designed to provide work/life balance. We regularly host team-building sessions and encourage discussions around mental health.
We reward talent and believe in acknowledging people for their contributions. We offer industry-leading compensation, along with generous equity. As a rapidly growing business, there are endless opportunities to grow your career with Merkle Science.

  • Build and maintain unattended production automation against platform APIs, with appropriate logging, monitoring, and failure alerting; use operational data to find and automate repeatable or bottlenecked work and measure the results.
  • Partner with Security and Compliance to engineer controls that produce their own audit evidence, and plan rollouts and remediation to fail safe under change control appropriate to a clinical environment.
  • Author enforceable standards, runbooks, and architecture decision records, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to IT engineers across the US, India, and our affiliated medical groups.

Who you are
