We are hiring a Co-Founder to give this brand its voice: a natural marketer and brand builder with a proven DTC track record, a deep feel for luxury and a genuine passion for health and longevity. The role centers on branding and online and offline marketing, owning brand and commercial end to end, and managing the day-to-day operations of the company. If you want to build the defining luxury name in longevity, from the first unboxing to the ten-thousandth subscriber, this role is yours.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build the brand from day one: positioning, identity, storytelling that turns serious science into desire, and a customer experience worthy of a luxury house
  • Drive go-to-market and DTC subscription growth across online and offline channels, with influencer, creator and community marketing at the core
  • Be the public face of the brand with customers, partners and press
  • Recruit and lead a lean, top-tier team with a KPI-driven culture
  • A proven track record of academic and professional achievements
  • Strong passion for health, wellness, self-optimisation and longevity
  • The entrepreneurial drive to found your own company, with a hands-on attitude and the ability to work in an independent, structured and goal-oriented manner
  • Familiarity with AI tools every day for research, building, writing and analysis, with workflows that let a small team ship like a big one
  • Experience in building or scaling a DTC brand, with focus on branding and running influencer and creator marketing
  • Strong command of DTC metrics: CAC, LTV, retention and subscription economics
  • Exceptional taste and brand instinct, with a proven ability to sell luxury or premium products

Why consider this opportunity:

  • The chance to define luxury longevity as a category and to build the Loro Piana of supplements
  • Highly generous equity package in line with your experience
  • Market related salary upon receiving Seed Funding
  • Opportunity to lead a company with a credible path to a $100m+ outcome

Longevity is becoming the ultimate luxury: more healthy years, lived well. 10x Value Partners is building a luxury, science-based longevity supplement brand for global markets: the Loro Piana of supplements. The brand offers a daily longevity formula, developed separately for men and women, with every ingredient chosen for differentiation and quality of evidence. The hardest groundwork is done: formulation is finalized across both launch products, suppliers are identified and the US regulatory review is complete.

Your founding partner is serial entrepreneur, investor and biohacker Christian Schroeder, expert in telomere extension, who leads R&D, regulatory and supply chain. Our venture studio has been active for 10 years and the companies we have incubated have raised over USD 500 million in follow-on funding.

Follow the science and the thinking behind the brand on our founder’s Substack: christianschroeder.substack.com

jobs.description:
Senior BESS Performance Engineer

We are:

Wizeline, a global AI-native technology solutions provider, develops cutting-edge, AI-powered digital products and platforms. We partner with clients to leverage data and AI, accelerating market entry and driving business transformation. As a global community of innovators, we foster a culture of growth, collaboration, and impact.

With the right people and the right ideas, there’s no limit to what we can achieve.

Are you a fit?

We are seeking a BESS Performance Engineer to join the Asset Management team, supporting a growing portfolio of distributed generation projects across the United States. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, this role will lead performance monitoring, analysis, and reporting for standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and solar-plus-storage assets, including AC- and DC-coupled configurations.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in battery performance modeling, renewable energy systems, and data analytics to optimize technical performance and commercial efficiency. Working closely with Data Science, Asset Management, Engineering, and Operations & Maintenance (O&M) teams, this individual will develop data-driven insights, automate reporting workflows, and identify opportunities to improve asset reliability, battery life, and energy market performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • BESS Performance Monitoring: Lead performance analysis, monitoring, and operational reporting for standalone BESS and paired solar PV + BESS assets across a distributed generation portfolio.
  • KPI Development & Tracking: Develop and monitor key performance indicators, including Round-Trip Efficiency (RTE), State of Health (SOH), State of Charge (SOC), auxiliary power consumption, and system availability.
  • Battery Degradation & Predictive Modeling: Develop degradation models and predictive analytics to forecast battery life, monitor SOH against capacity guarantees, and optimize charging and discharging cycles.
  • Data Analysis & Troubleshooting: Extract, clean, and analyze large-scale SCADA, DAS, telemetry, and discrete-event datasets to identify underperforming assets, diagnose component failures, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Data Integration & Automation: Collaborate with Data Science teams to integrate BESS telemetry into enterprise platforms, optimize data warehousing, and automate internal and external reporting pipelines.
  • Solar-Plus-Storage Performance: Evaluate the technical and operational impacts of transitioning from standalone BESS to AC- and DC-coupled PV + BESS configurations.
  • Performance Optimization & Reporting: Present technical and financial findings, recommend operational improvements and dispatch strategies, and communicate actionable insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Must-have Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in performance engineering, battery modeling, energy storage analytics, or a closely related field.
  • Strong understanding of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), battery architecture, degradation mechanisms, and performance modeling.
  • Experience with the operation, design, or analysis of AC and DC electric power systems.
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or SQL for data analysis, time-series manipulation, and modeling.
  • Hands-on experience with SCADA, DAS, telemetry, and operational datasets for power plant performance assessment.
  • Experience with analytical and business intelligence tools, such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex datasets into actionable insights.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in leveraging Generative AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate code development, automate data processing, and improve analytical workflows.

Nice-to-have

  • Renewable Energy Experience: Direct experience evaluating the performance of distributed generation or utility-scale BESS and solar PV assets.
  • Energy Markets & Financial Optimization: Experience analyzing wholesale electricity markets, ISO/RTO dispatch strategies, Locational Marginal Pricing (LMP), energy arbitrage, and battery dispatch optimization.
  • Solar-Plus-Storage Expertise: Experience analyzing standalone battery storage and AC- or DC-coupled solar-plus-storage projects.
  • SCADA & Monitoring Platforms: Familiarity with platforms such as AlsoEnergy, GPM, Power Factors, Ignition, Wattch, Denowatts, SynaptiQ, or OSIsoft PI System.
  • Cloud & Data Infrastructure: Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, data warehousing, and data pipeline development.
  • AI & Predictive Analytics: Experience designing and deploying AI-driven workflows, machine learning algorithms, and statistical models to improve predictive performance and operational efficiency.
  • Asset Management Systems: Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), such as Fiix, IBM Maximo, or Sitetracker.
  • Experience collaborating with Asset Management, Engineering, Data Science, and O&M teams in renewable energy environments.

What we offer

  • A High-Impact Environment
  • Commitment to Professional Development
  • Flexible and Collaborative Culture
  • Global Opportunities
  • Vibrant Community
  • Total Rewards (benefits vary by location and employment type)

Acerca del rol.

Coordinador/a de Becas.

En este rol serás responsable de coordinar la operación de becas del Campus En Línea para UNITEC, gestionando la asignación, renovación, seguimiento y liberación de los apoyos de alumnos de nuevo ingreso, regresos y reingreso conforme a cada calendario operativo. Tu labor conectará con nuestra misión global, generando impacto en la correcta aplicación de los instrumentos de beca, el cumplimiento normativo, la trazabilidad documental de cada expediente y la permanencia estudiantil.

Tus principales retos:

  • Coordinar la validación y asignación de becas de los alumnos de nuevo ingreso conforme a convocatoria, reglas de otorgamiento y documentación requerida, asegurando su correcta aplicación.

  • Gestionar la renovación de becas de la población de reingreso en cada calendario operativo, validando el cumplimiento de las reglas de permanencia en promedio, carga académica y documentación.

  • Atender los casos de regresos y excepciones de los alumnos, desde su análisis hasta la liberación de los apoyos mediante la aplicación de criterios normativos.

  • Coordinar la integración, validación y resguardo de los expedientes de beca, asegurando completitud, trazabilidad y soporte documental para auditoría.

  • Promover y difundir las convocatorias de beca entre los alumnos y áreas involucradas, garantizando claridad en requisitos, fechas y criterios.

  • Atender la auditoría de becas de las áreas centrales por tipo de instrumento, conciliando montos, vigencias y aplicación con Finanzas.

  • Generar reportes de otorgamiento, renovación, cobertura y seguimiento de becas por marca, escuela y nivel para la Gerencia.

  • Dirigir, asignar y dar seguimiento a las actividades del equipo a su cargo, estableciendo prioridades y controles de calidad para asegurar la atención oportuna.

Perfil que buscamos.

Requisitos indispensables:

  • Formación académica: Licenciatura en Administración, Educación, Psicología, Trabajo Social, Ciencias Sociales o áreas afines a la gestión y contención de problemas.

  • Experiencia: Al menos 3 años de experiencia en instituciones educativas de nivel superior, orientación de apoyos económicos (becas), atención y contención de casos de alumnos, y coordinación de equipos de trabajo.

  • Nivel de inglés: Básico.

Deseables:

  • Maestría o especialización en Gestión Educativa, Psicología, Administración o áreas afines.

  • Experiencia en entornos educativos superiores y procesos normativos de auditoría.

  • Competencias clave: Pensamiento analítico, atención al detalle, orientación al servicio, comunicación asertiva, resolución de problemas y liderazgo colaborativo.

Tu impacto en UNITEC

En la UNITEC trabajamos para ofrecer educación de calidad con sentido práctico, accesible y transformadora. Aquí no solo formarás parte de una universidad, sino de un proyecto que impulsa el desarrollo profesional de miles de estudiantes que buscan construir un mejor futuro. Ser parte de UNITEC significa generar impacto tangible: formar personas altamente empleables, con valores, competencias sólidas y un fuerte compromiso con su comunidad.

Diversidad e inclusión

En UNITEC, el talento no tiene límites. Nos enorgullece ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades y celebrar la diversidad en todas sus formas. Todas las personas candidatas cualificadas serán consideradas sin distinción de raza, religión, nacionalidad, sexo, estado civil, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad u otras características legalmente protegidas. En este centro de trabajo queda prohibida la solicitud de certificados médicos de no embarazo y de VIH como requisito para el ingreso, permanencia o ascenso.

Liquibase delivers world-class enterprise solutions that automate and streamline database change governance. These solutions leverage the industry's open-source leader with over 100 million downloads. Liquibase is hiring a Technical Writer to join our Documentation team, partnering alongside our Technical Writer and Content Engineer. This is a versatile, high-impact role responsible for keeping developer documentation accurate, clear, and actionable. You will craft engaging learning materials across our docs and Liquibase University, test technical instructions directly in the command line, and help operationalize modern agentic AI workflows to scale content quality. If you are an adaptable writer with a keen editorial eye and an appetite for learning developer-centric tools, you will thrive here.

  • You’re committed to excellence, holding high editorial standards while balancing speed and continuous iteration.
  • You bring a growth mindsetand an eagerness to learn developer workflows, CLI tooling, and modern documentation technology.
  • You embrace changeand uncertainty with energy and optimism, comfortable context-switching between planned roadmap deliverables and real-time customer feedback.
  • You take ownershipand follow through, proactively testing docs hands-on and resolving user pain points from start to finish.
  • You are innovative.You see agentic AI not as a replacement, but as an opportunity to scale and train automated documentation quality.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Author, edit, and maintain high-quality documentation, user guides, release notes, and reference material for Liquibase core features, extensions, and integrations.
  • Partner with Documentation, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success teams to develop interactive coursework and training materials.
  • Hands-on testing of technical documentation and examples in the product, verifying that installation steps, flags, and workflows function exactly as published.
  • Review, triage, and process inbound feedback, prioritizing fixes and updating content to address customer friction.
  • Help train and evaluate agentic AI tools, enforcing editorial rule sets, evaluating AI-generated drafts, and providing feedback to optimize internal automation prompts.
  • Apply core documentation best practices and topic-based authoring principles to maintain modular, searchable, and easily navigable docs.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Support, and Security teams to capture upcoming feature changes and technical specifications early in the development cycle.

  • An authentic eagerness to learn and experiment with developer tooling, technical applications, and emerging documentation tech.
  • Critical thinking skills to evaluate technical content from an end-user perspective and explain why an edit is necessary.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience experimenting with or prompting agentic AI platforms (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) for content generation, editing, or rule enforcement.
  • Experience developing training curricula, tutorials, or online coursework (e.g., LMS/University platforms).
  • Familiarity with topic-based authoring principles or structured formats like DITA.
  • Hands-on exposure to markup and data-interchange formats such as Markdown, YAML, XML, HTML, and JSON.

jobs.description:
About GreyNoise

GreyNoise Intelligence is a mission driven security startup focused on helping organizations understand and mitigate risks from Internet scanning and exploitation. GreyNoise provides real-time, verifiable intelligence on all actors scanning the Internet and how some of them are attempting to exploit vulnerabilities on assets connected to corporate networks. The intelligence is highly trusted because it’s generated from a global fleet of thousands of purpose built sensors observing the Internet. Advanced data science techniques and AI are used to process millions of observed events into real-time intelligence for customers.

The GreyNoise Global Observation Grid observes and analyzes unique threat data at-scale that no one else can. GreyNoise provides the most actionable threat intelligence against perimeter threats, so that no attack works twice.

All US based positions are fully remote within the US, with optional office attendance at our DC area headquarters, unless otherwise specified. Applicants must have US work authorization.

Please see the specific job description for all international position locations.

The Role

As Regional Sales Manager, West & North Central, you will drive GreyNoise's growth across the Western and North Central United States, expanding our presence among leading enterprises and building strategic customer relationships.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role requiring enterprise cybersecurity sales expertise, entrepreneurial drive, and strong execution. You will own your territory end-to-end, from territory strategy and pipeline development to navigating complex sales cycles and closing strategic deals. You will have significant autonomy to shape our go-to-market approach, build lasting customer relationships, and directly influence GreyNoise's growth.

Location: We are specifically seeking candidates based in the Western or North Central U.S., including California, the Pacific Northwest, Mountain West, and North Central regions. Travel to customer sites and industry events is required.

About the Team

The GreyNoise Americas Enterprise team is a small, high-ownership, mission-driven group transforming how the world's leading organizations leverage real-time threat intelligence to strengthen their security posture, defend critical infrastructure, and stay ahead of emerging threats.

As a lean, entrepreneurial team, we operate with a high degree of autonomy, accountability, and urgency. Every team member has the opportunity to shape our strategy, build meaningful relationships with industry-leading organizations, and directly influence how GreyNoise helps protect some of the world's most critical enterprises and digital infrastructure.

What You Will Do

  • Own and grow the West & North Central territory, driving revenue, pipeline development, forecasting, deal execution, and long-term growth.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to expand GreyNoise's presence across leading enterprise organizations.
  • Build executive relationships with CISOs, security leaders, technical stakeholders, and strategic partners.
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, from prospecting and technical evaluations through negotiation and close.
  • Represent GreyNoise at industry events, customer engagements, and partner forums to build relationships and generate opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to drive customer adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Champion the voice of enterprise customers, translating security challenges and market feedback into actionable insights.
  • Help shape GreyNoise's enterprise go-to-market strategy and culture with an entrepreneurial, high-ownership mindset.

What You Will Bring

  • 8+ years of US Enterprise sales experience - selling threat intelligence and/or adjacent solutions.
  • Strong, established relationships with the West & North Central regions and a track record of successfully negotiating and selling 6-figure deals into these organizations.
  • Strong familiarity with Enterprise cyber security functions, teams and goals; including SOCs, vulnerability management and threat hunting is a must.
  • A strong hunter mentality – able to drive net-new business and support a high-velocity sales environment.
  • Comfort in Enterprise executive relationship management, while also being able to engage with end users and develop them as strong Champions of GreyNoise.
  • A proven sales background of consistent achievement against quota.
  • Excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Past experience of thriving in a high-velocity tech sales environment.
  • Proven ability to institute a repeatable sales process to drive performance.
  • CRM Knowledge (preferably HubSpot).
  • Previous experience with PLG is a plus. At GreyNoise we embody product led growth which is focused on an end user model that relies on the product itself as the primary driver of customer acquisition and expansion.

This position reports to the Head of Enterprise Sales, Americas.

Benefits

💵 Equity in a Growing Startup. Every employee has the opportunity to share in GreyNoise's success through equity.

👩‍⚕️ Health & Wellness Benefits. US employees receive 100% company-covered health, dental, vision, and life insurance. Benefits for international employees vary by country and local requirements.

6️⃣ Retirement Benefits. US employees receive a competitive 6% employer 401(k) match, 100% fully vested from day one. International employees receive applicable statutory pension benefits in accordance with local regulations.

🏖 Flexible Paid Time Off. We believe taking time away from work is essential to staying healthy and doing your best work. We take this very seriously and even include scheduled all-company shutdowns throughout the year. Employees also receive any additional leave required by local laws.

🌎 Remote-First, Globally Connected. Headquartered in the Washington, DC area, GreyNoise is a distributed team working remotely across the US and Europe. We value flexibility, trust, and meaningful connections, no matter where you work.

💻 Equipment Budget. Every new employee receives a GreyNoise Apple Mac laptop and a $500 stipend (or local currency equivalent) for equipment and accessories to create a comfortable and productive workspace.

👼 Paid Parental Leave. Growing your family is a big milestone, and we're here to support you. We offer four months of paid parental leave for birth or adoption, plus up to two additional months of optional unpaid leave, coordinated with applicable statutory leave entitlements and local requirements.

📚 Learning & Development Budget. Every employee receives $1,500 annually (or local currency equivalent) to invest in professional development. Use it for courses, books, conferences, certifications, and other learning opportunities related to your role.

🌴 Team Connection & Company Offsites. We bring our distributed team together through multiple company and team offsites, virtual events, and local meetups to build relationships and stay connected beyond our day-to-day work.

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on country of employment, local regulations, and applicable employment arrangements.

GreyNoise Culture

The hallmark of any great company is a palpable and viscous culture. The most important pillars of our culture are:
  • Be transparent, honest, and objective. This is what it means to be “clinical”
  • Empathize with customers, partners, and each other
  • Learn from mistakes and share the knowledge
  • The way feedback is delivered to one another matters as much as the feedback itself
  • Good work-life balance is the key to sustained productivity
  • The measure of a team member’s effectiveness is how well the rest of the team operates in their unexpected absence
  • No such thing as a million dollar idea, only million dollar execution
  • Out-innovate our previous selves
Check out our (work-in-progress) longform culture document.

Explainability

Any security product that is a “black box” that asks you to blindly trust it should raise red flags - we believe the same is true of your place of work. We obviously think GreyNoise is doing something unique, but don’t take our word for it - ask any of our 150+ enterprise customers, investors, thousands of happy users, or dozens of journalists who have cited GreyNoise over the past few years.

Why You Should Work at GreyNoise

  • You enjoy identifying and solving hard problems
  • You are comfortable taking an idea from concept to customer
  • You are open to both explaining your stance and questioning others in a clinical, open-minded, and respectful manner
  • You want to directly impact users
  • You want to grow beyond your current skill set

True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

Position Overview

True Zero Technologies is seeking an experienced SOC Analyst IV to provide advanced cybersecurity monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and response support within complex federal environments. This senior-level position will serve as a technical escalation point for Security Operations Center (SOC) activities, leading sophisticated security investigations, analyzing emerging threats, and ensuring effective detection and response capabilities across enterprise systems.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on SOC experience, strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, and deep technical expertise in Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, endpoint security, network analysis, and cloud security monitoring.

Job Responsiblities

    Job Responsibilities

  • Advanced Security Monitoring & Incident Response: Provide Tier III SOC support for security alert triage, complex incident investigations, forensic analysis, and escalation of advanced security threats across federal enterprise environments.
  • Threat Detection & Analysis: Analyze security events, SIEM alerts, endpoint telemetry, network traffic, and threat intelligence to identify malicious activity, determine potential impact, and recommend appropriate containment and remediation actions.
  • SOC Tools & Situational Awareness: Maintain comprehensive operational awareness of SOC security technologies, monitoring platforms, log sources, and telemetry to ensure continuous visibility into enterprise security posture and emerging threats.
  • Incident Investigation & Escalation: Lead advanced technical investigations, correlate security events across multiple data sources, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate incident escalation and response activities with cybersecurity stakeholders.
  • SOC Operations & Process Improvement: Lead shift handovers, maintain incident documentation, and develop, review, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), incident response playbooks, and operational workflows to improve SOC efficiency and consistency.
  • Red Team & Purple Team Collaboration: Support Red Team and Purple Team exercises by evaluating detection capabilities, analyzing simulated attack activity, identifying monitoring gaps, and recommending improvements to threat detection and response procedures.
  • Technical Leadership & Knowledge Sharing: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior SOC analysts, assist with complex troubleshooting, and contribute to continuous improvements in threat detection, incident handling, and SOC operational effectiveness.

Job Requirements

    Job Requirements

  • Security Operations Experience: Minimum of 6 years of progressive experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, cybersecurity monitoring, threat detection, incident response, or related security disciplines, including advanced incident investigation and escalation responsibilities.
  • Professional Certifications: Must possess at least one of the following certifications: GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or CompTIA Security+.
  • SIEM & Endpoint Security Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience with SIEM platforms, security event correlation, endpoint detection and response (EDR) technologies, endpoint telemetry analysis, and advanced security alert investigation within enterprise environments.
  • Operating Systems, Networking & Cloud Security: Strong technical knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, network protocols, enterprise networking, and AWS-native security capabilities, including experience investigating security events across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Incident Response & Technical Communication: Proven ability to conduct complex security investigations, analyze potential indicators of compromise (IOCs), document technical findings, execute incident escalation procedures, and communicate actionable security recommendations to technical teams and federal stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: WHY DEPT®? We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster.
jobs.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

What we believe in

We build software for the world's most ambitious brands, and we're opinionated about how it gets made:

  • Code quality is a top priority. Style guides, code reviews, and best practices are how we move fast without breaking things. You'll also get your hands on a wide range of cutting-edge technology.
  • Great UI/UX is critical. Aesthetics, usability, and speed are all part of the product. A technically correct experience that feels bad isn't finished.
  • Collaboration wins projects. Great communication is the single strongest predictor of whether a project goes well.
  • We're pragmatic. We know what to build and what to leave alone, and we make real-world tradeoffs between cost, speed, and craft. Shipping something useful beats architecting something perfect.
  • We're intellectually curious. We're constantly learning through craft show & tells, lunch & learns, workshares, and active Slack channels full of talented engineers across the globe.

The role

As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.

You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.

This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.

What you'll do

  • Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.
  • Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.
  • Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.
  • Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.
  • Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.
  • Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.
  • Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.
  • Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.
  • Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.

What you bring

  • Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.
  • Strong proficiency in Python.
  • Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.
  • Solid working knowledge of database platforms, both SQL and NoSQL.
  • Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular and Typescript) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider. Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.
  • Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.
  • A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.
  • Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.
  • The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.
  • A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points

  • Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.
  • Exposure to agent development frameworks.
  • Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference speaking.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401k plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our effortshere.

jobs.description:
Lieu de travail : Montréal (Québec) Canada
Relève de : Vice-présidence, Marketing mondial et stratégie de croissance

Aperçu

GardaWorld est à la recherche d’un(e) directeur(trice), Prospection mondiale à distance et pipeline de croissance afin de bâtir et de faire croître une fonction de génération de pipeline performante à l’échelle de l’ensemble de nos entreprises dans le monde.

Relevant de la vice-présidence, Marketing mondial et stratégie de croissance, cette personne réunira deux fonctions complémentaires, soit la prospection à distance (par téléphone, par courriel et sur les canaux numériques) et la recherche de prospects, afin d’aider nos entreprises à cibler les bons comptes et les bons décideurs, à mobiliser efficacement les prospects et à convertir les occasions d’affaires en pipeline mesurable.

Il ne s’agit pas d’un rôle traditionnel de gestion des ventes : cette équipe ne remplace pas la prospection terrain des représentants; elle l’alimente en amont en générant et en qualifiant des occasions d’affaires pour les équipes de vente. Nous recherchons un(e) leader commercial(e) axé(e) sur la croissance, capable de bâtir des méthodologies reproductibles, de développer des équipes performantes et de déployer à grande échelle des activités de génération de pipeline au sein d’entreprises dont les marchés, les niveaux de maturité et les ambitions de croissance diffèrent.

Principales responsabilités

  • Diriger et faire croître les fonctions mondiales de prospection à distance et de recherche de prospects, en établissant les méthodologies, les guides de prospection, les processus, la formation et les normes de performance nécessaires pour bâtir une capacité de génération de pipeline de calibre mondial.
  • Développer des modèles de croissance évolutifs pour nos unités d’affaires, en adaptant la capacité de prospection à distance et de recherche de prospects à leur potentiel de marché, à leur maturité, à leurs objectifs de croissance et à l’évolution de leurs besoins.
  • Bâtir des équipes et des leaders performants, en instaurant une solide culture de performance axée sur l’accompagnement, la responsabilisation, l’amélioration continue et le développement des talents.
  • Piloter la performance et la rentabilité du pipeline, en reliant les activités aux occasions qualifiées, au pipeline, à la conversion, aux revenus et au rendement du capital investi (RCI), et non simplement au volume d’appels, de courriels ou d’activités.
  • Renforcer l’orchestration des Ventes et du Marketing, en veillant à ce que la connaissance des comptes cibles, la demande générée par le marketing, les échanges de l’équipe de prospection à distance avec les prospects et le suivi des Ventes fonctionnent comme un seul moteur de croissance intégré.
  • Tirer parti des données, de la technologie et de l’IA pour améliorer l’identification des comptes, les renseignements sur les prospects, la priorisation, la productivité et la performance, tout en préservant des échanges humains de grande qualité.

Exigences

  • 10 ans et plus d’expérience en prospection à distance, développement des ventes, développement des affaires ou génération de pipeline interentreprises, dont une expérience considérable en gestion.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la mise sur pied ou la croissance d’équipes performantes de développement des affaires (BDR), de développement des ventes (SDR) ou de prospection à distance.
  • Solide compréhension de la recherche de prospects, de la connaissance des comptes, des données sur les prospects et du développement des comptes cibles.
  • Capacité démontrée à transformer les activités de prospection en pipeline qualifié, en revenus et en RCI mesurable.
  • Expérience dans l’élaboration de méthodologies évolutives, de guides de prospection, de programmes de formation et de cadres de gestion de la performance.
  • Solide compréhension des systèmes de gestion de la relation client (GRC), des plateformes d’automatisation de la prospection, des renseignements sur les prospects et des technologies de vente émergentes fondées sur l’IA.
  • Excellentes capacités analytiques et sens aigu des affaires, combinés à des aptitudes exceptionnelles en leadership et en accompagnement d’équipe.
  • Une expérience au sein de plusieurs entreprises, marchés ou régions géographiques constitue un atout important.

Le profil recherché

Nous recherchons une personne qui pense en bâtisseur de croissance et dirige en cadre commercial.

Cette personne est obsédée par la rentabilité du pipeline plutôt que par le volume d’activités et comprend qu’une génération de pipeline performante commence avant le premier appel : avec les bons comptes, les bons contacts, les bons renseignements et la bonne approche. Surtout, cette personne sait comment reprendre ce qui fonctionne, comprendre pourquoi cela fonctionne, puis l’industrialiser et le déployer à grande échelle au sein d’entreprises présentant différents niveaux de maturité et d’ambitions de croissance.

We're on the lookout for a Bodily Injury Adjuster to join our growing team! jobs.title: Principal ASIC Design Verification Engineer
jobs.excerpt: K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit.
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We are seeking a Principal ASIC Design Verification Engineer whose role will be to verify the functionality, performance, and robustness of our custom silicon designs. You will help define the verification approach, contribute to methodology, and work closely with architecture, RTL design, DFT, firmware, physical design, and silicon validation engineers. This is a hands-on role with high ownership, deep technical engagement, and the opportunity to shape first-generation silicon.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute verification plans for block-level, subsystem-level, and full-chip environments.
  • Build SystemVerilog/UVM test benches, including agents, monitors, scoreboards, checkers, and coverage models.
  • Write SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and integrate formal verification where appropriate.
  • Drive constrained-random and directed testing strategies to validate functionality, corner cases, and stress scenarios.
  • Run simulations, triage failures, drive root-cause analysis, and collaborate with RTL designers to resolve issues.
  • Implement and maintain functional coverage, code coverage, assertion coverage, and ensure coverage closure for sign-off.
  • Manage regression testing, simulation farms, and CI pipelines to ensure high test throughput and fast debug iterations.
  • Participate in design reviews, microarchitecture discussions, and influence design-for-verification (DFV) best practices.
  • Work closely with architecture, RTL design, DFT, firmware, physical design, and silicon validation engineers to ensure end-to-end coverage and test.
  • Support silicon bring-up and post-silicon validation through test reuse, diagnostics, and debug analysis.
  • Participate in ASIC team interviews.
  • Drive advancement of DV methodologies and improvements.
  • Manage external IP providers and verification partners when needed.
  • Take lead on large and/or complex systems.

Qualifications

  • B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC verification.
  • Solid understanding of SystemVerilog, digital logic, RTL design, DFT, and hardware design and verification flows.
  • Proficiency with several simulation (VCS, Xcelium, Questa), waveform debug (Verdi, SimVision), coverage tools, and scripting languages (ex: Python, Perl, TCL).
  • Experience with test planning, UVM-based testbench development, constrained-random testing, functional coverage, and SystemVerilog assertions.
  • Experience with regression management, coverage analysis, revision control (ex: Git), CI/CD automation, and gate-level simulation.
  • Experience with developing and integrating reference models.
  • Experience with embedded processor-based designs and firmware/bare metal coding (ex: C, C++).
  • Understanding of many industry-standard interfaces (ex: APB/AHB/AXI).
  • Involvement in post-silicon validation planning and execution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with low power verification.
  • Experience with analog behavioral models.
  • Familiarity with physical design flows.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience in space, telecom, or RF/digital mixed systems is a plus.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $190,000 – $285,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

Equal Opportunity

K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Senior Product Manager, Provider and RWD Health Systems Applications

Natera's RWD platform at the clinic connects an ecosystem of real-world evidence, molecular data, and clinical insights to deliver actionable information to physicians. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help build and scale physician-facing RWD applications. We seek to unlock the full potential of real-world data to improve treatment outcomes and make molecular results actionable in everyday treatment decisions. In this role, you'll own a physician-facing RWD application for a patient's molecular and clinical journey and workflow integrations behind it, partnering with cross-functional product teams, engineering, AI/ML teams, and clinical teams to deliver intuitive tools centered on enriched patient insights.

What You'll Do

Advance Data Integration and Intelligence

  • Collaborate with clinical product management, EMR, user experience product management, marketing, medical and a broad cross functional team to drive product strategy and roadmap,
  • Drive integration of genomic tests into the platform (Signatera/ctDNA, hereditary risk, tumor/normal and NGS profiling, liquid CGP, etc.) as part of a unified oncology digitized experience.
  • Work closely with AI/ML teams to build applications for patient-level insights and clinic-level insights, including cohort comparison, clinical trial matching, and cohort analytics back to individual patient care.
  • Partner with legal, privacy, and security so HIPAA obligations, PHI handling, and data-governance requirements are designed into the product.

Elevate the User Experience

  • Own the single- and multi-patient views that bring a patient's molecular results and clinical events together in one physician-facing application.
  • Integrate AI-powered clinical trial matching that connects patients and physicians to the most relevant investigational therapies based on molecular, clinical, and patient criteria.
  • Help reduce friction points at both the provider and patient level to enroll in clinical trials.
  • Partner across Natera to enable EMR/EHR integration and mobile access, ensuring seamless experiences for providers.
  • Contribute to an analytics framework that captures user analytics and informs continuous product development.

Enhance the Utility of Genomic Testing

  • Support delivery of a physician-facing platform that highlights therapies, tracks treatment response, and monitors disease progression in real time.
  • Ship tools and functionality to aid physician collaboration.
  • Connect molecular and clinical findings to relevant treatment pathways and outcomes data to make testing more actionable at the point of care.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, MSL, Sales, and Clinical Operations on enablement, training, and adoption.

Launch the De-Identified Aggregated Research Platform for Health Systems

  • Partner with the Health Systems BU to define, build, and launch a de-identified, aggregated research platform that turns clinic data into a health-system-wide resource for precision medicine and research.

Engage Key Stakeholders

  • Engage with physicians, KOLs, and academic collaborators to translate clinical needs into features.
  • Help track KPIs centered on the physician experience with RWD at the clinic.
  • Support representation of RWD at the clinic at conferences, industry forums, and customer discussions as needed.

  • Experience delivering AI/LLM-derived clinical data into provider-facing products, including human-in-the-loop review, confidence labeling, and data transparency.
  • Backlog ownership: writing and grooming user stories in Jira and driving PM perspective in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, retros).

  • Track record of setting product KPIs and moving them, with specifics on adoption, engagement, and quality.
  • Fluency in oncology / genomics clinical concepts (staging, lines of therapy, biomarkers, MRD/ctDNA).
  • Commitment to user-centered design thinking, with a track record of translating user needs into intuitive and impactful product experiences.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with clinical, technical, and commercial audiences.

Preferred:

  • EHR integration experience (SMART on FHIR, HL7/FHIR, Epic or other EHR app ecosystems).
  • Strong technical fluency; comfortable working with engineers, scientists, and data teams, and reasoning about what AI/ML and LLMs can and can't reliably do.

jobs.excerpt: Adventure is our Culture.  Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love.
jobs.description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Senior Retail Technology Architect

Location: Remote (US, Canada, or Costa Rica)

What You'll Do

    Build AI-Accelerated Test Automation

  • Build and maintain scalable automation suites using Playwright across web, API, and mobile, contributing to broader QA frameworks and release validation standards.
  • Use AI coding assistants and agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Playwright's planner/generator/healer agents) to generate test plans, test cases, page objects, and test data from requirements, Jira stories, and PR diffs.
  • Review, validate, and harden every AI-generated test before it merges — you own the correctness of the suite regardless of what wrote the code.
  • Drive down flaky tests and maintenance cost through resilient locator strategies, AI-assisted self-healing, and automated failure triage.
  • Integrate automated quality gates into GitHub Actions CI/CD so every deploy is validated by the pipeline rather than by manual sign-off.
  • Build and maintain functional, regression, API, and performance/load testing coverage using tools like Postman, JMeter, or k6.

    • Apply Testing Judgment Where It Matters

  • Determine what should be automated, what can be delegated to AI, and what requires human testing — balancing coverage, risk, and release timelines.
  • Perform focused exploratory testing on new features, UI/UX changes, and complex user flows to catch edge cases and usability issues that automation and AI miss.
  • Turn every escaped defect into an automated regression check so the suite strengthens with each release.
  • Partner with engineers to embed tests, API contract checks, and AI-assisted code review early in the SDLC to reduce downstream defect costs.
  • Help define how to test AI-powered customer experiences (search, recommendations) where outputs are non-deterministic and need evaluation rubrics rather than exact assertions.
  • Track and report quality metrics (automation coverage, defect escape rate, flake rate, test cycle time) to show where automation is paying off.

    • Contribute to a High-Performing Team

  • Collaborate with QA peers and engineering teams, sharing knowledge, best practices, and the AI prompts and workflows that work.
  • Provide input on quality practices and process improvements across the engineering org, focusing on reducing manual regression and UAT effort.
  • Support and mentor QA engineers on automation and responsible AI-assisted testing, fostering a culture of quality ownership.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Testing, including 3+ years building and maintaining test automation that runs in CI/CD.
  • Proven, hands-on experience with Playwright for web and API E2E automation; Cypress or Selenium experience is a plus.
  • Strong automation fundamentals: ability to design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable test suites and frameworks, and to diagnose and eliminate flaky tests.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python (Java a plus); you write test code to the same standard as production code.
  • Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) to write, refactor, and debug test code, with the discipline to validate and correct AI-generated output.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred), including parallel execution, reporting, and quality gates.
  • Solid experience with functional, regression, API, and performance/load testing (Postman, JMeter, k6, or equivalent).
  • Strong exploratory testing skills and the judgment to build risk-based test strategies across automated, AI-assisted, and manual coverage.
  • Demonstrated SDLC and Agile experience with defect lifecycle management using Jira and TestRail.
  • Ability to operate effectively under a steady release cadence and manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • E-commerce QA automation experience, particularly in environments shipping frequently with CI/CD integration.
  • Experience building or adopting agentic testing workflows (AI test generation, self-healing tests, MCP-connected tools, or LLM-based failure triage).
  • Experience testing AI/ML-powered features such as search, recommendations, or LLM-generated content, including evaluation of non-deterministic output.
  • Familiarity with BrowserStack or similar cloud device and browser grids.
  • Experience with observability tooling like Grafana or GCP-based infrastructure, including using production signals to prioritize test coverage.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work touches every engineering team and every release — automation coverage and quality gates you build directly shape what ships to customers across web, mobile, and API.
  • AI-First Skill Building: You will work at the frontier of AI-assisted testing, using and evaluating emerging tools daily and building expertise that is defining the next generation of quality engineering.
  • End-to-End Ownership: You own the automation framework, the CI/CD quality gates, and the testing strategy — from choosing what to automate to deciding how to evaluate non-deterministic AI features.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Costa Rica): We offer an attractive benefits package including primarily remote work, private medical and life insurance, additional paid time off, monthly allowances and reimbursements, employee discounts, and opportunities for professional growth.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation focused on your automation experience, AI-assisted testing approach, and how you balance coverage with release velocity.
    3. Technical / Case Discussion - A hands-on session covering Playwright automation design, CI/CD integration, and your approach to evaluating and hardening AI-generated tests.
    4. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Salt Lake City office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
    5. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
    6. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

    Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Please Note

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.
  • Due to a high volume of fraudulent applications, you must share a valid LinkedIn profile URL in the application questions below to be considered. If you do not have a LinkedIn profile, you must provide a credible reason in that field and supply alternative evidence of your professional background to verify your identity.

CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact .

Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. This position is not open to and cannot be filled by a B.C. Resident.

We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them.

About The Opportunity

Homeward is looking for an Analytics Engineer to help build, strengthen, and scale the data foundation that powers decision-making across the business.

This role is ideal for someone who is a confident, self-sufficient data professional with deep experience in data modeling and a passion for turning complex data into reliable, usable products. You’ll own critical pieces of our data pipeline and architecture while partnering closely with analysts, technical teams, and business stakeholders to ensure our data is accurate, dependable, and easy to consume.

A major focus of this role will be data reliability and scalability. We need someone who can identify why pipelines and models are breaking, build solutions that address the root cause, and create an architecture that can scale as our business and use of AI evolve. Most importantly, you take ownership. When you see an opportunity to make our data infrastructure more reliable, scalable, or useful, you're motivated to figure out how to make it better.

  • Design, develop, test, and optimize scalable dimensional data models and data marts using dbt.
  • Structure data models around abstract business definitions, creating a reliable connection between business logic and technical implementation.
  • Help architect our data environment for AI-readiness, ensuring data is structured, documented, governed, and accessible in ways that support emerging AI use cases.
  • Evaluate and implement tooling and validation processes to ensure dbt models and AI-enabled data workflows produce accurate and trustworthy outputs.
  • Partner closely with Product and Technology teams on internal application and system changes, identifying upstream and downstream data dependencies and minimizing disruption.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand analytical needs and translate them into scalable solutions within our analytics platform.
  • Develop deep domain expertise across key areas of Homeward's business and serve as a technical point of contact for associated data models, metrics, and workflows.
  • Establish monitoring, testing, documentation, and data-quality practices that improve confidence in our data.
  • Identify opportunities to improve our overall data architecture and recommend practical solutions rather than waiting for requirements to be fully defined.

What You'll Bring:

  • Strong experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a similar data-focused role.

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production data models and semantic layers using dbt.

  • Experience designing data architecture that balances scalability, maintainability, usability, and business needs.
  • Experience with AWS or a comparable cloud data environment.
  • Experience with modern BI and analytics tools such as Looker, Hex, Tableau, or equivalent platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Python and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  • Understanding of data governance principles, including metric definitions, data quality, documentation, lineage, and access.

  • Ability to translate business concepts and definitions into clear, maintainable technical models.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently investigate ambiguous or complex data issues.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Compensation & Details:

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Computer reimbursement
  • Fully remote, LatAM-based, meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours.

Value-Driven Employee Experience

THE GOLDEN RULE. It’s simple: Treat others the way we want to be treated. Whether we’re dealing with colleagues or customers, we don’t prioritize money or growth over people, and we practice empathy at every opportunity.

CALM FOCUS. We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM. Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

With a robust clinical pipeline and continued expansion into new areas of microbiome health, we’re building for scale—with integrity, care, and curiosity.

(Best in Business, Female Founder 100)—a reflection of the science behind our products and the stories we tell to bring them into the world.

We’re a galaxy-class team of researchers, clinicians, designers, engineers, storytellers, and builders—each aligned in our belief in the transformative potential of the microbiome. If you’re a kindred dot-connector looking to shape the future of health, join us.

  • • •

You

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you lead the frontend implementation of Seed's digital experience. You have a deep love for product, a keen eye for design, and the technical depth to turn ambitious designs into fast, accessible, pixel-perfect features on our React/Next.js platform. You work inside a design system owned by a Staff peer and contribute production-ready components back to it. You partner early with Design and Product, own quality on your squad's surfaces, and raise the frontend bar for the engineers around you through code review, pairing, and mentoring.

  • 6+ years of professional experience in frontend engineering.
  • A strong portfolio or GitHub that shows your frontend work and your eye for UI craft.
  • A track record of shipping production frontend features end-to-end, on schedule.
  • Experience working day to day with designers and product managers.

What You'll Do

Build and Ship

  • Lead the frontend implementation of new features, from Figma through production.
  • Translate designs into production-ready code with obsessive attention to spacing, typography, motion, and responsiveness.
  • Own the frontend architecture behind your features: state management, data fetching, rendering performance, and test coverage.
  • Build accessible, performant interfaces that hold up across browsers and devices.
  • Ship safely: feature flags, A/B tests, instrumentation, and clear rollback paths.
  • Partner early with Design and Product to assess feasibility and resolve ambiguity.

Contribute to the Design System

  • Build composable, reusable React components into our shared library, following its architecture, APIs, and documentation standards.
  • Use design tokens and theming consistently so that a component built once is available everywhere.
  • Document what you add via usage guidelines, code examples, and Storybook stories.

Raise the Bar

  • Conduct thoughtful code reviews that hold the squad to a high standard in component design, accessibility, and visual fidelity.
  • Mentor engineers on the team through pairing.
  • Champion consistent use of the shared component library across our web applications.

Skills You Bring

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level React and Next.js (TypeScript required).
  • Strong understanding of design systems, design tokens, and component API design.
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, data fetching, rendering performance (Core Web Vitals), and testing.
  • Comfortable working from Figma designs and specs.
  • Experience with Storybook and at least one of CSS-in-JS, CSS Modules, or Tailwind CSS.
  • Working knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG).

Collaboration

  • Clear communicator; able to articulate design and technical trade-offs to engineering, design, and product partners.
  • Comfortable building within an architecture someone else owns while still bringing an independent point of view.
  • Experience giving and receiving constructive feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Experience translating motion design concepts into production-ready animations (Framer Motion, GSAP).
  • Experience in high-growth DTC or e-commerce companies, ideally on a headless Shopify stack.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar).
  • Knowledge of A/B testing frameworks and experimentation methodologies.
  • Background in health, wellness, or science-focused consumer brands.
  • Experience at a consumer brand known for design craft and obsessive attention to detail.

The annual pay range for this full-time position is $160k-$180k + equity + benefits across all US locations (this position is 100% remote-US). Our pay ranges are guided by discipline, level and experience required. Within the range, individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including: your specific location, desired skills/ technical competency, relevant experience and advanced education/ training.

Benefits + Perks:

Health & Wellness: Choose from multiple medical, dental, and vision plans, with generous employer contributions and coverage options to meet your needs. Enjoy access to top-tier virtual care and a complimentary Aaptiv membership for fitness and mental wellness. We also provide an HSA with employer contributions, along with Fullscript discounts for supplements.

Mental Health Support: All employees and eligible dependents receive 12 free therapy sessions per year, plus coaching, meditation, and 24/7 access to Spring Health’s digital tools and care navigation.

Long Term Wealth Planning: Invest in your future with our 401(k) plan through Betterment, featuring a 100% match on the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% of contributions—fully vested from day one.

Supporting Families: Our Parental Leave Policy includes 18 weeks of fully paid leave, with the flexibility to phase your return. We also offer four weeks of paid transition time at 80% capacity or four days per week.

Time to Recharge: Seed offers 15 vacation days, 7 sick/safe days, 2 personal days, 10 Recharge Days (Summer + Winter), and 15 paid company holidays each year.

Work Flexibly: Thrive in a remote-first culture that prioritizes autonomy and clarity. You’ll also receive a $750 one-time remote work setup stipend and ongoing access to a $450 quarterly wellness and workplace stipends via JOON.

And More: Access pet insurance, life and disability coverage, learning & development, and a vibrant culture rooted in science and impact.

Seed is an equal opportunity employer. For us, diversity isn’t an HR metric—it is the result of billions of years of evolution; it’s our nature. To serve our community inclusively means to cultivate a relative abundance of perspectives, backgrounds, geographies, and experiences. Like in biology, each role and its function is key to the productivity, sustainability, and resilience of our ecosystem.

About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

Prenuvo is building a longitudinal care model, where patients have an ongoing clinical relationship rather than a single scan. Our nurse practitioners are the clinicians patients talk to after their scan.

You will review imaging and laboratory results with patients by phone and video, explain what the findings mean, and agree on the right next step together. You will work scheduled consult blocks alongside our full-time nurse practitioner team, to the same clinical and documentation standards.

This is a remote contract role, and it reports to a Nurse Practitioner Manager. This is a 3-month contract position, with the possibility of extension based on business needs.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct results review consultations by phone and video, reviewing imaging and laboratory results and explaining what they mean
  • Prepare for each consult by reviewing the patient's report, intake, history and prior scans
  • Identify care gaps and recommend next steps, including follow-up imaging, referrals and the interval to the next scan
  • Follow established protocols for actionable findings, and escalate urgent findings to Radiology and Preventive Medicine physicians through the defined escalation pathway
  • Work with care coordinators and registered nurse navigators on follow-up and referral loop closure
  • Document every encounter to clinical standard in HealthCloud, including a care plan the patient can access
  • Work the consult blocks you commit to, and give advance notice of schedule changes
  • Participate in quality reviews and complete required onboarding and protocol training
  • Maintain active licensure and credentialing in assigned states

What You’ll bring

  • Active, unrestricted Nurse Practitioner license (minimum of 10 licenses) and national board certification (FNP, AGNP or ANP), with the ability to obtain licensure in additional states as required; compact state nursing license required
  • Two or more years of clinical practice as a Nurse Practitioner, preferably in primary care, internal medicine, preventive medicine or a related field
  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex clinical findings clearly and without alarming patients
  • Comfortable delivering care by phone and video
  • Strong documentation practice and comfort working in an electronic health record
  • Strong commitment to patient privacy and the handling of protected health information
  • Experience with imaging interpretation in a clinical context preferred
  • Experience in preventive or longevity medicine preferred
  • Experience working remotely in a clinical role preferred

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
