jobs.description:
Overview

At the heart of every great technology organization is a commitment to reliability, innovation, and exceptional service. As a Senior Analyst on our Service Excellence Team, you'll build hands-on experience across Incident, Problem, and Change Management and play a valuable role in driving that mission forward.

You'll work across teams to support Incident, Problem, and Change Management practices under the guidance of the Advisor and Senior Advisor team, helping deliver stable, high-quality IT services. We're looking for someone building ITIL expertise, an analytical mindset, and a passion for growing into a service excellence career.

This role is a great foundation for a career in IT Service Management, giving you hands-on exposure to core ITSM processes while you develop the skills and judgment to take on greater ownership over time.

Responsibilities

Incident ManagementSupport the Incident Management process by helping triage and document IT service disruptions. Participate in rapid response rooms (war rooms) for critical incidents under the direction of an Advisor or Senior Advisor, and help draft stakeholder updates.

Problem ManagementAssist the Problem Management process by gathering data and supporting root cause investigations led by more senior team members. Help document findings and track preventive actions to completion.

Change ManagementSupport the Change Management process by preparing change documentation, coordinating scheduling logistics, and helping validate post-implementation reviews under guidance.

Proactive Incident PreventionMonitor dashboards, alerts, and incident trends, flagging anomalies or emerging risks to senior colleagues for further investigation.

Jira Service ManagementUse Jira Service Management to accurately log and update incidents, problems, and changes. Follow established workflows and escalate data-quality issues to senior team members.

Service ImprovementContribute observations and ideas to service improvement initiatives led by others, and help implement approved changes to processes and workflows.

Metrics Tracking and ReportingAssist in compiling ITSM metrics and populating standard reports and dashboards under the guidance of senior team members.

Stakeholder EngagementCommunicate routine updates to Service Desk, Application Support, and Infrastructure teams, escalating more complex conversations to senior colleagues as needed.

DocumentationMaintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for ITSM processes, procedures, and incident/problem records.

Qualifications

EducationBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred (equivalent experience considered). ITIL Foundation certification is a plus, or should be obtained within the first 6 months of hire.

Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in an IT operations, service desk, or related technical support role
  • Exposure to Incident, Problem, or Change Management processes is a plus but not required
  • Familiarity with Jira Service Management or similar ITSM tools is a plus
  • Willingness and ability to participate in a rotating on-call schedule and respond to critical incidents outside of normal business hours when required

Skills

  • Clear communication and interpersonal skills, with a willingness to learn from senior colleagues
  • Developing analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Foundational knowledge of ITIL frameworks and ITSM best practices, or eagerness to build this knowledge quickly
  • Attention to detail and commitment to process adherence
  • Eager, proactive mindset with a focus on learning and improving service quality
  • Beginning to use artificial intelligence tools to support incident documentation and basic analysis, with guidance from senior team members
  • Developing familiarity with monitoring practices and tools (e.g., Datadog) to help detect and flag service issues

Total CompensationBase pay is one element of the total compensation package. Eligible employees may also receive an annual cash bonus and have access to a comprehensive benefits offering, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

Salary Range It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range. Individual pay may be influenced by factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity.

Applicant Privacy Notice

Pay Range

USD $74,000.00 - USD $99,000.00 /Yr.

At Yelp, our product suite reaches and engages diners, creating unforgettable guest experiences on the largest restaurant discovery platform in the world. Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior AI Platform Engineer to our Product Development team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Join the ML Development Lifecycle team within our Product Development (PD) organisation, where we are redefining how a global tech company leverages intelligence. We build the foundations that allow hundreds of engineers and data scientists to develop and deploy AI at scale. You will own the evolution of our cloud-native ecosystem, creating a seamless and high-performance environment for the next generation of AI-driven products.

If you are a software-minded engineer who thrives at the intersection of scalable Infrastructure and ML/AI orchestration, this is your chance to build a world-class platform that serves millions of users worldwide.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Scale the Ecosystem: Evolve and maintain our Kubeflow, Feast and Spark-on-Kubernetes infrastructure, ensuring it can handle the increasing complexity of both traditional ML and the new wave of AI.
  • Build for Autonomy: Design the internal tools, APIs, and abstractions that empower distributed teams to own their entire lifecycle—transitioning our data culture from "centralised bottleneck" to "self-service excellence."
  • Standardise Engineering Excellence: Collaborate with embedded Data Science teams to adapt software engineering best practices (CI/CD, versioning, testing) to ML-specific workflows, raising the bar for production-grade AI across the company.
  • Seamless Lifecycle Orchestration: Drive MLOps best practices and define the specific lifecycle requirements for LLMOps, ensuring a frictionless journey from experimental notebooks to robust, production-grade solutions by providing top-notch deployment frameworks and automation.
  • Cross-Squad Collaboration: Partner closely with our Infrastructure and Data squads to break silos and integrate ML artifacts into our global Data Catalog, Privacy, and Governance frameworks.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Platform-as-a-Product Mindset: You treat our AI infrastructure as a product, obsessing over Developer Experience (DX) and continuous feedback loops.
  • Collaborative Architect: You excel at balancing distributed team autonomy with global platform standards.
  • Pragmatic Innovator: You prioritize robust, scalable production solutions while staying on top of the wave of concepts and practices.
  • Systems Thinker: You see the big picture, valuing the integration of ML infrastructure with broader data cataloging and governance.

COMPETENCIES:

  • DevOps applied to ML/AI: Deep experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane), and Observability.
  • Kubeflow, Spark, K8 and AWS: Hands-on mastery of the Kubeflow platform, Spark engine, AWS ecosystem and Kubernetes.
  • Software Foundations: Strong Python skills, focused on building reusable libraries, APIs, and tooling abstractions.
  • Solution Architecting & Adoption: Ability to partner with Data Science teams to translate complex use cases into scalable "paved road" solutions.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhuband LinkedIn!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

jobs.title: Director, Creator Operations
jobs.excerpt: Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns.
jobs.description:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at .

About this position

We’re looking for a Director of Creator Operations to own the systems and processes that connect how Later finds, engages, and supports creators. Creators are on one side of every campaign we run, and as we bring the creator experience together across our programs, we need one leader to design how outreach, success, and support work as a single system. Mavely is the core of this role, and the scope extends to how we support affiliate creators across Later Influence.

You’ll own both ways we bring creators in: the sales-led motion, where our team reaches creators person to person, and the product-led motion, where outreach runs at scale through the product. Reporting to the VP of Revenue and Business Operations as part of Later’s Operations team, you’ll partner closely with the General Manager of Creator, Creator Growth, Creator Success, Creator Support, Product, and Engineering. You’ll manage one direct report, who owns HubSpot design and administration, and direct engineering and product resources on the integrations between our systems. This is a high-visibility role with regular exposure to senior leadership.

What you’ll be doing

Strategy and targets

  • Own the infrastructure behind creator acquisition and engagement across the sales-led and product-led motions, from first touch through activation and campaign participation.
  • Build the creator acquisition targets, and the forecast behind them, with the General Manager of Creator, so Creator Growth leadership has a number they can execute against and see coming.
  • Shape funnel strategy jointly with Creator Growth: they own the number and its execution, and you own the structure, the forecast, and the target model it runs on.
  • Own the roadmap for a consolidated creator engagement and tracking system, and decide what gets built and in what order.
  • Turn creator funnel data into decisions on where to put outreach effort, headcount, and automation.

Systems and integration design

  • Act as the primary integration designer between the creator product experience and the Success and Support teams that engage creators.
  • Partner with Product the way a product manager would: write the requirements for engagement flows, routing, and handoffs, and work with Engineering to ship them.
  • Own HubSpot as the system of record for creator marketing, engagement tracking, and the person-to-person outreach our Creator Success team runs.
  • Consolidate the creator outreach tech stack: assess each tool, retire the overlap, and make the remaining systems work from one shared record of each creator.
  • Own the budget for HubSpot and the other creator engagement tools, and decide where that spend goes as the stack consolidates.
  • Use AI and automation to take manual work out of outreach, routing, and follow-up, and measure what it saves.

Outreach and engagement operations

  • Own the systems behind product-led outreach to creators at scale, including segmentation, triggers, sequencing, and measurement.
  • Design the routing and handoff rules that move a creator between automated outreach and a person on our team at the right moment.
  • Build the engagement flows that bring affiliate and awareness creators into campaigns and keep them participating.
  • Define the standards (data definitions, field governance, and service levels) that keep outreach, success, and support data accurate and trusted.

Leadership and team

  • Lead and develop your HubSpot design and administration direct report with clear goals, regular coaching, and a growth plan.
  • Set the talent bar for Creator Operations and raise it with each hire and each process you ship.
  • Address performance gaps quickly and directly, in partnership with People.
  • Direct engineering and product work on integrations through clear requirements, priorities, and follow-through.
  • Clear blockers for the Creator Success and outreach teams before they escalate.

What success looks like

  • Within your first 60 days, you have mapped how creators are acquired, engaged, and supported today across every tool and team, set a baseline for the creator funnel, and shipped at least one change that removes manual work for Creator Success.
  • By 90 days, the plan to consolidate the creator outreach tech stack is agreed with Product and Engineering, and you have built the creator acquisition, activation, and campaign participation targets, with a forecast that the General Manager of Creator and Creator Growth leadership have signed off on.
  • By 6 months, the consolidated engagement and tracking system is live for Mavely: every creator touch, automated or personal, is tracked on one record, and routing between product-led and person-to-person outreach runs on documented rules.
  • By 12 months, the creator engagement stack is consolidated onto one system that supports all of Later’s affiliate creators, and affiliate creator acquisition is growing faster than the baseline you set in your first 60 days, without added headcount. In addition, your direct report owns the HubSpot platform day to day, and Creator Operations is the team the General Manager of Creator relies on to set creator targets and forecast them accurately.

What you bring

We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If you identify with any of the following, we encourage you to apply!

  • 6-8 years in Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, or Growth Operations, with a track record of building the systems behind a high-volume acquisition funnel.
  • Experience running B2C or creator-facing outreach at scale across both product-led and person-to-person motions, including designing how the two hand off.
  • Deep HubSpot experience, including designing lifecycle stages, workflows, routing, and engagement tracking for a team that works directly with customers or creators.
  • A track record of designing integrations between a product and the go-to-market systems around it, working with Product and Engineering on requirements, prioritization, and release.
  • Experience building targets and forecasts for a sales or outreach team that another leader executes against: you can build the model, set the number, and explain the gap.
  • A record of using AI and automation to remove manual work from operations, with results you can measure.
  • Experience leading through others, including managing a direct report, owning a tooling budget, and directing technical work across teams without formal authority.
  • You get up to speed quickly in a new domain, break complex multi-system problems into concrete plans with owners and milestones, and own the result end to end.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (for example, Klaviyo, Braze, or Iterable) is a plus.
  • An understanding of social platforms and how creators build audiences and earn on them is a plus.
  • Experience in the creator economy, affiliate marketing, or a two-sided marketplace is a plus.

How we work

  • We will do whatever it takes to win: We win when our customers and creators win. We bring full commitment to outcomes that matter, not just effort.
  • We have no limit to our aspiration: We think big, push beyond what seems possible, and refuse to let conventional thinking set the ceiling.
  • We are relentless: We keep going. Through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities, we find a way forward.
  • We deeply understand our business: If we don’t have the knowledge, we figure it out. We take ownership of understanding how Later works and what drives results.
  • We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: We bring rigor and accountability without ego, and we make space for each other to do our best work.

Our approach to compensation

We take a market-based and data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation biannually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable), while for others it is structured as salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience, and other factors help determine the final salary we offer, which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range:

United States: $129k - $170k OTE

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.

jobs.excerpt: Talent Acquisition Lead From Operations to Oracle, Sales to SAP, Marketing to PeopleSoft - help us find exceptional talent globally and build brilliant teams!
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Lead

From Operations to Oracle, Sales to SAP, Marketing to PeopleSoft - help us find exceptional talent globally and build brilliant teams!


About the role:

At Support Revolution, great people drive our success, and we're looking for someone who loves finding them!

We're looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Lead to find and attract brilliant talent across the UK, USA, India and beyond, supporting our continued growth in the Oracle, SAP and PeopleSoft third-party support market.

You'll be hands-on with recruitment while leading and supporting our internal recruitment team, headhunting great candidates, building talent pipelines, benchmarking the market and partnering with hiring managers across the business.

If you love the buzz of finding the perfect candidate, enjoy making recruitment better and are ready to take the lead, we'd love to hear from you!

This full-time position is fully remote within the UK.

What you’ll be doing:

Here’s where you’ll make your mark:

  • Lead and develop our Talent Acquisition function, setting high standards for recruitment quality and candidate experience
  • Personally deliver end-to-end recruitment across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance and other corporate functions
  • Lead recruitment for senior, specialist and business-critical appointments
  • Use direct sourcing, headhunting and talent mapping to identify exceptional candidates in competitive markets
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines aligned to future business growth
  • Provide salary benchmarking, competitor intelligence and talent-market insight to support hiring decisions
  • Review recruitment campaigns, sourcing strategies, job adverts and candidate shortlists to ensure consistently high standards
  • Coach and support our internal recruiting team, sharing expertise and driving recruitment excellence across the team
  • Partner with hiring managers to define roles, candidate profiles and effective selection strategies
  • Develop our employer proposition and ensure our external recruitment presence reflects the Support Revolution brand.

What we’re looking for:

You’ll bring:

  • Significant end-to-end in-house Talent Acquisition experience
  • A strong track record recruiting across commercial and corporate functions, such as Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance
  • Excellent direct sourcing and headhunting capability
  • Strong knowledge of salary benchmarking, talent mapping and market intelligence
  • Experience building proactive candidate pipelines
  • The credibility and confidence to partner with senior stakeholders
  • Experience coaching, mentoring or providing professional leadership to other recruiters
  • Excellent judgement when assessing candidate quality and suitability
  • Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how talent strategy supports business growth
  • The ability to operate successfully across different functions, seniority levels and international markets

Oracle, SAP or PeopleSoft recruitment experience? Even better, but it’s not a deal breaker!

Interview process:

Our hiring process is designed to be efficient and transparent. Here’s what to expect:

  1. Screening Call – A friendly chat with our Talent Acquisition team to get to know you and discuss the role
  2. Hiring Manager Interview – Your chance to showcase your skills, experience, and ask us any questions about the role and team
  3. Team Interview – Get to meet with other team members, dive into the exciting projects you’ll be working on, and experience the collaborative energy that drives our success!
  4. Final HR Interview – A deeper conversation to understand your values, ensure a great cultural fit, and discuss the next steps.

Benefits and perks:

We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Competitive Salary: We value your hard work with a competitive package to be discussed from the very first conversation
  • Generous Annual Leave: Take plenty of time to recharge with 25 days holiday, plus UK Bank Holidays, plus extra days as you grow with us!
  • Annual Leave Purchase Scheme: Need more time to relax? Purchase up to 5 additional days' leave per annum
  • Birthday Leave: Your birthday is yours – take the day off and enjoy it your way
  • Length of Service Rewards: Enjoy rewards like bonuses, extra leave, and paid sabbaticals for your dedication
  • Company Pension Scheme: Secure your future with our Company pension scheme
  • Perkbox Perks: Treat yourself with discounts, cashback, and wellness benefits
  • Fully Remote Model: Enjoy the flexibility of working 100% remotely, from wherever you are in the UK - no office required!
  • Employee Wellbeing: We’ve got your back with EAP, eye tests, flu vouchers, and excellent sick pay if you’re ever unwell
  • Personal Development: We invest in you with tailored training and career growth
  • Employee Referral Scheme: Get rewarded for bringing great talent to our team.

About Support Revolution:

At Support Revolution, we help organisations break free from overpriced software support and forced upgrades, slashing maintenance costs while delivering superior service. Our mission is to empower businesses to reallocate savings into innovation, fuelling their growth.
If you’re ready to be part of a fast-growing, forward-thinking company, join us and be part of the revolution!

For more details, click here.

(Note: Support Revolution does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies.)

By submitting your application, you consent to Support Revolution processing your personal data in accordance with our privacy policy, and for the purpose of recruitment for current and future roles. You can withdraw consent at any time.

jobs.description:
ABOUT INSPECTED

Inspected is a tech-enabled remote inspections and permitting platform changing how permitting gets done. We're a fast-growing company building modern tools and processes from the ground up — and this role sits right at the center of that mission, helping projects move through the permitting process faster and with less friction for our clients.

POSITION SUMMARY

Applicants must be current Florida residents.

The Permit Coordinator owns the full lifecycle of permitting for assigned projects, from initial research through final approval and closeout. This role is the primary connection point between internal teams, contractors, and government agencies, making sure every permit application is accurate, compliant, and submitted on time. The right person will be a sharp, organized problem-solver who thrives on tracking details, chasing down answers, and keeping projects moving even when agencies are slow to respond.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage the full lifecycle of project permitting, from initial research and application preparation through approval and closeout.
  • Prepare, review, and submit permit applications to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with all applicable regulations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between internal stakeholders, contractors, and government agencies.
  • Research and interpret local, state, and federal codes, ordinances, and regulatory requirements related to permitting.
  • Track permit application status, review timelines, and approval conditions to keep projects on schedule.
  • Respond to agency comments, requests for additional information, and correction notices in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate revisions and resubmittals with project stakeholders as required.
  • Maintain organized, up-to-date permitting documentation and records.
  • Identify permitting risks or delays early, and proactively communicate impacts and solutions to project teams.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements throughout the duration of each project.
  • Support inspections, approvals, and final sign-offs as needed.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience in permit coordination, permitting, or regulatory compliance; single-trade experience is a plus.
  • Proven experience managing permitting processes, regulatory compliance, or project coordination across multiple projects at once.
  • Strong working knowledge of municipal permitting regulations, licensing requirements, and code compliance processes.
  • Prior experience with a private provider or consulting environment preferred.
  • Ability to independently research, analyze, organize, and summarize complex issues into clear, well-written memoranda.
  • Sharp attention to detail, with the ability to accurately track applications, deadlines, documentation, and compliance requirements.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, collaborating with multiple business units and external stakeholders.
  • Self-starter who works well independently and as part of a team, juggling multiple projects and competing priorities.
  • Strong, professional communication skills across all levels of the organization and with regulatory agencies.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and permitting or document management systems.

WHY JOIN INSPECTED

  • Be part of a growing team building processes and systems from the ground up — your work will directly shape how we operate.
  • A collaborative, fast-moving culture where good ideas get heard, regardless of title.
  • Real opportunity for growth as the company scales.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position does not have any direct reports.

TRAVEL

This position may require up to 5% travel.

We are looking for global candidates to join our team!

About Us

TNT Growth specializes in skyrocketing businesses of all sizes, industries, and revenue models through our proprietary Full-Stack Marketing approach. We’ve spent over $200M on ads to pinpoint exactly what drives explosive growth.

We are in the top 200 Inc list for fastest growing private companies in the US!

We embed our A-team and Full-Stack Marketing system into our clients’ businesses to impact everything they do. Former and current clients include: Salesforce, Gusto, Formula 1, Synthesis School, and more.

Overview

We’re seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Sr. Bookkeeper to fully own bookkeeping, accrual-basis month-end close, accounts receivable, and accounts payable for TNT Growth and a related business.

This role will report directly to our CFO and work closely with Growth, Operations, and leadership teams to keep the books accurate, close every month on time, and make sure every billable service gets invoiced. The ideal candidate has deep accrual, project-based accounting experience, takes full ownership of their work, and is excited to use AI tools to make finance processes faster and more reliable.

Key Responsibilities:

Required Technical Skills:

Preferred skills:

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping or accounting experience, including owning a monthly close end to end
  • Experience supporting US-based companies, ideally agencies or professional services firms
  • Experience with multi-entity bookkeeping and billing pass-through costs with markups
  • Highly accurate and organized, with a track record of meeting close deadlines
  • Strong communication skills
  • Must be based in the US and have active work authorization

Compensation:

  • 12 Paid Holidays

jobs.description:
Product Manager

Digitalzone is a B2B marketing company building the demand orchestration systems that connect buying signals to revenue. Our products turn scattered signals into pipeline our customers can act on. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Product Manager to join the product team and help shape where these products go next.

POSITION OVERVIEW
As a Product Manager, you own the strategy and delivery of our demand orchestration products. Your deep understanding of B2B marketing and lead generation, combined with strong product management craft, will be central to aligning product strategy with business objectives. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, and marketing; make decisions grounded in data; and keep a clear line of sight from customer problems to revenue outcomes.
We also expect a modern toolkit. Product managers here use AI tools in their daily work to move faster: to synthesize research, to build a rough prototype that makes an idea concrete, and to tighten the loop between an idea and real user feedback. Those tools support the fundamentals, they do not replace them. Judgment is still the job.

Key Responsibilities
  • Product strategy: Own the roadmap for demand orchestration and align it with company objectives, connecting product decisions to outcomes such as SQLs, high intent leads, and marketing sourced and influenced revenue.
  • Customer and market understanding: Conduct market research, track competitors and industry trends, and maintain a deep working knowledge of lead generation and B2B marketing processes.
  • Discovery and user research: Talk to customers regularly, run interviews and usability sessions, and turn what you learn into prioritized product decisions.
  • Requirements and definition: Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Where a prototype communicates the intent better than a document, build one.
  • Prioritization: Make explicit trade-offs about scope, sequence, and what will not get built, and explain the reasoning to stakeholders.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with engineering, data science, design, sales, and marketing to take products from concept through launch and adoption.
  • Agile delivery: Run disciplined iterative development: short cycles, working software each sprint, and steady progress against the roadmap.
  • Data-driven decision making: Define success metrics before launch, instrument what you ship, and read the results honestly afterward.
  • Go-to-market partnership: Support launches with positioning input, enablement material, and a clear view of the customer value being delivered.
  • Communication: Articulate product vision and requirements to audiences ranging from engineers to executives to customers.
  • Problem solving: Break down ambiguous problems, including the newer ones that come with building AI powered features.
Ways of Working We Value
The fundamentals above are the core of the role. These practices are how we expect a PM to apply them today.
  • Prototyping: Comfort turning an idea into something tangible within days, whether that is a wireframe, a clickable Figma flow, or a rough working prototype. A prototype in front of a user answers questions a specification cannot.
  • User experience design: Strong instincts for information architecture, user flows, and interaction design. You can give a designer specific, useful feedback rather than adjectives.
  • Practical AI fluency: You use AI tools in your own work: synthesizing research and feedback, drafting and pressure testing documents, exploring data, and generating edge cases. You know where these tools help and where they add risk or noise.
  • Building with AI tools (vibe coding): Willingness to use AI assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, or v0 to stand up a prototype yourself. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be curious enough to try.
  • Rapid iteration: You favor tight build, measure, learn loops over long planning cycles, and you are comfortable revising or discarding your own work when the evidence points elsewhere.
  • Continuous learning: Commitment to staying current on evolving technologies, including AI capabilities, and bringing in the ones that genuinely change what is possible for our customers.
Qualifications
  • 3 - 5+ years of relevant experience as a Product Manager, preferably with experience in B2B marketing, lead generation, or martech.
  • A track record of shipped products or features you can walk us through, including the decisions and the outcomes.
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies and modern product management practice.
  • Experience using data and analytics to inform product decisions.
  • Working familiarity with design tools such as Figma, and comfort collaborating closely with designers.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in a professional context, with examples you can describe.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (for example Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration), or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to HaveExperience with workflow or orchestration products.
  • Experience building features on top of LLMs or agentic systems.
  • Familiarity with intent data, ABM, or revenue intelligence platforms.
  • Experience building your own prototypes with AI assisted coding tools.
Benefits
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Access to modern product and AI tooling.
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • Flexible work hours and remote work with opportunity to travel domestic & international.
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
This position is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

Digitalzone is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status under applicable laws. jobs.excerpt: Role type & Location• Full time Remote (Work from home) based either Dublin or UK only • Occasional Travel to Dublin office if Ireland based (Glasnevin) or UK (Oxford) if UK based Visa• We regret we cannot offer Irish or UK visa sponsorship for this role About this Role• Every laboratory and customer site we work with depends on a secure, reliable connection into our platform.
jobs.description:
Role type & Location

  • Full time Remote (Work from home) based either Dublin or UK only
  • Occasional Travel to Dublin office if Ireland based (Glasnevin) or UK (Oxford) if UK based

Visa

  • We regret we cannot offer Irish or UK visa sponsorship for this role

About this Role

  • Every laboratory and customer site we work with depends on a secure, reliable connection into our platform.
  • You will own that connectivity: the AWS infrastructure that links our products to laboratory and customer systems, and the secure network paths our research teams use to reach their compute. It supports a regulated clinical environment, so it must be secure, observable and recoverable
  • You will report to the Principal Engineer - Cybersecurity & DevOps and join a lean team in which each engineer owns a defined area, with no large support structure.

What This Is NOT

  • Not an IT, helpdesk or end-user support role.
  • Not an infrastructure ticket-queue role.
  • Not a product CI/CD ownership role. The DevOps team owns it, and you contribute as part of that team.
  • Not a role with hand-built servers. If it cannot be rebuilt from code, it is not finished.

About our DTO Team

  • Our Digital Trust & Transformation Office (DTO) brings together the teams that keep Deciphex trustworthy and moving forward: information security, cybersecurity, application security, DevOps, IT, data protection and privacy, AI and AI governance, and operational resilience.
  • We work to one aim: our customers, clinicians and patients can trust our systems and the data in them, and our engineers can ship safely and quickly.

Our Technology stack

  • AWS, GCP, Terraform, Helm, Docker, Mirth, Linux/Win/cloud networking/firewalling etc.

What You help us with

  • You work as part of a lean DevOps team
  • Lab Systems engineers own on-premises laboratory applications and you own the connectivity to them. Research and data science teams own their platforms and you own the secure network access to them. Cybersecurity and Data Security engineers set the security standards you implement.
  • This is a senior, hands-on role with real ownership.
  • You will set technical direction, make the design decisions, and be the person others rely on when it breaks.

This includes;

  • Run and scale our customer connectivity services on EKS, with monitoring, firewall rules and certificates.
  • Provide, as code (Terraform and Helm), the connectivity, network policy and secrets that teams need to connect new customers and laboratories. We do not use click-ops.
  • Operate and upgrade our cloud-hosted integration and laboratory platform services with high availability and backup.
  • Run disaster-recovery exercises and keep the evidence.
  • Own secure network access to our GPU and research compute across cloud providers. The research platform and ML tooling stay with the research teams.
  • Shape the shared network and connectivity layer of our AWS multi-account platform (landing zone), as part of the DevOps team.
  • Build the monitoring, flow-log analysis and alerting that finds faults before a laboratory or customer does.
  • Patch and harden the cluster, nodes and images, following the security team's standards.
  • Document the estate as code, join the on-call rota (planned changes happen outside laboratory hours), and mentor colleagues.

What You Bring

  • You will typically have 5/6++ years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering.
  • We care more about what you have owned and debugged in production than your job title.
  • Deep Linux/Win networking: iptables / nftables, routing, DNS and TLS. You can reason about a rule set line by line.
  • Site-to-site VPN and private connectivity (IPsec, WireGuard or OpenVPN), and tracing a failing flow with flow logs and packet capture.
  • Kubernetes in production, ideally Amazon EKS: Helm, hardened Docker images, and debugging with kubectl.
  • Infrastructure as code in production, ideally Terraform (or OpenTofu), including injecting secrets as code. We use Terraform, and you will write it from week one.
  • AWS administration at the level of trust to change VPCs, endpoints, RDS and IAM safely.
  • Disciplined production change: peer review, monitoring, runbooks and tested recovery.
  • Knowledge and experience with both Windows and Linux networking, CI/CD, secrets management and SSO or federation.
  • Experience with cloud-based healthcare integration (for example HL7 or FHIR), laboratory connectivity to cloud, GPU or research cloud environments, or a regulated environment helps but is not required.

What Success Looks Like

  • The cloud connectivity a new customer, internal team or laboratory needs is provided as code, through a predictable process, and documented.
  • Faults are found by monitoring before laboratory staff or customers report them.
  • Recovery is tested regularly, with evidence.

What are the benefits of working with Deciphex?

  • 💰 Salary with performance-based annual increases to recognise your contribution.
  • 🩺 Healthcare benefits to support your wellbeing.
  • 🌴 Annual leave plus additional Christmas leave to rest and recharge.
  • 🔬 Meaningful work that helps improve patient outcomes.
  • 🚀 A growing company where you can make your mark.
  • 💡 Varied, challenging projects to keep you learning.
  • 📈 Regular feedback and career opportunities to help you progress.
  • 🤝 A supportive, multicultural team to share ideas and learn from.

About Deciphex

Through the work that we do, the team at Deciphex helps pharma to accelerate the process of essential drug development and helps cancer patients get a timely and accurate diagnosis.

Founded in Dublin (Ireland) in 2017, Deciphex has scaled rapidly to a team of over 230 people and counting who are providing software solutions to address the pathology gap in research pathology and clinical areas. We have offices in Dublin, Exeter, Oxford, Chicago and Toronto, and are expanding our team throughout the world.

We are software developers, clinical specialists, artificial intelligence engineers, operations professionals and so much more, all working as one team to support our customers and patients.

Read more about Deciphex here and more about our team on our Careers Page here.

Deciphex is an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to the principle of equality. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, race, religious beliefs, political views, gender identity, affectional or sexual orientation, national origin, family or marital status (including pregnancy), disability, membership of the travelling community or any other classification protected by applicable law.

  • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and Applicant Tracking Systems
  • Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills, with the ability to evaluate both technical qualifications and overall fit

Director of Growth Marketing

About Navigate
Navigate helps organizations activate workforce health. Our Workforce Health Activation System™ brings programs, benefits, resources, and care together through one integrated framework: Culture strengthens the workforce, Care supports the whole person, and Clinical improves health outcomes. Our proprietary Readiness to Change model personalizes the experience around what each person needs, is interested in, and is ready to act on.
That could mean helping an employee complete an overdue cancer screening by explaining why it matters, where to go, and which benefit can help. For someone experiencing financial stress, it could mean connecting them to relevant education, coaching, or employer resources and giving them one achievable next step. For organizations, Navigate makes every benefit and resource more valuable by increasing discovery and utilization, directing attention toward high-value actions, and providing evidence of reach, behavior, and risk movement.
Navigate supports hundreds of organizations, from emerging businesses to Fortune 100 companies to health plans, PBMs, and broker partners. Our industry-aligned Client Success teams understand the realities of each workforce and help clients turn insight into coordinated strategy, meaningful action, and measurable improvement on the outcomes that matter most.
Our purpose is simple: Do Good Things. The opportunity ahead is significant. Organizations continue to invest in benefits, healthcare, wellbeing, and workforce resources, yet people are still left to determine what matters, where to turn, and what to do next. If you want your work to help more people turn health resources into meaningful action, this is an opportunity to make that impact at scale. We are entering our next stage of growth by establishing Navigate as the leader in Workforce Health Activation and bringing this different approach to more organizations and more people.

How You Contribute to Our Success
The Director of Growth Marketing will build and lead Navigate’s integrated growth motion across enterprise employers, brokers, and consultants. You will determine where Navigate can win, translate those opportunities into focused growth strategies, and connect campaigns, thought leadership, events, digital channels, sales activation, and follow-up around shared business outcomes.
This is a hands-on leadership role for a strategic builder. You will lead a focused team, create the operating model, launch and optimize growth motions, and turn what works into repeatable plays that create demand, accelerate pipeline, and contribute to measurable revenue growth.

What Success Looks Like
Within the first year, you will have:
  • Established a focused growth strategy around the audiences and market opportunities where Navigate can win
  • Launched and improved priority growth motions tied to market engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline progression, and revenue objectives
  • Built a repeatable growth approach for priority accounts
  • Created an integrated operating model that connects Growth Marketing with Brand and Creative and the broader commercial organization
  • Improved executive visibility into account engagement, pipeline impact, learning, and investment decisions

Key Responsibilities
Set the Growth Strategy
  • Build annual and quarterly growth strategies aligned to Navigate’s business and revenue priorities
  • Identify the audiences, market problems, accounts, and opportunities where Navigate has the strongest right to win
  • Use buyer insight, performance data, competitive intelligence, and market signals to make clear investment and prioritization decisions
Build Integrated Growth Motions
  • Turn priority market opportunities into integrated motions that connect positioning, thought leadership, content, product launches, events, digital activation, sales enablement, and follow-up
  • Develop distinct but connected strategies for enterprise employers, brokers, and consultants, including account-based and influence-led growth plays
  • Design focused experiments that test audience, message, offer, channel, and conversion assumptions before scaling investment
  • Partner with the Director of Brand and Creative from the beginning of each motion to align growth strategy with a distinctive narrative, creative platform, and market experience
Create and Accelerate Revenue Opportunities
  • Partner with Sales, Broker Relations, and Sales Enablement to create new opportunities, increase penetration within priority accounts, and advance active opportunities
  • Build an influence-led growth model that helps brokers and consultants understand, believe, retell, and recommend Navigate’s value
  • Ensure every campaign and event has a defined audience, commercial objective, activation plan, follow-up strategy, and accountable owner
Measure, Lean, and Scale
  • Establish a measurement framework connecting audience reach, target-account engagement, broker influence, opportunity creation, pipeline progression, and revenue outcomes
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to strengthen lifecycle definitions, attribution, account visibility, data quality, automation, and executive reporting
  • Lead regular growth reviews that clarify what is working, what has been learned, what should change, and where Navigate should invest next
  • Turn successful motions into repeatable growth plays and just as important, know when to stop work that does not produce meaningful market or business impact
Lead the Team and Operating Model
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Growth Marketing Lead and Events Manager while creating clear accountability across interconnected work
  • Build a practical operating cadence across Growth Marketing, Brand and Creative, Sales, Broker Relations, Sales Enablement, Revenue Operations, Product, and Client Success
  • Use AI and emerging technology to improve insight, execution speed, personalization, experimentation, and team capacity
  • Model a culture of commercial curiosity, urgency, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

The Ideal Candidate
  • Experience in employee benefits, healthcare, HR technology, wellbeing, or another complex B2B market
  • Experience marketing to benefits consultants, brokers, enterprise HR leaders, or benefits buyers
  • Experience establishing a differentiated market position, supported by working knowledge of HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4, ABM tools, marketing automation, and AI agents and workflows
  • Proven success developing integrated marketing campaigns that generate measurable pipeline and revenue growth through broker partnerships and direct to employer.
  • Strong understanding of account-based marketing, digital marketing, marketing automation, lead generation, and campaign analytics.
  • Experience managing paid media, email marketing, website optimization, SEO, AEO, webinar programs, and marketing technology platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into scalable marketing programs.
  • Exceptional analytical, project management, and communication skills.
  • Experience leading high-performing marketing teams while fostering collaboration across Sales, Product, Client Success, and Executive Leadership.

The Navigate Way – Core Expectations
At Navigate, we expect all employees to live our values:
  • Deliver the Boom
  • Everybody Love Everybody
  • We Are Family
  • Inspire & Innovate
  • Embrace Change
  • Growth is Great
  • Efficient & Effective
  • Give Back

Minimum Requirements
  • 7+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including meaningful ownership of growth, demand generation, or go-to-market strategy, with clear evidence you can own an outcome end to end rather than one function
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or equivalent experience.
  • A GM instinct building or materially transforming a growth capability and translating complex business problems into measurable commercial results
  • Experience with complex enterprise buying groups, long sales cycles, account-based growth, and a broker, consultant, advisor, partner, or other influence-led sales model
  • The ability to move comfortably between executive-level strategy and hands-on campaign development, problem solving, and execution
  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to decide where not to invest and align teams around a shared growth priority
  • Experience coaching a small, high-performing team in a fast-moving environment

Working Environment
  • Standard office work environment. Minimum ability to lift push and pull 10lbs.
  • Normal mental and visual attention is required. Normal office working conditions requiring continuous use of both hands. Sitting most of the time, may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time.
  • Position requires occasional bending, squatting, twisting and climbing stairs. There are minimal exposures to workplace hazards.
  • To perform the job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable a qualified individual with a disability to perform the essential functions.

Equal Opportunity

We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels heard and respected, and extending our culture of care so that every individual can reach their full potential. We want you to have a sense of belonging and feel valued for your contributions and the perspectives you bring.

Summary:

The Industrial Controls and SCADA (IC&S) Engineer - Generation acts as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) and is responsible for creating and executing a Generation Controls engineering program (which includes HMI displays, Energy Management Systems, Top Level/Master Power Plant Controls (PPC), and other Distributed Control System (DCS) functions) for the generation controls side of utility scale renewable power plants throughout all phases of new construction projects. This role provides SME review and guidance to the Engineering Delivery and Project Execution teams for all Generation Controls functions including but not limited to Independent System Operator (ISO) and local utility grid requirements, grid compliance/Top Level control systems, substation SCADA integration, BESS generation control systems, PV generation control systems, Wind Turbine generation control systems, and any hybrid control systems required for projects with multiple generation assets. This position understands and clearly communicates the control requirements of ISOs, how they are associated with the Interconnection Agreements (IAs)/Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) of each project and explicitly highlight control requirements that need to be verified in SCADA Integrator’s solutions. This position interfaces heavily with the Development and Construction teams, as well as Clients and Subcontractors.

Requirements:

  • Serves as SME to provide Generation Controls expertise on wind, energy storage, and solar power systems.
  • Oversees Generation Control system designs that include control narratives, HMI functionality, equipment BOMs, point lists, rack/enclosure elevations, power distribution diagrams, critical spares lists, software specifications, FAT procedures, construction work instructions, commissioning work instructions, SAT procedures, etc. to ensure technical requirements are met.
  • Provides technical oversight of Generation Control consultants and subcontractors which includes leading IC&S meetings, tracking deliverables, facilitating/coordinating testing activities, reviewing and approving bill of materials, advising on budgets, and ensuring system completion.
  • Develops quality assurance specifications that ensure a quality system is installed and tested to RES’s Generation Controls quality assurance specifications, and oversees quality assurance of Generation Controls systems during all phases of projects.
  • Ensures Generation Controls system installation, configuration, integration, and inspections that confirm the Generation Controls system has been installed per RES requirements and tested to meet RES, client, QSE, Utility, NERC, and regional reliability council requirements.
  • Executes quality assurance plan for Generation Control functions that ensure system safety, design reviews, factory acceptance tests (FAT), commissioning, site acceptance tests (SAT), and turnover plans are executed responsibly, reliably, and efficiently.
  • Communicates and coordinates with RES internal teams, owners, subcontractors, site teams, and other key stakeholders to execute Generation Controls system activities and ensure project milestones are met.
  • Creates deployment strategies for Generation Controls solutions according to timelines and budget.
  • Maintains project and department documentation in RES documentation control software.
  • Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled, or expected.
  • Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct, and Company Policies & Procedures.
  • Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.
  • Provides strategic advice and optimized business processes related to Generation Controls systems to project execution teams and their supporting departments.
  • Works with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction to identify and resolve Generation Controls problems or issues related to design information, schedule, material deliveries, change management, safety, and quality.
  • Manages the business process associated with Generation Controls QAQC.
  • Provides Generation Controls technical guidance and support to other Engineers, Project Execution teams, and other project stakeholders.
  • Supports review and analysis of data and technical report preparation.
  • Oversees, from a technical perspective, efforts to maintain Generation Controls project and department documentation.
  • Works with the Engineering Delivery and Project Execution teams to provide progress and schedule updates related to Generation Controls activities.

jobs.title: Senior MLOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Your wellbeing, our mission.  Join a company shaping a healthier world.
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior MLOps Engineer to our Product Development team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Join the ML Development Lifecycle team within our Product Development (PD) organisation, where we are redefining how a global tech company leverages intelligence. We build the foundations that allow hundreds of engineers and data scientists to develop and deploy AI at scale. You will own the evolution of our cloud-native ecosystem, creating a seamless and high-performance environment for the next generation of AI-driven products.

If you are a software-minded engineer who thrives at the intersection of scalable Infrastructure and ML/AI orchestration, this is your chance to build a world-class platform that serves millions of users worldwide.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Scale the Ecosystem: Evolve and maintain our Kubeflow, Feast and Spark-on-Kubernetes infrastructure, ensuring it can handle the increasing complexity of both traditional ML and the new wave of AI.
  • Build for Autonomy: Design the internal tools, APIs, and abstractions that empower distributed teams to own their entire lifecycle—transitioning our data culture from "centralised bottleneck" to "self-service excellence."
  • Standardise Engineering Excellence: Collaborate with embedded Data Science teams to adapt software engineering best practices (CI/CD, versioning, testing) to ML-specific workflows, raising the bar for production-grade AI across the company.
  • Seamless Lifecycle Orchestration: Drive MLOps best practices and define the specific lifecycle requirements for LLMOps, ensuring a frictionless journey from experimental notebooks to robust, production-grade solutions by providing top-notch deployment frameworks and automation.
  • Cross-Squad Collaboration: Partner closely with our Infrastructure and Data squads to break silos and integrate ML artifacts into our global Data Catalog, Privacy, and Governance frameworks.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Platform-as-a-Product Mindset: You treat our AI infrastructure as a product, obsessing over Developer Experience (DX) and continuous feedback loops.
  • Collaborative Architect: You excel at balancing distributed team autonomy with global platform standards.
  • Pragmatic Innovator: You prioritize robust, scalable production solutions while staying on top of the wave of concepts and practices.
  • Systems Thinker: You see the big picture, valuing the integration of ML infrastructure with broader data cataloging and governance.

COMPETENCIES:

  • DevOps applied to ML/AI: Deep experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane), and Observability.
  • Kubeflow, Spark, K8 and AWS: Hands-on mastery of the Kubeflow platform, Spark engine, AWS ecosystem and Kubernetes.
  • Software Foundations: Strong Python skills, focused on building reusable libraries, APIs, and tooling abstractions.
  • Solution Architecting & Adoption: Ability to partner with Data Science teams to translate complex use cases into scalable "paved road" solutions.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhuband LinkedIn!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Senior Security Engineer – Enterprise Security shares ownership of the day-to-day operation of the Samsara security environment. You will keep our network access, device trust, and visibility systems running, tuned, and resilient at enterprise scale in partnership with a global team. Utilizing modern principles, you’ll maintain and evolve a modern zero trust program, spend time both on policy design and real-time triage for escalations.

You take security seriously and believe the best solutions are low-friction and built in partnership with others. You are comfortable owning and maintaining production systems for long term success - troubleshooting systemic issues, tuning policies based on real incidents, and continuously improving what is already built. You bring an automation mindset to repetitive work, whether using Python, SOAR platforms, or AI-assisted tools. You enjoy supporting teammates and helping other engineers build their security knowledge.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

About this team:

Enterprise Security is a global team spanning the US, EMEA, and India. We work in close partnership with our coworkers as collaborators rather than gatekeepers. Leadership is hands-on and technical, and our culture encourages everyone to contribute across the full stack.

Executive leadership actively champions security as a competitive advantage that builds customer trust and helps win enterprise partnerships. You will see a direct line between the zero trust systems you operate and the security that protects our physical operations partners worldwide. Our on-call rotation for the highest severity incidents is spread evenly across the team for one week out of every ten.

In this role, you will:

  • Co-own the day-to-day operation, triage, and tuning of the Samsara endpoint security environment by responding to escalations, investigating anomalies, and resolving issues
  • Continuously improve existing endpoint visibility tools and workflows in partnership with our Security Operations team, and based on real usage patterns and incident learnings
  • Write clear, concise documentation and runbooks for enterprise security workflows
  • Collaborate with partners across Engineering, IT, and Security to ensure proper implementation of security tools and policies
  • Assist the Security Operations team during security investigations, acting as a technical subject matter expert within your domain
  • Partner with engineering teams to triage and support remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
  • Mentor engineers on the Security team to grow their domain knowledge, tool-specific skills, and communication abilities
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team)

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in an Enterprise Security role with demonstrated impact
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining endpoint security and visibility tools at enterprise scale (e.g. Crowdstrike, osquery, or similar)
  • Exposure to at least one additional enterprise security tool stack beyond endpoint security, such as Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), zero trust systems, email security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), or Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • An automation mindset with experience scripting and debugging code with Python (with or without AIassistance) and using SOAR platforms
  • Strong familiarity with common security challenges and the ability to independently evaluate their severity and business impact
  • Track record of delivering impactful work across multiple quarters and collaborating effectively across teams

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Significant breadth across the endpoint security ecosystem, including designing layered controls with EDR tools, passive telemetry, integration with threat intelligence feeds, and operation in cloud and containerized environments.
  • History of building out security programs using modern SaaS security platforms such as Crowdstrike, Mimecast Incydr, and Splunk
  • Experience with infrastructure as code deployments using Terraform
  • Experience with AI-driven automations

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co.
