jobs.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

The Solution Architecture team sits at the intersection of technology, customer advocacy, and revenue, working Honeycomb’s most strategic opportunities. We partner with world-class engineering organizations to solve complex observability challenges and change how teams build and operate software. This is a team of hands-on technical leaders who want to shape major customer decisions, influence go-to-market strategy, and redefine what great technical selling looks like.

What you’ll do in the role:

  • Own the technical sales motion on a portfolio of mid-market to enterprise accounts across AMER, partnering closely with sales to drive deals forward.
  • Lead discovery, solution design, and technical conversations that connect Honeycomb’s platform to real engineering and business priorities, from first call through close.
  • Drive the technical win. Define success criteria, run POCs, navigate competitive evaluations, and build stakeholder confidence with engineering teams and technical buyers.
  • Engage with engineering leaders, platform teams, and SRE organizations on observability best practices and AI-era workflows.
  • Translate complex customer environments into clear architectures and solution narratives that resonate with both hands-on practitioners and technical decision-makers.
  • Leverage AI tools to work efficiently and creatively while maintaining accuracy and reliability. Human-in-the-loop is a real thing!
  • Get hands-on when it matters. Instrument applications, troubleshoot technical blockers, and help customers prove outcomes in real environments.
  • Contribute to the team’s technical library: demos, solution frameworks, reference architectures, and repeatable assets that make the whole team more effective.
  • Deliver demos, workshops, and technical presentations that create conviction.
  • Collaborate across Sales, Product, Marketing, Field Engineering, and DevRel to strengthen the go-to-market motion and improve how we show up for customers.
  • Bring customer and field signals back into the company. Contribute to roadmap conversations and help shape how we demo and position the product.
  • Share what you know. Help onboard newer team members, document what works, and contribute to a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • 5+ years of pre-sales, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical experience in B2B SaaS with a highly technical ICP, with a focus on enterprise or mid-market accounts.
  • A consistent track record of winning competitive, multi-stakeholder deals with technical buyers and navigating complex evaluation processes.
  • Experience selling into developer, platform, SRE, or engineering-led organizations , you earn technical credibility quickly and know how to bridge technical depth with business value.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to tailor your message from hands-on engineers to VP-level decision-makers.
  • Sharp solutioning skills: you whiteboard clearly, simplify complexity, and craft compelling technical strategies even in ambiguous situations.
  • Hands-on fluency across modern cloud environments, CSPs, containers, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and API-driven architectures.
  • Solid working knowledge of observability, distributed tracing, and OpenTelemetry. You understand how modern teams instrument, troubleshoot, and optimize complex systems.
  • Comfort navigating code and implementation details across common languages and frameworks , enough to guide instrumentation and validate technical approaches with customers.
  • Strong instincts for unblocking deals, reframing challenges, and finding practical paths forward when things get ambiguous.
  • Experience owning POCs and technical evaluations end-to-end: defining success criteria, managing risk, and driving to a clear outcome.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional mindset with experience working alongside Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to improve how we go to market.
  • A point of view on where observability, developer tooling, and AI-assisted workflows are headed , and genuine enthusiasm for helping customers modernize.
  • A growth and contribution mindset: you share what you know, build reusable assets, and make the people around you better.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or Command of the Message is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel ∼20% for customer engagements, field events, and internal collaboration.
On Target Earnings (OTE) based on level of experience (Base + Commission)
$185,500—$225,000 USD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Pindrop is the Real Human + Right Human® Identity Trust Platform for the AI era. As AI-driven fraud and deepfakes erode trust in digital communication, Pindrop delivers continuous identity verification and deepfake detection across voice, video, and digital interactions in real time.

Enterprises rely on Pindrop to secure billions of high-risk customer interactions each year, including top U.S. banks, as well as leading insurers and healthcare providers. What you’ll do

As a Senior Software Engineer on Platform Core, you will own and evolve high-scale backend and data-layer services that every Pindrop product depends on. Platform Core owns foundational services including IAM, Interaction Service, Data Lake, reporting, and admin services, and the team is responsible for keeping these systems fast, reliable, and SLA-compliant even on record call-volume days.

More specifically, you will:

  • Design, build, test, and operate distributed backend services and APIs that support high-volume customer interactions.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of platform work, from framing ambiguous problems and shaping technical plans through implementation, rollout, and production support.
  • Improve reliability, scalability, latency, and cost across shared platform systems that serve teams across the business.

Who you are

  • You are self-directed, accountable, and able to drive work forward with limited supervision.

  • You are collaborative and communicate clearly across technical and cross-functional partners.
  • You are motivated by foundational platform work, shared infrastructure, and reliability-oriented backend engineering.
  • You have a mentorship mindset and raise team standards by example.

Your skill-set

Must-haves:

  • 5-7+ years of experience building backend services and APIs in production, or equivalent practical depth.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and/or Go.
  • Experience with distributed systems, concurrency, and cloud-native development on AWS and/or GCP using Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Proven production ownership, including deploying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and participating in on-call for high-scale services.
  • Strong experience with data and messaging technologies such as PostgreSQL or Aurora, Redis, and RabbitMQ, along with the ability to reason about reliability, performance, and scale tradeoffs.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with Redshift, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB, S3, Kinesis, or IAM.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, especially Terraform.
  • Strong observability habits across metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience scaling or migrating databases, including read replicas, cluster mode, or engine migrations.

What’s in it for you

Platform Core is the backbone the whole product depends on. In this role, your decisions will directly influence latency, reliability, scale, and cost across the systems that process customer traffic every day. You will own meaningful distributed systems work end to end, help the team scale through peak and record-load events, and increase the amount of major platform work Core can take on in parallel without compromising production stability. You will also work alongside experienced engineers across Core and adjacent teams, with a clear path to grow from strong senior execution into broader technical leadership and Staff-level impact over time.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Not sure if this is you?

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Title: Director, Policy and Research

Department: Strategy, and Policy Research

Reporting to: Senior Director, Policy and Research

Compensation: CAD102K - CAD131K

Employment: Full Time

Location: Remote - Canada (The team is primarily based in Ontario; candidates located in Ontario are encouraged to apply)

Who We Are:

World Education Services (WES) is a non-profit social enterprise that supports the educational, economic, and social inclusion of immigrants, refugees, and international students. For 50 years, WES has set the standard for international academic credential evaluation, supporting millions of people as they seek to achieve their academic and professional goals. Through decades of experience as a leader in global education, WES has developed a wide range of tools to pursue social impact at scale. From evaluating academic credentials to shaping policy, designing programs, and providing philanthropic funding, we partner with a diverse set of organizations, leaders, and networks to uplift individuals and drive systems change. Together with its partners, WES enables people to learn, work, and thrive in new places. For more information about WES, please visit our website at www.WES.org.

About the Opportunity:

The Director, Policy and Research provides strategic leadership in advancing WES Canada's policy, research, and advocacy agenda. Working closely with the Senior Director, Strategy and Policy Research, the Director leads major policy initiatives, develops evidence-based policy positions, manages strategic research, and cultivates high-impact partnerships that strengthen WES's influence across Canada's immigration and workforce development.

The Director leads complex cross-functional initiatives that advance WES Canada's strategic priorities. This role combines senior policy leadership with hands-on technical research capability, including the design and execution of applied economic research on immigration, economics, and labour market outcomes.

The Director provides leadership to policy staff, consultants, and project teams while fostering collaboration across WES departments to strengthen organizational impact and thought leadership. The role is responsible for translating emerging policy trends and research into organizational strategy, supporting executive decision making, and representing WES externally with governments, business associations, sector partners, and other stakeholders.

What You'll Do:

Policy Leadership and Strategic Influence (35%)

  • Apply rigorous economic and quantitative analysis, including econometric evidence on immigration and labour market outcomes to strengthen the empirical foundation of WES policy positions.
  • Lead the development of policy positions, strategic analysis, consultation submissions, and advocacy strategies aligned with WES Canada's priorities.
  • Identify emerging immigration, labour market, education, and workforce policy trends and assess strategic implications for WES.
  • Lead complex policy research projects that support evidence-informed organizational decision making.
  • Provide strategic advice to senior leadership regarding policy risks, opportunities, and emerging issues.
  • Develop policy frameworks and recommendations that strengthen WES's influence with governments and sector partners.
  • Represent WES in external policy forums, advisory committees, and stakeholder consultations.
  • Lead the preparation of executive briefing materials, policy papers, presentations, and strategic reports.

Research, Thought Leadership and Strategic Partnerships (30%)

  • Design and lead applied economic research on immigration and workforce integration, including econometric and quantitative studies related to immigration policy or economic issues, credential recognition, and labour market outcomes.
  • Direct strategic research initiatives that support WES Canada's public policy, advocacy, and systems change objectives.
  • Build and steward the team’s technical research capacity, including research design, quantitative methods, data acquisition, analytical tooling, and quality assurance standards for all empirical economic-focused work.
  • Build and maintain senior relationships with governments, business associations, post-secondary institutions, regulatory bodies, employers, and sector organizations.
  • Identify opportunities for collaborative research, policy development, and strategic partnerships that advance WES priorities.
  • Lead the development and dissemination of thought leadership publications, policy briefs, and research reports.
  • Provide strategic oversight of external research partnerships and ensure research quality and alignment with organizational priorities.
  • Represent WES as a recognized subject matter expert through speaking engagements, conferences, and stakeholder meetings.

Strategy, Governance and Organizational Leadership (20%)

  • Lead strategic planning initiatives that support implementation of WES Canada's strategic priorities as it relates to policy, research, and the advocacy agenda.
  • Direct cross-functional projects involving multiple departments and external stakeholders.
  • Lead strategic environmental scanning and scenario planning activities to inform executive decision making.
  • Support organizational governance through development of board materials, executive briefings, dashboards, and performance reporting.
  • Lead strategic planning and implementation of major policy, research and advocacy related initiatives within the Managing Director Office.
  • Develop systems and processes that strengthen knowledge management, organizational learning, and policy coordination.

Leadership and People Management (15%)

  • Lead, coach, and develop policy and research staff, consultants, and project teams.
  • Establish work plans, priorities, and performance expectations for direct reports.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performing team culture.
  • Support workforce planning, recruitment, and professional development within the Policy and Research function.
  • Promote effective collaboration across WES departments to achieve shared organizational objectives.

Your Experience:

Required

  • A bachelor's degree in economics, Public Policy, Political Science, Social Sciences, or another related discipline, or an acceptable equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in economic research or public policy within the social impact, public, or non-profit sectors.
  • Demonstrated technical research capacity, including experience designing and executing applied economic research on immigration and labour markets, from research design and data strategy through analysis, peer review, and publication.
  • Strong econometric and quantitative skills, including regression analysis, causal inference methods, and labour market outcome analysis, with working proficiency in statistical software such as Stata, R, or Python.
  • Minimum five (5) years of management or leadership experience leading teams, consultants, or complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Canadian labour market policy, workforce development, credential recognition, immigration or related public policy fields.
  • Experience managing external research partnerships and commissioned research.
  • Experience working with Canadian labour market and immigration data, such as the Longitudinal Immigration Database (IMDB), Census, and Labour Force Survey, including Statistics Canada Research Data Centre or administrative microdata environments.
  • Extensive experience leading policy development, consultation submissions, research projects, and strategic advocacy initiatives.
  • Proven ability to influence policy through research, stakeholder engagement, and strategic partnerships.
  • Experience building and maintaining relationships with senior government officials, business leaders, funders, and sector organizations.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills and executive presence: ability to build strong relationships and work with individuals at all levels of the organization; work collaboratively with people of different backgrounds, experiences, communication styles, and cultures towards collective goals.
  • Strong strategic planning, analytical, and systems thinking capabilities.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level briefings, reports, and presentations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
  • Excellent judgment, political acuity, and ability to manage sensitive issues with discretion.
  • Knowledge of federal and provincial government decision-making processes.
  • Experience managing external research partnerships and commissioned research.
  • Experience developing organizational policy and advocacy strategies.

Desired

  • A record of published economic or policy research, including peer-reviewed publications, working papers, or widely cited policy reports on immigration, economic policy, workforce development, and/or labour market topics.
  • Experience representing an organization publicly through conferences, media, or government consultations.
  • Functional bilingualism in English and French is considered a strong asset.

What We Offer:

Joining our team at WES means embarking on a purpose-driven career with a global impact, where you contribute daily to making a tangible difference in the lives of people worldwide. You'll thrive in an employee-centric environment, with access to learning opportunities, pathways for personal and professional development, and recognition of your achievements. Our inclusive, mission-driven culture values employees and focuses on investing in our people through our culture, people framework, and programming while offering the flexibility of remote work options.

  • Work-Life Harmony: We believe that success is all about maintaining balance. Enjoy the freedom of remote work and flexible scheduling, paired with generous time-off policies designed to assist you in maintaining a healthy equilibrium between your personal and professional commitments. Our comprehensive wellness programs and work environment are focused on fostering your well-being.
  • Rewards and Recognition: Your dedication and achievements are the cornerstone of our success. We recognize the importance of valuing your hard work, which is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and tangible rewards to celebrate your contributions.
  • Professional Growth and Development: We are committed to nurturing growth within our team, recognizing that growth is essential to providing opportunities for career advancement and ongoing professional development. To prioritize your learning and success, we invest in comprehensive training programs and offer tuition reimbursement opportunities. We promote a culture of continuous learning that empowers you to thrive and evolve in your career.
  • Innovation and Impact: Engage in work that directly transforms lives and empowers individuals and communities by expanding access to global educational and professional pathways. Join us in fostering a culture that values innovation, embraces new approaches, and leverages transformation to implement and drive impactful change.
  • Community and Connection: Our team is made up of individuals from different cultures and backgrounds who have varying perspectives and ideas. Our diverse workforce reflects the global community we serve, and we take pride in it. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Experience the power of connection by participating in a range of activities, including employee-led resource groups, town halls, collaborative team events, meaningful volunteer opportunities, and initiatives that promote equity, celebrate diversity, and cultivate a strong sense of belonging within our organization.

Values:

  • Opportunity - We open doors so people can build better futures.
  • Inclusion - We become stronger, more creative, and more resilient when we embrace diversity.
  • Equity - We uphold fairness and justice in our work and actions.

Inclusive Recruitment Process:

At our organization, individuals who thrive in a culture of continuous learning and inclusive teamwork excel. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

Our Commitment:

World Education Services is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the rich tapestry of our communities, both in the US and Canada. This commitment is underscored by our unwavering dedication to providing equal opportunities to all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or genetics. This commitment extends to every aspect of employment, from recruitment and hiring to promotions, training, and benefits. jobs.description:
Structural Designer

Remote | Hybrid option: Melbourne, FL, Ellicott City, MD, or Pittsburgh, PA

Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000

The Role

Above Group is looking for a Structural Designer to join our Structural Engineering team and help carry projects from concept through construction. Reporting to a Senior Structural Engineer, you will be responsible for the structural design of the projects you are assigned, producing CAD drawings and calculations and turning an engineer’s vision into clear, buildable documents. Your work will directly reflect the quality and vision of our company standards.

This is a hands-on role with room to grow. You will collaborate closely with engineers and project managers, visit active job sites to see how your designs come together, and support construction-phase work such as shop drawing reviews and RFIs. We rely on designers who work well both independently and as part of a team, communicate clearly, and are committed to excellence in everything they produce.

What You’ll Do

  • Create CAD drawings and calculations under the direction of structural engineers, and carry out the structural design of all projects to which you are assigned
  • Develop and implement design criteria and system designs from concept to construction, in line with company procedures, regulations, and client standards
  • Work alongside engineers to understand their vision and translate it into drawings and designs; support them with specific design tasks, markups, and review comments
  • Interpret Basis of Design (BOD) documents, field surveys, and code research; author BOD narratives and design criteria documents and edit design specifications
  • Coordinate with team members and other disciplines on the layout of structural systems and equipment locations
  • Review shop drawing submittals and respond to RFIs, submittals, and other construction-phase services tasks
  • Travel to job sites to gain a full picture of project conditions and construction progress
  • Attend weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly project meetings, as well as meetings with other departments, and keep engineering leads and project managers informed on timelines and deadlines
  • Incorporate feedback from project managers to deliver top-quality products for clients
  • Maintain current knowledge of codes, standards, and local regulations

What you Bring to the Role

  • Minimum of 3 years of related experience (or an equivalent combination of education and experience)
  • Associate’s degree in computer drafting and design or a related field, preferred
  • Proficient in structural concepts including connection design, design loads, lateral systems, different materials, and foundation design
  • Proficient in AutoCAD and Revit
  • Proficient in Bluebeam and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
  • Knowledge of the functionality of 3D imaging cameras
  • Excellent written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills; strong writing for BOD narratives, design criteria, specifications, and RFI responses; able to interface effectively with senior management
  • Strong work ethic; able to work independently/self-motivated, as well as in a collaborative team setting, highly organized, and detail oriented
  • Strong project management, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to multi-task
  • Strong time management with flexibility to adapt to changing schedules and duties
  • High levels of confidentiality, integrity, and dependability
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% for site visits and client meetings
  • U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident of the U.S.

Nice to have: Experience with structural design tools such as STAAD, TEDDS, or RAM Structural System.

Why Above Group

We are a faith-based AEC firm built around a simple idea: continuously improving the built environment for the glory of God. Our mission is to demonstrate the love of Jesus Christ by empowering excellent AEC professionals to provide superior service. Four values guide how we work: Christian Values, Uncompromising Quality, Buffalo (running toward challenges rather than away from them), and Extreme Team. If that resonates with you, you will fit here.

Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, employer-funded HSA contributions, and an annual profit-sharing bonus tied to the company’s collective results.

Remote Work Requirements

This role is fully remote or a hybrid option for candidates residing near Melbourne, FL, Ellicott City, MD, or Pittsburgh, PA. Any type of remote work requires reliable high-speed internet capable of supporting video conferencing, VPN, and cloud applications; a secure home network appropriate for confidential company and client information; and a dedicated, quiet workspace suitable for sustained focus and professional video meetings.

Partner closely with Services Solutions Advocates on regional pipeline and implementation demand.

Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

EPE is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer - Substation Design (P.E. required) to lead the engineering and design of medium- and high-voltage substations ranging from 34.5 kV through 345 kV and higher. This role will support our Owner's Engineering group, with a primary emphasis on physical substation design and the delivery of complete engineering packages from conceptual design through Approved for Construction (AFC). The ideal candidate will bring experience leading both greenfield and brownfield substation projects, with a strong understanding of physical design and exposure to Testing & Commissioning (T&C), as well as protection and control (P&C) design.

Our projects include utility-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), wind and hybrid collector substations, point-of-interconnection switching stations, and large-load interconnections supporting data centers and industrial customers across ERCOT and other U.S. markets. As a technical lead, you will guide engineers and designers, review and verify engineering deliverables, and collaborate directly with clients, transmission owners, and EPC contractors to deliver high-quality substation solutions.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Lead design from concept to IFC: Own the technical scope, quality and schedule of substation design packages through conceptual, 30%, 60%, 90% and IFC milestones.

  • Physical design: Develop and check general arrangements, plan and section drawings, electrical clearances and phase spacing, rigid and strain bus design, equipment and structure layouts, ground grid design (IEEE 80), lightning shielding (IEEE 998), raceway (conduit, cable trench, duct bank), lighting and bills of material.

  • P&C design: Develop and check one-line and three-line diagrams, AC and DC schematics, wiring diagrams, relay and control panel layouts, and cable schedules. Apply protection schemes for lines, transformers, buses, breakers and capacitor banks, including line current differential, distance, transformer and bus differential, breaker failure, and communication-assisted tripping (POTT, DTT).

  • Brownfield expansions: Lead field verification and reviews of existing conditions, integrate new bays, line terminals and P&C into energized substations, and develop outage, cutover and construction sequencing with the utility.

  • Utility and market interface: Apply transmission owner design standards and interconnection requirements (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, NYISO and other ISOs/RTOs), and support coordination on metering, telemetry and SCADA/communications.

  • Equipment and vendors: Write technical specifications and evaluate vendor proposals and drawings for power transformers, circuit breakers, switches, instrument transformers, relay panels, control enclosures, station service and DC systems.

  • Design reviews: Review EPC and third-party substation and collection system design packages, and provide clear, actionable comments to clients, both on EPE design projects and on owner's engineering assignments.

  • Proposals and estimating: Support scope development, engineering hour estimates and conceptual cost estimates for new work.

  • Mentoring and QA/QC: Mentor engineers and designers, check their work, and uphold EPE quality standards. Seal drawings as engineer of record where licensed.

  • Coordination and construction support: Coordinate with civil/structural, transmission line, system studies and communications/SCADA teams. Submit and respond to RFIs, and support construction and commissioning.

  • Deliver assigned projects on time while meeting project quality and budget objectives.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with a minimum of six years of high-voltage and MV substation design experience with a utility, consulting firm or EPC.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license (required).

  • Proven experience delivering complete substation design packages from conceptual to IFC, covering both physical and P&C design, at voltages from 34.5 kV to 345 kV or higher.

  • Experience with both greenfield substations and brownfield modifications to existing, energized facilities.

  • Working knowledge of NESC, NFPA, IEEE and utility/transmission owner design standards, and of how NERC requirements apply to substation design.

  • Solid understanding of protection philosophy and protective relays (SEL, GE, Siemens or similar), plus substation communications, SCADA/RTU and revenue metering.

  • Experience with AutoCAD and grounding analysis software (CDEGS, WinIGS or similar).

Lead the change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Reporting to the Director of Absence Partner Operations, the Advisor serves as the primary operational point of contact for Human Resources (HR) partners on leave and accommodation matters, owning the meeting cadence, surfacing insights from claims and case data, and ensuring partners can interpret outcomes and act with confidence.

This role pairs deep subject-matter expertise in the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), state leave laws, and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accommodation process with strong client-facing judgment. The Advisor understands how leave and accommodation decisions surface on partner data feeds and reporting, translates those outcomes for HR partners, and partners closely with account management to drive client satisfaction, retention, and program optimization. Subject Matter Expertise & Partner Enablement

  • Understand how leave and accommodation actions, approvals, denials, return-to-work (RTW) dates, extensions, appeals, and accommodation determinations translate into downstream data and appear on partner-facing feeds and reports.
  • Act as the partner’s guide to interpreting feed and report data, helping HR partners understand what each data point means and how to act on it.

Continuous Improvement & Transformation

jobs.title: Principal Software Architect
jobs.excerpt: About UsAbacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans.
jobs.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.

About the Role

Abacus is scaling fast – more Data Solutions applications, more agent-assisted engineering, more complexity worth getting right. We’re creating this role to put a strong technical voice at the center of that growth: someone who can take sharp architectural judgment and turn it into standards the whole organization can build on with confidence.

We’re looking for an experienced Software Architect to help set the technical vision for how Abacus builds, secures, and scales its healthcare data platform & data applications platform. This is an individual-contributor role, not a management track – you’ll be the architecture guru and evangelist for our platform, translating business and customer needs into target-state architectures across data, applications, cloud, and agent-assisted engineering, and sharing your expertise with engineers and Solution Architects as you go.

We’re excited to meet architects at a range of career stages. Whether you’re a mid-level seasoned architect ready to step into broader scope, a senior architect with a track record of leading complex designs, or a principal-level leader who has shaped architecture across an organization, we’d love to hear from you. We’ll meet you where you are and shape the scope of the role to the level where you can make the biggest impact.

Our platform is built for health plans, and we’re especially excited to hear from architects who’ve worked with healthcare data.

You’ll build the reusable application foundation – application blueprints, integration contracts, and production-readiness gates – that lets Data Solutions applications move fast without reinventing the wheel every time, create re-usable assets. And as agent-driven development becomes a bigger part of how we ship, you’ll be the one turning architecture standards into skills, rules, templates, and evaluation rubrics that let AI-assisted output meet the same bar as our best human-written code – putting you at the center of how Abacus builds software for years to come.

You’ll bring enough depth to guide decisions across data, application, integration, cloud, and agentic development, while staying pragmatic about fit-for-purpose architecture and delivery constraints. You won’t do it alone – you’ll partner closely with Product Engineering, our Principal Engineers, AI Engineering, Security, and Client Solutions, bringing architecture to life from concept through production, not just on a whiteboard.

Note: This role is based in the US and requires current authorization to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

Your day to day

The scope of your work will scale with your level. Mid-level architects will contribute to and own defined areas of this work, while senior and principal architects will lead it across teams and the platform.

Core architecture leadership

  • Own or contribute to the reference architecture for Abacus’s core platform – data ingestion, transformation, distribution, and serving – partnering with Principal Engineering where ingestion and distribution ownership is shared, and with Product Engineering on application and service layers.
  • Define and apply architecture standards for scaling, high availability/disaster recovery design, serverless patterns, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture across our AWS and Azure environments.
  • Design with HITRUST and GovRamp compliance in mind, partnering with Security and Compliance so designs meet audit and control expectations from the outset rather than as an afterthought.

Data applications and platform architecture

  • Design scalable architectures for data solutions and their analytical and operational serving layers – in our world, spanning payer claims, membership, provider, clinical, lab, and pharmacy/Rx domains.
  • Apply FHIR-based interoperability patterns and healthcare data standards where relevant to product or client implementations.
  • Establish data contracts, lineage, quality controls, metadata, and integration patterns across ingestion, transformation, and serving layers, in coordination with Data Engineering.

Application architecture and standards

  • Define standard user-management capabilities – tenant setup, roles, permissions, and admin experiences – as reusable patterns instead of something each team reinvents.
  • Partner with UX/Design on front-end and design-system standards that keep our applications consistent and accessible.

Agent-driven development and AI-enabled engineering

  • Translate approved architecture standards into skills, rules, templates, and evaluation rubrics that our ADD Harness and agent-assisted development workflows can consume directly.
  • Evaluate agent-generated code and designs against architectural standards, and help build the scoring and review mechanisms that let us scale the quality of agent-produced merge requests across engineering teams.
  • Partner with AI Engineering on semantic/context layers, agent interfaces (MCP and A2A), retrieval patterns, AI gateways, evaluation, traceability, and governed model access.

Architecture governance, knowledge sharing, and influence

  • Be an active contributor to Abacus’s Architecture and Data Guilds – introducing ideas, taking them to realization, and helping drive a culture of innovation through hackathons and beyond.
  • Share your expertise through pairing on designs, reviews, and pilots – and, as you grow in the role, mentor engineers and Solution Architects, building architectural capability across the team rather than concentrating it in one person.
  • Help establish lightweight architecture review mechanisms that protect critical standards without slowing delivery, measuring adoption through signals like reuse, exception volume, and escaped design defects.

Production readiness and operability

  • Ensure every architecture package includes deployment topology, support model, rollback strategy, and operational telemetry, partnering with DevOps/Platform and Security on CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability. Help to establish quality metrics like DORA.
  • Hold your designs to a resiliency bar appropriate for a platform of Abacus’s scale, and help teams reason through trade-offs between delivery speed and operational risk.

The impact you’ll have

In your first 6–12 months, you’ll leave a clear mark on how Abacus builds software:

  • Deliver or contribute to a reference architecture for Data Solutions applications that teams adopt from day one – a shared blueprint, API/data contracts, and starter implementations that let new work move faster instead of starting from scratch.
  • Stand up the skills, rules, templates, and evaluation rubrics that let our ADD Harness and agent-assisted workflows produce work that meets our architectural bar – a foundation that scales with the team, not just with you.
  • Build the architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, and operational-readiness checklists that give every release clear evidence it’s production-ready – deployment, observability, support, and rollback accounted for before go-live.
  • Strengthen architecture capability across the team through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing – leaving Abacus with stronger architectural judgment than it had when you started.

What you bring to the team

  • Software engineering experience (typically 8+ years, with more depth expected at the senior and principal levels), including significant time in architecture roles designing and guiding complex cloud, data, integration, and application solutions from discovery through production operation.
  • A full-stack engineering background – hands-on experience across services and APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure – that gives you the credibility to guide architecture end to end.
  • A proven ability to establish standards – you’ve helped define architecture patterns and guardrails and gotten teams to adopt them through influence and collaboration. At the senior and principal levels, this extends to leading adoption across teams and mentoring others.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure), including containers and container orchestration (Kubernetes/K8s, Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, Google GKE, OpenShift, or comparable), Git-based CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and secure production operations.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to convert custom implementations into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Drive standardization without sacrificing business agility.
  • Shape the long-term technical foundation while balancing immediate delivery needs.
  • Strong experience with a modern data platform and distributed data processing (e.g., Databricks and Spark, or Snowflake) and with modern application and service architectures (API-first services, with exposure to Python), identity and authorization, and multi-tenant SaaS patterns.

  • Design and build simulation and evaluation infrastructure used by AV and ML engineers, to accelerate development of Level 4 self-driving capabilities.

  • Collaborate with AI and Robotics teams to deeply understand their simulation and evaluation needs.
  • Build reliable services, APIs, data pipelines, and AV simulation and evaluation workflows and framework that operate at the scale of hundreds of millions of runs per day.
  • Optimize performance at every level: profiling, parallelization, memory efficiency, query optimization, and protocol redesign.
  • Build diagnostic and observability tooling that enables teams to understand and debug their data and test pipelines.
  • Actively drive the adoption of new standards and technologies in the physical AI tooling ecosystem.

  • BS or MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).
  • 15+ years of professional experience in software engineering with focus on distributed systems and data-intensive applications.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, or Java, and experience operating across the full backend stack.
  • Deep experience building high-performance low-latency data systems: binary serialization, efficient data encoding, columnar data formats.

  • Experience designing and implementing workflows across distributed systems.
  • Past success building foundational systems that multiple teams depend on, with high reliability and scale.
  • Communication skills to be able to translate nuanced system design to both technical and non-technical partners, and talk to users in their language.

YAMU Media is looking for a Talent Recruiter located outside of the United States to join our team. The role is open to people located in Latin America, Asia or Africa.

Job title: Recruiter

Job Overview

YAMU Media is a performance marketing agency working with B2B SaaS, ecommerce, and local businesses across the US market. We are a remote-first team of people who move fast, hold high standards, and care about building something worth working at.

We are looking for a mid-level recruiter to own hiring execution across YAMU. This is not a coordinator role. You will be the person who sources, screens, and moves candidates through the process with structure and speed, reporting directly to the Head of People. You will typically work across three to four open roles at once, all within marketing and paid media. You are the one who protects the pipeline by making sure only candidates who actually meet the bar get to the hiring manager, and that every candidate who touches YAMU leaves with a good impression of us, regardless of outcome.

Key Responsibilities

You will own sourcing across platforms including LinkedIn, Upwork, and our ATS, running both inbound screening and outbound outreach depending on the role. You will conduct screening calls that go beyond logistics: your job is to gather the information the hiring manager actually needs, flag misalignments early, and make a clear recommendation. You will coordinate technical tests and schedule interviews, making sure every step of the process is clean and no candidate falls through the cracks.

A big part of this role is calibration. You will work closely with the hiring manager to understand what each role actually requires, and you will make sure every candidate you advance has been evaluated against the full job description and the technical expectations set by the hiring manager. You will not pass someone through because they seemed nice. You will not advance someone because they interviewed well but can't do the work.

You will also take candidate experience seriously. That means timely updates, clear communication about next steps, and closing every candidate loop, including the ones who don't move forward. You will track pipeline activity and report on the status of open roles so that leadership always has visibility without having to ask.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of total recruiting experience, with a minimum of 2 years focused on marketing, paid media, or digital agency roles
  • Experience hiring for the US market, with international recruiting exposure in Latam, Asia, or Africa
  • Familiarity with AI tools used in recruiting workflows (HireEZ, SeekOut, ChatGPT/Claude for sourcing and screening support, AI-assisted ATS features)
  • Prior experience working in a startup environment, comfortable with fast-paced, evolving priorities
  • Demonstrated experience in end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management.
  • Strong skills in candidate sourcing through job boards, social platforms, networking, boolean search, and talent pipeline development.
  • Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), recruitment CRMs, and basic analytics or reporting tools. (BullHorn, Ashby, Greenhouse, Workable or any ATS)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to conduct structured, unbiased interviews.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple requisitions, and prioritize effectively.
  • Familiarity with SaaS, digital marketing, or tech-enabled service environments is highly beneficial.
  • Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and experience implementing fair, non-discriminatory hiring practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Your Attributes

You have a structured process and you follow it. You do not wait to be told something is wrong. If you notice a gap between what a hiring manager is asking for and the candidates coming in, you flag it before it becomes a problem. You are thorough without being slow. You know the difference between screening and selling, and you do not oversell roles to candidates in order to keep the pipeline full.

You are genuinely curious about people. You ask follow-up questions when an answer feels thin, and you know the difference between a real example and a framework answer. You take candidate experience personally because you understand that every interaction with a candidate is a reflection of the company you represent.

You are comfortable working across multiple roles at once without losing the thread on any of them. You do not need a lot of oversight to stay organized, but you communicate proactively and keep the people you report to informed.

You will work directly at a remote-first company that moves fast and values doing things right.

This is a role where you will see the full picture of how a high-performance team gets built, and your work will have a direct impact on the quality of every team we grow.

Become part of a team of smart, open-minded people with individual qualities

You'll be a part of a rapidly growing company, with plentiful opportunities to grow into leadership roles. And you'll face a steep learning curve & daily data science, technological, and business challenges.

Work-Life Balance:We understand the importance of balancing work with personal life and offer supportive, flexible work arrangements to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Yamu Media provides a start-up environment and culture; fast-paced and agile with quick decision-making. It's an honest and open environment where team members at all levels can make a difference and have a say.

We believe in life-long learning and supporting the development of our team. We are committed to internal promotions, offering clear pathways for advancements as your skills are developed and experience is gained.

About Us:

We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better.

ChiroHD is the cloud-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. Scheduling, EHR, billing, patient communication - everything a modern practice needs, built specifically for how chiropractors actually work. No more trying to force-fit horizontal software into your vertical world. We've cracked the code on product-market fit - prepped, proven, and ready for scale!

Role Overview:

You are a go-to-market operator with a technical mindset who builds the complex. You understand how pipeline, forecasting, attribution, and quota actually work, and you are just as comfortable writing the script, API call, or Claude workflow that makes them rock-solid and reliable.

Sitting inside Revenue Operations, you will own the technical build layer behind our GTM engine: the integrations between HubSpot, Maxio, Stripe, Intercom, data platforms, and beyond—including the automations that keep them in sync and the AI tools our reps and leaders rely on daily.

This is a go-to-market role with a technical edge, not a product engineering role. Your primary customers are our GTM individual contributors (AEs, BDRs, CSMs) and GTM leaders.

Why This Role:

We’ve proven the use cases. Our data pipelines, automations, dashboards, and AI tooling already work, and the revenue team relies on them daily. You take them to production grade and build what comes next.

You will multiply what both RevOps and our GTM teams can do. RevOps continues leading on strategy, definitions, governance, and cross-functional alignment, and still owns a significant portion of the hands-on building. You take on the technical, code-heavy work, translating ad-hoc business requests into clean technical systems and efficient processes.

What You'll Do:

  • Data Infrastructure & Identity: Build and maintain the GTM data layer: pipelines, data models, and identity matching that connect CRM, product telemetry, billing (Stripe/Maxio), and market data into one trusted, unified view of every account.
  • Event-Driven Systems & Integrations: Build monitored, documented integrations and automations in place of manual workarounds and one-off fixes. Manage routine technical administration across key systems, handling webhooks, rate limits, and error alerting.
  • A Reporting Foundation Leaders Can Trust: Deliver accurate, timely, warehouse-backed data reflecting shared business definitions for pipeline, funnel velocity, sales activity, and multi-touch attribution.
  • Production AI Tools & Agents: Build Claude skills, internal apps, and LLM workflows for prospect research, enrichment, scoring, summarization, deal hygiene, rep enablement, and key handoff milestones. Ensure workflows are production-grade, durable, and actively deliver value over time.
  • Signals to Action: Convert customer usage signals, prospecting triggers, account intent, and enrichment data into prioritized, automated routing and actionable tasks for sales and CS teams.
  • Measurement & Iteration: Track the tangible impact of the systems and tools you build (rep hours saved, user adoption, data quality, pipeline influence). Scale what drives revenue and aggressively retire what doesn't.

Who You Are:

  • GTM Fluency: You have 3–6+ years of experience across RevOps, Sales Ops, or technical GTM roles. You have a strong, working grasp of pipeline, funnel conversion, quota, forecast models, and attribution mechanics.
  • Deep HubSpot Mastery: You have hands-on architectural depth with HubSpot: custom objects, properties, advanced workflows, and the HubSpot API.
  • Hands-On Coder & Builder: You possess strong SQL skills for querying and data transformation, paired with working Python (or an equivalent scripting language) for interacting directly with REST APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.
  • Proven AI Builder: You have direct, hands-on experience building practical workflows with Claude or other LLMs—with a track record of builds that are still active and relied upon today. You integrate AI coding tools into your daily workflow to ship faster.
  • Systems Architect & Translator: You excel at turning ambiguous, ad-hoc business requests into clean, scalable technical systems and efficient operational processes. You explain technical trade-offs back to commercial leaders in plain language.
  • Relentless Documenter & Outcome Owner: You document your architecture, instrument monitoring so syncs never fail silently, and take end-to-end ownership of business outcomes rather than just checking off tasks.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience modeling Stripe, Maxio, or recurring subscription billing data.
  • Hands-on experience with modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) and dbt.
  • Familiarity with automation and orchestration engines (n8n, Clay, Temporal).
  • Prior experience operating in a multi-product SaaS environment or navigating data consolidation post-acquisition.

Probably Not a Fit (Disqualifiers):

  • No-Code Only Admins: Operations admins whose experience is strictly limited to point-and-click UI configurations and who do not write scripts, SQL, or code.
  • Core Product Software Engineers: Developers who want to own a customer-facing product roadmap and sprint backlog rather than GTM systems and revenue infrastructure.
  • Task-Takers: People who prefer to wait for pre-scoped engineering tickets and hand back finished tasks without understanding or owning the underlying business outcome.
  • Candidates Lacking GTM Literacy: Anyone lacking a moderate understanding of pipeline stages, rep quotas, and funnel math.

Why ChiroHD:

Impact & Growth

  • Vertical SaaS category leader in a wide market.
  • PE-backed with $26M in growth capital to scale aggressively.
  • Established product-market fit; scaling outbound-led growth engine now.
  • High-caliber sales culture focused on coaching, commercial excellence, and real career growth.
  • Direct leadership access, no bureaucracy, high visibility.

Culture & Values

  • Customer-obsessed team that puts patient care at the center of everything we do
  • Low-ego, builder-first environment where the best ideas win
  • High-accountability culture with emphasis on ownership and results
  • Commitment to work-life balance and professional development

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO and remote-first culture

Equal Employment Opportunist

ChiroHD is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or disability status.

Reports to:Controller

About Arc Beverage

Arc Beverage provides beverage co-manufacturing, packaging, and related operational services for brand owners. Our finance team partners with operations to maintain accurate financial records, support business decisions, and improve accounting processes.

Location and working hours

This is a remote position is based in Canada. Candidates must reside in Canada and be legally authorized to work in Canada. Regular working hours must align with Pacific Time (PT), including Pacific Standard Time (PST) and Pacific Daylight Time (PDT), as applicable. Additional availability may be needed during month-end and year-end close.

About the role

The Junior Accountant supports daily accounting activities with a focus on accounts receivable, accounts payable, accurate transaction processing, reconciliations, and month-end support. This role works under the guidance of senior finance staff and helps maintain complete, accurate records while following purchasing and approval procedures.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist with the day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash receipts, payments, and general ledger activities.
  • Process vendor invoices, employee expenses, credit card transactions, and other accounting entries accurately and on a timely basis.
  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations and investigate and resolve discrepancies.
  • Assist with month-end and year-end close processes, including preparing journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
  • Maintain accurate and complete accounting records and ensure transactions are properly coded and supported by appropriate documentation.
  • Support accounts receivable activities, including customer account reconciliations, cash application, collections support, and investigation of outstanding balances.
  • Support accounts payable activities, including invoice matching, payment processing, vendor statement reconciliations, and responding to vendor inquiries.
  • Assist with maintaining fixed asset records, prepaid expenses, accruals, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Assist with preparation of financial reports, management reporting, and other accounting schedules as required.
  • Support audit, tax, and other external reporting requirements by gathering documentation and providing accounting information.
  • Assist with maintaining appropriate internal controls and identifying discrepancies, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Work with operations and other departments to resolve accounting issues and ensure accurate financial information.
  • Assist with accounting system and data maintenance, including ensuring customer, vendor, and general ledger information is accurate and up to date.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and help develop more efficient and scalable accounting processes.
  • Perform other accounting and finance-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in accounting, finance, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Approximately 1–3 years of bookkeeping, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or general accounting experience preferred.
  • Foundational knowledge of accounting principles, reconciliations, and the accounts payable and purchase order cycle.
  • Working knowledge of Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and lookups; experience with accounting or ERP software is an asset.
  • Familiarity with U.S GAAP is an asset; manufacturing or consumer packaged goods experience is an asset.
  • Attention to detail, effective communication, and the ability to organize competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance on unfamiliar or complex issues.
  • Availability to work regular Pacific Time hours from Canada.

How you work

You bring accuracy, accountability, curiosity, and a service-oriented approach. You communicate clearly with vendors and colleagues and collaborate to resolve issues.

Benefits and development

Canadian health benefits and paid time off, subject to the applicable employment agreement and plan eligibility. Opportunities to develop accounting skills and contribute to a collaborative finance team.

Equal opportunity and accommodations

Arc Beverage is committed to equal employment opportunity and an inclusive workplace. Applicants will be considered without discrimination on grounds protected by applicable Canadian human rights legislation. Accommodations are available on request throughout the recruitment process.

You will own and optimise the end-to-end marketing leads flow, from attracting and qualifying prospects through to their handover to the Sales teams, while ensuring that marketing initiatives are aligned with the commercial strategy and revenue objectives.
Working closely with Product, Business Development, Sales, Sales Operations, Commercial Support, CRM/Technology and Commercial leadership, you will build structured processes, improve lead quality and optimise conversion performance across the marketing and sales funnel.

  • Developing and implementing the Revenue Marketing framework for the European region, ensuring that marketing activities directly contribute to pipeline growth and revenue generation.

  • Developing and maintaining monthly funnel performance reporting for senior management, providing clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve marketing ROI through structural funnel improvements, rather than relying solely on increased marketing investment.
  • Supporting the implementation and evolution of CRM processes, marketing automation systems and data governance frameworks related to revenue tracking, while collaborating with Sales Operations and Technology teams to optimise CRM data structures, reporting frameworks and marketing attribution models.

Your Profile:

  • Completed higher education in Business, Marketing, Economics, Data Analytics or a related field.
  • Between 5 and 8 years of experience in marketing, commercial strategy, revenue operations or a related discipline, ideally gained within a digital marketing agency.
  • Relevant experience within B2B environments, with a strong understanding of complex sales cycles and the dynamics between marketing, sales and commercial operations.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, marketing analytics tools and pipeline management processes.
  • Strong understanding of B2B marketing funnels, revenue attribution models and the key performance indicators that drive pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Advanced analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into practical, measurable commercial actions.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • Advanced proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Valid Category B driving licence.
  • A consistent focus on improving performance, identifying optimisation opportunities and implementing practical, results-oriented solutions.
  • Ability to objectively evaluate personal results, learn continuously and adapt approaches based on feedback and outcomes.
  • Proactive and internally customer-focused mindset, with the ability to identify stakeholder needs and deliver timely, effective and relevant solutions.
  • Solid understanding of organisational structures, culture and the cross-functional dynamics required to achieve commercial objectives.
  • Ability to listen to, understand and value colleagues’ perspectives, contributing to constructive, transparent and results-driven collaboration.

Compensation

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package.

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 115,000 employees from 160 nationalities, spanning 78 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.
