DIRECTOR OF CLINICAL SERVICES

Director of Clinical Services

Everleap Fertility is looking for an experienced Director of Clinical Services to work remotely with 30% travel to our US locations. This is a Monday-Friday from 8:30am-4:30pm.

Position Summary

The Director of Clinical Services provides network-level leadership and oversight of Medical Assistant, Sonography, Phlebotomy, and related clinical support services. This role establishes consistent clinical workflows, competencies, and quality standards to promote patient safety, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and exceptional patient experience.

The Director partners cross-functionally to reduce unnecessary practice variation, establish clear role and scope-of-practice expectations, and ensure clinical support teams are appropriately trained and operate at the top of their permitted scope.

Core Responsibilities

Clinical Services & Standardization

  • Provide network-level leadership for Medical Assistant, Sonography, Phlebotomy, and related clinical support functions.
  • Develop and maintain standardized policies, SOPs, workflows, competencies, and role expectations.
  • Establish standards for patient intake and rooming, phlebotomy and specimen handling, sonography, procedure support, point-of-care testing, clinical documentation, and room readiness.
  • Promote effective utilization of clinical support roles to improve patient flow, clinical capacity, and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with practice leadership to implement network standards and manage necessary state- or site-specific variations.

Patient Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Establish and monitor quality and safety standards for clinical support services.
  • Develop auditing processes for patient identification, specimen labeling and chain of custody, documentation, infection prevention, equipment, and clinical readiness.
  • Participate in incident review, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning within the role's scope.
  • Maintain readiness for applicable regulatory, accreditation, and internal audits.
  • Partner with appropriate stakeholders to operationalize regulatory requirements and address identified compliance gaps.
  • Ensure workflows align with applicable scope-of-practice, supervision, delegation, certification, licensure, and competency requirements.

Infection Prevention & Clinical Environment

  • Establish standards for infection prevention, cleaning, disinfection, sterilization, PPE, sharps safety, exposure response, and clinical waste management.
  • Standardize high-level disinfection processes for ultrasound probes and other applicable reusable equipment.
  • Establish clinical room, equipment, maintenance, calibration, and readiness standards.
  • Monitor compliance and support remediation of identified deficiencies.

Equipment, Supplies & Vendor Support

  • Establish clinical standards for equipment and supplies within the role's scope.
  • Partner with Procurement and Operations on product selection, standardization, equipment lifecycle planning, and vendor evaluation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness through appropriate standardization.

Training & Workforce Development

  • Develop standardized onboarding, training, and competency requirements for clinical support roles.
  • Ensure personnel have clearly defined responsibilities and validated competencies.
  • Promote top-of-scope practice, cross-training, and workforce flexibility within applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with practice leadership to address competency and performance gaps.

Continuous Improvement & Integration

  • Participate in compliance assessments during acquisition due diligence and support transition planning for newly integrated practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve clinical workflows, efficiency, throughput, and patient experience.
  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators for clinical support services.
  • Support new practice integrations, acquisitions, and de novo sites by assessing clinical workflows, staffing, competencies, equipment, supplies, and regulatory readiness.
  • Develop and support implementation plans to align new practices with network standards.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in nursing, healthcare administration, healthcare management, allied health, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and progressive healthcare leadership experience.
  • Significant progressive experience in ambulatory healthcare, multisite clinical operations, or a comparable healthcare environment.
  • Demonstrated experience leading clinical workflow standardization and operational improvement across multiple locations.
  • Strong knowledge of ambulatory clinical operations, patient safety, infection prevention, quality improvement, and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience with scope-of-practice requirements, clinical competencies, and workforce development.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence within a matrixed organization.
  • Strong communication, analytical, organizational, andchange-managementskills.
  • Ability to travel to practice locations as required.

Preferred

  • Advanced degree in nursing, healthcare administration, business administration, public health, or related field.
  • Relevant clinical licensure or professional certification.
  • Experience in reproductive medicine, women's health, ambulatory procedural care, or multi-site specialty healthcare.
  • Experience supporting integrations, acquisitions, or de novo clinical operations.
  • Experience implementing clinical standards across multiple states and regulatory environments.

Cada parceiro tem desafios e dinâmicas próprias, e nossa missão é arquitetar e sustentar a infraestrutura tecnológica exata para cada um deles.

Como pensamos (Nosso DNA)

Valorizamos quem tem BRIO!

Somos uma empresa formada por NERDs apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos com tecnologia inteligente. Atuamos com uma mentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Na GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH, mérito e entrega real andam juntos. Quem gera impacto e fortalece o time será sempre recompensado. Nossas lideranças e time sênior são formadas majoritariamente por profissionais que começaram como estagiários ou em cargos júnior. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos buscam futuros parceiros e sócios para a empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores [nossa base]

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.

Isso é GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

  • Liderança e mentoria:aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.
  • Voz ativa:a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos a inquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Venha construir o futuro da infraestrutura de crédito com a gente!

Na GIRO, unimos o melhor de dois mundos: tecnologia de alta performance e mercado financeiro. Para nós, segurança da informação não é um entrave burocrático; é o pilar que viabiliza nossas operações de crédito com máxima estabilidade, eficiência e confiança.

Se você tem a cabeça nerd e resolvedora de problemas, domina a fundo governança e riscos cibernéticos, e possui uma mentalidade de jogo infinito — entendendo que proteger a empresa é um compromisso contínuo e evolutivo —, queremos você no nosso time!

Nossa estrutura é enxuta e dinâmica. Por isso, você atuará de forma híbrida: com olhar altamente estratégico junto à diretoria e, ao mesmo tempo, "mão na massa", liderando diretamente as entregas de governança, conformidade regulatória, gestão de parceiros e a construção de uma cultura viva de segurança com todos os nossos colaboradores.

Aqui, a segurança é feita por pessoas e para pessoas. Seu objetivo será equilibrar proteção e agilidade, garantindo que o ecossistema da GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH continue crescendo rápido, seguro e no topo da vanguarda do mercado de crédito.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Resposta a Incidentes e Gestão de Fornecedores: Contratar, avaliar e gerenciar empresas terceirizadas de segurança (como SOC/MDR 24x7, ferramentas SaaS e consultorias de Pentest). Coordenar o Plano de Resposta a Incidentes e os Planos de Continuidade de Negócios e Recuperação de Desastres.
  • Liderança da Equipe e Orçamento: Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de segurança, definindo metas e prioridades. Elaborar e gerir o orçamento da área (ferramentas, serviços e pessoas) e acompanhar o roadmap de evolução da segurança da infraestrutura, incluindo o Programa de Acessos Críticos.

O que buscamos (requisitos)

  • Conformidade regulatória: conhecimento prático da LGPD e das regulamentações do Banco Central sobre segurança cibernética e contratação de serviços.
  • Continuidade e crises: experiência comprovada na elaboração e coordenação de Planos de Continuidade de Negócios (BCP) e Planos de Resposta a Incidentes (IRP).
  • Gestão de terceiros e SLAs: habilidade para negociar, contratar e auditar serviços gerenciados de segurança (SOC, testes de invasão e plataformas de conscientização).

Estamos buscando por pessoas que tenham brilho nos olhos por esses desafios e que queiram fazer parte da construção de um mundo melhor.

Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar novas parcerias, institucionais e comerciais, com empresas e associações, que envolvam contrapartidas como: eventos, posts em collab, estudos e pesquisas, cupons de desconto, referral partners, co-selling ou até mesmo revenue share.

jobs.title: Director, SAP BU Marketing
jobs.excerpt: The Director of Marketing for the SAP Business Unit acts as a “mini-CMO” for the BU: the single marketing leader accountable for turning SAP strategy into pipeline, brand, and growth.
jobs.description:
The Director of Marketing for the SAP Business Unit acts as a “mini-CMO” for the BU: the single marketing leader accountable for turning SAP strategy into pipeline, brand, and growth. Argano is an SAP Gold Partner. The SAP business unit helps enterprises plan, implement, and run SAP — S/4HANA and RISE with SAP, supply chain planning (IBP, PP/DS), Signavio, Ariba, Extended Warehouse Management, and SAP Business Technology Platform — with managed services after go-live. This role supports the SAP GTM across those offerings.

The role owns BU marketing strategy, product marketing messaging and positioning, campaign design, and, with the BU’s commercial leader, funnel velocity. It orchestrates Argano’s Demand Center of Excellence and Brand/Creative shared services, partners with Value Creation on solution launches, works with Alliances on SAP co-marketing, and partners with Analyst Relations on analyst and publisher briefings. We want a strong product marketer and a clear storyteller who measures success in pipeline.

RESPONSIBILITIES

BU Marketing Strategy & Product Marketing

  • Own the annual and quarterly SAP marketing plan; align spend across paid, events, content, ABM, and alliances to BU revenue and pipeline targets.
  • Define and maintain the SAP narrative, messaging hierarchy, positioning, and persona/buyer maps; keep every campaign and seller-facing asset aligned to them and to Argano’s high-performance operations story.
  • Translate the SAP GTM across S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, SAP Integrated Business Planning and PP/DS, Signavio, Ariba, Extended Warehouse Management, SAP Business Technology Platform (including Business AI), and managed services into outcomes buyers care about; maintain competitive intel and battlecards.
  • Turn client results into clear stories sellers can tell and buyers remember, framing clients as already high-performing.

Campaign Strategy & Funnel Mechanics

  • With the Demand Center of Excellence, design multi-touch campaigns across audience, offer, channel, and sales plays, including ABM and whitespace expansion in active, reactivated, and dormant accounts.
  • Own marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline targets for the SAP BU.
  • Partner with the BU’s commercial leader on funnel velocity (MQL/SQL/SAL/pipeline/closed-won by source, campaign, and publisher); find bottlenecks and rally teams to fix them.
  • Run a weekly pipeline-generation cadence with sellers and BDRs (theme, lists, talk tracks, follow-up) and a monthly SAP marketing operating review with the BU’s commercial leader: pipeline coverage, campaign performance, publisher ROI, and forward look.

Demand CoE: Campaigns, Sales Collateral & Events

  • Partner with the Demand Center of Excellence to scope, brief, and launch nurture, paid, ABM, webinar, and field programs in HubSpot and Salesforce.
  • Commission SAP sales collateral with Content/Brand shared services (pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, case studies, ROI tools) and equip sellers with talk tracks, ghost notes, and follow-up sequences.
  • Define the SAP event strategy and partner with Events and field marketing on publisher conferences, executive roundtables, and field events; represent Argano at major SAP ecosystem events.

Solution Launch: Partnering with Value Creation

  • Build market-ready SAP solution assets with Value Creation: positioning, naming, messaging, collateral, and demand plays.
  • Lead solution GTM launches, including sequencing, sales enablement, field activation, analyst/publisher briefings (with Analyst Relations), and demand kick-off.
  • Feed market signals (win/loss, objections, publisher roadmaps, conversation intelligence) back into Value Creation to sharpen the offering portfolio.

Publisher & Alliance Marketing

  • Own the SAP publisher marketing plan.
  • Partner with Alliances to secure and execute SAP-funded campaigns, MDF programs, and joint GTM motions through SAP partner programs; build relationships with SAP marketing counterparts.
  • Track and report SAP-sourced and SAP-influenced pipeline as a distinct funnel.

Organic Growth & Brand

  • Drive organic growth through SEO content, thought leadership, executive visibility, customer stories, community, and PR.
  • Build a content engine that sets out Argano’s point of view on SAP ERP modernization, RISE with SAP, supply chain planning, data, and AI.
  • Protect Argano brand standards while carrying a distinct SAP point of view across all communications.

jobs.title: Midwest Market Lead
jobs.excerpt: HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACTAs the Market Lead for Midwest, you'll have the opportunity to advance USGBC and GBCI's mission by increasing the adoption of green building products, services, and solutions while delivering measurable revenue growth.
jobs.description:
HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

As the Market Lead for Midwest, you'll have the opportunity to advance USGBC and GBCI's mission by increasing the adoption of green building products, services, and solutions while delivering measurable revenue growth.

The Market Lead is a revenue-generating sales role accountable for meeting or exceeding annual sales and revenue targets within a defined territory. You'll develop and execute territory-specific sales strategies, business development plans, and commercial activities to expand USGBC membership, LEED registrations and certifications, and other USGBC/GBCI products and services.

You'll work independently to build and manage a qualified sales pipeline, develop strategic relationships, negotiate and close new business, and achieve assigned revenue and product performance targets.

This position is responsible for one defined territory or market within the U.S. region. Commercial accountability, customer engagement, and sales execution will focus on that assigned territory, while collaborating with regional and global support teams as needed.

You'll represent USGBC and GBCI within your assigned market, cultivate relationships with members, customers, prospective buyers, and industry stakeholders, and convert those relationships into increased product adoption and revenue growth.

You'll lead business development across priority sectors and geographic areas within your territory, promoting USGBC/GBCI offerings such as membership, sponsorship, education, professional credentials, performance verification, project registration, and certification.

You'll also adapt approved marketing campaigns to local market conditions, strengthen strategic relationships, represent the organization at industry events, and contribute market insights and content that highlight sustainability leadership.

You will report to the regional director for U.S. Market Development and work closely with sales operations, customer account management, channel partner account management, client solutions, marketing and communications, and product teams to support effective commercial execution.

This role is ideal for a self-starter who thrives in an externally facing, growth-oriented environment and is motivated by purpose, performance, and measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Territory Sales Strategy and Revenue Growth:Develop and execute a go-to-market plan for the Midwest market aligned with regional commercial priorities and organizational objectives. Drive annual sales and revenue targets for USGBC/GBCI products and services, including membership, sponsorship, professional credentials, project registrations, certifications, and other approved offerings. Identify priority customer segments, market opportunities, and commercial activities that support sustainable revenue growth within the assigned territory.
  • Business Development and Pipeline Management:Build and manage a qualified sales pipeline by sourcing, qualifying, advancing, and closing leads, prospects, and commercial opportunities through direct outreach, targeted campaigns, and approved partner channels. Develop prospect lists and activation plans by market and sector. Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity, and forecast information in Salesforce. Take direct ownership of assigned new-business opportunities from initial engagement through commercial close, in accordance with approved sales processes.
  • Sales Execution, Negotiation, and Revenue Attainment:Negotiate and close new business, including memberships, sponsorships, and multi-product agreements, to meet assigned quarterly and annual sales targets. Apply consultative selling techniques to understand customer needs, position appropriate USGBC/GBCI offerings, and develop commercially viable solutions. Manage commercial opportunities within approved pricing, contracting, and decision-making authority, escalating exceptions to the regional director or other authorized stakeholders.
  • Customer Relationships and Account Development:Develop and maintain relationships with prospective customers, existing customers, members, senior executives, and other key stakeholders. Identify opportunities for product adoption, account growth, and continued engagement. Coordinate renewals, retention, cross-selling, lead handoffs, and customer onboarding with Customer Account Management, Sales Operations, and Client Solutions. Maintain clear responsibility for assigned new-business opportunities while coordinating existing account opportunities with the designated customer account owner.
  • Market Development and Campaign Execution:Execute approved regional or global marketing and sales campaigns within the assigned territory, adapting outreach and engagement activities to local customer needs, market conditions, and priority sectors. Convert market awareness and engagement into qualified opportunities and revenue-generating product adoption. Provide market feedback to marketing, sales enablement, and product teams to support effective campaign positioning and commercial outreach.
  • Strategic Partnerships and Industry Engagement:Cultivate relationships with industry associations, corporate and community partners, sustainability professionals, and other relevant stakeholders to strengthen market presence and generate commercial opportunities. Represent USGBC and GBCI at approved industry events, meetings, and conferences, supporting thought leadership and qualified lead generation. Coordinate channel partner-originated opportunities with channel partner account management to maintain clear partner and customer relationship ownership.
  • Strategic Account Opportunities and Product Adoption:Develop and execute growth plans for assigned strategic opportunities, expanding engagement and revenue across relevant USGBC/GBCI products and services. Identify customer needs related to membership, certification, credentials, education, and other offerings. Collaborate with customer account management and client solutions when opportunities involve existing customers, technical product questions, or ongoing customer relationship responsibilities.
  • Sales Performance, Forecasting, and Reporting:Track, monitor, and report on sales performance, including pipeline health, conversion rates, forecast accuracy, revenue outcomes, campaign effectiveness, and product adoption metrics. Maintain accurate and timely Salesforce records and participate in regular pipeline reviews and performance discussions with the Regional Director. Use sales data and market insights to identify performance gaps, prioritize opportunities, and recommend actions to improve territory results.
  • Market Intelligence and Cross-Functional Collaboration:Monitor local market trends, competitive activity, customer priorities, and relevant policy developments. Share insights with the Regional Director and appropriate USGBC/GBCI teams to inform commercial strategy, product positioning, and market development initiatives. Collaborate with Sales Operations, Account Management, Client Solutions, Marketing, Product, and other relevant teams to coordinate commercial activities and improve customer engagement. Support alignment with regional and global commercial processes while maintaining primary responsibility for the assigned territory.
  • Market Visibility and Organizational Representation:Contribute market stories, customer insights, and relevant content for approved USGBC/GBCI communication channels, including websites, newsletters, and social media. Highlight local sustainability leadership, successful projects, and market opportunities. Represent the organization professionally and consistently with approved messaging and organizational priorities. Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Assessment Notice

Candidates who advance in the interview process will be required to complete an assessment, more details will be provided as the time approaches.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or market development, preferably within the real estate, green building, sustainability, or related industries.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales and revenue targets, building and managing qualified sales pipelines, and negotiating and closing commercial agreements.
  • Experience developing and executing sales strategies, business development plans, and commercial outreach activities.
  • Experience engaging senior executives, decision-makers, corporate stakeholders, and industry partners through consultative selling and relationship development.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a defined sales territory, market, or customer segment with direct accountability for pipeline development and revenue generation.
  • Experience using CRM data to manage opportunities, maintain accurate sales forecasts, and monitor commercial performance.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional sales, account management, marketing, and product teams to support customer engagement and business development.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, international business, communications, real estate, sustainability, or a related field preferred.

Technology/System(s)

  • Proficiency with Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform, including using CRM data to manage pipeline and forecast revenue.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams, or comparable business productivity and collaboration tools.
  • Experience using CRM reports, sales dashboards, and pipeline tracking tools to monitor sales activities, conversion rates, and revenue performance.
  • Experience using virtual meeting, presentation, and digital collaboration platforms to engage customers and coordinate with regional and global teams.
  • Familiarity with sales prospecting, lead generation, or business intelligence tools is preferred.

Skills

  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to engage senior executives and decision-makers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare materials and present to diverse audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with a data-driven approach to commercial performance.
  • Financial literacy, budgeting, and the ability to interpret sales and revenue performance.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment, adapt to change, and maintain a results-oriented approach.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across organizational functions.
  • Ability to work independently, manage an assigned territory, and maintain accountability for individual sales and revenue targets.
  • Ability to develop and maintain relationships with customers and stakeholders across different industries, cultures, and professional backgrounds.
  • Ability to align territory-specific sales activities with regional market development priorities and approved organizational strategies.
  • Commitment to USGBC's mission and a desire for continuous professional growth and improvement.

Credentials/ Certifications

  • LEED Green Associate or LEED AP credential preferred, but not required.
  • Relevant professional certifications in sales, business development, or account management are a plus.

ABOUT OUR TOTAL REWARDS PACKAGE

Salary

Final compensation and benefits will be confirmed at the time of offer and may vary based on factors such as internal equity, relevant experience, qualifications, and employment status. Please note that salary negotiations will not extend beyond the top of the internal salary range.

Benefits

We offer you:

  • Competitive compensation
  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • Professional development reimbursement
  • We offer a healthcare plan through Cigna that includes medical, dental, vision, and prescription drugs. USGBC covers 100% of the premiums and an HRA that will assist you and your dependents in reaching the in-network medical deductible. You will only be responsible for the $300 individual / $600 family up front deductible for medical services before the employer funded HRA will process payments for your in-network claims
  • Generous paid time off (12 paid holidays, 9 paid personal sick days and based on career level either 2 to 3 weeks PTO), including operations closed for a full week between Christmas and New Year’s
  • 6 weeks paid renewal leave after 7 years of continuous service

LOGISTICS

Location:This position is remote in the Midwest market. We prefer to hire someone in the following cities: Metro Chicago, IL or Minneapolis, MN.

Work Schedule:Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM in candidate’s time zone. Flexibility to collaborate with regional and global teams across different time zones may be required.

Travel:Approximately 25% travel. Travel may include customer and partner meetings, industry events, and other market development activities within the assigned territory, with additional travel as approved.

EEO STATEMENT

The U.S. Green Building Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

ABOUT US

U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC)is a mission-driven nonprofit dedicated to accelerating and scaling the transformation of the built environment. Through LEED—the world’s most widely used green building rating system— and initiatives likes Greenbuild, the Center for Green Schools and advocacy, USGBC empowers professionals to drive market transformation that advances human and environmental health, climate resilience, and equity.

Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI)is the world’s leading sustainability and health certification and credentialing body, independently recognizing excellence in performance. GBCI administers project certifications and professional credentials and certificates includingLEED,PERFORM,SITES, andTRUE Zero Waste.

We are proud to be globally recognized for our leadership in green building, environmental performance, and sustainable development.

Our Global Impact

  • Over 120,000 LEED-certified commercial projects worldwide
  • Millions of square feetof certified healthy, efficient, low-carbon space
  • Recognition in 180+ countries for innovation in green building and business practices

Why Join Us?

At USGBC and GBCI, you’ll work alongside passionate, mission-aligned professionals who care deeply about people, the planet, and progress. We offer:

  • A purpose-driven, inclusive culture
  • Opportunities to grow your career and take ownership of meaningful work
  • A chance to make a measurable impact on global sustainability efforts
  • We’re seeking team members who thrive in collaborative environments, are committed to excellence, and want to build lasting partnerships that drive change in the built environment.

Meet Our Leaders and Learn More about our Mission:

  • U.S. Green Building Council Leaders
  • Green Business Certification Inc Leaders

Culture and Values Statement

Working together, each of us advances our mission by respecting all voices, trusting and supporting one another, excelling through collaboration and accountability, and continuously improving ourselves and our organization.

As the Manager, Pricing Strategy & Insights, you will help shape pricing strategy across H&R Block, spanning DIY tax preparation, Assisted in-person and Virtual services, and new products and services beyond tax. The Consortium Operations Manager leads the day-to-day operational execution of the Genesis Mission Consortium, translating strategic priorities and contractual commitments into coordinated workplans, staffing and resource plans, and timely delivery. The Consortium Lead retains overall accountability for RTI’s delivery of consortium activities, including implementation strategy, governance support, strategic sponsor relationships, major programmatic decisions with RTI’s authority, and overall performance.   • Maintain visibility across workstreams, dependencies, priorities, risks, and issues; work with functional leads to resolve execution challenges and escalate significant delivery, resource, strategic, governance, or sponsor matters to the Consortium Lead as appropriate.
  • Establish and maintain effective program management processes and operating rhythms appropriate to the size and complexity of the consortium.

Sponsor and Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a primary day-to-day operational point of contact for federal sponsors, in coordination with the Consortium Lead and designated sponsor/agency leads.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of briefings, status updates, decision materials, and other program information for sponsor and RTI leadership audiences.
  • Support the Consortium Lead in the preparation of senior sponsor engagements, strategic discussions, and major programmatic decisions.
  • Support integration of additional federal sponsoring agencies, working with agency leads and functional teams to accommodate sponsor-specific requirements while leveraging common Genesis Mission Consortium services and processes.
  • Coordinate follow-up on sponsor requests and agreed actions, ensuring clear ownership and timely responses, and escalating matters requiring Consortium Lead direction or contractual review.

Financial, Staffing & Operational Management

  • Lead program budgeting, forecasting, staffing, and resource planning in collaboration with the Consortium Lead, Financial Analyst, and functional leads.
  • Monitor and manage program expenditures against the budget, supported by the Financial Analyst, and assess actual and forecast costs against the contract values to identify emerging financial risks.

Monitor expenditures against amounts invoiced and coordinate resolution of billing delays or discrepancies.

Operational Improvement and Scaling

  • Develop and implement scalable operating approaches for supporting growth in consortium membership, programs, working groups, and federal sponsorship.

What You'll Need

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing concise program updates, briefings, and decision-support materials for senior audiences.

  • Periodic domestic travel may be required based on program needs.

Preferred

Hiring: Full-Time AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration) - Remote

⚡ Fast & Purposeful Recruiting– We move quickly but prioritize long-term fit, stability, and growth over just filling roles.

🌎 Connecting Global Talent– With 100+ outsourced professionals and growing, we link top talent worldwide with thriving US businesses.

❤️ Giving Back Matters– From building schools to feeding the homeless, we believe true success means making a difference.

🤝 An Inclusive & Thriving Culture– Your skills and unique gifts matter. We create an environment where outsourced professionals don't just work—they grow.

⚒️ Key Responsibilities of the AI Automation Engineer 📝

🔌 Middleware & Field Service Platform Integrations

🎙️ Voice AI Agent Engineering & Tuning

⚙️ Omnichannel & Back-Office Automation

🤝 Client Onboarding & Technical Support

📋 Internal Operations, Process Automation & SOPs

🔐 Data Security & Credential Management

Additional Information:

Review this Doc first!

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -

📢 Why Are They Hiring an AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration)? 🏢

Our client is hiring an AI Automation Engineer to bring all technical development, deployment, and fulfillment fully in-house, replacing a third-party agency that currently handles it. You'll build and own the custom middleware that connects AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to field service management systems like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro, so live phone conversations turn into accurate, booked jobs on a contractor's dispatch board. Beyond the build, your mission is reliability: proactively testing and monitoring voice agents so contractors get zero downtime and high booking accuracy, documenting the systems in clear SOPs, and laying the technical groundwork for upcoming enterprise industry partnerships in 2027. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you'll work directly with the founder and grow into technical leadership as the team expands.

If you're a proactive, code-first engineer who loves building voice agents and integrations that actually work in the real world, and you take pride in systems that never miss a call—this role could be a great fit for you. ✨

✅ Qualifications:

Must-Haves:

  • 🎙️ Voice AI Agent Experience– Hands-on experience building and deploying production voice agents with Vapi, Retell, Assistable, and/or ElevenLabs, including prompt tuning, latency optimization, and knowledge base design.
  • 💻 Real Coding Skills– Strong JavaScript and/or TypeScript; you write, review, and debug your own code (no "vibe coding"). Comfort reading .NET / C# / C++ environments is a big plus.
  • 🔌 APIs, Middleware & Integrations– Proven experience building middleware and integrations using REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and SDKs.
  • ⚙️ GoHighLevel Expertise– Solid experience building workflows, automations, and sub-account setups in GoHighLevel (GHL).
  • 🤖 Automation & Agent Frameworks– Experience with n8n, Hermes Agents, Composio, OpenClaw, or similar automation and agentic AI platforms.
  • 🔐 Security-Minded– Solid grasp of API security, data privacy, credential vaults, VPNs, and VPS hosting.
  • 💬 Clear Communication & Ownership– Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable supporting clients directly, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • 🏠 Field Service Management Experience– Direct experience with ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro, or with home service trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical).
  • 🧠 Advanced AI Concepts– Familiarity with RAG, MCP, and vector databases.
  • 🌐 Web & Marketing Tech– Website builders, hosting, landing pages, Google Business Profile, and AEO/SEO automation.
  • 🧑‍💻 Software Engineering Background– Software engineers or full-stack developers who have moved into AI automation and voice agents are an ideal match.

Responsibilities of the AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration):

Your responsibilities include:

  • 🔌 Middleware & Field Service Platform Integrations
  • Build and maintain custom middleware connecting AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to Field Service Management (FSM) systems
  • Integrate with platforms like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro using REST APIs and OAuth
  • Write integration logic that interfaces with .NET / C# / C++ backend environments
  • Program and verify end-to-end booking workflows that move live voice conversations straight into contractor dispatch schedules
  • Monitor, diagnose, and resolve sync issues such as duplicate bookings, dropped data payloads, or failed scheduling attempts
  • Code, review, and debug custom application logic in JavaScript and/or TypeScript
  • 🎙️ Voice AI Agent Engineering & Tuning
  • Build, configure, and maintain production-grade voice agents using Vapi, Retell, Assistable, and ElevenLabs
  • Fine-tune latency, test prompt frameworks, design agent harnesses, and curate dynamic knowledge bases
  • Architect multi-step decision trees and parent-child logic (e.g., distinguishing a tenant from a commercial property manager during an emergency call)
  • Run automated tests on conversational accuracy, speech recognition, and intent categorization to catch bugs before clients do
  • Keep after-hours call answering and emergency dispatch agents running reliably
  • ⚙️ Omnichannel & Back-Office Automation
  • Build and manage GoHighLevel workflows across SMS, email, appointment reminders, and estimate follow-up campaigns
  • Implement automations using platforms such as Hermes, OpenClaw, Composio, and n8n
  • Build AI agents that securely log into third-party portals to complete repetitive contractor admin tasks
  • Help build, test, and deploy company-wide automation packages for beta client accounts
  • 🤝 Client Onboarding & Technical Support
  • Join technical onboarding calls with new clients to gather system requirements, parameters, and integration details
  • Execute full client setup and integration during a typical two-month implementation window
  • Connect client information to their respective GoHighLevel sub-accounts
  • Proactively verify that client systems, credentials, and automations stay active, secure, and up to date
  • Handle technical support and troubleshooting when clients report issues
  • Escalate and resolve platform bugs directly with SaaS vendor support teams (including GoHighLevel)
  • Build client-facing and internal dashboards tracking voice minutes, booking volume, and system activity
  • 📋 Internal Operations, Process Automation & SOPs
  • Configure internal GoHighLevel automations (e.g., sending service agreements after payment, kicking off projects when documents are signed)
  • Document technical architectures and create SOPs for internal team execution
  • Recommend technical solutions and collaborate with the founder on system design
  • Work alongside the current fulfillment agency during a short overlap period to absorb existing workflows and system logic before taking full ownership
  • 🔐 Data Security & Credential Management
  • Enforce data privacy, API security, and protection protocols for client records and backend integrations
  • Manage and share sensitive credentials securely using tools like LastPass, NordPass, or One-Time Secret
  • Work through designated secure environments and VPN platforms
  • 🌐 Secondary Technical & Marketing Projects (Nice-to-Have)
  • Assist with website setup, landing pages, and hosting configurations as needed
  • Implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and automated AI content workflows
  • Support Google Business Profile connections and local marketing automations

🏡 Want to Know More About the Client?

Our client is an AI solutions company that provides specialized AI voice employees and business automation for home-service contractors—HVAC, plumbing, and electrical businesses that can't afford to miss a call. Their 24/7 voice agents answer inbound calls and texts, qualify leads, and book work straight onto the schedule, while automated follow-up systems make sure contractors never lose a job just because they're out on site. They also support field-tech operations, automated hiring assistance, and recurring-revenue workflows.

What sets them apart is where they come from. The company was built by operators, for operators—grounded in more than 20 years of HVAC industry relationships and a deep understanding of what keeps trade business owners up at night. With significant preferred-vendor partnerships rolling out in 2027, they're building an in-house technical team to deliver at scale, and you'll be at the very center of it. 🌟

Culture and Core Values:

This is a lean, high-trust team that moves fast, solves problems together, and genuinely cares about the contractors it serves. The guiding belief: "People don't care how much you know until they know how much you care."

  • 🏆 Extreme Ownership & Pride in Craftsmanship– Take deep pride in system quality and the real impact your work has on clients.
  • 🔭 Proactivity– Anticipate client needs and check systems before anyone has to report an issue.
  • 🤝 Mutual Trust & Integrity– Build trust through transparency, honesty, and reliable follow-through.
  • 🌱 Collaborative Growth– Learn together, experiment boldly, and build foundations that last.
  • 🔥 Care About the Outcome– Show up for the work and the client, especially when it matters most.

Here, flexibility goes both ways: the founder supports your personal life, and you show up when the systems and clients need you. 💯

What's in it for you? 😏

Joining this client means not just filling a role but embarking on a personal development journey. The growth potential is substantial, with opportunities to:

  • 🚀 Foundational Team Member– Be the first in-house technical hire and help build the company's technical foundation from the ground up.
  • 📈 Path to Technical Leadership– Grow into a leadership role and mentor future hires as the team expands.
  • 🔥 High-Growth Pipeline– Work on a product backed by deep industry relationships and major 2027 partnerships.
  • 💸 Performance Rewards– Strong potential for expanded responsibilities and performance-based compensation as the company grows.
  • 🧠 Real Technical Influence– Your recommendations shape architecture decisions directly with the founder.
  • ⚖️ Reciprocal Flexibility– Room for personal commitments and appointments, balanced with responsiveness during critical moments.

Your next big opportunity starts here—ready to take the leap? 🚀

🫥 WeAssist: 😌

(Not your average Recruiting Firm…)

Started by Reef Colman just seven years ago, is not your typical staffing agency...

We are a dynamic recruiting firm focused on creating fair opportunities in the business world. We have a team of over 100 people. We help US businesses find skilled remote workers and connect these workers with good employers.

What makes us different is how much we care about our people! We give good benefits, support personal growth, and get involved in the community. We also support good causes like building schools, helping the homeless, and improving education. Come join us at WeAssist, where remote workers do their best!

jobs.description:
About Mission Underwriting Services

At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.

What We Offer:

  • Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401K, 401K Match
  • Life and Disability Benefits
  • Unaccrued Paid Time Off
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • Employee Discounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Educational Assistance Program
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Paid Parental Leave

Purpose:

Mission is seeking an MLOps and AI Infrastructure Engineer to build and operate production-grade infrastructure across our agentic AI platforms. This hands-on role sits at the intersection of cloud engineering, DevOps, AI platform operations, and AI governance. The successful candidate will ensure that our AI infrastructure is secure, observable, scalable, resilient, auditable, and ready for enterprise production use.

This role owns the engineering practices that move AI workloads safely from development through production, including deployment automation, CI/CD, cloud security, monitoring and observability, incident response, model and agent lifecycle controls, model drift detection, and governance evidence. The role partners across engineering, data, product, security, and business teams to establish repeatable production-readiness standards across all three platforms.

Essential Duties/Functions:

AI infrastructure and production readiness

  • Define and implement production-readiness standards for the agentic AI platforms, covering deployment, security, observability, reliability, scalability, resilience, cost management, rollback, and auditability.
  • Design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and resilient AI infrastructure across Azure and AWS.
  • Establish reference architectures, environment standards, landing-zone patterns, and governance controls for agents, models, data, APIs, and platform components.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to identify operational and governance risks early and move prototypes into production safely.

DevOps, deployment, and CI/CD

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, applications, models, prompts, agents, configuration, and supporting services across development, test, and production environments.
  • Create reusable Terraform and Bicep modules with version control, peer review, automated validation, and policy-as-code controls.
  • Automate testing, security checks, approvals, artifact versioning, environment promotion, release controls, and rollback procedures using Azure DevOps and Bitbucket Pipelines.

Security, governance, and risk controls

  • Implement identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, network security, vulnerability management, configuration controls, and secure-by-default platform patterns.
  • Operationalize AI governance through model and agent inventories, version tracking, approvals, risk assessments, documentation, lineage, access controls, and audit evidence.
  • Partner with security, legal, compliance, and risk stakeholders to translate governance requirements into technical controls and repeatable operating practices.

Monitoring, observability, and model operations

  • Implement end-to-end monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and audit trails for AI platforms and their dependent services.
  • Monitor availability, latency, throughput, errors, data quality, model performance, token and cloud costs, security events, and user-impacting failures.
  • Establish controls for model, data, and concept drift, prompt and configuration changes, degraded output quality, and unexpected agent behavior.
  • Define thresholds, escalation paths, and remediation procedures for retraining, redeployment, rollback, and incident response; lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Networking, resilience, and scalability

  • Design and operate cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, firewalls, DNS, load balancing, private endpoints, and secure service-to-service communication.
  • Implement backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and failover strategies appropriate to AI workloads and business-critical services.
  • Plan capacity and performance and implement horizontal and vertical scaling while managing service limits, reliability, and cost.

Technical insights and business partnership

  • Provide technical direction, standards, code and architecture review.
  • Work effectively with business, delivery, product, data, security, and engineering stakeholders to communicate readiness, risk, dependencies, and tradeoffs.
  • Stay current with cloud, MLOps, AI platform, and governance practices and recommend improvements that strengthen production readiness.

Required Qualifications:

  • Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, MLOps, or AI platform engineering across AWS and Azure.
  • Professional-level architecture certification in both AWS and Azure is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Bitbucket Pipelines, and CI/CD for production systems.
  • Strong experience with Terraform, Bicep, infrastructure as code, version control, peer review, and policy as code.
  • Experience with cloud security, IAM, networking, secrets management, encryption, vulnerability management, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting, tracing, observability, and auditability for distributed systems.
  • Practical MLOps or AI platform operations experience, including deployment, versioning, performance monitoring, drift detection, and rollback.
  • Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, data privacy, model risk management, and audit or regulatory compliance.
  • Experience supporting business users or working in a forward-deployed, customer-facing, or similarly stakeholder-intensive technical role.
  • Ability to deploy, operate, and troubleshoot APIs across Azure and AWS.
  • Experience delivering AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, machine learning, or agent frameworks.
  • Ability to deploy and manage Databricks environments in Azure using infrastructure as code.
  • Strong problem-solving, written and verbal communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Cloud architect certification or equivalent architecture experience.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration, including Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with observability platforms and practices for distributed applications and AI workloads.
  • Experience with model registries, experiment tracking, evaluation frameworks, feature management, or AI platform services.
  • Experience with OAuth, JWT, API management, gateways, and secure service integration.
  • Experience building data pipelines and analytics solutions using Python, SQL, and Spark is a plus
  • Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and capacity planning.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated environment.
  • Experience with Agile, DevOps, automated testing, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong knowledge of cloud architecture, MLOps, infrastructure as code, DevOps, and production operations.
  • Ability to design production-ready AI infrastructure and translate AI governance requirements into measurable technical controls.
  • Ability to use monitoring and observability signals to identify model drift, AI quality issues, reliability risks, and operational bottlenecks.
  • Strong understanding of security, privacy, risk management, auditability, and responsible AI practices.
  • Strong incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement skills.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the ability to explain risk and tradeoffs.
  • Ability to lead through influence, mentor teammates, and establish practical engineering standards.
  • Strong documentation, metrics, dashboarding, and operational reporting skills.
  • Proficiency with Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, Terraform, Bicep, and common monitoring and observability tools.

Start-up-Spirit trifft Konzern-Power:Yorizon ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von HOCHTIEF. HOCHTIEF ist ein technisch ausgerichteter, globaler Infrastrukturkonzern mit führenden Positionen in seinen Kernaktivitäten Bau, Dienstleistungen und Konzessionen/Public-Private-Partnerships (PPP) und mit Tätigkeitsschwerpunkten in Australien, Nordamerika und Europa. So verbinden wir agilen Pioniergeist und flache Hierarchien mit der Stabilität eines internationalen Konzerns.

Dein Wirkungsbereich:

Als Netzwerkarchitekt (m/w/d) im Team Data Center Operations entwirfst Du das Netzwerk unserer Cloud. Es reicht vom Spine-Leaf-Fabric über Multi-Tenant-Netze in OpenStack und Kubernetes bis zu GPU-Clustern für AI-Workloads, und das über mehrere Rechenzentrumsstandorte hinweg. Du legst fest, wie unser Netz heute und in drei Jahren aussieht, und arbeitest dabei eng mit unseren Plattform- und Operations-Teams zusammen.

Deine Rolle:

  • Architektur & Design:Du entwirfst skalierbare, hochverfügbare Netzwerkarchitekturen für unsere Multi-Datacenter-Umgebung auf Basis von OpenStack und Kubernetes.

  • High-Performance-Netzwerke für AI:Du planst Netzwerktopologien für GPU-Cluster mit RoCE, InfiniBand und lossless Ethernet und optimierst sie für verteiltes Training und latenzkritische Anwendungen.
  • Multi-DC-Strategie: Du verantwortest Inter-DC-Connectivity, Geo-Redundanz, Failover-Szenarien sowie Disaster-Recovery- und Business-Continuity-Konzepte.
  • Performance & Betrieb: Du sorgst für Verfügbarkeit, Performance und Sicherheit des Netzes, unter anderem durch Load-Balancing, Traffic-Engineering, QoS und Kapazitätsplanung.
  • Technologieauswahl: Du bewertest neue Netzwerktechnologien und Standards und triffst fundierte Entscheidungen, gerne auch für offene Lösungen wie SONiC.
  • Wissen teilen:Du erstellst Architekturdiagramme, Standards und Best-Practice-Leitfäden, berätst Entwicklungs- und Operations-Teams und gestaltest Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen mit.

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Architektur und Betrieb von Netzwerken in Rechenzentren. Du hast physische DC-Infrastruktur selbst geplant und betrieben, nicht nur Cloud-Netze bei Hyperscalern konfiguriert. Ob Du dafür ein Informatikstudium oder einen anderen Weg gegangen bist, ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was Du kannst.
  • Fundiertes Know-how in modernen DC-Architekturen (Spine-Leaf/CLOS) und Routing mit BGP und EVPN-VXLAN
  • Erfahrung mit Netzwerkvirtualisierung in OpenStack (Neutron, OVN/OVS) und/oder Kubernetes (CNI, Network Policies, Ingress)
  • Praxis mit Automatisierung und Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitOps
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Netzwerkthemen verständlich zu erklären und Entscheidungen sauber zu dokumentieren
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen zu unseren Rechenzentrumsstandorten

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit GPU-Netzwerken: RDMA/RoCE, InfiniBand, GPUDirect, NVLink/NVSwitch
    Verständnis für die Netzwerkanforderungen von verteiltem AI-Training (NCCL, MPI, All-Reduce)
  • Erfahrung mit SONiC, P4 oder anderen SDN-Ansätzen
  • Erfahrung mit 100G/400G Ethernet und optischen Netzen
  • Monitoring mit Prometheus, Grafana oder ELK
  • Zertifizierungen wie CCIE, CKA oder NVIDIA NCP, die für uns aber kein Muss sind

Unser Angebot:

  • Teamspirit:Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, wachsenden Teams mit echter Du-Kultur. Wir bieten dir den Freiraum, deine Talente aktiv einzubringen und die Zukunft des Unternehmens mitzugestalten.
  • Karrierechancen: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Nutze die vielfältigen Aufstiegschancen in einem expandierenden Umfeld und profitiere von unseren spannenden internationalen Perspektiven.
  • Remote first:Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Arbeite 100 % remote aus Deutschland oder Österreich oder hybrid an unseren Standorten in Berlin, Augsburg oder Wien.
  • Deine Entwicklung:Wir investieren in dich. Mit einem eigenen Weiterbildungsbudget entscheidest du selbst, welche fachlichen oder persönlichen Skills du als Nächstes vertiefen möchtest.
  • Equipment: Damit du Bestleistungen bringen kannst, bekommst du das passende Werkzeug. Wähle frei zwischen modernsten Apple- oder Windows-Geräten.
  • Mobilität:Wir bezuschussen dein Deutschlandticket, damit du entspannt und nachhaltig unterwegs bist.
  • Wellbeing:Mit Wellpass nutzt du tausende Fitnessstudios, Schwimmbäder, Yoga- und Wellnessangebote in ganz Deutschland, ganz flexibel nach deinem Geschmack.
  • Zeit für dich:Freu dich auf 30 Urlaubstage. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns zusätzlich komplett frei.
  • Purpose: Für dein ehrenamtliches Engagement bekommst du einen zusätzlichen freien Tag.

Bereit für die Herausforderung?

Du willst das Netzwerk einer souveränen europäischen Cloud von Grund auf mitprägen, von der Fabric bis zum GPU-Cluster? Dann bewirb Dich bei uns. Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Product Manager

POSITION SUMMARY

Help shape the digital experiences that connect hospitality organizations with their guests. Uniguest is seeking an entrepreneurial Product Manager to own and evolve our Hub product, turning customer insights into capabilities that strengthen guest engagement, improve experiences, and drive company growth.

As part of Uniguest’s Global Product Management team, you will own the product roadmap and guide initiatives from discovery through development, launch, and continuous improvement. You’ll work directly with hospitality customers to understand how they use digital channels to inform, engage, and serve guests, while partnering closely with engineering, design, and commercial teams to bring solutions to market. This role combines strategic product ownership with hands-on Agile delivery, including managing the backlog, shaping user stories, and advancing integrations across the hospitality technology ecosystem.

If you enjoy solving customer problems, making data-informed decisions, and seeing your ideas translate into measurable results, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a growing hospitality SaaS product focused on guest-facing digital engagement.

This is a remote position based in the United States, with occasional travel of up to 15% for customer meetings, customer advisory board meetings, sales kickoffs, and similar events. Regular or weekly travel is not expected.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define and build innovative capabilities that drive growth, customer outcomes and differentiation for the Hub product across hotel and resort properties
  • Serve as the Product Owner within an Agile Scrum environment by managing the product backlog, writing high‑quality user stories and acceptance criteria, and guiding features through development, testing, and release.
  • Collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams - including engineering, design, sales, marketing, services, and support - to ensure successful product launches and strong market adoption.
  • Drive product performance through data‑driven decision‑making, experimentation, and continuous iteration.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to inform and refine the product roadmap.
  • Maintain expertise in hospitality industry trends, guest technology, and familiarity with third‑party systems ecosystem, including PMS, POS, CRM/loyalty and others.
  • Create clear, compelling customer‑facing product documentation, such as release notes, feature guides, and capability one‑pagers,
  • Engage directly with key customers - including hotel brands, management companies, and on‑property teams - to understand guest experience workflows, challenges, and unmet needs, ensuring that voice of customer directly informs product decisions.
  • Partner closely with engineering to translate customer insights into user stories and requirements, including integrations with third‑party hospitality systems, ensuring solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with business goals.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

  • Skilled in Agile methodologies and the full SDLC, with strong capabilities in requirements elicitation and translating needs into clear user stories.
  • Deep experience with SaaS products, in hospitality or guest‑facing technology.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset focused on driving product‑led growth and market impact.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem‑solving skills; thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
  • 5+ years in Product Management; familiarity with JIRA and Confluence is a plus.
  • Confident working directly with hospitality stakeholders—brand, property operations, IT, and guest‑experience teams - to understand needs and drive meaningful outcomes.
  • Experience integrating with property management systems (e.g., Oracle OPERA, Mews) or partnering with major hospitality technology vendors, such as POS, CRM/loyalty, or guest‑engagement platforms.
  • Solid understanding of SaaS product management and the Agile lifecycle from discovery through launch and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, commercial, and business teams.
  • Growth mindset with a passion for learning, experimentation, and delivering innovations that improve guest and staff experiences.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Ability to travel up to 15% of the time.

Uniguest is the global leader in providing highly secure, fully managed customer-facing technology solutions on an outsourced basis to the hospitality, senior living, specialty retail, education, and corporate sectors. Our suite of turnkey consumer-facing technology solutions includes hardware and software solution packages, system implementation, and 24/7/365 multi-lingual support for public space kiosks, purpose-built kiosks (PC, iMac, tablet), digital signage, Interactive TV, tablets, remote printing, and more – all designed to deliver a consistent and safe experience to our clients’ customers.

A Software Configuration Manager is part of a team that manages, automates, and sustains the software configuration and release lifecycle using a wide variety of tools and platforms. Software Configuration Managers are expected to be proficient in configuration management principles, version control, build automation, and deployment pipeline integration. They must be able to establish and enforce baseline configurations, support continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows, and ensure software artifacts comply with Department of Navy (DoN) deployment standards. They work closely with software developers, cybersecurity personnel, and project leads to quickly troubleshoot pipeline or release issues and make recommendations to improve baseline governance, traceability, and deployment efficiency.

As with any position, additional expectations exist. Some of these include, but are not limited to, adhering to typical working hours, meeting deadlines, following customer company and policies as outlined by the Employee Handbook, communicating regularly with assigned supervisor, and staying focused on the assigned tasks.

Responsibilities

  • Support continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline development, maintenance, and automated build execution.
  • Deliver and deploy software deliverables into Department of Navy (DoN) DevSecOps environments and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage source code repositories, branching/merging strategies, version control structures, and software tagging using tools like GitLab and Azure DevOps.
  • Review software configuration requirements and support sprint/iteration planning, capacity planning, and retrospectives within Agile/SAFe frameworks.
  • Support and ensure project team compliance with CMMI, ISO, and Navy software release objectives and processes.
  • Thoroughly validate release packages, build artifacts, and deployment scripts to minimize discrepancies and build failures.
  • Generate and maintain project documentation and configuration tracking tickets (e.g., YouTrack, GitLab, Azure ADO tickets), ensuring tickets are updated in a timely manner.
  • Work closely with software developers, systems architects, and cybersecurity specialists to ensure configuration baselines align with Cyber Workforce and security controls.
  • Follow established software configuration management plans, release standards, and deployment procedures.
  • Proactively recommend alternative processes, technologies, or automation scripts to improve build performance or reduce build time and deployment costs.
  • Help troubleshoot and resolve build failures, environment discrepancies, and deployment pipeline issues.
  • Effectively communicate with customers, program leads, and team members regarding software build statuses, release notes, and configuration baselines.

Basic Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance

    • Familiarity with Agile or SAFe software development methodologies.
    • Understanding of Department of Navy (DoN) cloud ecosystems, DevSecOps pipelines, or enterprise software delivery factories (e.g., Overmatch Software Armory / OSA, NavFactory).

jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewPearson Virtual Schools operates learning platforms that serve schools, teachers, and students at enterprise scale, and we are actively rebuilding parts of our technology foundation to be more resilient, secure, and cloud-native.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Pearson Virtual Schools operates learning platforms that serve schools, teachers, and students at enterprise scale, and we are actively rebuilding parts of our technology foundation to be more resilient, secure, and cloud-native. This work sits at the intersection of high-velocity product delivery and the governance expectations of a large, regulated enterprise.

As our Principal Enterprise Architect, you lead transformative architectural initiatives for our core platforms, orchestrating large-scale changes that improve performance, security, and interoperability. You balance strategic planning with hands-on technical execution: guiding teams through detailed designs, leading complex integrations, and making the calls that reduce legacy dependencies and technical risk. Your influence extends to cross-functional steering committees and project boards, where your technical judgment shapes the prioritization of multi-year platform investments.

This is not an ivory-tower architecture role. You will spend real time on designs, code, and incident retrospectives alongside engineering teams, bringing the pragmatic, ship-and-learn instincts of a high-growth startup to an enterprise setting that has to get security, compliance, and reliability right.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy & Enterprise Modernization

  • Define the north-star technical architecture for PVS's core platforms, aligning business strategy with modern, sustainable cloud topologies.

  • Lead the migration and refactoring of legacy, monolithic, or on-premise systems into decoupled, cloud-native architectures.

  • Own multi-year modernization roadmaps that balance pragmatic delivery with long-term platform health, sequencing initiatives for measurable reductions in legacy dependencies.

  • Present architectural strategy and trade-offs to cross-functional steering committees and project boards, driving alignment and prioritization on platform investment.

Cloud-Native, Event-Driven & API Patterns

  • Design systems for elastic, demand-driven scaling, including workloads that scale to zero when idle and scale out based on real-time queue depth.

  • Architect loosely coupled, event-driven integrations using message brokers and event streams, applying saga patterns to manage complex distributed transactions.

  • Establish API-first design discipline across REST, gRPC, and GraphQL contracts so services integrate cleanly and predictably.

  • Guide adoption of agentic and autonomous processing patterns, including background workers, self-healing units, and AI/LLM orchestration, where they solve real platform problems.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Define, document, and champion architectural patterns and guardrails across engineering teams, ensuring consistency without stifling team-level autonomy.

  • Act as a hands-on technical leader: review designs, unblock complex integration problems, and step into implementation when a team needs it, not just diagrams.

  • Mentor senior engineers and architects on modern cloud patterns, distributed-systems trade-offs, and pragmatic sequencing of technical debt versus new investment.

  • Model a bias for action, bringing an iterative, ship-and-learn mindset while operating within enterprise governance and risk expectations.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Governance

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering & product leaders and executive stakeholders, translating architectural decisions into business impact, risk, and cost.

  • Partner with cybersecurity, data governance, and compliance teams to ensure architectural decisions meet enterprise security and regulatory standards.

  • Evaluate vendor platforms and build-vs-buy decisions, weighing cost, resilience, and integration complexity.

  • Track and report on architecture health: uptime, IT service levels, integration risk, and adoption of modern patterns across business platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering and systems architecture experience, with demonstrated progression into enterprise-scale architecture roles.

  • Significant tenure at fast-growing, internet-based startups, with firsthand experience building under constraints, scaling rapidly, and making pragmatic trade-offs.

  • Proven track record modernizing legacy, on-premise, or monolithic enterprise systems into cloud-native architectures.

  • Deep expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and the foundational patterns that make cloud services resilient and cost-effective.

  • Hands-on experience with event-driven and asynchronous integration: message brokers, event streams (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS EventBridge), and saga patterns for distributed transactions.

  • Strong discipline in API-first design (REST, gRPC, GraphQL) as the contract layer between services.

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, serverless container environments) at production scale.

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows, background/autonomous processing, and modern AI/LLM orchestration patterns.

  • Exceptional communication skills, comfortable pitching architectural vision to executive stakeholders and debugging distributed-systems issues with senior engineers in the same week.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent; advanced degree a plus.

  • EdTech, SaaS, or K-12 platform experience a plus, not required.

Key Behaviors & Attributes

Transformation-Minded: You treat legacy complexity as an opportunity, not a threat, and lead teams into modernization with conviction and empathy.

Bias Toward Action: You bring the ship-fast instincts of a startup into an enterprise setting - pragmatic trade-offs over perfect designs, without cutting corners on risk.

Strategic and Grounded: You translate a multi-year architecture strategy into concrete, sequenced technical decisions that teams can actually execute.

Hands-On by Default: You stay close to the code and the design reviews - this is a working architect role, not a diagrams-only role.

Trusted Advisor: You move fluidly between a C-suite architecture pitch and a debugging session on an asynchronous race condition, and both audiences trust your judgment.

Collaborative by Default: You build guardrails and patterns with engineering teams, not for them, so adoption sticks without heavy-handed enforcement.

Key Relationships

Direct Reports: None — individual contributor role; sets technical direction and mentors senior engineers and architects across teams

Peers: Lead, Solution Architecture; Lead, Service Operations & Cyber Risk; other senior technical leaders within Platform & Security

Cross-functional: Engineering, Product Management, Security, Data Governance, and DevSecOps teams across PVS

External: Cloud and vendor platform partners, Pearson corporate technology

Pearson is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
