Job Description

Overview


We are seeking a Senior Licensing Engineer Energy – Remote. This remote position is based out of our Oak Ridge, TN office.


Your role


  • Leads the development and integration of 10 CFR Part 70 license applications for fuel cycle facilities.
  • Sets the regulatory approach for assigned scope, owns the integration and quality of the application package across content prepared by multiple organizations, and provides technical direction to licensing engineers.
  • Works with limited supervision, exercise independent regulatory judgment, and represent AtkinsRéalis with clients, subcontractors, and the NRC.
  • Leads development of assigned portions of 10 CFR Part 70 license applications, establishing the regulatory approach and defending it with the client and internally.
  • Owns application integration and quality assurance, including the crosswalk against NRC acceptance criteria, the assumptions register, and the section templates and drafting conventions used across the application.
  • Owns the licensing commitments framework, including identification of commitment language, traceability to source sections and regulatory bases, and control of commitments across content prepared by multiple organizations.
  • Reviews application content furnished by clients, subcontractors, and other contractors for regulatory adequacy and interface alignment, and resolves conflicts across sections.
  • Provides technical direction to subcontracted licensing scope, including scoping, review of deliverables, and integration into the application package.
  • Determines where bounding assumptions are appropriate in place of mature design information, and judges when an assumption must be closed.
  • Prepares and defends position papers where the existing regulatory framework does not directly apply, and leads interactions with the NRC including pre-application engagement, audits, and responses to requests for additional information.
  • Provides technical direction, review, and mentoring to licensing engineers, and checks their work before issue.
  • Accountable for the technical quality and timely delivery of assigned licensing scope, including identifying and resolving issues that affect schedule or regulatory defensibility.
  • Supports scoping, estimating, and proposal development for fuel cycle licensing pursuits.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

About you

  • Requires a Bachelor's degree in Nuclear Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Health Physics, or a related engineering or technical discipline. Master's degree desirable.
  • Requires 7 years of relevant nuclear industry experience, with significant experience in licensing and regulatory affairs.
  • Demonstrated experience leading the technical and regulatory direction of a license application section or package, including content prepared by others.
  • Experience working directly with the NRC or another regulatory authority, including pre-application engagement or responses to requests for additional information.
  • Experience working with designers and engineers to develop safety analysis or licensing basis documentation.
  • Deep working knowledge of 10 CFR and associated NRC regulatory and industry guidance, with the ability to establish and defend a regulatory position.
  • Working knowledge of the licensing framework for facilities possessing and using special nuclear material, including 10 CFR Part 70 and the material control and accountability requirements of 10 CFR Part 74.
  • Ability to structure a license application against NRC acceptance criteria, including the guidance in NUREG-1520, and to maintain its integrity as content matures.
  • Ability to make and defend judgments about the use of bounding assumptions where design information is conceptual or incomplete.
  • Demonstrated ability to direct and integrate licensing content prepared by multiple organizations, including subcontractors and client-furnished sections.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical direction, review, and mentoring to less experienced licensing staff.
  • Excellent technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to present and defend licensing positions to clients and regulators.
  • Familiarity with fuel cycle facility processes, uranium chemistry, material forms, and radiological and chemical hazards is desirable.
  • Experience licensing facilities under 10 CFR Part 70, including license applications or amendment requests for fuel cycle facilities preferred.
  • Experience with the integrated safety analysis process, items relied on for safety, and management measures preferred.
  • Experience with fuel fabrication, conversion, deconversion, enrichment, or other fuel cycle operations preferred.
  • Experience with material control and accountability under 10 CFR Part 74, physical protection under 10 CFR Part 73, or transportation under 10 CFR Part 71 preferred.
  • Experience preparing Environmental Reports under 10 CFR Part 51, or with advanced reactor fuel supply chain projects including high-assay low-enriched uranium deconversion and fuel fabrication preferred.
  • Experience mentoring or supervising licensing staff preferred.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or other relevant nuclear industry qualifications are desirable.

jobs.excerpt: Do you relish the prospect of leading cross-organization, transformational programs?
jobs.description:
Do you relish the prospect of leading cross-organization, transformational programs?

Do you thrive on managing complexity?

Join our Program Management team!

Our Akamai Information Technology organization is a team of industry-leading professionals dedicated to owning/driving the innovation of Akamai's Corporate Infrastructure, Applications, Development, Security, and Compliance for our customers/corporate stakeholders. Information Technology manages all aspects of the IT Program Lifecycle as well as the coordination and delivery of key cross-organizational strategic programs.

Work with programs across Akamai

As a Technical Program Manager II, you will have end-to-end accountability for the delivery of assigned projects and programs. You will lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from planning to sustainment, coordinating delivery across teams, and reporting progress/program benefits to key stakeholders.

As a Program Manager II Technical, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the definition, planning, scope, and execution of assigned IT projects and programs, including complex, multi-year initiatives
  • Defining integrated project and program plans, including detailed work breakdown structures, deliverables, milestones, and team responsibilities
  • Identifying and managing dependencies across teams, projects, and programs to support coordinated delivery
  • Managing project and program health, anticipating risks and issues, and working with teams to implement mitigation plans
  • Working independently to clarify requirements, resolve delivery challenges, and keep teams aligned on priorities and next steps
  • Managing stakeholder engagement and expectations, and communicating status, risks, and program benefits to technical teams, business stakeholders, and executives
  • Coordinating external implementation providers and internal teams to deliver agreed outcomes

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have at least 5 years of relevant experience and a bachelor's degree in Business Management or its equivalent
  • Have professional experience as a Project Manager, Program Manager, Business Analyst, or Consultant supporting IT projects or programs
  • Have sufficient technical understanding to work credibly with technical teams, assess project risks and issues, and communicate technical dependencies
  • Have experience delivering IT implementations, such as software-as-a-service (SaaS) applications or infrastructure upgrades, and managing external implementation providers
  • Demonstrate great leadership, interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills
  • Be able to work effectively across a wide range of stakeholders in a diverse corporate environment, including technical teams and senior leadership

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Compensation

Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $100,700 - $181,300/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. jobs.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Analista de Crédito Imobiliário
jobs.excerpt: Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndarSomos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina.
jobs.description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões.

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse:

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

  • Remote-First:Atuamos no modelo remote-first, oferecendo total flexibilidade para você trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Para quem gosta de encontros presenciais, disponibilizamos nosso escritório em São Paulo e coworkings parceiros. Além disso, contamos com o programa Work From Anywhere (WFA), que permite trabalhar remotamente de qualquer lugar do mundo por até 90 dias no ano. Esse time tem encontros a cada 2 meses, mas para quem não mora em São Paulo, isso não é obrigatório.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

Você é apaixonado(a) por construir coisas novas e fazer parte de um time que está moldando o futuro? 🚀

Estamos em busca de pessoas com espírito empreendedor, proatividade e senso crítico apurado, que gostem de aprender rápido, resolver problemas complexos e contribuir em um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico.

Se você tem perfil técnico, atenção aos detalhes e vontade de transformar a jornada do crédito imobiliário, essa vaga é para você!

O que você vai fazer por aqui 🏡

Sua missão será garantir a agilidade e a qualidade em todo o processo de financiamento imobiliário, atuando como peça-chave na experiência dos nossos clientes.

Entre suas principais responsabilidades, estão:

  • Avaliar e recomendar as melhores opções de crédito conforme o perfil de cada cliente, de forma personalizada e estratégica;
  • Analisar as documentações recebidas da equipe de atendimento, assegurando a conformidade e a qualidade das informações;
  • Inserir e enviar os dados/documentos nas plataformas das instituições financeiras;
  • Manter os processos atualizados nos sistemas internos e apoiar a equipe de atendimento com dúvidas técnicas;
  • Acompanhar de perto a jornada do cliente nos bancos, garantindo fluidez e cobrando agilidade de BPOs ou prepostos quando necessário;
  • Realizar contestações para defesa de crédito ou análise jurídica, sempre que for preciso;
  • Garantir o correto pagamento às partes envolvidas ao fim do processo.

O que esperamos de você 📋

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Experiência prévia de pelo menos 1 ano com crédito imobiliário;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de crédito imobiliário dos bancos: Itaú, Santander, Bradesco e/ou Caixa Econômica Federal;
  • Domínio das normas e regras do FGTS aplicáveis ao financiamento imobiliário;
  • Certificações necessários: CA-300, CA-600 ou ANEPS, LGPD e PLDFT;
  • Boa comunicação, verbal e escrita, senso de urgência e comprometimento;
  • Habilidade em gestão de tempo e foco em resultados;
  • Perfil propositivo, com olhar constante para melhorias e aprimoramento da experiência do cliente.

Por que trabalhar com a gente? 🤝

Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo, a colaboração e a construção coletiva. Valorizamos pessoas curiosas, com brilho nos olhos, que gostam de fazer acontecer e querem crescer junto com o negócio.

Vamos juntos transformar o mercado de crédito imobiliário?

Candidate-se e venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Como é nosso processo seletivo?

Desenhamos uma jornada transparente, direta e focada em avaliar seu potencial técnico, comportamental e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e trilhas de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

  • Aplicação e triagem
  • Entrevista com recrutamento
  • Painel prático
  • Entrevista com liderança
  • Oferta

Importante: Avaliamos todas as candidaturas individualmente e garantimos retorno para todas as pessoas. Toda a comunicação é feita por e-mail, então certifique-se de liberar o domínio @quintoandar.com.br na sua caixa de entrada.


Benefícios

Oferecemos um pacote completo focado na sua saúde, bem-estar, família e desenvolvimento:

  • Remuneração: Salário competitivo, Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR - para funções elegíveis) e Remuneração Variável (para funções elegíveis).
  • Saúde e Bem-Estar: Plano de Saúde, Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Wellhub (Gympass) e QuintoCare (apoio psicológico, jurídico, social e financeiro gratuito).
  • Qualidade de Vida: Vale Refeição e Alimentação, Day Off de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais.
  • Flexibilidade: Auxílio Home Office e programa Work From Anywhere (WFA).
  • Família e Cuidado: Auxílio Creche, Auxílio Parentalidade Atípica, Licença Parental Estendida e Kit Leiturinha.
  • Educação e carreira: Parcerias com instituições de ensino;

Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas! Você verificará que existem algumas perguntas sobre diversidade no formulário de inscrição. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público-alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura.

Privacidade e Proteção a Dados

O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo, mas não se limitando à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato com a gente pelo Canal de Atendimento.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Embedded
jobs.excerpt: Opportunity is not evenly distributed.  Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business.
jobs.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

PURPOSE OF POSITION:

The Salesforce Administrator is responsible for maintaining, configuring, and optimizing the Salesforce platform to support operational efficiency, internal business processes, and reporting. The administrator will work closely with leadership, developers, and the user community to gather requirements, execute Salesforce configurations, and conduct testing. The successful candidate must balance analytical problem-solving with hands-on technical configuration to translate business needs into functional solutions. This role requires strong communication, business process analysis skills, a diligent work ethic, and a collaborative, positive presence.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as one of the primary systems administrators for the Salesforce.com environment of 400+ users

  • Conduct business requirement gathering sessions that detail end-to-end process mapping

  • Develop user stories and to-be process flows to support the design and development of Salesforce solutions

  • Work collaboratively with team members to design and execute solutions that include data mapping, object modeling, page layout design, and automated business processes.

  • Implement new enhancements including the creation of custom objects, advanced Salesforce Flows, email alerts, approval processes, and templates.

  • Support, optimize, and maintain Salesforce AI capabilities—including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, and predictive models—to enhance system automation and streamline business processes.

  • Assist in managing and maintaining integrations between Salesforce and other applications/systems.

  • Successfully document and maintain documentation on application use, process flows, and user training materials.

  • Design, test, debug, and deploy quality, scalable, and well-documented configuration-based solutions on the Salesforce platform.

  • Perform routine reviews of configuration, data, and usage to ensure long-term viability, data integrity, and user adoption.

  • Identify opportunities for enhancements and modifications to improve system performance, efficiency, and reporting.

  • Handle all basic administrative functions including user account maintenance, role hierarchy/security management, report and dashboard development, and other routine tasks.

  • Complete regular internal system audits, manage Salesforce data feeds, and prepare for seasonal platform upgrades.

  • Effectively act as a liaison between users, vendors, and the application development team.

  • Process Automation:Proficiency in designing, building, and troubleshooting complex Salesforce Flows (Record-Triggered, Screen Flows, Scheduled Actions) in alignment with platform best practices.

  • Analytical Thinking:Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a high attention to detail.

  • Communication:Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization (including management, staff, students, and external vendors).

  • Requirements Gathering:Ability to critically evaluate information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts, decompose high-level information into details, and distinguish user requests from underlying true business needs.

  • Impact Analysis:Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce and existing upstream/downstream processes or systems.

  • A high school diploma or equivalent experience

  • Saleforce.com Certified Administrator (ADM201) required

  • Hands-on administration experience with Salesforce Education Cloud, Agentforce, Data Cloud and Tableau is highly desirable

  • Experience leveraging and configuring AppExchange products to develop a solution

  • Experience in 3rdparty integrations, preferably with the following providers: HubSpot, Intacct, Asperato, DocuSign, FormAssembly, Canvas, Regent, Marketing Cloud

  • A documented history of successfully driving projects to completion

People operations (30%)

  • Coordinate with finance and EOR or payroll partners on monthly payroll inputs, joiners, leavers, and changes across countries.

  • Draft, update, and roll out HR policies and the employee handbook for a remote, multi-country team.

  • Manage HR and recruitment vendors, tools, and subscriptions, and look for ways to Automate repetitive admin.

What you bring

  • Proven experience hiring for startups or high-growth companies, ideally as a solo or small-team recruiter.
  • Track record of hiring for fintech roles.
  • Experience hiring for marketing and affiliate businesses, including performance marketing and affiliate or partnership roles.
  • Hands-on experience hiring across APAC and the Middle East, with an understanding of regional talent markets and compensation.
  • Practical HR or people operations experience: onboarding, documentation, HRIS, and payroll coordination.
  • Strong sourcing skills, especially headhunting passive candidates.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, comfortable juggling hiring and admin work in parallel.
  • Comfort working independently and remotely, with strong ownership and prioritization.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and confident stakeholder management with senior leaders.
  • Working knowledge of at least one ATS, one HRIS, and LinkedIn Recruiter.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to employer branding or recruitment marketing.
  • Experience with hiring data dashboards and reporting.

  • Vietnamese).

What we offer

  • Real ownership: you build Pulse's hiring and people operations from the ground up.

jobs.title: Director, Sales Operations (Remote in U.S.)
jobs.excerpt: HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACTThe Director of Sales Operations is a hands-on functional leader and people manager who will build and lead the commercial operating foundation for USGBC/GBCI and provide global oversight of sales operations, commercial processes, systems, analytics, and sales enablement.
jobs.description:
HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

The Director of Sales Operations is a hands-on functional leader and people manager who will build and lead the commercial operating foundation for USGBC/GBCI and provide global oversight of sales operations, commercial processes, systems, analytics, and sales enablement.

The Director will establish effective processes, usable commercial data, forecasting discipline, Salesforce business requirements, and enablement.

They will lead the Sales Operations function, including the Sales Operations Analyst and Sales Enablement Lead, and support consistent commercial execution across all global regions.

The role is responsible for establishing and maintaining scalable sales processes, data governance, forecasting frameworks, performance reporting, and enablement resources that support market development and account management teams worldwide.

The Director of Sales Operations reports to the Global Head of Market Development and works in close partnership with the Regional Directors and Market Leads, the director of account management, customer account management and channel partner account management teams, the Client Solutions team, and the Product, Marketing, Finance, and Technology teams to support sales success across regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build the sales operations function and lead people:Establish charters, role expectations, operating priorities, methods, and service commitments. Recruit or develop approved capacity, coach and assess staff, manage workload, and prioritize resources and operational initiatives to support the development and effectiveness of the global sales operations function. Provide direct leadership, coaching, performance management, and professional development for the sales operations analyst and sales enablement leads.
  • Global commercial operations support:partner with the director of account management, regional directors, and market leads to establish consistent commercial processes, reporting frameworks, and operational standards that support customer acquisition, account management, and channel partner activities across all regions. Provide operational guidance and systems support without assuming direct responsibility for account management strategy, customer retention, revenue expansion, partner development, or account management team performance. Collaborate with the director of account management to ensure account management teams have the systems, reporting, process guidance, and enablement resources necessary to support their commercial responsibilities.
  • Establish coverage and engagement rules:Design sales territories, account hierarchies, segmentation, assignment frameworks, lead routing, regional handoffs, partner attribution, and joint-pursuit rules. Recommend equitable quota and KPI distribution across Market Leads for approval by the Regional Directors and the Global Head of Market Development. Administer approved allocations and resolve routine issues within delegated authority; and escalate strategic coverage decisions. Partner with the director of account management on account and partner coverage frameworks, handoff processes, and attribution standards.
  • Sales processes, pipeline management, and forecasting:establish and maintain opportunity stages, required evidence, pipeline reviews, commercial handoffs, and forecasting procedures to improve sales efficiency and effectiveness. Challenge unsupported assumptions, consolidate forecasts, and coordinate commercial plans with market development leadership and finance. Maintain visibility into commercial risks, resource capacity, and performance trends. Standardize forecasting methodologies, reporting expectations, and pipeline governance across global regions to improve data consistency and decision-making. Collaborate with the Director of Account Management to incorporate account retention, renewal, expansion, and partner revenue forecasts into consolidated commercial reporting, while account management leadership retains accountability for the underlying revenue results.
  • Salesforce governance, data quality, and business systems:own commercial data definitions, data quality standards, reporting priorities, and the salesforce business-improvement backlog. Oversee the sales operations analyst's business requirements, testing, and adoption activities while coordinating technical delivery and system controls with technology. Support Market Leads and Account Managers in maintaining accurate pipeline and forecasting data. Establish global CRM governance standards, data integrity practices, and user adoption expectations while ensuring system improvements support regional commercial requirements.
  • Sales enablement and commercial readiness:lead sales enablement priorities, including onboarding, playbooks, learning resources, tools, and process adoption for market leads, account teams, and relevant partners. Partner with product, marketing, client solutions, and service teams to ensure approved content, product-launch readiness, defined handoffs, and consistent working standards. Oversee the development and implementation of scalable global sales enablement programs that support consistent commercial capabilities across regions. Collaborate with regional directors and the director of account management to identify sales enablement needs, prioritize training and development resources, and support consistent commercial readiness across global teams.
  • Cross-functional commercial execution:serve as a liaison between market development teams and marketing and communications on campaign setup, audience segmentation, lead routing, and return-on-investment reporting. Collaborate with product, client solutions, finance, legal, hr, and technology to align commercial processes, customer handoffs, approval requirements, and operational priorities. Facilitate cross-regional collaboration and ensure global commercial processes are coordinated with organizational strategies and local market needs.
  • Commercial performance, reporting, and analytics:Monitor process adoption, customer and partner performance data, commercial performance, and cost and capacity considerations. Reconcile reporting with Finance, maintain auditable attribution, and prevent double counting or unauthorized commitments. Recommend resource and organizational adjustments based on performance evidence. Establish consistent global sales operations reporting and performance indicators to support leadership visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, customer retention, expansion, and partner performance. Provide accurate and timely reporting to the director of account management and other commercial leaders, who retain accountability for customer retention, renewals, account expansion, and channel partner performance.
  • Operational improvement and change management:identify opportunities to improve commercial processes, system adoption, reporting accuracy, and team effectiveness. Lead operational improvements in collaboration with sales operations, technology, and regional leadership. Develop and implement scalable process improvements, documented standard operating procedures, and change-management practices that support consistent execution across global teams.
  • Operational governance, decision-making, and risk management:Manage sales operations team performance, operational priorities, review cadence, data standards, and enablement requirements within approved authority. Allocate work and administer approved commercial coverage frameworks and operational processes. Recommend territory planning frameworks, quota and KPI allocation methodologies, sales operations staffing, system investments, incentive reporting processes, and operational improvements. Escalate unresolved commercial process issues, sales operations capacity conflicts, disputed attribution, systems risks, and proposed operational changes to the appropriate functional leaders. Maintain clear decision-making authority, approval processes, and escalation procedures across global commercial operations, in alignment with the Global Head of Market Development.

Assessment Notice

Candidates who advance in the interview process will be required to complete an assessment, more details will be provided as the time approaches.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • A minimum of ten years of progressively responsible experience in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial operations, or related business-to-business commercial functions, including at least five years with substantive responsibility for sales processes, forecasting, commercial analytics, or business systems, and at least three years of direct people-management experience.
  • Demonstrated success building, scaling, or materially transforming a sales operations or revenue operations function, including leading operational teams and implementing improvements in commercial processes, forecasting, systems, and performance reporting.
  • Practical expertise in pipeline governance, forecasting processes, account coverage, partner attribution, and commercial performance analysis in a complex business-to-business environment.
  • Experience translating commercial needs into Salesforce business requirements and governing improvements with technical teams without assuming technical control responsibilities.
  • Experience developing employees, managing approved resources, resolving commercial conflicts, and maintaining clear decision rights and auditable reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or supporting sales operations across multiple geographic regions or international markets.
  • Experience establishing standardized commercial processes, forecasting practices, and performance reporting for geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and managing operational change in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Experience leading global sales operations or revenue operations functions that support multiple business units, regions, or commercial models.
  • Experience developing sales operations frameworks, reporting dashboards, or CRM governance practices from the ground up.
  • Experience supporting commercial operations within a nonprofit, membership-based, certification, or professional services organization (preferred).

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, marketing, business analytics, operations management, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree in business administration (MBA), finance, business analytics, or a related discipline preferred.

Technology/System(s)

  • Advanced proficiency with salesforce or a comparable customer relationship management (CRM) platform, including pipeline management, forecasting, account hierarchies, reporting, and data governance.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, pivot tables, forecasting models, and performance reporting.
  • Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or comparable analytics platforms.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, or comparable business productivity and collaboration tools.
  • Experience using sales reporting, forecasting, and performance management systems to support commercial decision-making.
  • Ability to define business system requirements, support user acceptance testing, and partner with technology teams on CRM enhancements, system integrations, and process automation.

Skills

  • Strong change leadership, cross-functional influence, prioritization, analytical judgment, and executive communication, with the ability to build standards while maintaining business operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and coach employees while managing performance and competing organizational priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate commercial performance, identify operational risks, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cultures, geographic regions, and organizational levels.
  • Strong strategic planning, project management, and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and lead teams across global time zones.
  • Ability to balance standardized global commercial processes with regional business needs, customer requirements, and market conditions.
  • High level of business acumen, financial literacy, and attention to detail, with a commitment to data accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Commitment to the missions of USGBC and GBCI and an interest in advancing sustainability in the built environment.

Credentials/ Certifications

  • Professional certifications in salesforce, revenue operations, business analytics, project management, or change management are preferred.
  • LEED Green Associate or LEED AP credential is preferred.

ABOUT OUR TOTAL REWARDS PACKAGE

Salary

Final compensation and benefits will be confirmed at the time of offer and may vary based on factors such as internal equity, relevant experience, qualifications, and employment status. Please note that salary negotiations will not extend beyond the top of the internal salary range.

Benefits

We offer you:

  • Competitive compensation
  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • Professional development reimbursement
  • We offer a healthcare plan through Cigna that includes medical, dental, vision, and prescription drugs. USGBC covers 100% of the premiums and an HRA that will assist you and your dependents in reaching the in-network medical deductible. You will only be responsible for the $300 individual / $600 family up front deductible for medical services before the employer funded HRA will process payments for your in-network claims
  • Generous paid time off (12 paid holidays, 9 paid personal sick days and based on career level either 2 to 3 weeks PTO), including operations closed for a full week between Christmas and New Year’s
  • 6 weeks paid renewal leave after 7 years of continuous service

LOGISTICS

Location:This position is remote in the U.S.

Work Schedule:Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM in candidate’s time zone. Flexibility to coordinate meetings and collaborate with teams across international time zones may be required.

Travel:May include domestic or international team meetings, strategic customer and partner engagements, and other organizational events as business needs require.

EEO STATEMENT

The U.S. Green Building Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

ABOUT US

U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC)is a mission-driven nonprofit dedicated to accelerating and scaling the transformation of the built environment. Through LEED—the world’s most widely used green building rating system— and initiatives likes Greenbuild, the Center for Green Schools and advocacy, USGBC empowers professionals to drive market transformation that advances human and environmental health, climate resilience, and equity.

Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI)is the world’s leading sustainability and health certification and credentialing body, independently recognizing excellence in performance. GBCI administers project certifications and professional credentials and certificates includingLEED,PERFORM,SITES, andTRUE Zero Waste.

We are proud to be globally recognized for our leadership in green building, environmental performance, and sustainable development.

Our Global Impact

  • Over 120,000 LEED-certified commercial projects worldwide
  • Millions of square feetof certified healthy, efficient, low-carbon space
  • Recognition in 180+ countries for innovation in green building and business practices

Why Join Us?

At USGBC and GBCI, you’ll work alongside passionate, mission-aligned professionals who care deeply about people, the planet, and progress. We offer:

  • A purpose-driven, inclusive culture
  • Opportunities to grow your career and take ownership of meaningful work
  • A chance to make a measurable impact on global sustainability efforts
  • We’re seeking team members who thrive in collaborative environments, are committed to excellence, and want to build lasting partnerships that drive change in the built environment.

Meet Our Leaders and Learn More about our Mission:

  • U.S. Green Building Council Leaders
  • Green Business Certification Inc Leaders

Culture and Values Statement

Working together, each of us advances our mission by respecting all voices, trusting and supporting one another, excelling through collaboration and accountability, and continuously improving ourselves and our organization.

jobs.excerpt: Wholesale Sales & Account ManagerLocation: Woodstock, GA (Primarily Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time About the RoleA growing consumer products company is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales & Account Manager to drive sales, develop new retail partnerships, and grow its wholesale business across two unique brands.
jobs.description:
Wholesale Sales & Account Manager

Location: Woodstock, GA (Primarily Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

A growing consumer products company is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales & Account Manager to drive sales, develop new retail partnerships, and grow its wholesale business across two unique brands.

This is an opportunity for a relationship-driven sales professional who understands the boutique and specialty retail market and knows how to turn product interest into orders, build lasting retailer relationships, and generate repeat business.

The role supports two brands: an established luxury accessories brand specializing in authenticated vintage handbags and accessories, sold through boutiques, gift shops, resorts, and specialty retailers; and an emerging faith-forward wellness brand preparing to expand into the wholesale market.

The ideal candidate has experience representing consumer products to retailers, presenting collections, developing new accounts, and managing the full wholesale sales cycle. You'll have the opportunity to leverage existing relationships while identifying new markets, opening doors with prospective retailers, and helping grow both brands.

Key Responsibilities

Wholesale Sales & New Business Development

  • Identify, prospect, and develop new wholesale accounts with boutiques, gift shops, specialty retailers, resorts, and other relevant retail partners.
  • Build relationships with boutique owners, retail buyers, and purchasing decision-makers.
  • Proactively reach out to prospective accounts through phone, email, social media, industry connections, and wholesale platforms.
  • Present products, collections, and brand offerings to prospective retailers and secure new orders.
  • Follow up on sales opportunities, maintain an active pipeline, and move prospects through the buying process.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce existing retail partners to additional products and complementary brands.

Wholesale Account Management & Growth

  • Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of wholesale accounts, taking ownership of ongoing retailer relationships.
  • Develop strategies to increase order frequency, average order size, and overall account revenue.
  • Build repeat business by consistently following up with customers, identifying reorder opportunities, and introducing new products and collections.
  • Re-engage inactive accounts and turn first-time buyers into long-term wholesale partners.
  • Understand individual retailer needs, buying cycles, product preferences, and customer demographics to recommend relevant products.
  • Maintain regular communication with accounts before and after orders to strengthen relationships and encourage continued business.

Trade Shows, Markets & Product Representation

  • Represent the brands at major wholesale markets, trade shows, and industry events.
  • Schedule and conduct appointments with current and prospective retail buyers.
  • Present product collections, communicate brand value, and develop new sales opportunities.
  • Follow up with leads and buyers after events to convert interest into wholesale orders.
  • Help prepare for markets and coordinate outreach to existing and prospective accounts.

Sales Operations & Account Coordination

  • Maintain organized records of customer interactions, sales opportunities, orders, and follow-up activities.
  • Track account performance, outreach, new business development, and reorder activity.
  • Utilize Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and other wholesale platforms to manage customer relationships and sales activity.
  • Coordinate with internal operations and fulfillment teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.
  • Assist wholesale customers with order questions, shipping updates, and product information as needed.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded wholesale sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing business, and taking ownership of sales results.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of direct wholesale sales, B2B sales, or wholesale account management experience.
  • Experience selling consumer products to boutiques, independent retailers, gift shops, apparel stores, or specialty retailers.
  • Demonstrated success developing new business, securing orders, and growing existing customer accounts.
  • Experience working directly with retail buyers, boutique owners, or purchasing decision-makers.
  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting, product presentations, sales conversations, and consistent follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of repeat business, account development, and the wholesale buying cycle.
  • Self-motivated and able to independently manage a sales pipeline and portfolio of accounts.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills.

Preferred Experience:

  • Background in women's apparel, accessories, handbags, jewelry, beauty, gifts, or lifestyle products.
  • Experience representing multiple brands or product collections.
  • Previous showroom sales, territory sales, or national wholesale sales experience.
  • Experience attending wholesale markets, trade shows, or buyer appointments.
  • Familiarity with Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and online wholesale platforms.
  • Remote Work Experience: Previous experience working remotely and the ability to work independently, stay organized, and manage daily responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Technology Requirements: Must have a reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional workspace suitable for virtual meetings, customer communication, and daily sales activities.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position open to qualified candidates nationwide. The ideal candidate will have prior remote work experience and be comfortable working independently, managing their schedule, and maintaining consistent communication with the team.

Sales and account management activities will be conducted remotely through phone, email, virtual presentations, wholesale platforms, and other sales tools. Occasional in-person meetings and trade show participation may be required.

This is not a daily road-sales position, but it does require proactive outreach, new business development, and the ability to confidently sell products, manage wholesale relationships, and grow accounts.

Why This Role Matters

The company has an established wholesale customer base and significant opportunity to expand its retail presence. There is an opportunity to develop new wholesale partnerships, reactivate existing accounts, increase repeat purchasing, and introduce an emerging brand to an established network of retailers.

The person in this role will have a direct impact on wholesale revenue and brand growth. Success will be measured by the ability to:

  • Develop and secure new wholesale accounts.

  • Diagnose PLC communication issues, I/O faults, and network disruptions to restore operational continuity.
  • Design and maintain industrial control system architectures, including Studio 5000 environments, FactoryTalk, Modbus TCP networks, and Ethernet based instrumentation.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Modbus TCP communication between PLCs, HMIs, and automation controllers.
  • Ability to perform duties in high pressure, time sensitive situations
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to apply technical knowledge

Who we are:

Sprague takes a collaborative, customer-centric approach to providing best-in-class energy products and related services throughout the Northeast. Founded in 1870, we pride ourselves on offering customers the expert solutions and high-quality service that help their businesses thrive in any market landscape. Descriçãoda vaga:

O(a) Digital Customer Success Manager é dono(a) do segmento digital da Atlas Governance: uma pessoa operando uma jornada escalável e orientada por dados, no lugar do modelo 1:1 de CSM.A posição fica na área de CSCX e reporta ao(à) Head of Customer Success. A missão é manter cada cliente do segmento digital saudável, engajado e renovando, por meio de gatilhos, plays automatizados e toques humanos pontuais, com um custo de atendimento bem menor que o do modelo high touch.

Monitoramento (Ops)

  • Monitorar diariamente o Health Score da carteira digital e agir sobre quedas, alertas de risco e inatividade.

  • Testar, medir e iterar: testes A/B de mensagens e cadências, reportando o que move as métricas.

Customer Success (CS)

  • Ser o ponto de contato humano do segmento quando os gatilhos exigirem: calls de risco, sessões de adoção, conversas de renovação.

  • Levar feedback dos clientes e insights de uso para Produto e para a liderança de CS.

jobs.excerpt: Description et livrables de la prestationContexte :Dans le cadre d’un projet de décommissionnement de SAP BW, une organisation renforce son équipe Data Platform pour concevoir, industrialiser et optimiser ses pipelines de données sur Google Cloud.
jobs.description:
Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte :

Dans le cadre d’un projet de décommissionnement de SAP BW, une organisation renforce son équipe Data Platform pour concevoir, industrialiser et optimiser ses pipelines de données sur Google Cloud.
Les données sources sont déposées sous forme brute dans BigQuery via SAP Datasphere. La mission porte principalement sur leur transformation en modèles analytiques fiables, performants et exploitables pour les usages décisionnels.

Livrables attendus :

  • Pipelines de transformation développés avec dbt dans BigQuery.
  • Modèles analytiques structurés et documentés.
  • Tests de qualité intégrés aux traitements.
  • Développements versionnés et intégrés au processus CI/CD.
  • Documentation technique et d’exploitation.

Missions principales :

  • Concevoir et développer les transformations de données sous BigQuery à l’aide de dbt.
  • Structurer les modèles selon une architecture en couches de type médaillon : données brutes, données nettoyées et harmonisées, puis modèles analytiques.
  • Traduire les règles de gestion définies avec les interlocuteurs métier et techniques en transformations SQL.
  • Optimiser les performances et les coûts des traitements BigQuery, notamment par le partitionnement, le clustering et les stratégies de chargement adaptées.
  • Mettre en place des tests et des contrôles de qualité des données.
  • Industrialiser les développements en appliquant les bonnes pratiques de versionnement, de revue de code et d’intégration et de déploiement continus.
  • Contribuer à la fiabilité des pipelines et à l’analyse des anomalies.
  • Documenter les modèles de données, les transformations et les procédures d’exploitation.
  • Selon les besoins, contribuer à l’exposition des données dans Looker à l’aide de LookML.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous disposez d’une expérience significative en Data Engineering ou Analytics Engineering et savez intervenir de manière autonome au sein d’une équipe Data Platform.
Vous faites preuve de rigueur dans la conception, les tests et la documentation. Vous êtes capable de comprendre les besoins métier, de clarifier les règles de transformation et de collaborer avec les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles.

Compétences requises :

  • Maîtrise du SQL avancé et de la modélisation analytique.
  • Expérience confirmée de BigQuery : développement, optimisation des requêtes, partitionnement et clustering.
  • Expérience confirmée de dbt : modèles, dépendances, tests et documentation.
  • Maîtrise de Git et des pratiques CI/CD appliquées à la data.
  • Capacité à concevoir des traitements maintenables et fiables en production.

Compétences appréciées :

  • Premières connaissances de Looker / LookML.
  • Expérience de projets de migration d’entrepôts de données ou de refonte décisionnelle.
  • Familiarité avec les environnements SAP BW ou SAP Datasphere.

Mobilité

Non renseigné

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Guide responses to proposed federal and state rules, payer policies, fee schedules, laboratory payment reforms, and other public-comment opportunities.

People Leadership Responsibilities

  • Establish measurable objectives, operating rhythms, decision rights, and accountability aligned to enterprise priorities.

  • Annual federal and state health policy strategy with prioritized issues, stakeholders, risks, and action plans.
  • CPT and ICD-10-CM coding roadmaps, applications, evidence packages, and milestone plans for priority products.
  • State rWGS adoption strategy, including legislative, Medicaid, appropriations, coalition, and implementation pathways.
  • Congressional and state policy engagement plans executed with authorized Government Affairs and Compliance partners.

  • Executive dashboards covering policy developments, coding milestones, reimbursement risks, advocacy progress, and expected business impact.

  • Progress against federal and state policy priorities, including compliant engagement with members of Congress and legislative stakeholders.
  • Pipeline products and tuck-in acquisitions entering commercialization with complete coding, coverage, payment, and evidence strategies.
  • Timely identification and mitigation of material legislative, regulatory, coding, and reimbursement risks.
  • Improvement in payment adequacy, coding clarity, reimbursement predictability, and access for Baylor Genetics products.
  • Team performance, retention, succession readiness, and achievement of annual objectives.
  • Quality, timeliness, and executive usefulness of policy intelligence, scenario planning, and recommendations.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 7+ years of leading teams in health policy and reimbursement
  • 12+ years in progressive experience, combination with the following experience;

o8+ years of progressive experience in health policy, reimbursement, coding, government affairs, market access, or related healthcare leadership roles.

o8+ years of direct laboratory health policy and reimbursement experience, preferably in molecular diagnostics, genomics, or precision medicine.

  • Demonstrated experience leading CPT coding strategy and familiarity with ICD-10-CM coordination and federal coding processes.
  • Demonstrated success influencing state or federal health policy, reimbursement, Medicaid, or legislative initiatives through compliant advocacy and coalition engagement.
  • Experience leading and developing teams responsible for policy, coding, reimbursement, or government affairs.
  • Ability to interpret legislation, regulations, coding guidance, payment policy, and payer requirements and translate them into business strategy.
  • Executive-level communication, deductive storytelling, negotiation, and cross-functional influence skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience with rWGS, WGS, WES, NGS, rare disease, oncology genomics, reproductive genetics, or pediatric critical care.
  • Experience with AMA CPT processes, CMS payment systems, state Medicaid programs, and CDC ICD-10-CM coordination processes.
  • Established relationships with laboratory trade associations, patient-advocacy organizations, state policy coalitions, federal agencies, and legislative stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting product pipeline strategy, licensing, mergers and acquisitions, or post-acquisition integration.

✓ Government Affairs & Advocacy ✓ State Policy Strategy

✓ Pipeline & Acquisition Planning ✓ Executive Presence & Influence

This role shapes the policy, coding, and reimbursement environment required to accelerate rWGS adoption, support product innovation, enable strategic growth, and expand patient access to Baylor Genetics testing.

Lensemble de nos équipes, quels soient orientés fonctionnel ou technique, travail dans la collaboration pour livrer des solutions qui répondent à des besoins métiers afin de donner toujours plus de valeur ajoutée à nos produits.

jobs.excerpt: Field Sales RepresentativeLocation: Sheffield, covering Sheffield or surrounding areas such as Rotherham or Chesterfield (fully field-based) £50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package Hello.
jobs.description:
Field Sales Representative

Location: Sheffield, covering Sheffield or surrounding areas such as Rotherham or Chesterfield (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

The Salesforce Solution Architect is responsible for end-to-end solution design and delivery across the Salesforce platform, primarily supporting Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft-driven integrations. What makes you a great fit:

6) Integrations, Automation & Reporting

jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Fraud Strategist is responsible for developing, testing, and optimizing fraud strategies, policies, rules, thresholds, treatment paths, and decision logic within assigned onboarding and monitoring workflows in RealPage’s payments ecosystem. This role will focus on development of policies and rules across new account onboarding, tenant payments, vendor payments, owner draws, funding instrument verifications, limit management, transaction monitoring, and payer anomalies. The successful candidate will take part in building RealPage’s next generation of fraud controls. This is a hands-on strategy role for someone who can independently identify the right data, write and troubleshoot SQL, connect fraud signals across systems, and translate analysis into practical decisions. They will test hypotheses, quantify fraud exposure and customer impact, evaluate strategy performance, and recommend policies, rules, thresholds, and controls that reduce fraud while protecting the customer experience and enabling business growth.

Responsibilities

Fraud Strategy, Policy & Controls

  • Responsible for the development, maintenance, and optimization of fraud risk policies, strategies, rules, thresholds, decision logic, treatment paths, and control documentation across onboarding and monitoring workflows.
  • Develop data-backed recommendations for auto-approval criteria, manual-review routing, payment holds, restrictions, limit treatments, step-up verification, account monitoring, and escalation thresholds.
  • Document strategy rationale, rule logic, data sources, expected impact, monitoring plans, policy considerations, change history, and recommended follow-up actions.
  • Design and optimize controls for payment fraud, onboarding risk, account takeover, business email compromise, counterparty fraud, tenant payment fraud, synthetic identity, first-party misuse, bust-out behavior, stolen payment instruments, refund or dispute abuse, and emerging typologies.
  • Monitor launched strategies and recommend tuning on an ongoing basis.

Analytics, Data Science & Rule Performance

  • Independently source, query, and analyze data using SQL to validate hypotheses, identify fraud patterns, assess false positives and false negatives, and evaluate loss exposure, operational impact, and customer friction.
  • Write and troubleshoot SQL queries using multi-table joins, aggregations, date windows, common table expressions, window functions, and segmentation logic to investigate fraud patterns and measure strategy performance.
  • Apply analytical and data science methods to support feature exploration, cohort analysis, segmentation, model output evaluation, threshold setting, experimentation, champion/challenger comparisons, back-testing, and post-launch performance monitoring.
  • Partner with Risk Data Science & Analytics to translate dashboards, models, features, risk scores, and analytical insights into practical fraud decision strategies and operational controls; assess and provide feedback on whether those outputs are effective for fraud strategy use cases, with guidance on complex cases.

Operational Feedback & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with Onboarding Risk Operations and Risk Monitoring Operations to incorporate case outcomes, queue trends, investigator feedback, alert quality, and operational pain points into strategy improvements.
  • Review themes from Trust and Safety escalations to identify control gaps, recurring fraud signals, product or process vulnerabilities, or policy needs requiring durable remediation.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Payment Operations, Compliance/AML, Legal, and Operational Excellence on tooling, workflow, data availability, rule implementation, and control monitoring.
  • Provide concise updates on fraud trends, strategy performance, emerging risks, rule effectiveness, false positive impact, and recommended actions to fraud leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Share fraud findings and trends with fraud operations, monitoring, and escalation teams to inform how case learnings translate into policies, rules, thresholds, or monitoring improvements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, Criminal Justice, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of full-time experience in fraud strategy, fraud analytics, payments risk, data science, financial crime, risk operations strategy, or a related technical risk function.
  • Advanced, hands-on SQL experience is mandatory. Candidates must be able to independently write, troubleshoot, and explain SQL queries used to source data, validate hypotheses, identify fraud patterns, assess false positives, and evaluate rule or control performance; dashboard-only experience is not sufficient for this role.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or optimizing fraud rules, thresholds, decision logic, treatment paths, controls, or monitoring strategies based on independently sourced and analyzed data.
  • Exposure to data science, statistics, experimentation, model evaluation, Python/R, feature development, segmentation, or analytical methods used in fraud or risk decisioning.
  • Experience working with fraud operations, risk analytics, data science, product, engineering, compliance, or payment operations stakeholders.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

Required:

  • Advanced analytical curiosity and ability to connect fraud signals across disconnected tools, imperfect data, evolving processes, and multiple product or payment workflows.
  • Strong ability to translate independently sourced data findings into clear fraud strategy recommendations, rule changes, threshold adjustments, control improvements, monitoring plans, and policy considerations.
  • Strong working knowledge of fraud typologies such as synthetic identity, first-party misuse, counterparty fraud, business email compromise, onboarding fraud, stolen payment instruments, tenant payment fraud, account takeover, refund or dispute abuse, or bust-out behavior.
  • Ability to evaluate fraud strategies using metrics such as loss exposure, fraud capture, precision, false positives, customer friction, queue impact, and post-launch performance trends.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize technical findings for fraud, product, operations, data science, and leadership audiences.
  • High ownership, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to balance fraud mitigation with customer experience, operational capacity, compliance considerations, and business growth.
