jobs.description:
Overview

CPI Card Group is seeking a Cloud Engineer with a DevSecOps focus and hands-on experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS), AWS Security Services, infrastructure automation, to join the Infrastructure Cloud Engineering team. This role implements, automates, and operates secure, resilient infrastructure capabilities across a hybrid environment that includes on-premises environments, AWS Infrastructure as a Service, and relevant SaaS integrations.

The position strengthens the Cloud Engineering organization with a focus on AWS Cloud Security, and associated security services, infrastructure delivery pipelines, threat-detection integration, vulnerability and configuration remediation, data-protection controls, incident response, and compliance-control implementation. The engineer contributes to reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, guardrails, and automated controls that integrate security throughout the platform engineering and CloudOps lifecycle.

Working closely with Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and other technology teams, this role translates security and compliance requirements into implementable infrastructure capabilities. This role is accountable for incorporating AWS Cloud Security controls within the scope of Infrastructure Cloud Engineering and associated infrastructure cloud platforms. Enterprise cybersecurity architecture, security policy, and cyber-risk governance remain with Cybersecurity.

Responsibilities

  • AWS infrastructure security: Engineer and operate security capabilities supporting multi-account AWS environments, including logging, configuration compliance, threat detection, vulnerability visibility, network protection, encryption, and data protection. This work leverages AWS-native services such as AWS CloudTrail, AWS Config, Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, AWS Security Hub, AWS Shield Advanced, and AWS KMS.
  • Infrastructure as Code and automated controls: Develop and maintain Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, scripts, modules, policies, and automated workflows that provision secure infrastructures and platforms while continuously validating required security controls.
  • Secure delivery pipelines: Implement and improve infrastructure delivery pipelines, including security testing, policy checks, approval controls, separation-of-duties requirements, artifact integrity, and controlled promotion across environments.
  • Secure infrastructure patterns and standards: Implement and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure patterns across AWS and hybrid integrations using approved architectures, standards, and guardrails.
  • Threat, vulnerability, and risk reduction: Automate the identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation of infrastructure vulnerabilities, insecure configurations, and control gaps. Provide technical evidence and remediation support for risk-management activities.
  • Hybrid infrastructure protection: Integrate security controls across on-premises environments, AWS infrastructure, and relevant SaaS services. Support network segmentation, security groups, firewall integration, DDoS-resilient designs, secure connectivity, and infrastructure protection patterns.
  • Security monitoring and response: Improve infrastructure telemetry, alerting, and operational response through AWS and enterprise monitoring platforms. Participate in security and infrastructure incidents, root-cause analysis, containment, recovery, and corrective-action automation.
  • Compliance implementation and evidence: Partner with Cybersecurity to translate PCI DSS and other applicable control requirements into technical controls, validation methods, documentation, and repeatable audit evidence. CloudOps and platform operations: Monitor infrastructure health, security posture, reliability, and control effectiveness. Participate in lifecycle management, change management, problem management, operational readiness, and the team's 7x24 on-call rotation.
  • Collaboration and documentation: Contribute to design reviews, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing. Communicate options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical, non-technical, and leadership audiences.
  • Continuous improvement: Evaluate relevant AWS services and industry practices, pilot improvements within approved guardrails, and reduce manual work through safe, measurable automation.

Qualifications

  • Builds for operations: Designs infrastructure with day-two operations in mind. Monitoring, alerting, patching, backup, and recovery are part of "done," not added later.
  • Builds security in: Treats security controls as engineering requirements that are coded, tested, and validated in the pipeline, not as reviews applied after deployment.
  • Automates first: Prefers code over console changes. Spots repeated manual work and turns it into automation that is versioned, reviewed, and repeatable.
  • Troubleshoots across layers: Diagnoses issues that span AWS, networking, identity, on-premises systems, and SaaS integrations. Uses logs, metrics, and security findings to find the root cause, not just the symptom.
  • Works with operational discipline: Follows change management and approved standards. Leaves systems and runbooks in a state another engineer can support during an on-call event.
  • Respects ownership boundaries: Understands what Cloud Engineering owns and what belongs to Cybersecurity and Technology Governance, Risk and Compliance, and knows how to engage those teams effectively.
  • Exercises risk-aware judgment: Recognizes when a design, request, or shortcut creates unacceptable risk. Raises it with evidence and a recommended option, explained in plain terms for engineers, auditors, and leaders.
  • Keeps learning: Keeps AWS, security, and automation skills current and applies what they learn to improve team patterns and practices.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or comparable professional experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud security engineering, or comparable technical roles.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, securing, and operating AWS infrastructure in production or regulated hybrid environments.
  • Experience implementing or improving security controls within production cloud or hybrid infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, with experience developing reusable modules, automated testing, policy validation, and controlled deployment practices.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms and source control, such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS-native delivery services.
  • Strong scripting or software automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or a comparable language.
  • Experience with multi-account AWS environments, identity and access controls, logging and monitoring, configuration compliance, vulnerability management, encryption, data protection, and network security.
  • Experience participating in infrastructure or security incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action implementation.
  • Working knowledge of regulated-industry security and compliance practices. Experience with PCI DSS is preferred.

Preferred Certification and Qualification Paths:

Candidates may demonstrate readiness through one or more of the following paths. AWS certifications are preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered: Preferred path: An equivalent combination of AWS architecture, operations, security, automation, and production engineering experience aligned to the following certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate

Additional desired qualifications: AWS certifications or equivalent experience aligned to: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional AWS Certified AI Practitioner

jobs.description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

RTI’s Center for Data Interoperability is seeking dynamic and detail-orientated candidates for a full-time Programmer/Analyst with Python or SQL analytic programming experience. The Programmer/Analyst will work with researcher teams to analyze and synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative administrative health data from multiple sources into meaningful results. Individuals in this role will provide analytic development and statistical programming knowledge to project teams conducting research using healthcare data, especially large and complex health insurance claims and survey data, in a fast-paced environment.

This position is based in Research Triangle Park, NC or any other U.S. location as a telecommuter.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

Approximately 85% of working time will require:

  • Developing coding expertise and best practices to query, merge, and analyze complex healthcare data from large relational databases
  • Leveraging a variety of quantitative methods to standardize, blend, and distill data from multiple disparate sources, transforming them into analytic insights for use in client reports, journal manuscripts, abstracts, or posters for professional meetings
  • Iteratively developing and maintaining Python code while adopting best practices for increasing efficiency, minimizing computational errors, implementing process improvements, and other approaches that add value to business processes and analytic results
  • Participating in thorough code review and documentation, as well as parallel coding efforts for other programmers to maintain quality standards and ensure that code may be efficiently transferred among team members as needed
  • Constructing analytic datasets and databases to support deliverables for various public health and healthcare financing engagements
  • Collaborating with project team members to review, critically evaluate, and refine business requirements, and then translate those requirements into programming logic
  • Adopting and refining technical skills on projects, including working independently, proactively resolving day-to-day issues of small complexity, and leveraging coding best practices and standards

Approximately 15% of working time will require:

  • Participating in continuing education courses on healthcare-related and/or technical coding topics (including learning new coding languages) as applicable to the role and evolving business needs
  • Sharing insights gained from the above activities with fellow programmers, leaders, and other division staff through activities such as presentations at staff meetings, contributions to collective codebase utilities, and training early career staff

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BS/BA or advanced degree in data science, computer science, statistics, social sciences, health policy or related field with at least 3 years of programming experience OR the equivalent combination of education and experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience is defined as a Master’s degree in the same areas mentioned above and at least 1 year of relevant experience
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with Python or SQL analytical coding with demonstrated familiarity with the linkage of various types of data files
  • Programming experience using data stored in relational databases such as Teradata, Snowflake, DB2, Oracle, and SQL Server
  • Experience designing and implementing flexible, reusable, scalable, programming code
  • Commitment to analytic programming quality and best practices, including experience with QA/QC procedures (e.g., peer review of code, parallel programming)
  • Familiarity with all phases of the Analytic Development Life Cycle and demonstrated experience in working with at least 1 of these phases
  • Organizational and planning skills that enable independent work while contributing to a team effort
  • Analytic thinker with exceptional attention to quality and detail
  • Good interpersonal skills, including written and oral English-language skills, the ability to effectively manage competing deadlines, and the ability to work independently on a day-to-day basis while regularly collaborating with project teams
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, have lived in the United States for at least 3 of the last 5 years, and should not require now, or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status

Preferred Qualifications:

  • At least 1 year of experience using SAS for analytic programming
  • Demonstrated understanding of relational database management concepts
  • Healthcare industry experience, analytic experience in work with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and/or knowledge of healthcare terminology and taxonomy/classification systems (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS)
  • Programming experience within CMS data systems such as the Integrated Data Repository (IDRC), Chronic Conditions Warehouse (CCW), or Centralized Data Repository (CDR)
  • Understanding and use of issue tracking and code versioning tools such as Jira or Git
  • Ability to thoroughly review and adjust code, ultimately providing quality programming output while developing the ability to identify overall enhancements to programming or project team processes

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian Administration is the control centre for every organisation running on Atlassian's System of Work. Admins use it to set up their organisation, get the right people onto the right apps, keep their data secure and compliant, and grow their Atlassian investment over time.

As Atlassian becomes AI-first, Administration is changing from a place where admins dig for information into one that tells them what to act on, explains how and why, and acts on their behalf. It's built on trusted data, flexible org structures and visibility into everything connected to a customer's Atlassian portfolio, and powered by Rovo and agents. The result is enterprise-grade governance with far less effort.

Your Future Team

You'll join Admin Experience, the team behind the operating system for Atlassian admins. Admins use it to set up and manage their organisation, get people onto the right apps, and grow their Atlassian investment over time. Our vision is an Atlassian Admin that tells admins what to act on, advises them on how and why, and acts on their behalf. To get there, we're rebuilding trusted foundations: accurate license data, reliable org structure through Units, and visibility into what's connected to a customer's Atlassian portfolio. At the same time we're launching AI-powered experiences such as Rovo in Admin Hub and a reimagined Overview. You'll be part of a small, high-conviction design team working on problems at enterprise scale, for some of the world's largest and most regulated organisations.

Responsibilities

What you will do

  • Design the high-stakes foundation every Atlassian customer runs on. Every organisation depends on Administration to set up, secure and scale how it works, one decision can affect every user, app and site. Admin actions are often irreversible and hard to see, so you’ll make changes clear, safe and auditable at the scale of the world’s largest, most regulated enterprises.

  • Own whole admin journeys, not just screens. Define complete journeys end to end — setting up an organisation, structuring it with Units, managing licences, governing connected apps, including the edge cases, errors and bulk actions that only show up at scale.

  • Shape AI-powered administration. Help turn Administration from a place where admins dig for answers into one that tells them what to act on, explains how and why, and acts on their behalf through Rovo and agents, designing the transparency, controls and governance that make admins comfortable trusting AI.

  • Make Administration feel like one product. Many teams build admin experiences; you’ll create the patterns, information architecture and Admin UI Kit components that make them feel consistent and cohesive for admins.

  • Turn trust into a design outcome and champion admins. Partner with Engineering and Data so licence counts, user activity and connected-app data are accurate and easy to understand. Represent IT admins, security teams and org owners, learning from customer calls, escalations and usage data, and measuring your work against leading enterprise admin tools.

What your day to day looks like

  • Designing end-to-end admin experiences for complex, data-heavy and permission-sensitive workflows, such as licensing, org hierarchies, identity and access, and app governance.

  • Designing AI-native and agentic experiences, including recommendations, approvals, audit trails and rollback, that earn the trust enterprise admins need.

  • Building functional, AI-enabled prototypes to explore options, de-risk complex flows and test ideas with customers.

  • Contributing patterns to the Admin UI Kit and the Atlassian Design System so the admin experience stays cohesive across contributing teams.

  • Partnering with your PM and Engineering partners to define goals, reduce ambiguity and own outcomes as priorities change.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Qualifications

What You Bring

We'd love to see a portfolio that demonstrates:

  • Enterprise and admin SaaS experience. 5+ years of product design experience with complex B2B, SaaS or enterprise software, including time spent on administration, settings or other data-heavy, permission-sensitive surfaces.

  • Strong craft in visual and interaction design. A high level of craft across interaction design, information architecture and visual design, backed by strong systems thinking and experience contributing to design systems.

  • Excellent prototyping. Strong prototyping skills that show behaviour, options and trade-offs, not just screens, to de-risk complex flows and test ideas with customers.

  • End-to-end problem solver, grounded in evidence. Experience owning end-to-end UX, solving complex problems with clear, practical solutions, running generative and evaluative research, and measuring success through qualitative and quantitative methods.

  • A great team player. Clear, evidence-based communication, the ability to influence cross-functional partners and stakeholders, and sound judgement balancing customer needs with business goals and technical feasibility.

What sets you apart

  • Deep enterprise admin domain knowledge. Hands-on familiarity with concepts like SSO/SCIM, licensing, org hierarchies, and OAuth and API governance, you understand how large organisations are actually run and secured.

  • Proven AI-native and agentic design. Recent, hands-on experience designing AI-powered features, workflows or agentic tooling, including the recommendations, approvals, audit trails and rollback that earn enterprise trust.

  • Prototyping in code. Comfort building functional prototypes in code to bring behaviour and trade-offs to life for partners and customers.

  • Scale and regulation. A track record designing for some of the largest, most regulated enterprises, where edge cases, bulk actions and auditability are the norm, and comfort collaborating across time zones.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

About the Role

Go Fish Digital is building a focused, integrated go-to-market engine to accelerate growth across our digital and performance marketing services. We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Director of Demand Generation to build and lead that effort, with a clear focus on creating qualified mid-market pipeline. You’ll partner closely with Sales, GTM Operations, Product Marketing, and our agency specialists to develop and execute integrated campaigns that reach the right buyers and turn engagement into sales opportunities.

This is a leadership role for a builder. You’ll set strategy, develop campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve results. Success requires strong and creative judgment: knowing which buyers to target, creating compelling offers, and selecting programs that convert marketing investment into qualified pipeline. You should be able to speak clearly about campaigns you personally built, why they worked, the results they generated, and how you adapted when performance fell short.

This is an opportunity to help build a new growth engine with direct exposure to senior leadership and meaningful influence over go-to-market strategy and marketing investment. You’ll have access to experienced specialists in paid media, SEO/GEO, creative, and web development, enabling you to build integrated programs that produce measurable commercial outcomes. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, challenges assumptions, and knows how to turn marketing investment into qualified pipeline.

What You'll Do

Generate Qualified Mid-Market Pipeline

  • Own demand generation strategy and execution, with accountability for qualified opportunities and sales pipeline.
  • Own the demand generation program budget within agreed investment guardrails. Allocate spend across campaigns and channels, manage demand generation vendors and partners, and stop, refine, or scale programs based on qualified pipeline contribution and acquisition economics.
  • Develop campaigns targeting priority accounts, industries, and senior decision-makers.
  • Partner with Sales leadership and BDRs to coordinate marketing programs, prospecting, and follow-up.

Build a Sophisticated Email Marketing & Nurture Engine

  • Own email marketing, audience segmentation, lifecycle nurture, and marketing-led outbound campaigns.
  • Leverage HubSpot to build scalable campaigns, automated workflows, and personalized engagement.
  • Coordinate executive-branded outreach, marketing emails, and BDR/seller sequences to create a cohesive buyer experience.
  • Continuously improve email performance, deliverability, conversion, and pipeline contribution.

Orchestrate Integrated Demand Generation Campaigns

  • Translate product positioning, client stories, research, and thought leadership into integrated campaigns.
  • Coordinate across email, paid media, SEO/GEO, events, partnerships, and outbound sales activity.
  • Partner with internal specialists who execute paid media, SEO/GEO, website, and creative work.
  • Identify and test new opportunities to reach relevant buyers through targeted channels and distribution.
  • Plan and oversee execution of paid campaigns across priority channels, including LinkedIn, paid search, programmatic, and ABM tactics; use performance data to optimize targeting, creative, offers, and investment.

You do not need to be the deepest technical expert on every channel, but you must understand how they work, how to evaluate them, and how to integrate them into a cohesive growth strategy.

Drive Experimentation, Analytics & Optimization

  • Define and track KPIs focused on qualified meetings, opportunities, pipeline, and revenue contribution.
  • Analyze funnel performance, identify conversion gaps, and develop structured A/B tests.
  • Evaluate channel effectiveness and recommend changes to campaigns and investment based on results.
  • Own campaign automation, including audience segmentation, nurture workflows, email deployment, and campaign quality assurance, supported by a Demand Generation Coordinator. Partner with GTM Operations on CRM integration, lead routing, data quality, and reporting.

Strengthen Campaign Messaging & Creative Effectiveness

  • Work closely with Product Marketing and Content to translate differentiated capabilities into compelling campaigns.
  • Evaluate offers, messaging, copy, creative, and landing pages for relevance and effectiveness.
  • Provide specific feedback to improve campaign content and conversion.
  • Identify gaps in commercial content and client proof needed to support demand generation

What You Will Need

  • Proven Mid-Market + B2B pipeline generation: 8+ years of relevant demand generation experience, with demonstrated success generating qualified mid-market or enterprise pipeline for complex B2B services or solutions. Must have personally built and optimized campaigns that produced measurable sales opportunities and pipeline.
  • Industry Experience: Multiple years working at an agency or a marketing technology company
  • Deep email marketing expertise: Significant hands-on experience with email marketing, nurture, segmentation, and marketing automation. HubSpot strongly preferred.
  • Analytical discipline: Strong ability to interpret funnel data, design experiments, and optimize campaigns based on pipeline and revenue outcomes.
  • Cross-channel fluency: Hands-on experience planning, launching, and optimizing paid demand generation campaigns, including account-based marketing and channels such as paid search, LinkedIn, and programmatic. Broad understanding of how paid media integrates with SEO/GEO, content, events, and outbound sales to generate qualified pipeline.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • Industry Experience: Expertise in marketing to marketers
  • Creative judgment: Ability to recognize compelling B2B messaging, challenge ineffective content, and develop campaigns that resonate with target buyers.
  • Builder mentality: Comfortable operating in a lean, fast-moving environment, balancing strategic ownership with hands-on execution.

Why Join Us
You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.

Benefits & Compensation 

We believe great people deserve great support. Our company offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and career growth, including:

jobs.title: Tabular AI Solution Architect
jobs.excerpt: The roleYou are the technical voice of Probabl in front of US data science teams: the person who takes a first conversation to a technical discovery, a demo on their own problem and a scoped proof of concept, alongside the sales team.
jobs.description:
The role

You are the technical voice of Probabl in front of US data science teams: the person who takes a first conversation to a technical discovery, a demo on their own problem and a scoped proof of concept, alongside the sales team. Services owns technical pre-sales and delivery; you bring that field engineering expertise to the sales team on every US opportunity.

Probabl is the Tabular AI company founded by the creators of scikit-learn. Skore, our platform, builds, validates and tracks predictive models on tabular data with the methodology of the scikit-learn maintainers built in. Data science is being rewritten by agents faster than the discipline can absorb it; our job is to keep the science guarding the speed.

This is our first Solution Architect in the US. You join the Services team, Probabl's applied AI team of field engineers and solution architects, and work day to day with our US sales lead. Our pre-sales practice already runs in France, with a Solution Architect, a reference demo, a demo kit and a PoC playbook. You run it for the American market and feed back what you learn, so the whole team's practice gets better.

What you'll do

  • Run the demo.Own the reference Skore demo for the US and adapt it to a prospect's use case in days, with the demo kit, on your own.

  • Run technical discovery. With data science leads and their platform teams: current stack and tooling, how models are built and validated today, where reliability leaks, what a first project would look like.

  • Scope the PoC.Turn a qualified opportunity into one scoped question on the customer's data, with a clear go/no-go, then hand it to our field engineers to deliver.

  • Run workshops and hackathons. Hands-on sessions with a prospect's data science team on their own data, and the occasional hackathon with partners or schools: the fastest way to show what Skore does and to qualify a team.

  • Answer the hard questions. Architecture, security, deployment options (on-prem, BYOC, cloud), how Skore fits an existing stack. You bring Engineering in when needed, not by default.

  • Work the deal with Sales.Technical qualification, RFPs and evaluation workshops, alongside our US sales lead.

  • Bring the field back to Product. What US customers ask for, what blocks a deal, what wins it: written up, sized, and fed into the roadmap every week.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in data science or ML engineering, then pre-sales or solutions work for a data or AI product. You have built models in production and you have sold the idea of building them better.

  • You master tabular data work end to end, whatever the framework: scikit-learn of course, but just as much gradient boosting, PyTorch, time series and the like, with the evaluation and validation that go with them. You can read a prospect's pipeline, spot the leakage, and show them in a notebook what a sound evaluation looks like.

  • You run a room. A live demo to 20 data scientists, a whiteboard with a platform team, a discovery call with a VP: you adjust and you land the point.

  • You are comfortable with enterprise buying groups: data science, IT and security, procurement, and the economic buyer, each with their own question.

  • Based in the US, remote, with travel to customers and periodic trips to Paris.

  • Strong plus: experience with agentic or LLM-based data science tooling, and a healthy skepticism about its outputs.

  • Nice to have: Kubernetes and cloud basics, tabular and time series foundation models (TabICL and others), an open-source footprint in the Python data ecosystem.

Why Probabl

  • Credibility you don't have to build. scikit-learn is downloaded over 200 million times a month. You walk into every room with the stewards of the library behind you.

  • A category, not a feature. We are defining Tabular AI: AI on the structured business data that runs companies, with the scientific method built in. You help define what it means in the US.

  • A team that builds its playbook together.We have a first version of our demos, PoC playbook and processes, and they still have a lot of room to evolve. You use them with US customers and improve them with the rest of the team.

  • Short distance to the product. Solution Architects and field engineers sit in a weekly Product–Services sync. What you hear from customers changes the roadmap, visibly.

Practical

  • Reports to the VP Services (Paris). Day to day with our US sales lead, who is fully involved in the hiring.

  • Location: United States, remote. Preferred time zone: East Coast (to confirm). Travel to customers as needed; two to three trips a year to Paris, including onboarding.

  • Compensation:fixed + variable tied to pipeline and closed deals; band to confirm.

  • Start:as soon as possible.

  • Process, three weeks from first call to offer:

  1. 30-minute call with the VP Services.

  2. 30-minute call with our US sales lead.

  3. Practical evaluation

  4. 30-minute call with a co-founder.

  5. Offer.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Data Analyst II is a capable analytical contributor who independently designs, executes, and delivers data analysis and visualization work across RS21's client engagements. This role is designed for a practitioner who can take an analytical question from problem definition to client-ready findings without day-to-day direction, make sound methodological choices within established frameworks, and communicate results clearly to a range of audiences, technical and non-technical alike.

This person works confidently across RS21's analytical toolchain, produces high-quality reporting and dashboards, applies statistical methods appropriately, and adapts rapidly to the needs of each client context. They are able to provide constructive feedback to junior analysts, contribute to RS21's analytical documentation, and are actively deepening their expertise in the areas that will define their senior-level contribution.

This role is embedded in real client delivery and expected to take full ownership of assigned analytical workstreams. The Data Analyst II does not wait for scope to be handed down; they clarify requirements, propose analytical approaches, flag methodological risks, and keep delivery moving. They understand that the best analysis is the one that is used long after the engagement ends, and they design their work accordingly.

Critically, the Data Analyst II is developing into the kind of analyst RS21 depends on across engagements: someone who delivers accurate, timely, and persuasive analytical work, communicates with genuine client-centricity, and brings enough self-awareness to know when a question requires a methodology or domain expertise that they need to develop.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Insight Delivery

  • Independently design and execute analytical projects across multi-source datasets; manage data extraction, transformation, quality assessment, and exploratory analysis without requiring direction on approach.
  • Write clean, functional Python or R code for data analysis, automation, and reporting tasks; apply software discipline including version control, notebook documentation, and reproducibility practices.
  • Write complex SQL queries independently; optimize performance, choose appropriate query patterns by workload, and communicate query logic clearly in documentation and code review.
  • Apply statistical techniques including regression, significance testing, sampling methodology, and descriptive analysis to produce findings that are both technically sound and interpretively honest about uncertainty.
  • Independently design and publish production dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent; connect to multiple data sources, apply sound visualization and UX principles, and govern data model and access design.
  • Independently produce compelling data narratives using storytelling tools and visualization frameworks for diverse client and stakeholder audiences; adapt depth, format, and framing to the audience.

AI-Augmented Analytics

  • Use AI productivity tools independently to meaningfully accelerate research, analysis, and reporting tasks; apply sound judgment about when AI assistance improves work and when it introduces risk.
  • Apply AI-assisted data preparation and pattern detection within established analytical workflows; validate AI-generated outputs critically before incorporating them into client deliverables.
  • Stay current on emerging AI-augmented analytical tools and share relevant learnings with the analytics team; help the practice understand where these tools add genuine value.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Manage stakeholder relationships independently for assigned engagements; facilitate analytical meetings, communicate findings clearly, navigate competing interpretations, and keep stakeholders aligned on scope and timeline.
  • Produce high-quality client reports, analytical briefings, and status communications; tailor content to audience and ensure clients have the information they need to act on analytical findings.
  • Apply established data governance frameworks in client environments, including documenting ownership, lineage, and metadata, under the direction of an engagement lead.
  • Anticipate evolving client analytical needs and proactively communicate concerns about scope, data quality, or methodological limitations before they become delivery risks.

Data Quality and Documentation

  • Independently validate analytical outputs for accuracy, reproducibility, and appropriate handling of data limitations; document assumptions, caveats, and quality decisions clearly so reviewers and downstream users can trust and build on your work.
  • Maintain high-quality analytical documentation in Confluence or equivalent; structure documentation so teammates unfamiliar with an engagement can understand what was analyzed, how, and what it means.
  • Contribute to reusable analytical templates, code libraries, and accelerators that help the team move faster on common problem types.

Collaboration and Mentorship

  • Provide structured support to junior analysts through hands-on coaching, code review, documentation, and pairing; help them develop the technical and communication habits that will carry them toward independent contribution.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to ensure analytical work connects to the right data assets and model outputs; understand the full data flow well enough to design analysis around it.
  • Partner with project managers to keep analytical delivery aligned with client expectations and contractual constraints; surface scope and timeline risks early with enough context for leadership to act.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Public Policy, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3 to 5 years of progressive experience in data analysis or business intelligence, including independent delivery of analytical projects from problem definition through client presentation.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical language (Python or R), including libraries for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and visualization.
  • Advanced proficiency with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent BI platforms; able to design, publish, and govern production dashboards independently.
  • Strong grounding in applied statistics including regression, hypothesis testing, sampling methodology, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including written reports and live presentations.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships and delivering analytical work independently across client engagements.

Preferred

  • Experience with geospatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS, QGIS, or Python-based spatial libraries.
  • Background in advanced analytics, program evaluation, or government data environments.
  • Familiarity with longitudinal data, panel data methods, or quasi-experimental evaluation designs.
  • Basic understanding of cloud data platforms such as AWS Redshift, Google BigQuery, or Snowflake.
  • Background in consulting or multi-client delivery environments where analytical standards and client communication expectations are high.
  • Familiarity with AI-augmented analytics tooling and responsible approaches to integrating generative AI into analytical workflows.

Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute, significantly, to the impact that we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department that they work in of the level of time that they are able to commit. Our servicesprimarily offer a peer-support network to young people right across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor who is of a similar age to them and somebody that they feel more comfortable speaking with.

If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse, but likeminded individuals, collaborating to increase the reach of the Charity and improve support provisions available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are remote workers,but that doesn't stop us keeping in touch and maintaining a strong positive culture amongst our whole team.

About the role

Youth4Youth is seeking new Trustees for its Board as it continues to grow its impact at a national level. As a Trustee, you will have a unique and exciting opportunity to shape the future of the charity, whilst ensuring that we are governed effectively. We are Looking to appoint 4 - 5 new Trustees to our Board, and we are particularly interested in hearing from you if you have experience in the following areas:

  • Safeguarding, particularly in digital spaces

  • Fundraising

  • Commercial Development / Growth

As a youth focussed charity, we are committed to ensuring that Youth Voice is at the heart of every decision that we make. Alongside those experienced in the above areas, we are seeking individuals aged 25 and under to represent their peers on our Board, ensuring that Youth Voice is heard at every level.

If you would like to have an informal chat with the Chair of the Board prior to submitting an application, please reach out to .

Responsibilities and commitment

As a Trustee, we would ask that you are able to commit approximately 2 - 4 hours per month of your time. This may include:

  • Attending monthly Board connect meetings, hosted remotely (1 Hour)

  • Attending quarterly Board meetings (1.5 hours)

  • Attendance at any relevant committees, role specific

  • Attending an annual Development Day (1 full day)

Due to the make-up of our Board, all scheduled meetings fall outside of standard working hours, usually falling in evenings and weekends. This is subject to change based on the majority preferences of the Board.

As a Trustee, we would expect you to:

  • Challenge the status quo, leveraging your expertise to support the ongoing development and growth of a rapidly changing, but much needed charitable organisation.

  • Ensure that the Charity is governed correctly, in line with its governing document and charity law.

  • Support the development of future strategies which will enable further growth, and create sustainable, long-lasting impact.

  • Get involved as a volunteer, as required and in line with your availability, to support the CEO and other members of the organisation.

You will be joining a well established Board of Trustees who are all driven to create meaningful impact for young people across the UK. Our current Board of Trustees is chaired by the founder of Youth4Youth, Josh Towers, and is made up of an additional 5 Trustees. There is also an additional, newly formed, Commercial Trading Subsidiary Board (Y4Y Trading Ltd), chaired by a long-standing Trustee, Barney Harrison.

Supporting the organisation operationally is our CEO, Richard Nuttall and Operations Manager, Dora Botta. The remainder of a team is a mix of a very small paid team, but the organisation is primarily supported by volunteers.

Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you only are a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth

We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

  • Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions

  • Becoming a member of a strong network of likeminded individuals, spread across the UK, who you can connect with and collaborate with both within and outside of the Charity

  • Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers

  • Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

The hiring process

Our hiring process typically has two stages

  1. Video or Written Application (when applicable)

  2. Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator for that role

Some roles will have extra stages but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.

Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

Overview

As a Product Manager II, you'll drive two connected areas at the center of how enablement and marketing teams create the materials that guide human and AI sellers.

The Pages platform. You'll own Seismic's dynamic webpage-building platform, the foundation behind Pages, Plays, and Digital Sales Rooms. This is detailed, craft-heavy product work. You'll work shoulder to shoulder with UX design and Engineering on the decisions that make a page building and consumption great: layout, composition, re-usable components, and templates. You'll obsess over the details of the authoring experience, from the editing canvas to brand controls, while exploring how AI can make it dramatically easier to create polished, personalized experiences. And you'll tackle the unique challenge of enterprise sales enablement: giving teams creative freedom while ensuring everything they build is on-brand, governed, and easy to scale.

AI content creation. You'll create AI solutions that help marketers and enablers quickly and dynamically produce engaging enablement materials across formats, through a unified flow that speeds generation and makes it easy to deploy and optimize enablement for the field. That content will appear first in Seismic, but it also forms a trusted content layer that informs agents and agentic experiences within Seismic and everywhere sales teams work. And you'll close the loop: figuring out how to use AI, adoption data and context to help page creators improve their content based on what's working on the ground.

The most compelling part of this role is the intersection of three disciplines:

  • Creative tooling: making sophisticated design and content creation feel effortless.
  • Interaction design: obsessing over the small details that make an editor intuitive, fast, and enjoyable.
  • Enterprise workflows: adapting those capabilities to the needs of sales and marketing teams, including governance, reuse, personalization, and scale.

All of it incorporates the latest AI practices to simplify workflows and help creators accelerate, without losing control.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll dig into customer problems, make the call on what to build, and own the results: adoption, retention, and the outcomes our customers see.

Who you are:

  • 3+ years of product management experience building user-facing products (B2B or B2C), including taking one or more key features to market successfully.
  • Strong specification and delivery skills. You write clear specs with the right level of detail, make sound tradeoff decisions with your team, and know when to escalate.
  • Design sensibility. You can assess a user experience, give specific and constructive feedback, and work comfortably with designers on layout, interaction, and visual detail.
  • Fluency with data. You can define instrumentation, analyze results, and use what you learn to set realistic goals and recommend next steps.
  • Technical curiosity. You can have productive conversations with engineers about front-end architecture, LLMs, and data, and you're eager to go deeper.
  • An AI-forward way of working. You use AI regularly to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
  • Clear communication. You bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you, and keep your manager and stakeholders well informed.
  • Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus points

  • You've shipped AI-powered features and know what it takes to make them reliable.
  • You've worked on a page builder, website builder, CMS, design tool, or other no-code creation product, or a product with theming and brand-customization requirements.
  • You've worked on enablement, sales, marketing, or content-management software.

Why This Role

  • A category being rewritten. AI is changing how content gets made and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
  • Ownership that's real. You'll drive a key product area with the accountability and room to grow that come with it.
  • Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams, marketers, and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
  • A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own outcomes, not output. Set clear goals and success metrics tied to adoption, retention, and customer results. Follow through after launch, report honestly on what happened, and recommend the next step.
  • Own the Pages platform roadmap that powers key Seismic Pages, Plays, Digital Sales Rooms, and other native content types: critical user-experience infrastructure for the whole product.
  • Create AI solutions that empower creators. Help users quickly and dynamically build engaging enablement materials across formats to guide human and AI sellers, delivering a trusted content layer for agents inside Seismic and wherever sales teams work.

jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

Your future team

The Atlassian Advisory Services team is a globally distributed team of Atlassian experts who are passionate about creating customer success. Advisory Services team members engage with our largest strategic and enterprise organisations with some of the most complex business challenges to help them deliver delightful solutions to their users. We provide customer teams with trusted advisors to help orchestrate successful outcomes, providing the highest benefits from their Atlassian investment. At Atlassian, you'll have an impact on millions of users, fast! We don't just want to know your opinions, we want to see your ideas in action. We hire great people and then trust them to be great.

We're hiring a Principal Consultant - Agile Scale, with an Enterprise Strategy and Planning focus, and strong AI expertise, to join our Advisory Services Delivery team as an individual contributor - this is not a managerial role. Atlassian Principal Consultant / Enterprise Architectsare experts in Atlassian products, practices, and solutions, delivering guidance to drive value realisation for clients that have purchased Advisory Services from Atlassian. Each member of the team is accomplished at delivering performant strategic technical guidance at scale, aligning product capabilities with business needs and desired outcomes.

You will help our strongest promoters showcase successes to their peers, and serve as the tip of the spear in growing the reach of our technologies for new use cases and markets. Our aim is to help customers unleash the potential of their teams and get the most out of their Atlassian investment.

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with your peers in Advisory Services to align on strategic outcomes that deliver exceptional service to our customers

  • Partner with customers to help solve their business challenges and achieve their internal goals through Atlassian products, practices, and solutions

  • Identify and promote opportunities for service and product expansion within a client’s organization

  • Cultivate deep industry and solution expertise, staying up-to-date with evolving best practices that support different types of teams

  • Lead complex customer engagements using a System of Work approach, drawing upon your expertise in two or more Atlassian solution areas

  • Drive global internal initiatives that positively influence our Advisory Services business and partner organizations across Atlassian

  • Delegate effectively to the Solution Consultants on your team, while maintaining ownership of client outcomes

  • Develop comprehensive and innovative technical solution content, and provide tailored enablement that enhances our team's ability to drive customer success and meaningful outcomes

  • Reach into all parts of Atlassian to influence and facilitate a deeper level of engagement, advocacy, and innovation for our largest enterprise customers

  • Spend up to 30% of your time traveling domestically, and in some cases internationally, for both internal and customer-facing events

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Your background:

  • 8-12 years of experience within SaaS companies

  • 8+ years of experience in customer-facing roles where you've engaged with and influenced customer stakeholders that range from technical administrators to executive leadership

  • Demonstrated expertise in Enterprise Agility, including

    • Direct experience contributing and developing enterprise-wide Agile adoption strategies, providing solutions to customer business challenges, while having in-depth knowledge of client organizational objectives

    • Hands-on experience planning and executing the rollout of large-scale enterprise planning tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally), customizing solutions to integrate with client systems while ensuring alignment to client organizational objectives

    • Experience in developing tailored enablement programs, leveraging relevant certifications to empower client teams with Agile expertise, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement

    • Proven track record for building relationships and influence with senior management, both with clients as well as internally

  • Demonstrated expertise in Artificial Intelligence, including

    • Familiarity with Atlassian’s Rovo platform, and ways in which Agents are implemented and deployed

    • Background in large language models (LLMs) for generative content, prompt engineering, and chat-mediated interactions

    • Proven ability to design proof-of-concept solutions to address common business challenges for Enterprise customers, particularly in the Enterprise Strategy and Planning space

  • Demonstrated expertise in Atlassian's System of Work, including

    • Mastery in identifying customer business challenges and uncovering key requirements

    • Extensive experience designing and advising customers at scale on comprehensive solutions that span products, services, practices, and platforms to support better teamwork and collaboration

  • Experience with Rovo, Agentic AI, MCP, and/or other AI integrations

  • You're fluent in English, and nice to have a second language relevant to the SEA market.

It’s nice if you are:

  • Comfortable coaching best practices and tailoring curated guidance for stakeholders to facilitate those practices

  • Experienced working on cross-team projects, engaging with Sales, Product, Support, and other teams

  • Experienced working with large customers in a consulting or technical expert capacity

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

About the position:

Velosio is seeking a Product Manager to own the vision, roadmap, and execution of our IP solution's within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ecosystem. This role is responsible for ensuring the product aligns with market needs, business strategy, and customer outcomes while driving cross-functional execution across development, consulting, sales, and support.

This is a hands-on product leadership role that blends strategy, execution, and stakeholder enablement to deliver measurable value for customers and internal teams.

Your day might look like:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own and communicate the product vision and roadmap

  • Prioritize features and enhancements based on customer feedback, market trends, and business objectives

  • Review and refine roadmap priorities on a quarterly basis

  • Monitor competitive landscape and industry trends to inform strategy

Customer & Market Insights

  • Partner with IP, consulting, and support teams to gather customer feedback and requirements

  • Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and risks

  • Use customer insights to guide backlog prioritization and product decisions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary liaison between development, sales, consulting, marketing, and support teams

  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria

  • Partner closely with development during sprint planning, backlog grooming, and execution

  • Collaborate with documentation and functional teams to support releases and adoption

Stakeholder Communication

  • Provide regular updates on roadmap progress, release timing, and priorities

  • Communicate risks, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly to leadership and stakeholders

  • Respond to inbound requests from sales, consulting, and support teams

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Participate in customer calls to clarify requirements and gather feedback

  • Review support cases to identify recurring issues and enhancement opportunities

  • Support webinars, advisory councils, and customer update sessions as needed

Backlog & Requirements Management

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog

  • Create, refine, and maintain user stories and acceptance criteria

  • Review bugs regularly and prioritize based on customer and business impact

  • Ensure backlog items are development-ready prior to sprint execution

Release Planning & Delivery

  • Coordinate release schedules, sprint cutoffs, and delivery milestones

  • Create and maintain release documentation and SharePoint content

  • Oversee QA, UAT, and test environment readiness

  • Maintain release notes, documentation, and supporting materials

  • Facilitate daily scrums, sprint ceremonies, and retrospectives

What you'll bring:

Product & Technical Expertise

  • Strong understanding of product lifecycle management

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and project accounting / PSA solutions

  • Ability to translate business needs into actionable technical requirements

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, DevOps pipelines, and QA processes

Communication & Collaboration

  • Strong facilitation skills for sprint ceremonies and cross-functional sessions

  • Ability to clearly articulate product vision to stakeholders and leadership

Ownership & Execution

  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable managing competing priorities

  • Strong attention to detail with a bias toward execution

  • Commitment to continuous improvement and product quality

We have earned recognition from Microsoft as a top 1% performing partner worldwide and an emerging NetSuite leader. We have strategic independent software vendor (ISV) partnerships and a portfolio of solution and service offerings to accelerate what’s next for business.

Our mission is to enable clients to realize business value faster, simplify the process of deploying technology, acquire deeper data-driven insights, and explore ongoing innovation to drive business forward. Velosio is the only Microsoft Cloud Distributor that specializes in Dynamics 365 and is a prominent Microsoft Master VAR. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Velosio’s 400 employees serve over 4,000 clients.

Beyond our expertise, as a Velosio team member, you can leverage the Velosio award-winning culture - a network of top-notch peers, day-to-day flexibility, career development resources and the largest incentive opportunities in the industry.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

AMOpportunities is the category leader in tech-enabled clinical training placements and workforce solutions. We equip universities and healthcare providers with the infrastructure needed to expand clinical education across all healthcare disciplines. With partnerships spanning 100+ allopathic (MD), osteopathic (DO), nursing (NP and pre-licensure), PA, and allied health degree programs at 650+ healthcare institutions nationwide and internationally, AMO is solving the healthcare training shortage by enabling quality clinical education at scale.

Since expanding to domestic B2B solutions in 2020, we've secured 75+ partnerships with U.S. academic institutions and placed students in nearly 6,000 clinical rotations. Our proprietary SaaS platform and comprehensive service solutions help schools expand enrollment, open new clinical campuses, and prepare for accreditation visits.

At AMOpportunities, we're guided by a clear set of values that shape how we show up for each other and for those we serve, every day.

  • Trust: Trust the process. Trust one another.
  • Impact: Local focus, global impact. Solutions today for tomorrow.
  • Be a global citizen: Collaborative mindset. Embrace our differences. Work better together.
  • Quality: High quality service. Delighting those we serve.
  • Adapt with Agility: Embrace change. Move fast, stay flexible.
  • Rooted in Relationships: Strong partnerships. Support and celebrate each other. Grow together.

Frequently cited statistics show that women and underrepresented groups apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. AMOpportunities encourages you to apply even if you do not meet all listed qualifications. We look forward to your application. 

About the position:

The VP of Hospital & System Partnerships is the owner of AMO’s hospital and health system relationships. This leader builds and runs the top-down clinical partnerships engine that secures new relationships with hospital systems and their associated medical professionals to build a network of active clinical experiences for AMO's customers.

The role combines business strategy with senior level selling to C-suite executives, graduate medical education (GME) leaders, and other administrators. Specifically, this leader identifies and prioritizes health systems, hospitals, and clinics for outreach, then takes opportunities through the end-to-end sales funnel – from initial outreach through to pitching and contracting.

This role owns the top-down recruitment of clinical supply, which begins with facility contracting & leadership engagement and continues through preceptor identification, qualification, and engagement (in partnership with AMO’s clinical network development team) to build preceptor networks at acquired hospitals and turn that hospital capacity into core clerkship clinical slots that enable student rotations and generate revenue.

The VP of Hospital Partnerships and the VP of Clinical Network Development share ownership of AMO’s clinical network, the VPHP owning facility relationships and the VPCND owning the development of the preceptor network, working in collaboration to build our best-in-class Clinical Network. They set strategy together, deciding which health systems to pursue, how to scope and structure Network Development Services (NDS) engagements, and where to build clinical hubs. They also execute together, joining school and hospital conversations as-needed to recruit preceptors and close deals.


While this position can be fully remote, we are looking for candidates to be residents of Alabama, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, New York, Ohio, Texas, or Wisconsin.

Essential Functions:

Hospital and Health System Acquisition Strategy

  • In consideration of company targets and contractual obligations to customers, set the national hospital acquisition strategy: define target health systems, prioritize them by capacity, geography, and fit with customer demand, and set the plan and timeline for onboarding new relationships.
  • Build and sustain relationships with health system leadership, including C-suite executives, clinical leaders, GME leaders, legal & finance teams, and the broader academic administrators.
  • Personally lead the highest-value partnership conversations and close new hospital and health system deals.
  • Expand existing health system partnerships by identifying growth opportunities across hospitals, clinics, and affiliated facilities.

Deal Execution and Contracting

  • Guide hospital deals through contracting and approval at large institutions, working with AMO's counsel.
  • Provide strategic guidance on complex affiliation agreements and partnership terms.
  • Keep contracting and affiliation processes clear, documented, and efficient, in partnership with Program Implementation teams.

Turning Hospital Partnerships into Clinical Supply

  • Operationalize every new hospital partnership by 1) cultivating buy-in for AMO’s staffing model, 2) enabling recruitment of preceptors within the hospital's affiliated and employed providers (physicians, PAs, NPs, nurses, and others) and, 3) as applicable, winning commitments of preceptor capacity from relevant hospital leaders.
  • Facilitate VPCND’s on-site recruitment events, referral programs, and targeted outreach to affiliated physician lists to secure new preceptor relationships in core and elective specialties
  • Work with operations to identify gaps in AMO’s clinical network and lead the replacement or buffer recruitment for departed or underperforming facilities.

Partnering on NDS and School Demand

  • Work with the VP of Clinical Network Development and Sales to identify the best-fit hospital targets for each NDS engagement, including clinical hubs and clusters.
  • Assist Sales team with preceptor strategy and availability for new and existing education partners.
  • Provide hospital supply for NDS engagements for PA, MD, DO, and NP programs, and collaborate with academic institutions and health systems to grow strategic clinical hubs over the long term.

Team Leadership and Site Management Oversight

  • Direct the implementation and continued development of standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and training so day-to-day site work can be handed to the implementation team, with the most valuable relationships routed to the acquisition team.
  • Maintain and build out standardized dataset of clinical sites, their affiliation and credentialing requirements, and their key contacts.

Reporting, Systems, and Cross-Functional Work

  • Own pipeline visibility for hospital acquisition: forecasts, dashboards, and reporting in HubSpot.
  • Own and operationalize research and prospecting tools such as Definitive and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to segment and develop leads.
  • Collaborate across the company to keep the clinical network healthy and well documented.
  • Travel to hospital sites, partnership meetings, and conferences.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Skills, Education, & Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in a healthcare-related field, or equivalent experience in a relevant field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in healthcare business development and partnerships, provider network development, clinical-site recruitment, or health system sales, including senior-level or executive-level accountability for hard delivery targets.
  • Demonstrated record of building trusted relationships with hospital and health system leadership, GME leaders, legal teams, or academic administrators, and closing partnerships with them.
  • Experience navigating complex approval and contracting processes with multiple stakeholders at large institutions.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for C-suite executives, clinical leaders, and academic administrators.
  • Ability to drive outcomes through teams and colleagues across functions, including people who do not report directly to you.
  • Experience building, documenting, and training others on new processes.
  • Experience with a CRM; HubSpot strongly preferred.
  • Willingness to travel roughly 2-4 times per month, for site visits, on-site recruitment events, and conferences.

Preferred

  • Existing relationships across hospital systems and in medical education.
  • Healthcare clinical education experience (Dean, Director of Clinical Education, or similar).
  • Experience engaging and recruiting preceptors, both in person and virtually, including through referral programs.
  • Working knowledge of contracting tools and sales intelligence tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, and Definitive.
  • Comfort using AI tools (ex: Claude) to support research, workflow documentation, and communication.

What You Gain:

  • Competitive $125,000 to $200,000 total compensation annually
  • Comprehensive Benefits Program: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, Tax Exempt Student Loan Repayment, and Commuter Benefits
  • A mission-driven work environment committed to a spirit of support, growth, and achievement
  • Performance-based career growth opportunities
  • A front-row seat for the exponential growth of a booming education tech company
  • Work/life balance

Equal Opportunity Employer

At AMOpportunities we champion the reality of diversity and the necessity of inclusion and accessibility. We are deeply committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees, and to providing our employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strictly prohibit discrimination and harassment based on disability, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy status (including childbirth and related states), sexual orientation, race, color, social or ethnic origin, religion, age, HIV status, past/present military service, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

AMOpportunities manages our business remotely, unless otherwise stated. This is inclusive of interviewing, onboarding, and each role day to day. Please consider that our roles are hybrid with options to work at our River North Office.
