Delivery Solutions Architect

Company Overview

Waterfield Tech enables companies to select, design, and deploy tailored customer engagement solutions from the world’s leading providers enhanced by cutting edge Applied AI. The results are happier customers, enhanced insights, and lower costs.

Once live, we empower companies to support, optimize, and modernize those solutions and AI applications, leading to lower risk and increased efficiency. Our client-centric process and track record of success have earned the trust of clients around the world when it comes to customer interaction.

We value our people—their diversity, their dedication, and their commitment to customer satisfaction. We encourage each other. We understand the value of hard work and the importance of a healthy balance. We’re all on the same page… even though we may get there from different perspectives. All in all, it’s a pretty cool place to be and we’re growing our global team of engineers, sales professionals, and creative souls.

Position Summary

The Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA) owns the technical solution on Waterfield Tech’s Avaya engagements — from validating the pre-sale scope through project delivery. As a member of the Delivery team, the DSA serves as the technical counterpart to the Project Manager, designing, validating, and governing the end-to-end architecture that turns client requirements into resilient, secure, and implementable outcomes.

This role anchors technical governance for Waterfield’s Avaya portfolio across upgrades, migrations, integrations, and new deployments. The DSA validates pre-sale scope and solution design alongside the Client Advisor, contributes to costing, and carries that design through project initiation, build, testing, and deployment so that what is sold is what is delivered.

The DSA is not expected to be the deepest expert on every platform. On multi-platform programs, the DSA knows the contact center landscape well enough to identify the right internal and external subject-matter experts, orchestrate their input, and ensure that integration points are documented and accounted for in the design — serving as the connective tissue that keeps technical decisions consistent, defensible, and aligned to business goals.

This role requires deep technical fluency in the Avaya Aura ecosystem, strong client-facing presence, and the discipline to govern delivery against an approved design and document it clearly.

This is a high-impact role for a senior practitioner who enjoys owning technical outcomes, partnering closely with project and pre-sales teams, and seeing complex solutions through from design to deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical architecture for assigned Avaya engagements, designing and validating solutions that meet documented business and functional requirements
  • Validate pre-sale scope and solution design in partnership with the Client Advisor on complex, high-touch pursuits — confirming technical fit, surfacing risks, and ensuring scope assumptions are deliverable
  • Contribute to costing inputs and effort estimates so that solutions can be delivered within the agreed scope and margin
  • Review the pre-sale design at internal kickoff (IKO) and provide clear technical direction to the assigned implementation team
  • Serve as the technical counterpart to the Project Manager, providing technical governance across the project lifecycle and ensuring integration points are identified, documented, and resourced
  • Govern delivery against the approved design — oversee functional testing and solution deployment, validating that what is built matches what was designed
  • Identify technical scope changes early and partner with the Project Manager on change control
  • Identify and orchestrate the right internal and external subject-matter experts, coordinating their input into a coherent, well-documented design
  • Produce concept design drawings and solution documentation for pre-sale validation and implementation hand-off
  • Maintain technical authority across the Avaya Aura ecosystem (Communication Manager, Session Manager, AES, Experience Portal, Elite, AACC) and adjacent partner stack
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, executable, and secure
  • Translate complex technical concepts and trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and client leadership
  • Partner with existing customers to develop and optimize their technology roadmap
  • Stay current on emerging trends, platforms, and technologies relevant to the contact center and CX landscape

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in solution architecture, technical architecture, or senior technical delivery in contact center / unified communications, ideally within professional services or systems integration, with significant time on Avaya
  • Deep, current expertise in the Avaya Aura ecosystem with the ability to design, defend, and govern solutions in client-facing settings
  • Experience validating pre-sale scope and contributing to professional services costing and effort estimates
  • Demonstrated experience designing and governing solutions with multiple integration points across more than one platform
  • Strong written communication — produces design documentation and integration details clearly, without heavy editing
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical and executive audiences
  • Strong time-management skills, with the ability to govern multiple concurrent engagements
  • Preferred: experience with adjacent CX platforms (e.g., Five9, Genesys, Cisco, NICE, Zoom); exposure to applied AI and automation in contact centers (e.g., Hyro)

Additional Requirements

  • Avaya certifications (ACSS, ACIS) preferred
  • Availability to work flexible hours as needed

Physical Requirements

  • Sitting: Ability to sit for long periods of time.
  • Vision & Hearing: Normal or corrected vision and hearing to work with others in person and video conference.

jobs.description:
Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte de la prestation

La Direction Data a 3 grandes prestations : maximiser la collecte de données tout en respectant les
réglementations en vigueur, développer la connaissance et l’expérience utilisateurs et mettre à
disposition auprès des équipes internes des outils de pilotage et d’aide à la décision.
Dans une volonté d’améliorer la valeur ajoutée issue de nos données, nous mettons en place un
catalogue de données avec la contribution de plusieurs parties prenantes. Dans ce cadre nous
souhaitons renforcer nos équipes par une prestation de Data Catalog Product Owner qui orchestrera
la mise en oeuvre de notre futur catalogue de données.
La prestation attendue consistera à participer à la gestion et l'évolution de notre catalogue de
données. Le prestataire s'assurera que le catalogue est une ressource précieuse, utile et facile à
utiliser pour l'ensemble de l'organisation, facilitant l'accès et la compréhension des données

disponibles.

Objectif de la prestation

1. Gestion du catalogue de données :

  • Développer et maintenir le catalogue de données, y compris la classification, l'annotation et la

documentation des ensembles de données.

  • Assurer la qualité et la cohérence des métadonnées.

2. Amélioration continue :

  • Collecter et analyser les retours des utilisateurs pour améliorer continuellement le catalogue.
  • Construire, prioriser et piloter la réalisation de la liste des besoins et des fonctionnalités requises

(Backlog), en collaboration étroite avec le Data Manager ainsi que l’ensemble des parties prenantes.

  • Implémenter des fonctionnalités nouvelles et améliorées en collaboration avec les Data Stewards

3. Gouvernance des données :

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre des politiques et procédures pour la gestion des données.
  • Veiller à la conformité des données avec les réglementations en vigueur, en coordination avec le PO

Privacy.

4. Formation et support :

  • Organiser des formations utilisateur sur les meilleures pratiques d'utilisation du catalogue de

données.

  • Fournir un support continu aux utilisateurs pour assurer une utilisation optimale du catalogue.

5. Collaboration et Adhésion :

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec toutes les parties prenantes (les Data Owners, Data

Stewards, Data Manager, Data scientists, Data analysts, Etc) pour s'assurer que le catalogue répond

aux besoins de tous les utilisateurs.

  • Contribuer activement à l’adoption du Data Catalog par l’ensemble des départements.
  • Piloter et mesurer cette adoption via des métriques conjointement établis avec l’équipe Data

Gouvernance

Expertise souhaitée

Expertises techniques requises pour la réalisation de la prestation :

  • Maîtrise d’au moins une solution Data catalog
  • Très bonne compréhension des environnements Data et Big data
  • Connaissance de la conception d’un métamodèle et de son implémentation
  • Compréhension des standards et des pratiques pour la collecte, le stockage, et l'utilisation des

métadonnées.

  • Compréhension des principes et fonctionnement des API pour les interfaçages du Data Catalog avec

d’autres systèmes de l’environnement

  • La connaissance de la solution COLLIBRA serait un plus

Expertises fonctionnelles requises pour la réalisation de la prestation :

  • Connaître les fondamentaux de la Data Gouvernance (Data Catalog, Quality, Policies, Process, etc)
  • Bonne connaissance des indicateurs marketing
  • Bonne connaissance de la réglementation (RGPD, CNIL)
  • La connaissance du domaine du Numérique et des médias (FAI, Agrégateur, Distributeur, SEO/SEA,

…) serait un plus

Mobilité

Non renseigné

Salary Range: $70,000 - $80,000 / year

Job Summary

Pace Center for Girls seeks a detail-oriented, mission-driven, and experienced Senior Staff Accountant to manage and coordinate all financial activities across our centers. Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Senior Staff Accountant will ensure fiscal and regulatory accountability, providing critical support to the organization's financial health and sustainability. The Senior Staff Accountant will play a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization, supporting its mission, and fostering organizational excellence.

Who We Are: At Pace we transform girls’ lives through academic and counseling programs based on girl-centered, strength-based and trauma informed framework. Team members create a safe place for girls to learn, process, heal and begin again. Founded in 1985, Pace Center for Girls is a nonprofit organization that believes all girls, regardless of their story, deserve a safe and supportive space where they can become strong, compassionate and successful women.

Our Culture:

At Pace, our culture is built on core beliefs that foster a supportive, mission-driven, and empowering environment where girls can thrive and reach their full potential. Our culture is rooted in the following foundational behaviors:

  • Caring – We are warm, sincere, compassionate, and collaborative, fostering an environment of support and connection.
  • Purposeful – We are focused on our mission and committed to social responsibility, ensuring our efforts make a meaningful impact.
  • Learning Oriented – We are open, inventive, and exploratory, continuously seeking growth and improvement.
  • Results Driven – We are focused on achieving goals and measurable success, ensuring accountability and progress.
  • Girl-Centered – The ways that girls learn and develop are unique. That's why we've created an environment that responds to their needs so they can feel safe enough to develop meaningful and trusting relationships while embracing their capabilities, strengths and autonomy.
  • Using Your Strengths – Every girl brings something exceptional to the table. At Pace, we focus on developing these special characteristics. By supporting a girl's talents and positive attributes we help her achieve her goals.
  • Understanding Trauma – Trauma can alter the course of a girl's life. At Pace, we recognize that trauma may be the root cause of unhealthy behaviors, which is why we work hard to help heal and empower girls.

What We Offer:

  • Growth and Development - Competitive salaries, ongoing learning and development opportunities, and subject-specific instructional coaching to support growth and success.
  • Work Life Balance – Team members benefit from 20 paid time off days, 14 paid national holidays, and an additional 5 days for wellness week. Center based team members observe a balanced schedule with 230 academic days and 20 dedicated in-service planning days. Teachers become eligible to receive an additional 2 weeks of paid time off after one year of employment.
  • Comprehensive Benefits - Full-time team members are eligible for a range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, critical illness, accident coverage, legal and identity theft protection, and a 403(b)-retirement plan. Team members working 30 or more hours per week are eligible for medical, dental, FSA, HSA, and the 403(b)-retirement plan. Those working less than 30 hours per week are eligible for the 403(b)-retirement plan.
  • Mental Health and Well-Being - All team members have access to wellness resources, offering wellness rewards, counseling sessions, leadership coaching, mindfulness resources, and more to support their overall well-being.

What This Role Does:

Financial Management – Ensure Fiscal Accountability

  • Manage and coordinate all financial activities across Pace centers, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Oversee accounting functions including property, plant and equipment, investments, insurance accounts, in-kind donations, special event transactions, and other specialized accounts.
  • Perform monthly account reconciliations and allocations to ensure accuracy of financial statements and tax and regulatory returns.
  • Prepare and submit required agency applications, reports, reviews, and documents.
  • Support the budget and forecast process.

Grant and Contract Management – Drive Excellence and Compliance

  • Coordinate all major federal and state grant accounting and reporting.
  • Serve as liaison between grantors and the agency; process monthly and quarterly claims and invoices; monitor accounts receivable aging.
  • Prepare grant and contract financial reports accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Develop and maintain effective relationships with contract managers and agency partners.
  • Maintain an organized grant/contract filing system.

Financial Reporting and Analysis – Support Decision-Making

  • Provide recommendations for accounting and reporting process improvements.
  • Prepare and support in process documentation and controls.
  • Conduct research and lead efforts for all audits.
  • Act as the financial liaison for the Department of Juvenile Justice (DJJ).
  • Coordinate reporting for the National School Lunch Program (NSLP) and other assigned grants and contracts.
  • Prepare reports, reviews, and recommendations based on research and analysis.
  • Identify and communicate financial and compliance issues for assigned areas to the Finance Leadership and executive management, summarizing and explaining results.

Team Collaboration and Training – Foster a High-Performing Finance Team

  • Support the finance team by cross-training as necessary.
  • Participate in the training of temporary staff or new hires as necessary.
  • Provide training, research, and analysis to facilitate effective decision-making.
  • Participate in conference calls and webinars, delivering continuous improvement training to agency staff regarding NSLP, IRS, and other assigned projects.

Audit and Tax Compliance – Uphold Standards and Regulations

  • Assist in the preparation and performance of annual audit and tax return and other periodic regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare requested schedules and documentation for auditors in a neat, concise, and timely manner.
  • Manage sales and use tax returns along with all other applicable returns.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

What We Require for the Job:

A detail-oriented, analytical professional with a deep commitment to Pace’s mission and values. Someone who excels in financial management, compliance, and reporting, and can effectively support the organization's fiscal health and sustainability.

Core Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in accounting or business.

  • In-depth knowledge of accounting processing and reporting systems.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office.
  • Knowledge of relevant federal and state laws impacting not-for-profit fiscal compliance and reporting.
  • Advanced analytical and critical thinking skills; strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with a wide range of management, staff, and external vendors.
  • Strong computer and internet research skills.

Other

About this job:

We are looking for aData Business Analyst (1 seat, Middle to Senior level) for our client, one of the largest specialty provider networks in the US and part of a major healthcare company. The network includes independent and affiliated practices in urology, gastroenterology, rheumatology, and oncology. The goal is to turn practice EHR data (joined with pathology and genomic reports, medical claims, and disease registries at the patient level) into real-world data products that pharma and biotech companies license and build on.

The Data Business Analyst owns the definitions and the specs. They take what pharma customers, sales, and the business ask for and turn it into specs the data team can build, starting with prostate and bladder cancer. They check the data before a spec goes out.

  • Start: As soon as possible;
  • Length: 6-month initial term, expected to extend well past that;
  • Hours: Full-time, US Eastern business hours;
  • Work format: Remote, with onshore preferred and nearshore accepted if fully aligned with US Eastern hours. Occasional US office visits required; frequency yet to be determined;
  • Team mix: The seat can be supported by, or blended with, nearshore or offshore staff;
  • Data platform: Databricks (Delta Lake, medallion architecture) on Azure, alongside a large SQL Server estate with legacy stored procedures.

Location: Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Uruguay, Peru, Colombia, Costa Rica

How you'll make an impact:

  • Own the product definition and Concept of Operations for each data product;
  • Take long, messy field lists from sales, customers, and the business and turn them into ranked, buildable specs;
  • Own one set of definitions every group uses: what counts as a patient, a stage, a line of therapy, and a refresh;
  • Work the data before writing a spec: profile the source, check fill rates, and confirm what the records support;
  • Sit with the architect, engineers, and clinical reviewers to settle how each field gets built and checked;
  • Write the acceptance criteria and sign off that what was built matches what was asked.

What makes you a great fit:

  • Experience writing specs for a clinical data product that was built without rework;
  • Knowledge of clinical fields: stage, biomarkers, lines of therapy, and outcomes;
  • Understanding of what pharma researchers and commercial teams need from each field;
  • Hands-on experience with data: SQL, source-to-target mapping, and data models;
  • Experience as the single owner of definitions across business, product, and data groups.

You are a star if you have:

  • Experience working at a real-world data company such as Flatiron Health, ConcertAI, or Tempus, or at a provider network or health system that sells its data;
  • Oncology or urology data experience, including pathology and genomic reports;
  • Experience with EHR, claims, and registry data, and the OMOP common data model;
  • Experience writing specs for fields that AI pulls from clinical notes, including when a person reviews them;
  • Experience writing a product definition or Concept of Operations for a data product sold to pharma;
  • Knowledge of the coding systems ICD-10, CPT, NDC, and LOINC;
  • Experience building or using data readiness scorecards: fill rates, coverage, and what changed between refreshes;
  • Experience working in Databricks with SQL, and using work tools such as Jira or Confluence.

jobs.description:
Overview

Title: Director of Donor RelationsLocation: Remote

Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 USD Annaully

Position Summary

The Director of Donor Relations is responsible for cultivating, securing, and sustaining financial support for Corporate Chaplains of America (CCA). This role focuses on identifying, researching, qualifying, and developing relationships with prospective donors while strengthening engagement with existing supporters to encourage long-term commitment and increased giving.

A primary responsibility is cultivating meaningful relationships with major gift donors, defined as individuals or organizations with the capacity to contribute $5,000 or more annually. Through intentional relationship-building and personalized engagement, the Director will connect donors' philanthropic interests and passions with CCA's mission, helping them experience the fulfillment of investing in a ministry that makes a lasting spiritual impact.

The Director will implement strategies to expand CCA's donor base, improve donor retention, increase charitable contributions, and foster lasting partnerships that advance the organization's mission and long-term sustainability.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identify, qualify, cultivate, and steward a portfolio of major donors, with particular emphasis on developing relationships with prospective donors outside CCA's existing ecosystem.

  • Establish individualized fundraising goals for each donor based on giving history, demonstrated interests, engagement, and financial capacity.

  • Develop and execute personalized donor engagement strategies, including communication, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship plans designed to strengthen relationships, improve retention, and increase giving.

  • Build and maintain meaningful, long-term relationships with CCA's major donors, connecting their philanthropic interests with the mission and impact of the ministry.

  • Utilize Salesforce to effectively manage donor relationships, track engagement activities, maintain accurate records, and identify opportunities for continued cultivation and increased support.

  • Maintain accurate, confidential donor records in accordance with CCA's Privacy Policy and established organizational standards.

  • Prepare and submit timely weekly and monthly reports, as directed by leadership, accurately reflecting donor engagement, fundraising activities, progress toward established goals, and overall performance.

  • Travel extensively, with an expectation of more than 50% travel, to cultivate donor relationships, conduct meetings, and represent CCA at ministry-related events.

  • Perform additional donor relations and development responsibilities as assigned to support CCA's fundraising objectives and organizational mission.

Spiritual and Ministry Responsibilities

  • Actively participate in and, when appropriate, lead biblical devotions, worship, and group prayer.

  • Faithfully support the mission, leadership, employees, and ministry partners of CCA through regular intercessory prayer.

  • Provide biblical teaching and training to business owners and employees when invited and authorized.

  • When ordained and appropriately qualified, conduct funeral services and provide biblical counseling and spiritual care to business owners, employees, and their families, as opportunities arise.

  • Consistently demonstrate a Christ-centered character, biblical integrity, and a commitment to advancing CCA's mission through professional responsibilities and personal conduct.

Qualifications

Qualifications and Requirements

Spiritual Qualifications

  • Demonstrate a strong, growing personal relationship with Jesus Christ and a clear sense of God's calling to serve in Christian ministry.

  • Maintain a personal commitment to CCA's Christian mission and demonstrate a passion for advancing the ministry of corporate chaplaincy.

  • Affirm and uphold CCA's Statement of Faith.

  • Demonstrate alignment with CCA's Core Values and Missionary Mindset.

  • Respect CCA's Christian beliefs and consistently adhere to the organization's Christian Community Standards.

  • Actively participate in a local Christian church.

  • Exhibit personal integrity, spiritual maturity, and a lifestyle consistent with biblical principles and an authentic Christian faith.

Professional Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to identify, research, qualify, and cultivate prospective major donors with significant giving potential.

  • Ability to establish realistic, measurable fundraising goals based on individual donor giving history, financial capacity, and engagement potential.

  • Proven ability to develop and execute personalized donor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies that reflect individual interests, motivations, giving patterns, and communication preferences.

  • Ability to develop compelling fundraising proposals, presentations, and donor communications that clearly articulate ministry needs, opportunities, and measurable impact.

  • Demonstrated commitment to donor stewardship, including providing timely and meaningful updates regarding the use and impact of charitable contributions.

  • Ability to establish performance metrics, monitor fundraising progress, and prepare accurate, timely reports for organizational leadership.

  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to build trust and establish meaningful relationships with diverse donors and ministry partners.

  • Ability to communicate CCA's mission, vision, and ministry impact with clarity, authenticity, and passion.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and donor relationships in a dynamic environment.

  • Demonstrate a positive, professional attitude and a collaborative, service-oriented approach.

  • Possess strong critical-thinking, creative problem-solving, and strategic planning abilities.

  • Demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to independently identify opportunities and resolve challenges effectively.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required.

  • Denominational ordination preferred.

  • Minimum of 1–3 years of experience in donor relations, fundraising, development, client relations, or a related field.

  • Experience cultivating major gifts and managing donor portfolios preferred.

  • Experience utilizing donor relationship management systems, particularly Salesforce, preferred.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

The physical demands and working conditions described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job responsibilities.

  • Work is primarily performed in a remote office environment, with frequent travel to donor meetings, ministry events, and organizational functions.

  • Position requires extensive travel, generally exceeding 50%, which may include overnight stays and occasional evening or weekend commitments.

  • Physical exertion is generally minimal, with occasional periods of prolonged standing, walking, or sitting during meetings, travel, and events.

  • Regularly requires the ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and through virtual communication platforms.

  • Frequently requires the use of computers, mobile devices, and standard office equipment.

  • May occasionally require bending, reaching, climbing stairs, or carrying lightweight materials associated with meetings and events.

  • Requires visual abilities sufficient to read documents, operate computer equipment, and perform essential job responsibilities, with or without reasonable accommodation.

jobs.description:
Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte :

Un grand groupe du secteur des services à l’environnement recherche un Product Owner métier GMAO pour accompagner la transition de son environnement Maximo vers Maximo Application Suite 9 (MAS 9).
Le programme s’appuie sur des équipes disposant d’une bonne connaissance de Maximo et sur un partenaire chargé de la configuration. Le PO portera la vision et les besoins métier, en interface avec les utilisateurs, les équipes SI et ce partenaire.

Votre rôle :

Vous traduisez les enjeux opérationnels de maintenance en besoins fonctionnels clairs et priorisés. Vous challengez les demandes, contribuez aux arbitrages et veillez à ce que la solution cible réponde aux usages des équipes.
Votre responsabilité porte principalement sur le contenu fonctionnel, la coordination métier et la validation des évolutions.

Vos principales missions :

1. Porter les besoins métier

  • Recueillir et analyser les besoins des utilisateurs de la GMAO.
  • Animer les ateliers avec les équipes de maintenance et d’exploitation.
  • Identifier les processus à conserver, à simplifier ou à faire évoluer lors de la transition.
  • Formaliser les exigences, les user stories et les critères d’acceptation.

2. Structurer le backlog et les arbitrages

  • Construire et maintenir le backlog produit.
  • Proposer les priorités en fonction de la valeur métier, des contraintes opérationnelles et des dépendances.
  • Challenger les demandes de reprise à l’identique et de développements spécifiques.
  • Préparer et documenter les arbitrages avec les parties prenantes.

3. Coordonner la mise en œuvre

  • Assurer l’interface entre les métiers, les équipes SI et le partenaire de configuration.
  • Clarifier les besoins et suivre leur traduction dans la solution.
  • Évaluer les conséquences fonctionnelles des choix proposés.
  • Contribuer à l’identification des dépendances avec les données et les applications connectées.

4. Organiser la validation et accompagner la transition

  • Définir les scénarios de recette à partir des usages métier.
  • Coordonner la participation des utilisateurs à la recette et suivre les anomalies.
  • Veiller à la couverture des besoins prioritaires avant le déploiement.
  • Contribuer à la préparation des supports utilisateurs et à l’accompagnement du changement.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que Product Owner, responsable fonctionnel ou Business Analyst senior sur des projets de GMAO, avec une pratique fonctionnelle de Maximo.

Compétences indispensables :

  • Bonne maîtrise des processus de maintenance et de gestion des actifs : équipements, ordres de travail, maintenance préventive et corrective.
  • Expérience fonctionnelle concrète de Maximo.
  • Participation à une migration ou à une montée de version de Maximo.
  • Connaissance de Maximo Application Suite, idéalement MAS 9.
  • Participation à l’harmonisation de processus de maintenance entre plusieurs équipes ou sites.
  • Capacité à recueillir, challenger et prioriser des besoins métier.
  • Expérience de coordination entre utilisateurs, équipes SI et intégrateur.
  • Maîtrise de la formalisation des exigences et de la recette fonctionnelle.

Qualités attendues :

  • Écoute des utilisateurs et compréhension des réalités opérationnelles.
  • Capacité à challenger les demandes et à expliciter les compromis.
  • Rigueur dans la formalisation et le suivi des besoins.
  • Aisance pour faciliter les échanges entre interlocuteurs métier et techniques.
  • Capacité de synthèse et sens des priorités.

Mobilité

Non renseigné

jobs.title: Senior Continuous Improvement Manager
jobs.excerpt: Fluke Health Solutions is seeking a Senior Fortive Business System Leader(FBSL) to partner with business and functional leaders in applying FBS to the organization's most important priorities.
jobs.description:
Fluke Health Solutions is seeking a Senior Fortive Business System Leader(FBSL) to partner with business and functional leaders in applying FBS to the organization's most important priorities. This role translates strategic objectives, customer needs, and performance gaps into focused improvement strategies that deliver measurable and sustainable results.

The Senior FBSL prepares for and facilitates complex Kaizen events, leads structured problem solving, builds organizational capability, and creates followership without relying on positional authority. Success requires strong Lean and FBS fundamentals, business acumen, adaptability, self-directed learning, and effectiveness across virtual, hybrid, and in-person environments.

Who You Are

  • Experienced Lean and continuous improvement practitioner who connects strategy, Kaizen activity, and measurable results.
  • Skillful facilitator able to prepare for and lead multiple complex Kaizens concurrently without compromising quality or sustainment.
  • Influential leader who creates alignment and followership across functions and organizational levels.
  • Versatile coach and mentor who connects with L2 leaders, functional leaders, continuous improvement practitioners, FBSLs, and team members closest to FHS products and customers.
  • Structured problem solver with exposure to product, commercial, service, or customer-facing work and an aptitude for AI-enabled and digital tools.

Key Responsibilities Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as the FBS partner for assigned functions, sites, or priorities and understand their customers, processes, performance, and capability needs.
  • Translate strategic priorities and performance gaps into focused improvement plans, clear measures, actions, and operating cadences.
  • Constructively challenge assumptions, build stakeholder alignment, and communicate progress, results, risks, and support needs.

Kaizen Preparation, Facilitation, and Sustainment

  • Partner with leaders on complex Kaizens from scoping and prework through facilitation, implementation, and sustainment across operational, transactional, commercial, product, service, and customer-facing environments.
  • Prepare for and lead multiple Kaizens concurrently while maintaining planning quality, sponsor alignment, engagement, execution, and sustainment.
  • Provides leadership for large-scale President’s Kaizen and Shingijutsu events by orchestrating stakeholder alignment, event selection, logistics, executive engagement, and governance activities to deliver measurable business results and a high-impact participant experience.
  • Partner with sponsors and process owners to define the problem, scope, objectives, team, measures, customer outcomes, roles, risks, milestones, and expected results.
  • Engage team members closest to FHS customers, products, services, and processes, so their knowledge informs problem definition and solutions.
  • Guide teams through root-cause analysis, decisions, and countermeasure development while driving ownership and accountability.
  • Translate outcomes into implementation plans with clear ownership, and escalation expectations while monitoring their sustainment.
  • Facilitate effectively in virtual, hybrid, and in-person settings.

Problem Solving, Performance, and FBS Leadership

  • Lead structured problem solving using facts, process data, customer information, and a broad cross-functional perspective.
  • Select and apply the appropriate FBS approach rather than defaulting to a manufacturing-oriented solution.
  • Connect improvement work to strategic, financial, operational, commercial, quality, and customer KPIs.
  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in multiple FBS tools and serve as a technical resource to leaders and practitioners.
  • Support policy deployment, daily management, business operations reviews, and improvement funnels so they drive decisions and action.

Coaching, Influence, and Capability Building

  • Coach individuals at all levels, from team members closest to FHS products and customers through L2 leaders, adapting style to the audience and situation.
  • Coach leaders in using FBS to set priorities, review performance, remove barriers, solve problems, and lead change.
  • Develop Champions and Practitioners through training, application, observation, feedback, and progressively greater ownership.
  • Set the standard for what good looks like for FBSLs in business partnership, prework, facilitation, sponsor engagement, problem solving, implementation, and sustainment.
  • Create followership through credibility, business understanding, candid communication, and consistent follow-through.
  • Transfer ownership to leaders and process owners rather than creating dependency on the FBS team.

Adaptability, Virtual Leadership, and Digital Improvement

  • Lead change through ambiguity and shifting priorities while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
  • Build productive relationships across functions, sites, cultures, and time zones using virtual collaboration and visual management.
  • Apply AI, automation, analytics, and digital tools responsibly to defined business needs and share practical learning.

Qualifications Required

  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in continuous improvement, operations, product, service, commercial, customer-facing, or another relevant environment.
  • Five or more years of hands-on experience applying Lean, FBS, or comparable continuous-improvement fundamentals.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex Kaizens from problem definition and prework through implementation and sustainment, including multiple concurrent events.
  • Project-management capability within a Kaizen environment, including scope, milestones, ownership, risks, measures, stakeholder alignment, and implementation planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate cross-functional problem solving, coach from frontline team members through L2 leaders, and influence without direct authority.
  • Exposure to product, commercial, service, or customer-facing work sufficient to understand customer-centered challenges and commercial problem solving.
  • Strong business acumen, communication, facilitation, adaptability, independent judgment, and self-directed learning.
  • Aptitude for AI-enabled tools, analytics, automation, and digital collaboration.
  • Ability to lead virtually and travel up to one week per month.

What Success Looks Like

  • Multiple Kaizens are prepared for and facilitated concurrently with strong participation, measurable results, clear ownership, and sustained performance.
  • L2 leaders and team members closest to FHS products and customers are effectively engaged, and their perspectives are connected in improvement decisions.
  • Leaders, process owners, Champions, Practitioners, and FBSLs demonstrate increased capability and ownership.
  • Improvement activity is prioritized around customer and business impact and supported by disciplined problem solving.
  • Relevant AI and digital capabilities improve productivity, analysis, decision-making, or customer outcomes.

Role: Senior Associate - Policy Engagement, Mumbai
Experience: 4+ years
Salary: 9 to 12 LPA

Role Overview
We seek individuals to work in our Policy Engagement vertical and help us in the creation of evidence-backed collaterals. This will involve conducting literature reviews, analyzing government budgets, policies, and programs, reviewing existing evidence, and liaising with academics and experts to produce sharp insights, policy briefs, and actionable toolkits.
This role requires a solid understanding of public policy in India, social research methodologies, and program evaluation. Most importantly, the ideal candidate must have a strong belief that cash transfers empower people with choice, dignity, and the ability to carve their own path out of poverty.
Key Responsibilities:
Research & Data Analysis
  • Work closely with the policy research and program teams to conduct evidence-based research on social policies and author articles and briefs.
  • Develop concept notes and decks for proposed ideas and programs.
  • Support in producing comprehensive research reports, whitepapers, and presentations for stakeholders.
  • Ensure wide dissemination of insights into the cash transfer movement, including existing schemes, internal implementation, and global research.
  • Support monitoring, evaluation, and data analysis efforts, including building research tools for program implementation.
Policy Engagement
  • Undertake rigorous analysis of different aspects of the cash transfer movement in India to understand gap areas and potential solutions to strengthen our role in enabling cost-effective impact at scale.
  • Support the team in developing and executing a policy engagement plan to engage with relevant stakeholders, including governments.
Communication
  • Effectively communicate research findings to stakeholders through slide decks, concept notes, policy briefs, op-eds, newspaper articles, and journals.
  • Build and maintain stakeholder relationships independently.
Qualifications and Experience:
  • Education: A Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Development Studies, or a related field is strongly preferred.
  • Work Experience: At least 3 years of full-time, relevant work experience with a preferred Master's degree.
  • Alternatively, candidates with a Master's degree and at least 6 years of full-time work experience in empirical analysis, policy-focused research, and writing will be considered.
  • Candidates with over 3 years of experience working with government stakeholders on a day-to-day basis are highly preferred.
Technical Skills:
  • Experience in preparing high-quality policy briefs, research papers, and concept notes is required.
  • Experience working with government orders, budgets, and policies is required.
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, data analysis, and interpretation is required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools is required.
  • Prior experience with data analysis software such as Stata, R, JAMOVI, or Tableau is preferred.
  • Familiarity with major Indian research datasets and experience compiling/using complex, large-scale datasets is preferred.
Knowledge & Competencies:
  • Familiarity with cash transfer programs, poverty dynamics, social security systems, and fieldwork is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of macroeconomics, public policy, and development economics is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated commitment to ethical research practices and a passion for social justice.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex research findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, handling uncertainties, and adapting quickly to organizational needs.
  • Language & Travel:
    • Ability to understand Marathi; proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the language is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryMAG Aerospace is recruiting for a Senior Network Engineer who will Architect and manage secure, scalable enterprise network infrastructure that connects business operations across cloud and on-premises environments.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

MAG Aerospace is recruiting for a Senior Network Engineer who will Architect and manage secure, scalable enterprise network infrastructure that connects business operations across cloud and on-premises environments. You'll design robust network solutions that ensure seamless connectivity, security, and performance while supporting digital transformation initiatives and multi-tenant secure environments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop network monitoring, automation, and performance optimization strategies
  • Configure and manage Microsoft Azure networking services (VNets, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Network Security Groups)
  • Evaluate, re-evaluate, understand, and support existing/legacy network requirements, including documenting and extending/revisiting implementations
  • Design and implement enterprise network architectures for hybrid cloud environments
  • Work with other IT cross-functional teams for collaboration where networkoperations could be impacted
  • Deploy and maintain Fortinet security appliances (FortiGate firewalls, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager)
  • Configure and optimize Cisco enterprise networking equipment (switches, routers, wireless controllers)
  • Implement network segmentation and microsegmentation strategies for secure multi-tenant environments
  • Design and deploy software-defined WAN (SD-WAN) solutions
  • Configure quality of service (QoS) for business-critical applications

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Support cybersecurity compliance requirements
  • Implement zero-trust network security architectures
  • Design and configure network access control (NAC) solutions
  • Perform network security assessments and vulnerability remediation
  • Implement advanced threat protection and intrusion prevention systems
  • Support compliance requirements (SOX, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2)
  • Manage network automation and infrastructure-as-code initiatives
  • Provide escalation support for complex network issues
  • Implement network security controls (encryption, authentication, segmentation)
  • Design and configure firewall rules and intrusion detection
  • Perform network vulnerability assessments
  • Implement zero-trust network architectures

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering
  • Advanced Knowledge of routing, switching, and network protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, STP, VLANs, QoS, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure networking (Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, Application Gateway, Microsoft Entra ID)
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls and security appliances (Fortinet, Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto,etc.)
  • Experience with FortiGate SD-WAN implementation
  • Experience with Cisco Identity Service Engine (ISE)
  • Experience troubleshooting network security protocols (IPSec, SSL/TLS, 802.1X)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Cisco enterprise equipment (Catalyst switches, ISR/ASR routers, Wireless LAN Controllers)
  • Experience with network automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, Python scripting)
  • Understanding of container networking (Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Experience with SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela, Silver Peak, VeloCloud)
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools (FortiManager, PRTG, Nagios)
  • Experience with secure remote access solutions (VPN, ZTNA)
  • CCNA/CCNP, Azure certifications, or Fortinet NSE certifications

Clearance:

  • Must be eligible for Secret Security Clearance
  • US Citizenship required

Special Note

The position is contingent upon candidate’s ability to meet physical and medical requirements as needed by the position; including compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local jurisdictional requirements.

Benefits and Compensation

At MAG Aerospace, we value your contributions providing our employees with a robust Total Rewards package that supports your total well-being. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in MAG's Total Rewards programs. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits as well as paid leave, professional development, and tuition assistance. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our Total Rewards Program by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site: Salary at MAG Aerospace is determined by various factors including but not limited to location, the particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $97500 to $162500 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of MAG's total compensation package for employees.

  • Construir e manter pipelines de ingestão, transformação e qualidade de dados em batch e streaming com BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub e Cloud Storage.

  • Conhecimento em governança e segurança de dados no GCP: Cloud IAM, Dataplex, policy tags e Cloud KMS.
  • Terraform e CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou similares).
  • Experiência prática em ambientes GCP com múltiplos projetos, organização e folders.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e orientados a eventos (filas, retries, idempotência e consistência).
  • Experiência preparando dados para ao menos uma aplicação com LLM em produção (RAG ou agentes com uso de ferramentas).
  • Conhecimento de LGPD aplicada a dados sensíveis, incluindo técnicas de anonimização e mascaramento.

    Diferenciais

  • Vertex AI (RAG Engine, Vertex AI Search, Agent Engine, Pipelines), Gemini e Model Armor.
  • Frameworks de agentes (ADK, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI) e desenvolvimento de servidores MCP.
  • Vector stores (Vertex AI Vector Search, AlloyDB com pgvector, BigQuery Vector Search); GraphRAG é um plus.
  • Experiência no setor de saúde ou com padrões de dados clínicos (HL7, FHIR, Cloud Healthcare API).
  • Data Mesh, arquitetura hub-and-spoke e FinOps no GCP.
  • Certificação Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Professional Machine Learning Engineer ou FinOps Certified Practitioner.

    • Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara com cientistas de dados, times de IA, áreas de negócio e parceiros externos.
  • Disciplina de segurança e ética no tratamento de dados sensíveis de pacientes, especialmente quando consumidos por agentes autônomos.
  • Capacidade de explicitar trade-offs técnicos (cópia de dados vs. acesso entre projetos, batch vs. streaming, custo vs. latência).

jobs.excerpt: Get to know us betterCodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms.
jobs.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join the team behind a leading network source-of-truth (NSoT) platform, used by thousands of organizations - from fast-growing tech companies to Fortune 500 enterprises - to model, document, and automate their network infrastructure.

CodiLime engineers work within the platform's Observability team, which connects the network source of truth with what is actually running on the network. The team builds products for network discovery, network assurance (detecting drift between the intended and the actual state of the network), management of the agents that collect discovery and telemetry data, and a reliable pipeline that ingests this data into the platform.

The platform is built AI-first, with its own Claude Code agent skills and MCP server, and that mindset carries over to how the team works: Claude Code is used heavily day to day to help the team move fast and consistently deliver high-quality results.

In this role, you will build and run the infrastructure and tooling behind the platform's products - from AWS and Kubernetes environments, through CI/CD pipelines, to the observability stack - for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform. The scale is significant: some of the platform's largest customers manage hundreds of thousands of devices across globally distributed environments.

As the observability offering keeps growing, the team is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who manages infrastructure through code and automation, owns the reliability of what they deploy, and works closely with developers to get code to production.

Technology stack:

  • Cloud: AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, EKS)

  • Containerization & orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Docker Compose

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Helm

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, OpenTelemetry

  • Programming & scripting: Python, Go, shell scripting

  • Data & messaging: PostgreSQL (RDS), event streaming and CDC, RabbitMQ, MQTT

  • Security & compliance: IAM, SOC 2 controls, OAuth2

  • APIs: REST, gRPC

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, MCP servers, Anthropic tooling

What else you should know:

  • Small, cross-functional team with strong ownership of reliability, security and automation

  • The team is distributed across Europe and the US, and we are looking for someone whose working hours can overlap with the US East Coast

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow - Claude Code is used heavily across the team

  • This is an infrastructure-focused role, working closely with the product teams to connect code to production

  • Startup-like vibe: proactive, ownership-driven, fast-paced

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building and maintaining infrastructure for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform

  • Operating and optimizing AWS infrastructure (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS) for cost, security and performance

  • Managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and Helm

  • Building and improving CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and internal platform tooling that lets developers serve themselves

  • Improving monitoring, alerting and incident response, and defining SLOs (Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki)

  • Helping enforce security and compliance standards, including SOC 2 controls

  • Working closely with the product teams to get code to production reliably

  • Contributing to documentation and onboarding, and taking part in the on-call rotation

  • Using Claude Code day to day: setting constraints, reviewing the output and staying accountable for correctness and security

Do we have a match?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering

  • Strong experience with AWS, especially EKS and Kubernetes

  • Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Helm

  • CI/CD experience (ideally GitHub Actions)

  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir or Loki, and with OpenTelemetry

  • Proficiency in Python, Go or shell scripting

  • Experience with CDC and event streaming, or with scaling large multi-tenant observability systems

  • Comfort in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools (ideally Claude Code)

  • Strong communication and documentation skills

  • Availability for an on-call rotation and working hours overlapping with the US East Coast

  • Good knowledge of English (minimum C1 level)

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with SOC 2 or other security-focused environments

  • Experience with messaging technologies such as MQTT or AMQP (e.g. RabbitMQ)

  • Familiarity with network source-of-truth or network automation tooling

  • Open-source contributions

  • Experience working in a B2B software startup (ideally 2+ years)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

jobs.excerpt: Learn to Evaluate Freight, Not Just Find ItWe are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.
jobs.description:
Learn to Evaluate Freight, Not Just Find It

We are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.S. transportation operations with a focus on freight evaluation, load selection, mileage calculations, and operational planning.

This position is entry-level specifically in professional freight dispatching. Previous employment as a freight dispatcher is not required. Applicants must, however, have relevant exposure to U.S. trucking or transportation operations and a working understanding of freight load boards.

The right candidate should understand that a load cannot be evaluated by rate alone. Deadhead, loaded miles, equipment, appointments, driver availability, Hours of Service, and operating requirements all affect whether freight makes sense for a truck.

What You'll Evaluate

  • Search DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.
  • Compare available freight by lane, equipment type, mileage, rate, and appointment requirements.
  • Calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Identify excessive deadhead and inefficient freight options.
  • Review pickup and delivery schedules for operational feasibility.
  • Consider available driver Hours of Service when evaluating loads.
  • Determine whether available equipment is appropriate for the freight.
  • Identify potential delays, accessorial considerations, and unusual load requirements.
  • Organize suitable freight options for authorized review and booking.

Understanding Freight Economics

Freight evaluation requires looking beyond the advertised load rate.

You will be expected to understand how factors such as:

  • Loaded mileage
  • Deadhead mileage
  • Rate per mile
  • Equipment type
  • Pickup and delivery appointments
  • Driver Hours of Service
  • Freight lanes
  • Driver location and availability
  • Potential detention or other accessorial situations

affect the operational value of a load.

Applicants should be comfortable working with mileage calculations, spreadsheets, freight information, and basic trip economics.

Relevant Transportation Background

Prior professional freight-dispatch employment is not required.

Relevant experience or knowledge may come from:

  • CDL-A truck driving
  • Owner-operator or fleet operations
  • Transportation coordination
  • Truck-driver recruiting with practical trucking knowledge
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Carrier operations
  • Load planning
  • Logistics or transportation operations

Applicants must have enough U.S. trucking knowledge to understand basic freight terminology, equipment, mileage, lanes, and load-board information.

Essential Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Familiarity with freight load boards such as DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable systems.
  • Understanding of common equipment types including Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, and Step Deck.
  • Ability to calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total miles, and rate per mile.
  • Basic understanding of U.S. freight lanes.
  • Working understanding of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Strong spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with drivers, brokers, carriers, and transportation personnel.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.
  • Computer proficiency and reliable internet access.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Verify freight information before presenting loads for review.
  • Communicate load information accurately to drivers and authorized operations personnel.
  • Assist with pickup and delivery scheduling.
  • Review rate confirmations and load information for consistency with agreed terms.
  • Monitor active shipments and document operational changes.
  • Maintain accurate load and dispatch records.
  • Escalate broker-verification, safety, compliance, service, or documentation concerns.
  • Maintain professional and timely communication throughout assigned operations.

Work Arrangement

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. transportation operations.

The position requires availability during assigned U.S. trucking operating hours. Specific working days and schedules will be provided as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, dependable communication capability, and a professional remote-work environment.

  • Short-term & Long-term disability

Job Summary and Responsibilities

SUMMARY

Circet USA is a premier technology infrastructure design, build, and maintain partner. The Director, Project Management Office (PMO) will build and lead the Data Center Services PMO and Primavera P6 scheduling department. This hands-on leader establishes the project delivery framework, project controls, scheduling standards, governance, tools, reporting, and talent needed to support rapid growth and consistent execution across the project portfolio.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following; other duties may be assigned:

  • Define the PMO charter, operating model, roles, decision rights, governance cadence, and project delivery framework from preconstruction handoff through closeout and customer turnover.
  • Establish common standards and templates for project kickoffs, stage gates, risk and issue logs, change management, lessons learned, closeout, and customer reporting.
  • Select and implement the PMO tools and reporting stack in partnership with IT, Finance, Operations, Sales, and Estimating.
  • Build and lead the Primavera P6 scheduling department, including its mission, organization, staffing plan, hiring, training, career paths, and operating standards.
  • Serve as the business unit authority for P6 enterprise structure, coding, calendars, permissions, templates, baselines, resource loading, and update protocols.
  • Develop repeatable schedule templates for data center scopes, including structured cabling, phased data hall turnover, and commissioning support.
  • Require sound critical path method schedules and lead schedule-quality reviews using recognized criteria such as the DCMA 14-point assessment.
  • Oversee look-ahead schedules, recovery plans, delay analyses, and time impact analyses supporting change orders and claims.
  • Align Circet schedules with owner, customer, and general contractor master schedules and reporting requirements.
  • Provide leadership with an integrated view of portfolio health across schedule, cost, margin, safety, quality, staffing, change, and risk.
  • Partner with Finance on forecasting, estimates at completion, change-order tracking, work-in-progress reviews, and margin performance.
  • Lead monthly portfolio reviews, identify at-risk projects early, and present data-supported recovery recommendations to the SVP.
  • Define and maintain key performance indicators for project delivery, PMO effectiveness, schedule quality, and portfolio performance.
  • Forecast labor and resource demand across backlog and pipeline, identify capacity constraints, and connect training capacity to project demand.
  • Support Sales and Estimating with schedule development, delivery plans, and customer-facing project-controls content.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop PMO and scheduling professionals; train project managers, superintendents, and field leaders on standards and tools.
  • Build a culture of accurate reporting, early escalation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to Project Managers for change management and change order execution on their assigned project/s.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to Project Managers as applies to project budget management, job cost control, and earned value management on their assigned project/s.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability required.

  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be substituted.
  • 10+ years of project delivery, project controls, or scheduling experience in data center, mission-critical, telecommunications, or complex infrastructure construction.
  • 5+ years leading a PMO, project controls group, scheduling team, or leading large-scale delivery.
  • Demonstrated success building or substantially rebuilding a PMO or scheduling function in a rapid-growth environment.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Primavera P6, critical path method scheduling, schedule logic, baselines, resource loading, and schedule-quality review.
  • Experience with recovery schedules, delay analysis, time impact analysis, and change orders tied to schedule impacts.
  • Working knowledge of contractor financials, including forecasting, estimates at completion, margin, and work in progress.
  • Experience reporting to executives and working directly with owners, customers, and general contractors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience supporting hyperscale or colocation data center delivery.
  • Familiarity with structured cabling, methods of procedure (MOPs), commissioning levels, TIA-942, and BICSI standards.
  • PMP, PMI-SP, AACE PSP, or AACE CCP certification.
  • Experience with Power BI or a similar reporting platform and construction management software such as Procore.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed or similarly high-growth services business.
  • Experience with field-services workforces and labor-capacity planning.

COMPETENCIES

  • Strategic Leadership and PMO Development
  • Primavera P6 and Project Scheduling
  • Project Controls and Portfolio Governance
  • Financial Acumen and Performance Reporting
  • Risk, Change, and Claims Management
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Influence
  • Executive and Customer Communication
  • Talent Development and Change Adoption

SUCCESS MEASURES

  • Within 30 days: current projects, tools, and reporting gaps assessed; PMO charter and hiring plan approved.
  • Within 90 days: P6 environment and standards defined; initial schedulers hired or assigned; monthly portfolio review operating; highest-risk projects on P6 schedules.
  • Within 6 months: all new projects launched using standard templates and stage gates; portfolio dashboard live; schedule-quality reviews established.
  • Within 12 months: all active projects baselined in P6; PMO and scheduling teams staffed to plan; labor forecasts informing capacity decisions; function prepared to support continued growth.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex business, construction, contractual, and technical documents; ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and communicate clearly with executives, customers, general contractors, and field teams.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate and interpret percentages, rates, variances, productivity, forecast-to-complete values, margins, schedule performance, earned-value indicators, and other project and financial measures; ability to apply basic algebra and quantitative reasoning.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to define problems, collect and validate data, establish facts, evaluate alternatives, identify cause and effect, and draw sound conclusions in situations involving multiple variables, competing priorities, and incomplete information.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; talk; and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role combines office or remote work with regular travel to active project sites and customer locations. Site visits may require personal protective equipment and compliance with site safety, security, and access requirements. JOB SUMMARY

The Lead Systems Engineer provides leadership, expertise, and delegates work for design document deliverables for building automation system (BAS), electrical power monitoring system (EPMS), and software integration design projects in hyperscale data center and similar mission critical / technology sectors.

The Lead Systems Engineer will work with internal and external MEP/FP trade engineers, equipment representatives, product vendors, and BIM / Revit / AutoCAD production resources.

The Lead Systems Engineer will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. This role also will coordinate activities of other personnel and serve as a people manager.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals / values, and departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Develop and Execute Building Automation Systems Engineering Solutions (55%)

  • Serve as client program lead, project trade lead, and SME for the BAS and EPMS scope for one or more projects and / or programs.
  • Develop client standards, basis of design (BOD), perform feasibility studies, and assist clients with building automation roadmaps
  • Lead designs for DDC and PLC based BAS and EPMS systems
  • Design controls network / system architecture including IT / OT requirements
  • Select instrumentation, sensors, actuators, valves and other field devices
  • Coordinate with equipment, system, and product vendors for building automation interface requirements
  • Create and review project book and sheet specifications
  • Create and review sequence of operations
  • Create and review system diagrams and point / alarm lists
  • Work closely with client IT departments for network design, interface details, and security requirements
  • Provide direction on engineering production aspects with internal and external Revit / BIM resources

Construction Related Process, Deliverables and Submissions (15%)

  • Accountable for design document deliverables for design phases including Schematic Design (SD), Design Development (DD), Issue For Permit (IFP), Issue For Construction (IFC)
  • Lead planning and execution of Construction Administration (CA) phase activities remote and on site
  • Lead building automation focused design reviews and page turns
  • ​Participate in internal and external quality control and peer reviews
  • Lead internal and external project meeting discussions on engineering scope

Reporting and Communication (15%)

  • Manage project communication and reporting
  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

People Manager (15%)

  • Implement and monitor team objectives to meet set goals.
  • Manage and execute departmental or organizational projects, ensuring alignment with departmental focus.
  • Ensure employee adherence to company policies and procedures, serve as the first stop for employee questions on workplace rules and practices.

  • Cultivate a team environment that encourages cooperation and collective problem-solving.
  • Assist with team and departmental hiring and recruiting processes.

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Skilled in navigating clients through BAS project designs including identification of standards, needs, and option evaluation
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management

    • Wireless systems, including Wi-Fi

    • Access control
    • Intrusion detection
    • Video surveillance systems
