jobs.description:
HEAD OF GROWTH - SAMAKO CLEANING

Full-time | Remote (EU)

Competitive package + performance bonus

We've partnered with Samako Cleaning, a fast-scaling direct-to-consumer home-care brand, to find a Head of Growth who can lead its next stage of scale. This is a true build-and-scale opportunity: take fragmented growth activity and turn it into a structured, systemised and predictable engine connecting acquisition, eCommerce, conversion and retention.

ABOUT SAMAKO CLEANING

At Samako, we believe a clean home creates a clear mind. Cleaning shouldn't feel like a chore or a source of frustration; it should bring calm, clarity and balance to everyday life. Rooted in Dutch design, Samako creates minimalist, beautifully crafted cleaning companions designed to be seen and used. Thoughtful products, packaging and customer experiences help transform a functional category into a desirable lifestyle brand.

After strong and consistent growth, Samako is building the foundation for an internationally scalable €100M+ business. The opportunity is to bring full marketing ownership, structure and creative leadership to the heart of the company.

Explore the brand:

THE ROLE

The Head of Growth owns the full growth engine - acquisition, conversion and retention - and the commercial operating system that connects them. You won't simply manage channels or agencies. You'll identify where growth is constrained, prioritise the highest-impact opportunities, build an experimentation framework and lead execution across performance marketing, eCommerce and CRM. You'll also lead the Creative Strategy (CS) team, bring strong creative judgement and make high-impact AI adoption central to how the growth function operates.

You'll work directly with the founder and leadership team, creating visibility into what drives performance, what isn't working and where the business should invest next. This role requires both strategic clarity and the ability to operate at pace.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Full-funnel growth strategy

  • Own the growth roadmap across acquisition, CRO, retention and customer value.
  • Translate ambitious revenue targets into practical channel, customer and conversion plans.
  • Identify the biggest bottlenecks across the customer journey and prioritise initiatives by commercial impact.
  • Connect paid media, eCommerce and CRM into one cohesive system rather than disconnected functions.

Performance marketing and creative effectiveness

  • Lead and develop the Creative Strategy (CS) team, setting its direction and priorities while partnering with acquisition specialists and agency partners to improve creative effectiveness, spend efficiency and new-customer growth.
  • Bring strong creative judgement to concepts, hooks, messaging and formats, and build a clear feedback loop between creative testing, landing-page performance and customer behaviour.
  • Evaluate campaigns using CAC, LTV, conversion and broader business economics, not isolated platform results.
  • Drive practical, hands-on AI adoption across research, ideation, creative briefing and production, analysis and optimisation, using AI to increase the speed, volume and quality of testing.

Conversion and customer experience

  • Drive structured testing across landing pages, product pages, offers, checkout and merchandising.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insight to remove friction and improve conversion rate and AOV.
  • Work with eCommerce and product teams to ensure the site converts the demand generated by marketing.

Retention and customer lifetime value

  • Align lifecycle, CRM and acquisition priorities around long-term customer value.
  • Improve repeat purchasing and retention through better journeys, targeting and experimentation.
  • Establish a consistent understanding of how acquisition quality affects customer value.

Measurement, forecasting and operating rhythm

  • Build reporting that makes acquisition, site and lifecycle performance visible to leadership.
  • Own growth forecasts, testing priorities and clear performance reviews.
  • Establish disciplined experimentation: hypotheses, baselines, test design, learning and next actions.
  • Turn data into decisions and decisions into delivery.

Leadership and cross-functional execution

  • Align marketing, eCommerce, product and operations around shared commercial objectives.
  • Bring clarity and accountability to teams and external partners.
  • Build the structure, processes and capabilities needed as the brand scales.

DAY TO DAY

  • Review performance across acquisition, site conversion and lifecycle.
  • Diagnose where growth is being lost and agree the highest-value interventions.
  • Run and prioritise creative, landing-page, offer and retention tests.
  • Collaborate with eCommerce and CRM to improve conversion and LTV.
  • Lead weekly reporting and performance reviews with senior leadership.
  • Keep multiple growth initiatives moving without losing accountability for results.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You've already helped scale a DTC/eCommerce brand and understand how to make growth repeatable. You're equally comfortable discussing a commercial growth model and interrogating the details of a conversion experiment.

You bring:

  • Proven experience driving growth in a high-growth DTC/eCommerce environment.
  • Strong full-funnel understanding from acquisition through conversion to retention.
  • Strong creative judgement and experience leading creative strategists or a Creative Strategy team, alongside practical understanding of performance marketing, CRO and lifecycle.
  • Analytical rigour and the ability to translate data into action.
  • Experience designing structured experimentation programmes and embedding AI tools and workflows into day-to-day growth and creative operations.
  • Commercial fluency in CAC, LTV, CVR, AOV and growth efficiency.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and an operator's sense of ownership.
  • Fluency in English; German is a strong plus.

WHAT REALLY MATTERS

You think like an operator, not just a marketer. You understand that growth is a system, not a collection of channels. You can create structure where activity feels fragmented, balance strategy with hands-on execution, and move quickly without sacrificing commercial judgement. You want to build and own the engine end-to-end.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Progress towards scaling revenue from approximately €30M to €100M+.
  • Improved CAC:LTV and overall growth efficiency.
  • Higher conversion, AOV, retention and customer lifetime value.
  • Faster experimentation and learning cycles, supported by AI-enabled workflows and a high-performing Creative Strategy team.
  • Clear full-funnel performance visibility and accountability.
  • A more predictable, system-driven growth organisation.

WHY JOIN SAMAKO?

  • Join a brand with strong momentum and genuine product-market fit.
  • Own the entire growth engine, rather than a single channel.
  • Play a central role in the journey towards €100M+.
  • Work directly with the founder and leadership team.
  • Build best-in-class growth systems with meaningful autonomy.
  • Have real ownership, impact and progression as the business scales.

PACKAGE AND LOCATION

Competitive salary plus performance bonus. Full-time.

If this sounds like you, apply or contact for a confidential conversation.

Samako is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Applications from all backgrounds are welcome; please let us know if you require adjustments during the recruitment process.

The successful candidate will act as the architecture lead for defined initiatives within the client's Microsoft Power Platform landscape, designing secure, scalable, and supportable solutions across Power Platform, Azure, and connected enterprise systems.

The role combines architectural leadership with practical technical involvement, guiding delivery teams from concept and solution design through implementation, deployment, production stabilization, and continuous improvement.

Tasks

  • Act as the architecture lead for defined initiatives within the client's Power Platform landscape.
  • Translate business capabilities, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into pragmatic end-to-end solution architectures.
  • Design end-to-end architectures covering Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Azure services, and external integrations.
  • Define solution boundaries, data models, integration patterns, security concepts, environment strategies, and deployment approaches.
  • Evaluate and guide decisions between configuration, low-code, and custom development approaches.
  • Assess the appropriate use of technologies such as React, PCF, Azure Functions, and other Azure components.
  • Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, identity and access management, data protection, ALM, security, and operational support requirements.
  • Define and maintain appropriate environment strategies across development, testing, staging, and production.
  • Lead architecture reviews and document architecture decisions, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and exceptions.
  • Support solution estimation, backlog refinement, technical planning, and delivery planning with product owners and engineering teams.
  • Provide technical guidance to developers and review solution designs, technical approaches, integration patterns, and deployment concepts.
  • Coach delivery teams and promote consistent architecture and engineering practices.
  • Provide technical leadership during critical releases, production stabilization, incident investigation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks before they impact delivery or production.
  • Balance governance and architectural standards with practical delivery needs, avoiding unnecessary complexity.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of solution architecture, solution design, or software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on experience designing enterprise Microsoft Power Platform solutions.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering production solutions spanning multiple applications, environments, systems, and integration endpoints.
  • Strong expertise in Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power Platform architecture.
  • Strong understanding of Dataverse data modelling, relationships, security roles, permissions, identity, and enterprise data architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, integration patterns, connectors, and enterprise application integration.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Azure and designing solutions that integrate Power Platform with Azure services.
  • Hands-on experience with managed solutions, environment strategies, source control, Azure DevOps, and structured ALM practices.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD and deployment strategies for enterprise Power Platform solutions.
  • Ability to define and assess non-functional requirements covering security, performance, scalability, availability, reliability, supportability, maintainability, and compliance.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and enterprise identity and access management concepts.
  • Experience defining security architecture and data protection approaches for enterprise applications.
  • Experience evaluating when to use configuration, low-code, custom development, or external services to achieve the appropriate solution architecture.
  • Practical understanding of React, PCF controls, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, and/or event-driven integration is an advantage.
  • Experience with Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and the architecture or governance of AI-enabled business solutions is an advantage.
  • Experience with Power Pages and external-facing Power Platform solutions is an advantage.
  • Experience supporting distributed, remote, or nearshore development teams is an advantage.
  • Microsoft Power Platform or Azure architecture certification, particularly PL-600, is an advantage.
  • Proven ability to facilitate architecture decisions with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to different audiences.
  • Strong experience producing clear, structured, and traceable architecture documentation and technical decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, delivery-oriented approach.
  • Ability to provide hands-on technical guidance and validate key architectural decisions without becoming disconnected from implementation realities.
  • Professional English communication skills, including strong written and verbal communication in an international engineering environment.

Marketing Manager
Fulltime | Remote | U.S.East Coast

Who We Are

vialytics is revolutionizing how cities manage road infrastructure. Our AI-powered road management system, combining intelligent software with a simple smartphone, enables municipalities to detect road damage, prioritize maintenance, and make smarter infrastructure decisions.

Founded in 2018 in Germany, we have rapidly scaled across Europe and the U.S., supporting 1000+ municipalities in 7 countries.

We're now entering the next phase of growth:

  • accelerating our international expansion

  • taking our product to the next level

  • building an organization that truly scales

The U.S. is a key part of that journey. We’re looking for an ambitious, entrepreneurial Marketing Manager to join our marketing team and drive our growth in the U.S. market.

🎯About the role -Ready to make an impact?

This is a hands-on role with real ownership.

As our U.S.Marketing Manager, you’ll be the marketing partner for our U.S.Sales, SDR and Customer Operations teams, driving marketing activities that create measurable impact on pipeline and growth.

You’ll be part of our Global Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Director Global Marketing, working closely with colleagues across the U.S.and Europe. To enable smooth collaboration across time zones, we’re looking for someone whose working hours significantly overlap with Central European business hours. Therefore we are looking for East Coast time zone based candidates only.

💼 Your Key Responsibilities - What you'll do

You make our global strategy work in the U.S.

You’ll translate global campaigns, positioning and product launches into relevant, effective programs for the U.S. market. At the same time, you’ll bring insights from the U.S. back into our Global Marketing team.

  • Build and accelerate pipeline : Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across email, web, webinars, social media and partner channels. You’ll work closely with Sales and SDRs to make sure leads don’t just get generated, but reach the right people and move through the funnel.

  • Own our U.S. events : Conferences and events are an important growth channel for vialytics in the U.S., and you’ll own them end to end. From planning and logistics to event materials, shipping and follow-up, you’ll make sure our events run smoothly and that every lead has a clear next step. This also means occasional travel to conferences and events across the U.S.Yes, this role is strategic. And yes, sometimes it also means making sure the booth gets to the right city at the right time.

  • Build our presence in the U.S.: Help vialytics become a recognized voice in the U.S. market. You’ll identify relevant stories and opportunities and drive press releases and media activities that build awareness and credibility.

  • Turn customers into advocates : Our existing customers are an important part of our story. Together with Customer Operations, you’ll develop customer marketing initiatives such as email campaigns, direct mail, customer events and customer success stories.

  • Enable our Sales team: You’ll work closely with our U.S. revenue teams and provide the content, campaigns and collateral they need to support real pipeline conversations.

  • Measure what matters : Marketing should create measurable business impact. You’ll use Salesforce campaigns and attribution to understand how marketing contributes to the funnel, pipeline and revenue. You’ll monitor conversion rates and campaign performance, identify opportunities and continuously improve how we work.

  • Own your budget : You’ll independently manage the U.S. portion of our global marketing budget within an agreed plan, balancing opportunities across campaigns, events and other channels.

🌟 We would be the perfect match if you...

  • Bring at least 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in field marketing, demand generation or a similarly broad role

  • Have hands-on experience planning and executing events and campaigns end to end

  • Are experienced in working with Salesforce campaigns, CRM data and marketing attribution

  • Have solid experience with email marketing and content, and understand how Marketing, SDRs and Sales work together to generate and progress pipeline

  • Are comfortable managing competing priorities and budgets independently

  • Work in a structured way and look for ways to improve processes rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems

  • Communicate confidently and effectively, including with senior stakeholders

  • Have a proactive mindset, spotting opportunities and turning them into action rather than waiting for a list of tasks

  • Have strong knowledge of the U.S. market

  • Are willing and able to travel within the U.S. for conferences and customer events

Simply put, you are a hands-on B2B marketer who enjoys both building the plan and making it happen.

Bonus points if you have experience in B2B SaaS, GovTech, public works, infrastructure, engineering, GIS, or local government.

Finance Audit Lead Analyst

About Cigna Healthcare

Cigna Healthcare is a global health service company dedicated to transforming healthcare. With roots in the U.S. and operations in over 30 countries, we serve more than 180 million customers and patients worldwide. Ranked 13th on the Fortune 500 in 2025, Cigna is recognized as one of the most trusted and influential names in the industry.

Our mission is to improve the health, well-being, and peace of mind of those we serve.

Join our globally recognized brand, where trust, communication, and a positive culture are at the core of everything we do. Our leadership is consistent, approachable, and supportive—ensuring your well-being and work-life balance.

We’re looking for individuals who thrive in collaborative environments, are passionate about meaningful change, and want to grow in a company that puts people first.

At Cigna, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven team that values innovation, compassion, and impact. Whether you're shaping better care experiences or supporting customers through life’s key moments, your work will matter.

Grow with us—and help shape the future of healthcare.

About the Role


The Finance Audit Lead Analyst will support the delivery of Cigna Healthcare KSA's Internal Audit Plan by executing risk-based audits, evaluating internal controls, assessing operational and regulatory risks, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation.

The role will work closely with business stakeholders to assess governance, risk management and control effectiveness across healthcare insurance operations while supporting audit reporting, remediation tracking and regulatory compliance activities.

  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive remediation activities.
  • Excellent interviewing, report-writing and presentation skills.
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a proactive and results-oriented approach.

Technical / Functional Skills

  • Internal Audit execution and delivery.
  • Risk assessment and internal controls evaluation.
  • Audit planning, fieldwork and testing.
  • Audit reporting and issue management.
  • Operational risk and compliance reviews.
  • Governance and control framework assessments.
  • Healthcare insurance operations knowledge.
  • Claims and underwriting process understanding.
  • Regulatory compliance monitoring.
  • Data analysis and audit analytics.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience within health insurance, healthcare providers, hospitals or healthcare administration organisations.
  • Knowledge of CCHI requirements, Insurance Authority regulations and healthcare insurance governance requirements.
  • Professional audit or accounting certifications such as CIA, CPA, SOCPA or ACCA are preferred.
  • Familiarity with COSO or other recognised internal control frameworks is preferred.

jobs.description:
Fully remote | Working directly with the CEO | Monthly compensation in USD

About Us

We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes.

Job Description

As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business.

Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track.

You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed.

You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up.
  • Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early.
  • Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers.
  • Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions.
  • Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed.
  • Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up.
  • Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists.
  • Support marketing initiatives by organising briefs, assets, deadlines and collaboration with internal and external contributors.
  • Coordinate IT requests, access requirements, software subscriptions and communication with technical colleagues.
  • Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible.
  • Connect Microsoft tools with suitable AI skills and workflows, respecting permissions and confidentiality.
  • Create, adapt and maintain AI skills and repeatable workflows for research, reporting, documentation and operational coordination.
  • Check AI-generated work for accuracy, relevance and completeness before it is used.
  • Keep business information organised and handle confidential matters with discretion.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in executive assistance, business operations, project coordination or a comparable role involving substantial ownership.
  • A working understanding of HR, finance, IT and marketing, sufficient to coordinate tasks, ask informed questions and recognise when specialist expertise is required.
  • Strong practical experience with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to organise collaboration across these tools, including shared documents, structured information, task tracking and access coordination.
  • Confidence using Excel to maintain operational overviews, reconcile information and prepare clear reports.
  • Practical experience creating or configuring reusable AI skills and applying them to real work.
  • Ability to explain a workflow you personally implemented, including how you checked its results and handled its limitations.
  • Strong prioritisation and follow-through, including the ability to manage several workstreams without constant reminders.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.
  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, documents, shared knowledge systems and task management tools.
  • Sound judgement about confidentiality, access permissions and the information shared with AI tools.
  • Willingness to take responsibility, resolve routine issues independently and escalate significant risks promptly.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a startup environment, including changing priorities, incomplete information and periods of high workload.
  • Ability to remain calm, communicate clearly and maintain quality under pressure.
  • A practical approach to solving problems and taking ownership when established processes or clear instructions are not yet available.
  • Confidence raising capacity constraints early, proposing realistic alternatives and clarifying which tasks take priority.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Working directly with a founder or supporting a small startup team.
  • Improving processes that span several business functions.
  • Using AI agents, tool integrations or automation platforms to reduce repetitive work.
  • Hands-on experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to build useful automations and AI assistants.
  • Building reusable procedures and shared knowledge that other team members can use.
  • Coordinating recruitment, financial administration, suppliers or marketing delivery.

What We Offer

  • Close collaboration with the CEO and visibility across the startup.
  • Meaningful ownership of operational work and process improvements.
  • A broad role combining executive support, team coordination and practical AI use.
  • A fully remote working arrangement.
  • Monthly compensation in USD.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will work remotely and maintain clear visibility of priorities, progress and blockers. Reliable communication, organised documentation and consistent follow-through are essential. Working hours and required availability will be agreed during the hiring process.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and describe relevant examples of work you have personally delivered. Include an AI skill or workflow you created or substantially adapted, the business task it supported, and how you ensured the result was useful and reliable. An example of coordinating work across different business functions would also be helpful.

  • Competitive Salary in USD

  • Remote mode of work

  • 10+ business days of paid time off

  • Team building and corporate events

  • Equipment provided

  • A supportive team

Required experience and skills

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 2–3 years operating at a Senior or Staff level with end-to-end ownership of major systems or projects.

  • Curiosity for the energy domain, the transition to flexible consumption, and the challenges of orchestrating real-world devices in reliable and scalable ways.

  • Familiarity with modern backend ecosystems; our stack includes Python, Rust, event-driven systems, and cloud platforms (GCP).

Why Join Us

  • Work on a mission that matters by building the foundational systems that will reshape how millions of people consume energy and reduce global CO₂ emissions.

  • A rare opportunity to shape the technical DNA of a company from the beginning and influence long-term architectural decisions.

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Producer
jobs.excerpt: Great creative work takes more than a great idea.
jobs.description:
Great creative work takes more than a great idea. It takes people who know how to bring that idea to life across different channels, disciplines and teams.


A single campaign might involve film, websites, digital experiences, social content, print, experiential activations and dozens of individual deliverables. Each has its own requirements, timelines and production challenges. Making them all work together takes experience, judgement and an understanding of how things get made.


We're looking for a Senior Integrated Producer who can bring all of that together. Someone who sees the bigger picture, connects the right people and knows how to turn ambitious creative ideas into exceptional work.


You'll be the connective tissue between teams, disciplines and deliverables. You'll know when to bring in the right experts, recognize when something isn't working and understand which levers to pull to get things back on track.


About ICF & ICF Next

ICF is a global consulting and technology services company working on some of the most pressing challenges facing businesses, governments and communities. From energy and climate to public health, infrastructure and government, our teams bring deep expertise to problems that don't have easy answers.


ICF Next brings creativity into that equation.

We're writers, designers, strategists, technologists and creative thinkers working together to help organizations connect with people and move them to action.


We have the creative ambition of an agency and access to the expertise of a global consultancy. That combination gives us an unusual opportunity to understand difficult problems from the inside, find the human story and create work that makes a difference in the real world.


Our Creative team brings together more than 150 professionals across design, copy, video, motion, production and operations. We work across disciplines to deliver ambitious, effective and beautifully executed work.


The Role

As a Senior Integrated Producer, you'll take ownership of complex, multichannel campaigns, working across Creative, Account, Strategy, Digital and specialist production teams to bring ideas from the initial brief through development, production, launch and delivery.

You'll understand how the different elements of a campaign fit together, what each discipline needs to succeed and how decisions in one area can affect the wider work.


You'll have a strong working knowledge of digital production, including websites, interactive experiences, digital advertising and content platforms, alongside film, video, motion, print, experiential and other channels. You don't need to be a technical specialist in every area, but you do need to understand how things work, recognize potential gaps and know when to involve the right experts.


You'll be expected to make decisions, challenge assumptions and help teams navigate the realities of complex production. When something isn't working, you'll understand why and know what needs to change, whether that's the resources, the schedule, the scope or the way teams are working together.


This is a senior role for someone who can bring clarity to complexity, keep people connected and make sure the work delivers on its creative ambition.


What You'll Do

  • Bring it all together. Lead the planning and delivery of integrated campaigns across digital, social, film, video, motion, print, experiential and emerging channels. Understand how individual deliverables connect and make sure the entire campaign works as a cohesive whole.
  • Connect the teams. Work across Creative, Account, Strategy, Digital and specialist production teams. Establish clear responsibilities, keep people aligned and know when to bring in the right expertise.
  • Know how things get made. Bring a broad understanding of production across channels, with particularly strong digital knowledge. Recognize the technical requirements, dependencies and potential gaps, and work with specialists to find the right solutions.
  • Keep things moving. Own project planning, schedules, resources, estimates and budgets. Manage competing priorities and make sure teams have what they need to deliver great work.
  • Know when to intervene. Recognize when something isn't working, understand what's causing the problem and take action. Challenge assumptions, adjust resources, revisit timelines or bring people together to find a better way forward.
  • Protect the work. Partner with creative and production leads to maintain quality and consistency across deliverables, ensuring the finished work reflects the strength of the original idea.
  • Build trust. Develop strong relationships with teams, clients and production partners. Communicate clearly, manage expectations and navigate difficult conversations with confidence and good judgement.
  • Make the team better. Improve how work moves through the organization, from briefing and planning to reviews, approvals and delivery. Mentor less experienced colleagues, share knowledge and help build stronger production capabilities across the team.

Who You Are

You understand the big picture without losing sight of the details.


You've worked on complex campaigns with demanding clients, tight deadlines, multiple teams and more deliverables than anyone would like to count. You know how creative work gets made and what it takes to bring everything together.


You understand digital production, but you're equally comfortable working across film, social, print, experiential and other channels. You don't pretend to have every answer. You know enough to ask the right questions, recognize when something isn't right and bring in the right people who can help.


You can spot a problem before it becomes a crisis. And when things do go wrong, you don't just report what's happening. You understand the options, make decisions and help people move forward.


You have strong commercial judgement. You understand the relationship between scope, resources, budgets, timelines and quality, and you know how to balance them without losing sight of the work.


You're comfortable leading teams, but you know that good leadership isn't about having all the answers. It's about bringing the right people together, creating clarity and helping them succeed.


Most importantly, you care about the work and the people making it. You know that great production isn't simply about getting things delivered. It's about making ambitious creative work possible.


What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in integrated production, creative project management or creative operations, preferably within a large advertising, marketing or creative agency.
  • A bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, communications or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience managing or leading people, including coaching, mentoring and developing others.

Professional Skills

  • Proven experience leading complex, integrated campaigns across multiple channels, teams and creative disciplines.
  • Strong working knowledge of digital production, including websites, interactive experiences, digital advertising, social platforms and content production workflows, alongside broader experience in video, motion, print and experiential.
  • Experience managing significant project budgets, scopes of work, resources, schedules and competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, manage stakeholders and resolve complex production challenges.
  • Proficiency in Asana or comparable project management and workflow tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering high-volume campaigns within a large, multidisciplinary agency or creative organization.
  • Familiarity with digital development workflows, including UX, design, development, testing, accessibility and deployment.
  • Experience working with external production partners, vendors and technical specialists.
  • Experience improving creative workflows, production processes and operational efficiency.
  • Experience working with public-sector, mission-driven or highly regulated clients.

Location: This role is fully remote, with a preference for candidates based on the West Coast. Candidates in other locations are welcome to apply if they are comfortable aligning their work schedule with West Coast business hours.


Why ICF Next

The problems we work on aren't always easy to explain. They don't always come with glamorous briefs or obvious answers.


That's what makes them interesting.


You'll work with talented people across creative, strategy, technology and production, helping bring ambitious ideas to life in ways that make a real difference.


You'll have the opportunity to shape how complex campaigns come together, strengthen the way teams collaborate and help deliver work that people are proud to put their names to.


If you love making complicated things work, bringing great people together and seeing ambitious ideas become reality, we'd like to meet you.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 


Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.


Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 


However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at . We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  


Pay Range

There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.

About the role

Our client in the UK is looking for an experienced Payroll & Bookkeeping Specialist to join their UK-based accounting practice. This role is suited to someone with strong UK payroll and bookkeeping experience who can independently manage a portfolio of clients, take ownership of their accounts and act as their first point of contact.

You will be responsible for end-to-end payroll processing, bookkeeping, CIS returns and VAT preparation across multiple UK clients. You will work closely with the Operations Director, ensuring accuracy, meeting deadlines and maintaining strong client relationships.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop into a senior position, with a clear progression pathway towards reviewing work and eventually overseeing the bookkeeping team.

Responsibilities

  • Manage your own portfolio of UK payroll, bookkeeping and CIS clients, acting as their primary point of contact.
  • Process weekly and monthly payrolls from start to finish, including RTI submissions, auto-enrolment pensions, statutory payments, starters and leavers, P11Ds, P60s and year-end processes.
  • Prepare and submit monthly CIS returns, including contractor verifications and deductions.
  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping, including bank reconciliations, purchase and sales ledgers, month-end processes and UK VAT returns in line with Making Tax Digital (MTD) requirements.
  • Maintain accurate financial records, manage deadlines and communicate directly with clients regarding their payroll and bookkeeping needs.
  • Work closely with the Operations Director, taking responsibility for the quality and accuracy of your work while progressively taking on additional responsibilities.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on UK payroll experience within an accounting practice, payroll bureau or outsourced environment, managing multiple external client payrolls (both weekly and monthly). Single in-house payroll experience will not meet the requirement.
  • Strong knowledge of UK payroll legislation and HMRC systems, including RTI (FPS/EPS), auto-enrolment, statutory payments, P11Ds, P60s and year-end procedures.
  • Practical experience preparing and submitting monthly CIS returns, including contractor verifications, deductions and CIS300 submissions.
  • Strong UK bookkeeping experience across multiple clients, including reconciliations, ledgers, month-end processes and VAT returns under MTD.
  • Strong Xero experience is essential, with BrightPay experience strongly preferred. Familiarity with Karbon, Dext or AutoEntry would be advantageous.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple client accounts independently.
  • Confident communication skills, with the ability to handle client calls and build trusted client relationships.
  • AAT, ACCA, CIMA, SAIPA or CIPP qualifications, Xero or BrightPay certifications, and previous experience reviewing work or supervising junior team members would be advantageous.

Role Progression

The successful candidate will initially focus on managing their own portfolio of payroll, bookkeeping and CIS clients, with regular guidance and reviews from the Operations Director.

Within the first 90 days, the expectation is to manage payrolls accurately and on time, build trusted client relationships and progressively work with greater independence.

Following a performance review at 6–9 months, there will be an opportunity to take on responsibility for reviewing other bookkeepers' work and VAT returns, with the longer-term progression towards overseeing the bookkeeping team.

RAND is widely respected for operating independently of political and commercial pressures as a nonpartisan organization. RAND values objectivity and integrity in both its research processes and internal interactions and emphasizes a collegial environment that respects the contributions and dignity of all staff.


RAND is seeking a Senior Researcher to lead its effort to integrate AI into RAND's research and into the business processes that support it. This is a one-year term position, renewable. The role helps set the direction for AI adoption across RAND: understanding where RAND is today, learning from peer organizations, defining what RAND needs to be good at in an AI world, and working with researchers and leadership to make adoption real at scale.


The position is well suited to someone who has used AI directly in research and business work, has helped other organizations build AI into their core functions, and can move a large, expert community toward practical use.


Key Responsibilities

  • External learning: Draw lessons from peer organizations, including FFRDCs, UARCs, and consulting firms, on what distinguishes successful adoption from failed attempts, and translate them to RAND's context.
  • Strategic direction: Recommend a framework for how AI fits across RAND's diverse portfolio.
  • Adoption at scale: Design and test approaches with researchers on real projects, including quick wins that build momentum, and define what AI tools need to look like to be used well inside RAND's culture and research practice.
  • Tools and resources: Advise on the tool landscape (what to keep, build, buy, or stop), how separate tool efforts should work together, and how to allocate resources, with attention to security, compliance, and budget constraints.
  • Governance and measurement: Propose how decisions about AI deployment should be made and define evidence-based measures of whether adoption is working.

Qualifications

All research positions at RAND require excellent analytic skills; the ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English, both orally and in writing; the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team; and a strong commitment to RAND's core values of quality and objectivity.

Required:

  • Experience integrating AI to transform research and business processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a cross-organizational effort, working with senior leaders and with technical and non-technical staff.
  • Ability to synthesize evidence from interviews, usage data, and external practice into clear recommendations for leadership.
  • Experience moving users from skepticism to routine use of new tools.
  • Familiarity with research organizations, FFRDCs, or similar institutions.

Preferred:

  • Experience with AI governance, security, and compliance requirements.

Education Requirements and Experience

The preferred candidate will have a PhD and 8+ years of experience, or a Master's degree with thesis and 13+ years of experience, in computer science or engineering, information science, cyber engineering, or related field (such as mathematics, operations research, physical sciences, or closely related discipline). Professional experience should demonstrate the applicant’s ability to design, execute and disseminate results of research using analytically rigorous methods.

Location

Fully remote

Salary Range: $171,800 - $283,100


RAND considers a variety of factors when formulating an offer, including but not limited to, the specific role and associated responsibilities; a candidate's work experience, education/training, skills, expertise; and internal equity. This position is eligible for overtime. The salary range includes base pay plus RAND's sabbatic pay (which provides additional compensation above base pay when vacation is taken). In addition, RAND provides strong benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, paid time-off and more.

We are Other-Obsessed. We design every People Ops process to support others in achieving their goals. We work from first principles with clear outcomes in mind. We say “yes” when we can. We give sustained maximum effort—every day—because enabling the success of others is our success too.

jobs.excerpt: What is 8020REI? 8020REI is a pioneering B2B data and SaaS platform that empowers professional real estate investors to generate consistent leads from Cold Call, SMS, and Direct Mail without spending more.
jobs.description:
What is 8020REI?

8020REI is a pioneering B2B data and SaaS platform that empowers professional real estate investors to generate consistent leads from Cold Call, SMS, and Direct Mail without spending more. We leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to identify homeowners likely to sell at a discount, and we use a proven strategy to maximize our clients' ROI. As part of our network, we also operate alongside three sister companies: DMForce, 8020Recruit, and 8020CRM, each contributing specialized services to the real estate sector.

Core Values at 8020REI:

  • Find a Better Way:We dig until we understand the real problem, then improve or innovate to solve it. Focused on the 20% that drives the biggest result.

  • Have Each Other's Back:We work as a team. We support, step in, and go the extra mile to create a great experience for each other and our clients.

  • Honor Your Word:We honor our promises, hold ourselves accountable, and do the right thing even when nobody’s looking.

  • Own Your Growth:We're obsessed with personal growth and take pride in the work we deliver. Intrinsically motivated, we hold ourselves to a high standard and never coast.

  • Bring Your A-Game:We take care of our recovery, health, and family time, and that’s why we show up focused, energized, and ready to perform at our best.

🎯 Role Overview

As our SDR Manager, you run our sales team and you build the system it sells inside. You lead the SDRs who open the conversations, you work alongside the Account Executives who close them, and you own the number the team produces.

You will be hiring and coaching reps, running the 1:1s and the call reviews, and building the machine underneath them: the dialer, the outreach sequences, the prospect list, the CRM discipline, and the reporting that says which stage is losing deals and why.

This is a hands-on seat. You run the 1:1s and the call reviews yourself, and you get on the phone with the live list every week. There is no layer between you and the reps, which is the point: you'll know exactly why the number is what it is.

💡 Key Responsibilities:

This role is about owning a team and the system behind it. Parts of this are still to be built, and building them is the job.

• Lead the SDR Team: Every SDR is yours: their number, their ramp, their development. You coach off their own recordings, not off a scoreboard, working one habit at a time and closing it out on a later call before starting the next. You hire, you decide who makes it, and keeping the reps worth keeping is part of the job.

• Own the Number: You carry your team's number, from first touch through to qualified pipeline. Booked calls that don't get held, and meetings that don't survive qualification, are a miss and not a result. You own that number and you report it, with the reasons behind it, every week.

• Own the Three Channels: Cold calling, email, and LinkedIn. That is the job, and it is deliberately narrow. Email and LinkedIn are underbuilt today, so expect to rebuild rather than maintain.

• Build the Systems: The dialer, the outreach sequences, the CRM, the reporting, the tooling. You set them up, you fix them when they break, and you decide what the team spends its budget on. This is a builder's seat as much as a manager's.

• Know Why the Numbers Move: When something slips, you can say whether it was the list, the script, the process, or the rep, and you bring the evidence. A diagnosis, not a dashboard link.

• Protect What Reaches the Closers: You work with our Account Executives on what a qualified deal looks like, and you own the quality of what your team hands them.

• Use AI Where It Actually Wins: You scale the repetitive parts with the tools available and you test where AI genuinely beats a person, instead of assuming it either way.

• Stay Call-Ready: No personal quota, but you work the live list every week and you personally run a new script before handing it to the team. A leader who hasn't worked the list can't coach the list.

• Keep the Tank Full: You set the spec for the prospect list and hold the bar on quality, so the team never runs out of the right people to call.

✅ Qualifications

• Experience: 4 to 7 years in B2B sales, with at least 2 years managing reps. You've run a cold-calling team, not just been on one.

• Industry Fit: You've sold in B2B, SaaS, or another niche industry where the buyer is a specific kind of operator and the addressable list is finite. Broad consumer or commodity selling is a different job and it does not transfer here.

• Built the System, Not Just Run It: You've stood up the machine your team sells inside, the dialer, the sequences, the CRM discipline, the reporting, and can walk through what you changed and what it did to the numbers. This is the bar.

• Hands-On Depth: Real depth in at least two of cold calling, email, and LinkedIn, shown not claimed. Outreach you personally built and ran, not work you approved or handed to an agency. Two done well beats passing familiarity with all three.

• Thinks in Unit Costs: You can say what a booked call cost you in a previous seat and what you did to move it. You don't need to have run a P&L, but you should be the kind of manager who knows what the team's activity actually buys.

• Coaches From the Recording: "At 4:12 you asked a closed question, here's the open one, here's why he shut down." Not "be more energetic."

• Holds the Line: You can tell a rep the number isn't there, on the day it isn't there, in plain words, and still have the relationship next week.

• Manages by Numbers: You know your team's conversion at every stage without opening a report, and you catch a dip in days.

• Native-Level Spoken English: A hard requirement. You'll coach tone and delivery on live U.S. cold calls, and you can't coach a bar you can't hit.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working alongside or managing closers.

  • Sales teams built in more than one industry, with a clear account of what had to change between them.

  • Knowledge of Salesmate, Koncert, Instantly, or Clay. Having taken a rep from zero to quota. Having built a sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one.

  • Experience selling into contractors or the trades.

Why Join Us?

At 8020REI you'll be building the sales engine, not inheriting one. The team, the process, and the systems are yours, with a real budget behind you and the autonomy to decide what gets scaled, fixed, or cut. Most seats like this hand you a machine and ask you to run it a little better. This one hands you the whole problem and gets out of your way. If you want a role where the funnel is yours end to end and the results are unmistakably yours, this is it.

📝 What We Offer:

  • Competitive Base Compensation

  • Profit Share Bonus

  • Flex PTO (up to 26 days per year)

  • Home Office Upgrade Bonus

  • HMO Bonus

  • Full-time Remote Work

  • Opportunity for growth and team-building potential

  • Ongoing support and budget to develop new skills

Join us at 8020REI and contribute directly to revolutionizing the real estate investment landscape!

The Role

At Treewalk, you’ll own the entire public-company reporting cycle: fast closes, MD&A storytelling, IFRS/US GAAP judgment calls, and scalable system design. You’ll own end-to-end financial disclosure for a portfolio of high growth clients in life sciences, including pharmaceuticals, therapeutics, and other applications of biosciences and biotechnology. Many engagements will tap you as a de-facto fractional CFO, guiding strategy as well as disclosure; others will lean on you as the go-to technical expert. Either way, every file is yours to run.

Deadlines are real; overtime isn’t a lifestyle. We staff sensibly, treat extra hours as the rare exception, and back that up with true schedule autonomy and remote flexibility—so your evenings stay yours.

If you’ve led pub-co audits at a small- to mid-size firm or managed reporting inside a listed issuer, and you’re ready to trade 70-hour busy-season marathons for high-impact work, tangible ownership, and genuine balance, then we would love to hear from you.

How You’ll Create Impact Day-to-Day

  • Own the story behind the numbers: Draft and polish quarterly and annual financial statements and MD&A that stand up to capital-markets scrutiny and tell each client’s growth narrative from the science, to the milestones, and the financial commitments required to achieve the business objectives.
  • Make R&D spend make sense: Advise clients on accounting for research and development costs, clinical and pre-clinical trial accruals, CRO/CDMO arrangements, and measuring burn rate against progress.
  • Master the technical hurdles: Tackle complex issues such as licensing and collaboration agreements, milestone and royalty revenue, acquired IPR&D, government grants and funding, intangible assets and impairment, and package them into robust technical memos and disclosures.
  • Untangle complex capital structures: Work through warrants, convertible instruments, derivative liabilities, royalty and streaming financings, unit offerings, debt/equity splits, and stock-based compensation.
  • Run the engine of multi-entity groups: Build rock-solid consolidation and foreign-currency translation models that make complex structures look effortless.
  • Turn data into insight: Deliver sharp balance sheet and P&L analyses, spotlighting trends and red-flag variances before anyone else sees them.
  • Keep leadership laser-focused: Produce monthly variance reports against forecasts and annual plans, translating the findings into clear, action-ready recommendations, including cash runway and financing timing.

About 8 West Consulting

8 West Consulting provides consultancy services and software solutions to clients across the US, Europe and the UK. We work in sectors including insurance, healthcare and retail, helping organisations tackle complex technology challenges and modernise critical platforms.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a senior, hands-on software engineer who has used AI coding agents to deliver secure, production-ready software within established enterprise environments. You will help 8 West develop practical, repeatable agent-driven engineering workflows for existing applications and client projects, with a particular focus on GitHub Copilot and Microsoft technologies.

This is not an AI strategy or prompt-only role. You will write and review code, build and operate agent harnesses, and ship thoroughly tested changes to real systems, including legacy and business-critical applications. You will guide developers in adopting these practices alongside live delivery commitments and within enterprise security, governance and contractual boundaries.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Deliver production software. Personally design, implement, test, review and release agent-assisted changes to existing enterprise applications, not only new builds or prototypes.

  • Engineer agent workflows and harnesses. Build reusable instructions, tools, context pipelines, execution loops and feedback mechanisms that help agents work reliably within enterprise repositories and engineering controls.
  • Modernise brownfield applications. Adapt agent workflows to established .NET services, legacy code, databases, integrations and build pipelines; manage dependencies, regression risks and safe incremental change.
  • Make quality non-negotiable. Connect agent output to unit, integration and end-to-end tests, code review, security scanning, build pipelines and clear release criteria; investigate failures yourself.
  • Respect enterprise boundaries. Apply least-privilege permissions, approved tools and models, secure environments, sensitive-data controls, traceability and human approval points to agent workflows.
  • Modernise delivery incrementally. Introduce practical workflows for understanding, modifying, testing and maintaining existing systems; pilot improvements without disrupting live project commitments.
  • Work in the Microsoft ecosystem. Apply GitHub Copilot and other approved agentic tools to .NET, Azure, SQL and established Git repositories, integrating with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and existing delivery pipelines.
  • Coach developers through delivery. Pair on real work, demonstrate techniques, review agent-generated changes and create concise playbooks that enable other engineers to work independently.
  • Influence stakeholders. Explain opportunities, limitations, risks and technical choices clearly to developers, engineering leaders, security teams and client decision-makers.
  • Demonstrate measurable value. Evaluate delivery speed, rework, escaped defects, engineering effort, reliability and cost rather than treating AI-generated code volume as success.

Essential Skills & Experience

Proven enterprise production delivery. Demonstrable personal experience shipping and supporting production software through agentic coding workflows, with evidence of rigorous verification, release controls and operational outcomes.

  • Brownfield enterprise experience. Must have personally built and deployed AI-driven development workflows around existing production applications, not only greenfield projects. Comfortable with legacy code, incomplete documentation, complex dependencies, established tests and change controls.
  • Agentic development and harness design. Hands-on experience with multi-step coding agents, planning, context engineering, reusable instructions or skills, tool integrations (including MCP where relevant), safe execution controls and feedback-driven validation.
  • Strong core software engineering. Substantial experience designing, coding, debugging and maintaining complex enterprise applications and services; sound judgement on architecture, APIs, data, performance and maintainability.
  • GitHub Copilot and Microsoft tooling. Practical experience with GitHub Copilot agent workflows in Visual Studio or VS Code, plus familiarity with .NET/C#, Azure, SQL Server and GitHub or Azure DevOps delivery practices.
  • Engineering quality and release controls. Ability to implement automated unit, integration and end-to-end testing, CI/CD checks, peer review, security controls, deployment verification and production troubleshooting for AI-assisted changes.
  • Security and governance by design. Experience working within enterprise restrictions on source code, client data, secrets, tools, networks and access; understands prompt-injection risks, IP/licensing concerns and auditable approvals.
  • Pragmatic engineering transformation. Evidence of helping established enterprise teams adopt agentic practices, working through legacy constraints, resistance to change and competing delivery priorities.
  • Communication and mentoring. Strong ability to teach by pairing and demonstration, communicate with technical and non-technical leaders, constructively challenge assumptions and bring developers with you.

Desirable Experience

  • Regulated industries. Insurance, healthcare, financial services or similarly controlled environments, including evidence of compliant delivery, auditability, privacy and formal change management.
  • Broader agentic tooling. Experience with additional coding agents or frameworks, agent orchestration, custom agents, hooks, MCP servers, sandboxing and evaluation harnesses.
  • Advanced delivery automation. Infrastructure as code, secure build environments, observability, DevSecOps, platform engineering or repeatable software delivery templates.
  • AI systems and assessment. Experience evaluating agent performance with repeatable tasks, automated checks, traces and failure analysis; familiarity with LLM-enabled product features is useful.
  • Consulting and technical leadership. Experience coaching engineers across multiple enterprise teams or client engagements, developing reusable practices and advising stakeholders on trade-offs.

Personal Profile

You are a hands-on, security-conscious engineer who enjoys complex, imperfect codebases. You modernise existing systems safely, teach others by example and know when agents require human oversight. You are practical, collaborative and accountable for production quality.

What Success Looks Like

Existing client systems benefit from secure, tested agent workflows that meet enterprise release controls. Reusable harnesses reduce repetitive work without increasing defects or risk. Developers gain practical skills, and 8 West demonstrates measurable improvement across engagements.
