jobs.excerpt: The Senior Manager, Customer Engagement & AI – Go-to-Market is a senior client-facing solution leader responsible for helping Avanade shape, position, and win Customer Engagement and AI opportunities across the Microsoft ecosystem.
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Customer Engagement & AI – Go-to-Market is a senior client-facing solution leader responsible for helping Avanade shape, position, and win Customer Engagement and AI opportunities across the Microsoft ecosystem.


This role sits at the intersection of go-to-market, pre-sales, solution architecture, Microsoft alignment, and delivery expertise. The individual will work directly with clients, account teams, Microsoft, industry leaders, and delivery teams to identify opportunities, shape differentiated solutions, develop compelling demonstrations and prototypes, and translate emerging Microsoft capabilities into practical client outcomes.


This is not a traditional sales role or an architecture-only role. The expectation is to bring enough technical and functional depth to actively shape solutions, demonstrate capabilities, challenge assumptions, and help teams move from an initial client problem through a credible solution and deal.

.

Core Responsibilities


1. CE & AI Go-to-Market Leadership

  • Help define and evolve Avanade's point of view for Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, Power Platform, Copilot and agentic AI.
  • Translate Microsoft's rapidly evolving product capabilities into clear client propositions and use cases.
  • Identify repeatable solution patterns and offerings that can be taken to market across industries.
  • Partner with Microsoft, Sales, Industry and Account teams to identify and develop priority opportunities.
  • Bring market and client feedback back into the practice to influence offerings, investments, accelerators and capability development.

2. Pre-Sales & Solution Shaping

  • Engage directly with clients to understand business problems, desired outcomes and existing technology landscapes.
  • Lead discovery, envisioning and solution-shaping conversations.
  • Define solution approaches across Dynamics 365 CE, Dataverse, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Azure AI capabilities, selecting technologies based on the client problem rather than leading with a product.
  • Develop solution narratives, architecture concepts, estimates, assumptions and implementation approaches.
  • Partner with pursuit teams on proposals, presentations, workshops and competitive positioning.
  • Provide a credible senior technical and functional presence during critical client conversations.

3. AI-Led Customer Engagement

  • Help clients identify where Copilot, generative AI and agents can meaningfully transform customer and employee experiences.
  • Connect AI opportunities to core CE processes such as sales, service, field service, relationship management, case management and customer operations.
  • Shape solutions that combine traditional CRM capabilities with AI and intelligent automation rather than treating AI as a standalone offering.
  • Help clients distinguish between practical near-term AI opportunities and longer-term transformation opportunities.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Microsoft's evolving AI capabilities and their application within business processes.

4. Demonstrations, Prototypes & Innovation

  • Own or guide the creation of compelling client demonstrations, prototypes and proof-of-concepts.
  • Be comfortable getting hands-on with Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio and related technologies when required to prove an idea.
  • Rapidly translate client scenarios into demonstrable solution concepts.
  • Develop reusable demos, reference architectures, patterns and accelerators that can be leveraged across pursuits.
  • Use Copilot and AI-assisted development techniques to accelerate solutioning, prototyping and proposal development.

5. Deal Shaping & Commercial Support

  • Work with account and sales leadership to qualify opportunities and determine where CE and AI capabilities can create differentiated value.
  • Help establish scope boundaries, solution assumptions, delivery approaches and major dependencies.
  • Participate in estimation and commercial shaping to ensure proposed solutions are both compelling and deliverable.
  • Identify technical and delivery risk before commitments are made.
  • Support the transition from pursuit to delivery, maintaining continuity between what was sold and what can realistically be implemented.

6. Practice & Capability Development

  • Upskill architects, consultants and delivery teams on CE, Copilot and emerging AI capabilities.
  • Coach teams on how to tell the business story, not just demonstrate technology.
  • Establish solutioning patterns, reusable assets, reference architectures and leading practices.
  • Bring lessons from pursuits and clients back into the broader CE practice.
  • Build a community of people capable of independently supporting CE + AI pursuits.
  • Help identify capability gaps and influence hiring, training and investment priorities.

What This Role Is

A strategist: Understand where CE and AI are going and translate that into a meaningful Avanade proposition.

A solutioner: Turn ambiguous client problems into credible solutions.

A storyteller: Connect technology capabilities to business outcomes in a way executives and practitioners understand.

A builder: Prototype and demonstrate ideas rather than relying exclusively on PowerPoint.

A closer: Create confidence in the solution and help move opportunities from interest into funded work.

A multiplier: Build reusable assets and develop others so CE + AI solutioning capability scales beyond one person.


What This Role Is Not

  • Not purely a delivery architect.
  • Not a PowerPoint-only pre-sales role.
  • Not limited to a single CE workload such as Contact Center.
  • Not an AI evangelist disconnected from real business processes and implementation.
  • Not expected to personally deliver every engagement, but must have enough delivery credibility to ensure that what is sold can actually be built.

Desired Experience

  • Significant experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement and Power Platform.
  • Strong understanding across multiple CE workloads, ideally including Sales, Customer Service, Field Service and broader customer engagement scenarios.
  • Demonstrated experience in enterprise pre-sales, solution architecture, consulting or complex solution shaping.
  • Practical experience applying Copilot, Copilot Studio, generative AI or agentic AI to business scenarios.
  • Ability to lead client discovery, envisioning and solution-design workshops.
  • Experience developing demonstrations, prototypes, proofs-of-concept or solution accelerators.
  • Strong understanding of Dataverse, integrations, security and enterprise solution architecture.
  • Ability to communicate with both C-level/business stakeholders and deeply technical audiences.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with Microsoft, sales teams, delivery teams and clients.
  • Proven ability to turn emerging technology into repeatable, sellable and deliverable solutions.

Established in 2001, Nexus Mods is the largest video game modding platform on the internet - a household name in the PC gaming ecosystem.
  • 80M+ registered members

  • 26B+ mod downloads
We’re currently focused on product modernisation, driving growth and building infrastructure for the next 10 years of community-powered modding.

Our Role
We’re looking for a Linux gaming specialist to join our Engineering team, working on the Linux experience for Vortex, Nexus Mods’ flagship desktop mod manager. Your main focus will be SteamOS and Steam hardware such as the Steam Deck, helping bring Vortex to Linux gamers and delivering on Nexus Mods’ commitment to SteamOS.

Vortex is a desktop application, currently Windows-first with Linux support on the roadmap. It runs on Linux today but is some way off parity with Windows, and most of the remaining problems come from gaming on Linux, such as Wine and Proton, game store compatibility and game-specific workarounds. You’ll also help us build a support strategy for Linux players and triage Linux issues as they come in. We’re looking for someone who knows how Windows games and modding tools behave on Linux and can make the changes themselves.

What You’ll Be Working On
  • Developing and improving the Vortex experience on SteamOS and Steam hardware.
  • Adapting existing functionality, particularly Windows functionality, to work with games running through Proton and Wine.
  • Taking existing solutions and implementing them for Linux rather than reinventing everything from scratch.

  • Establishing standards for Linux development and making it easier for our engineers to work on Linux.

Role Requirements

Must-haves:
  • Extensive Linux gaming experience. Occasional use or owning a Steam Deck isn’t enough. Ideally you’re Linux-first and strongly prefer working on Linux.

  • Experience debugging production software on machines you don’t control.

  • Clear communication and comfort working with other teams.
  • Ability to balance speed, quality and pragmatism in a long-lived codebase with active community contributors.
Nice to haves:
  • Linux modding experience.
  • Familiarity with Nexus Mods and modding more broadly. Not essential, as we provide internal training.
  • Hands-on Electron experience, including the main vs. renderer split.
  • Strong React experience, including state management.
  • Packaging, code signing and auto-update experience (electron-builder, Flatpak, or equivalent).
  • Hands-on CI/CD experience.
  • Experience taking a Windows-first app to Linux, or maintaining Windows/Linux parity in production.
  • Background in launchers or content distribution clients (Steam, Heroic, Lutris, GOG Galaxy, modding tools).
  • Open source contributions, especially to Linux gaming projects like Proton, Wine, Lutris, Heroic or Bottles.
  • Understanding of gaming ecosystems, such as file formats, save management, load orders and plugin systems.
  • Experience setting up or running user support processes.

Role Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Linux-specific features and platform integrations across the frontend, backend and integration layers of a desktop app used by more than a million people every month, across SteamOS, Steam hardware and desktop distros.
  • Adapt Windows-first functionality (file system, permissions, case sensitivity, and running Windows modding tools under Proton) to work reliably on Linux.
  • Make game discovery and launching work across Steam, other stores and third-party launchers.
  • Work out game-specific fixes and workarounds, and keep them maintainable as the list grows.
  • Tackle hard technical problems like platform-specific bugs, performance regressions and race conditions.
  • Work across the delivery lifecycle, from prototyping to multi-sprint delivery of Linux support and parity work.
  • Support packaging and distribution for Linux (e.g. Flatpak, AppImage, or equivalent).
  • Triage incoming Linux issues and work with our community and support teams to set up a proper support process for Linux players.
  • Diagnose field issues using crash reports, telemetry and logs across SteamOS and other Linux environments.
  • Collaborate with other teams and review contributions from community contributors and internal engineers.
  • Write clean, well-tested code and uphold high standards across CI/CD, packaging and documentation.
  • Share Linux knowledge and support other engineers across pods.

Benefits of Working at Nexus Mods

Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Germany | Rem
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €100,000 - €125,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

jobs.excerpt: Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.
jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada is hiring a Director, Business Value & ROI Strategy to lead how we define, prove and communicate the financial value of Omada across the customer lifecycle. You will own Omada's ROI and business case strategy, from the first conversation with a prospective employer or health plan through implementation, client reporting and renewal.

As we launch new programs and our customers make decisions in a fast-changing GLP-1 market, every buyer needs to hear one clear, credible and consistent economic value story. This role makes that happen.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Strategy, Planning & Business Development and lead a cross-functional team with partners from Client Analytics, Actuarial, Clinical Economics and Commercial Operations. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will lead through influence, a shared roadmap and clear decision rights.

Your Impact:

  • Build and lead the cross-functional business value team. Set the team's charter, roadmap, decision rights and operating cadence, and align senior stakeholders around one end-to-end financial value story.
  • Own business case strategy. Design simple, flexible, evidence-backed ROI models and assumptions that sellers can use and buyers can trust, with transparent assumptions and the right level of customization for each customer.
  • Equip Marketing and Sales. Partner with B2B Marketing and Sales to turn approved economics into messaging, sales tools, training and buyer conversations,including informing and sharpening positioning for new programs and GLP-1 care offerings.
  • Lead ROI performance guarantee strategy. With Pricing Strategy, Clinical Economics, Finance/Actuarial and Legal, define eligibility, measurement and exposure limits for guarantees, and run monitoring, escalation and reconciliation for guarantees in market.
  • Carry the value story through post-sale and renewal. Work with Client Analytics, Product Marketing Managers, and client-facing teams to recommend how financial impact is built into standard client reporting, annual business reviews and renewals.
  • Close the loop. Use realized results and customer objections to sharpen business cases, positioning and field execution.

About you:

  • 10+ years of experience in healthcare, with a track record of demonstrating financial value to employers, health plans or other healthcare purchasers through ROI modeling, value realization, health economics, value-based contracting or commercial strategy.
  • Strong financial modeling skills. You can build an ROI model from scratch, pressure-test its assumptions and explain clearly the difference between projected and measured savings.
  • Fluency with clinical and claims-based evidence. You partner credibly with health economists and actuaries and translate their work into terms buyers understand.
  • Experience turning complex economics into clear buyer-facing business cases and sales tools, working closely with sales, marketing and account management.
  • Experience designing or operating performance guarantees, value-based contracts or other at-risk arrangements, including how results are measured and how financial exposure is managed.
  • A record of leading cross-functional work without direct authority and building a new capability or operating model from the ground up.
  • Executive communication skills. You can make complex economics simple for C-suite leaders, benefits decision-makers, consultants and frontline sellers.
  • Hands-on AI fluency. You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can point to tools or workflows you have built, tested and improved.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to learn quickly in a changing market.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience at a digital health company, especially in cardiometabolic care (diabetes, hypertension, weight management) or GLP-1 related programs.
  • Familiarity with how employers, health plans, PBMs and benefits consultants evaluate and buy digital health solutions, including third-party validation reviews.
  • Hands-on claims analysis or prototyping skills (SQL, Python or low-code tools).
  • Experience building a new team or function.
  • An advanced degree in business, health economics, public health, finance or a related field.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Job Title

Staff Security Engineer, AppSec

Organizational Reporting

Manager, Security Engineering

Function/Dept

Business Technology / Security

Purpose of the Job

As members of 6sense’s Security department, the Security Engineering team protects the platform. Application Security Engineers work closely with engineering teams, product managers (PM), and third-party entities to ensure that 6sense SaaS products are secure.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

  • Serve as mentor to other Security Engineers, providing guidance and support
  • Ability and willingness to assist with Senior level responsibilities if needed
  • Support and consult with engineering and product teams around application security vulnerabilities.
  • Assist teams in reproducing, triaging, and addressing application security vulnerabilities identified through Pen Testing, SAST, DAST, or Dependency scans
  • Take initiative and drive changes in our bug bounty program which position us as an industry leading security program
  • Lead in development of automated security testing to validate that secure coding best practices are being used
  • Lead application security reviews and threat modeling, including code review and dynamic testing
  • Lead and influence cross-functional changes across the Security organization
  • Have significant ownership in and evangelize security training with development teams
  • Drive initiatives which scale application security and holistically address multiple vulnerabilities found in a functional area
  • Design and execute quarterly (O)KRs

Performance Measurement

  • Understands the 6sense product and platform at an expert level
  • Takes initiative to identify gaps and drive change to improve the security posture
  • Participates in weekly 1:1s with manager and monthly skip levels
  • Implements security controls considering the latest security threats, trends, and best practices to ensure that 6sense's security posture remains effective and efficient
  • Manages vulnerabilities to remediation within targeted SLA or risk acceptance
  • Maintains inventory of security scope for 6sense product(s)
  • Maintains up to date collateral, metrics and processes

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Educational and Experience Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in information security, with a focus on all aspects of application security, including threat modeling, developer training, vulnerability management, automated security testing, and code reviews.
  • Expert understanding and ability to explain common security flaws and ways to remediate them (e.g. OWASP Top 10)
  • Expert level of understanding of network and web related protocols (such as TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS protocols)
  • Some development or scripting experience and skills in Python or JavaScript
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with an ability to articulate complex topics in a clear and concise manner
  • Experience working directly with software developers to improve code security
  • Expert understanding and practical experience with common security libraries, security controls, and common security flaws
  • Experience with security tools (e.g., Vulnerability Scanners, SAST/DAST, DevOps software, AWS cloud security tooling)
  • Strong knowledge of industry frameworks, regulations and standards, such as: NIST 800-218 SSDF, OWASP, SAFECode, CIS benchmarks, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, PCI, SOX, NIST 800-53, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field
  • Relevant industry certifications, such as AWS, CNCF, and GIAC are highly desirable

Competencies and Behaviors

  • Exceptional communication skills, including verbal, written, and presentation skills, and ability to appropriately address audience in communications
  • Works independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Influences and collaborates with cross-functional teams
  • Translates technical requirements into actionable and timebound requests
  • Drives projects and tasks to completion by following up on questions, deadlines, and requests for input
  • Maintains accuracy of information
  • Rapid and effective prioritization and escalation
